unprecedented.en: The research team reported unprecedented growth in renewable energy adoption last year.
unprecedented.zh: 研究团队报告称，去年可再生能源的采用率出现了前所未有的增长。

unprecedented.en: Such an ambitious deadline would be unprecedented in the history of the industry.
unprecedented.zh: 如此雄心勃勃的截止期限在该行业历史上将是前所未有的。

unprecedented.en: The collaboration produced unprecedented results that surprised every reviewer.
unprecedented.zh: 这次合作取得了令人惊讶的空前成果，让每一位评审都感到意外。

exceptionally.en: The southern coast is exceptionally rich in minerals and rare plants.
exceptionally.zh: 南海岸的矿产和珍稀植物资源格外丰富。

exceptionally.en: Enrollment grew exceptionally fast after the new policy took effect.
exceptionally.zh: 新政策生效后，入学人数增长得非常迅速。

exceptionally.en: Visitors should wear jackets, since evenings can be exceptionally cold.
exceptionally.zh: 游客应携带外套，因为夜间可能会格外寒冷。

hitherto.en: The hitherto ignored documents now provide valuable evidence for historians.
hitherto.zh: 这些迄今一直无人问津的文件如今为历史学家提供了宝贵证据。

hitherto.en: Hitherto private archives have been opened to qualified researchers.
hitherto.zh: 迄今为止一直处于私人保管的档案已向合格研究者开放。

hitherto.en: Her hitherto unproven method yielded remarkably consistent results.
hitherto.zh: 她那套迄今未经验证的方法却取得了出奇一致的结果。

controversial.en: The proposal to raise tuition fees proved highly controversial among students.
controversial.zh: 提高学费的提案在学生中引发了极大争议。

controversial.en: The controversial decision was later reviewed by an independent panel.
controversial.zh: 这一有争议的决定后来由一个独立小组进行了复核。

controversial.en: Researchers remain divided over the controversial findings published last spring.
controversial.zh: 研究人员对去年春天发表的有争议的结论仍存分歧。

peculiar.en: The specimens displayed a peculiar metallic sheen that resisted explanation.
peculiar.zh: 这些样本呈现出一种奇特的金属光泽，无法解释。

peculiar.en: Every city has peculiar customs that outsiders rarely notice.
peculiar.zh: 每座城市都有外人很少注意到的独特习俗。

peculiar.en: His peculiar manner of speaking unsettled everyone in the room.
peculiar.zh: 他说话方式古怪，房间里的所有人都感到不安。

yield.en: The new battery technology yields far more energy than conventional cells.
yield.zh: 这种新型电池技术产生的能量远超传统电池。

yield.en: Repeated trials of the algorithm yielded surprisingly consistent results.
yield.zh: 对该算法的反复试验得出了出乎意料地一致的结果。

yield.en: The committee refused to yield to pressure for a faster timetable.
yield.zh: 委员会拒绝屈服于要求加快进度的压力。

unexpectedly.en: The device unexpectedly stopped working during the final demonstration.
unexpectedly.zh: 该装置在最后演示过程中意外地停止运行。

unexpectedly.en: Sales unexpectedly declined despite the substantial advertising campaign.
unexpectedly.zh: 尽管投入了大量广告宣传，销量还是出乎意料地下降了。

unexpectedly.en: The two departments unexpectedly reached a compromise on the new budget.
unexpectedly.zh: 两个部门出人意料地就新预算达成了妥协。

stem from.en: Many of these errors stem from a lack of clarity in the original design.
stem from.zh: 其中许多错误源于原始设计缺乏明确性。

stem from.en: Her interest in linguistics stems from childhood exposure to multiple languages.
stem from.zh: 她对语言学的兴趣源于童年时期接触多种语言。

stem from.en: The growing demand for housing stems from rapid population growth in the region.
stem from.zh: 不断增长的住房需求源自该地区人口的快速增长。

puzzling.en: The puzzling results of the experiment have prompted several follow-up studies.
puzzling.zh: 实验结果令人费解，促使研究者开展了数项后续研究。

puzzling.en: Several puzzling similarities between the two manuscripts remain unexplained.
puzzling.zh: 两份手稿之间若干令人费解的相似之处仍无解释。

puzzling.en: Her puzzling silence during the meeting worried the entire research team.
puzzling.zh: 她在会议上的沉默令人费解，这让整个研究团队都很担心。

contrast.en: There is a sharp contrast between the two theoretical frameworks.
contrast.zh: 这两个理论框架之间形成了鲜明的对比。

contrast.en: In contrast, the second experiment produced entirely consistent readings.
contrast.zh: 相比之下，第二次实验产生了完全一致的读数。

contrast.en: The report draws a clear contrast between urban and rural living standards.
contrast.zh: 该报告清楚地对城市与农村的生活水平作了对比。

extensive.en: Extensive fieldwork over three years reshaped the original hypothesis.
extensive.zh: 三年广泛的田野调查重塑了最初的假设。

extensive.en: The library holds extensive records of every local land transaction.
extensive.zh: 图书馆保存着每一笔本地土地交易的大量记录。

extensive.en: The damage to the coastal ecosystem was far more extensive than reported.
extensive.zh: 对沿海生态系统的损害范围远比报告中所述更大。

complementary.en: The two theories are complementary rather than competing explanations of the data.
complementary.zh: 这两个理论是互补的，而非对数据的竞争性解释。

complementary.en: Qualitative interviews provided complementary evidence to the statistical analysis.
complementary.zh: 定性访谈为统计分析提供了补充性的证据。

complementary.en: The teaching role and the research role have always been complementary here.
complementary.zh: 在这里教学与研究这两个角色一直是相互补充的。

prior.en: No prior approval is required before submitting the revised manuscript.
prior.zh: 提交修订稿之前不需要任何事先批准。

prior.en: Her prior experience in industry shaped the design of the new curriculum.
prior.zh: 她此前在工业界的经历影响了新课程的设计。

prior.en: Prior studies of this phenomenon produced contradictory results.
prior.zh: 此前对这一现象的研究得出了相互矛盾的结果。

accordingly.en: The funding was cut sharply; accordingly, the project timeline was extended.
accordingly.zh: 经费被大幅削减，因此项目时间表也随之延长。

accordingly.en: Researchers should interpret the results cautiously and accordingly revise their assumptions.
accordingly.zh: 研究人员应谨慎解读结果，并据此修正自己的假设。

accordingly.en: The audience was clearly fascinated, and accordingly the lecture ran well past midnight.
accordingly.zh: 听众显然被吸引住了，因此讲座一直持续到午夜之后很久。

paramount.en: Protecting patient safety remains the paramount concern of every hospital board.
paramount.zh: 保护患者安全始终是每一家医院董事会最首要的关注事项。

paramount.en: Data integrity is paramount, and shortcuts are never acceptable.
paramount.zh: 数据完整性至高无上，捷径永远不可接受。

paramount.en: Of all the criteria, reproducibility is paramount in modern research.
paramount.zh: 在所有标准中，可复现性在现代研究中最为重要。

drastic.en: The government introduced drastic measures to stabilize the housing market.
drastic.zh: 政府采取了严厉措施以稳定住房市场。

drastic.en: A drastic cut in public spending would harm research most.
drastic.zh: 大幅削减公共支出对研究的危害最大。

drastic.en: The company made drastic changes to its organizational structure last spring.
drastic.zh: 公司去年春天对其组织结构进行了重大调整。

dramatic.en: The policy shift produced a dramatic improvement in rural access to healthcare.
dramatic.zh: 政策转变带来了农村医疗可及性的显著改善。

dramatic.en: A dramatic fall in temperatures forced the research team to cancel fieldwork.
dramatic.zh: 气温骤降迫使研究团队取消了野外考察。

dramatic.en: Her dramatic presentation won over the skeptical members of the committee.
dramatic.zh: 她富有感染力的演讲赢得了委员会中持怀疑态度的成员。

exclusively.en: The laboratory conducts research exclusively on marine microorganisms.
exclusively.zh: 该实验室专门研究海洋微生物。

exclusively.en: These materials are sourced exclusively from certified organic farms.
exclusively.zh: 这些材料全部来自经过认证的有机农场。

exclusively.en: The journal publishes exclusively articles that have undergone peer review.
exclusively.zh: 该期刊仅发表经过同行评审的文章。

explicitly.en: The contract explicitly states that all data belong to the university.
explicitly.zh: 合同明确规定，所有数据均归该大学所有。

explicitly.en: She explicitly denied involvement in the disputed data fabrication.
explicitly.zh: 她明确否认参与了有争议的数据捏造行为。

explicitly.en: The guidelines explicitly forbid any use of personal information in advertising.
explicitly.zh: 这些准则明确禁止在任何广告中使用个人信息。

intriguing.en: An intriguing pattern in the data suggests a link between the two variables.
intriguing.zh: 数据中一个耐人寻味的模式暗示两个变量之间存在联系。

intriguing.en: The intriguing manuscript attracted attention from scholars across four continents.
intriguing.zh: 这份耐人寻味的手稿吸引了四大洲学者的关注。

intriguing.en: He proposed an intriguing hypothesis about the origins of the language.
intriguing.zh: 他提出了一个关于该语言起源的引人入胜的假设。

trial.en: The new treatment was tested in a randomized clinical trial.
trial.zh: 这种新疗法在一项随机临床试验中进行了测试。

trial.en: Early trials of the prototype revealed several unexpected hardware failures.
trial.zh: 原型的早期试用暴露出若干意外的硬件故障。

trial.en: The defendant awaits trial before the district court next month.
trial.zh: 被告将于下月在该区法院受审。

prevail.en: Common sense finally prevailed after several hours of heated debate.
prevail.zh: 经过几个小时的激烈辩论，常识终于占了上风。

prevail.en: In the western provinces, traditional crafts still prevail in rural markets.
prevail.zh: 在西部省份，传统手工艺在乡村集市上仍然盛行。

prevail.en: The argument that efficiency should come first prevailed within the committee.
prevail.zh: 效率优先的观点在委员会内部占了上风。

ascribe.en: Historians ascribe the decline of the empire to prolonged internal conflict.
ascribe.zh: 历史学家把帝国的衰落归因于长期的内部冲突。

ascribe.en: The author ascribes her success to persistence and careful planning.
ascribe.zh: 作者认为自己的成功源于坚持和周密的规划。

ascribe.en: Few scholars ascribe the original design to a single architect.
ascribe.zh: 很少有学者把最初的设计归于一位建筑师。

seminal.en: Her seminal paper became the foundation for two decades of research.
seminal.zh: 她的开创性论文成为此后 20 年研究的基础。

seminal.en: The seminar discussed three seminal works in modern linguistics.
seminal.zh: 这场研讨会讨论了现代语言学中的三部开创性著作。

seminal.en: His seminal contribution reshaped how historians interpret the industrial era.
seminal.zh: 他的开创性贡献重塑了历史学家解读工业时代的方式。

subsequent.en: Subsequent studies by other teams confirmed the laboratory's original hypothesis.
subsequent.zh: 其他团队随后的研究证实了该实验室最初的假设。

subsequent.en: The subsequent analysis revealed errors in the collected survey data.
subsequent.zh: 随后的分析揭示了所收集调查数据中的错误。

subsequent.en: Subsequent chapters develop the argument introduced in the opening section.
subsequent.zh: 后续章节展开了开篇部分提出的论点。

extraordinary.en: The region showed extraordinary resilience during the economic downturn.
extraordinary.zh: 该地区在经济衰退期间表现出非凡的韧性。

extraordinary.en: Extraordinary claims require extraordinary evidence in any serious research.
extraordinary.zh: 在任何严肃研究中，非凡的主张都需要非凡的证据。

extraordinary.en: She made the extraordinary discovery hidden in a dusty archive.
extraordinary.zh: 她在积满灰尘的档案中作出了一个非凡的发现。

definitive.en: The court ruling was definitive and ended years of legal dispute.
definitive.zh: 法院的裁决是最终的，结束了长达多年的法律纠纷。

definitive.en: A definitive edition of the poems will be published next spring.
definitive.zh: 这些诗作的权威定本将于明年春天出版。

definitive.en: The absence of any response is not definitive evidence of agreement.
definitive.zh: 没有得到任何回应并不构成赞同的确凿证据。

definite.en: There is no definite answer to the question of causality.
definite.zh: 关于因果关系的问题没有明确的答案。

definite.en: We detected a definite improvement in the quality of translated texts.
definite.zh: 我们发现翻译文本的质量有了明确的提升。

definite.en: A definite deadline makes the project far easier to manage.
definite.zh: 一个明确的截止期限会使项目管理容易得多。

a priori.en: The model was rejected because it relied on a priori assumptions about human behavior.
a priori.zh: 该模型被否决，因为它依赖了对人类行为的先验假设。

a priori.en: A priori reasoning cannot substitute for empirical evidence in clinical decisions.
a priori.zh: 在临床决策中，先验推理无法替代实证证据。

a priori.en: The study was designed a priori rather than in response to unexpected results.
a priori.zh: 该研究是事先设计的，而非因应意外结果而制定。

proceed.en: Work will proceed as planned despite the shortage of laboratory equipment.
proceed.zh: 尽管实验室设备短缺，工作仍将按计划进行。

proceed.en: The committee asked the researchers to proceed with the second phase.
proceed.zh: 委员会要求研究人员继续进行第二阶段的工作。

proceed.en: Having read the report, we proceeded to examine the raw data.
proceed.zh: 读完报告后，我们继续查阅原始数据。

preceding.en: The preceding chapter introduces the theoretical framework used throughout this book.
preceding.zh: 前一章介绍了贯穿本书的理论框架。

preceding.en: Any conclusions must be consistent with the preceding evidence.
preceding.zh: 任何结论都必须与先前的证据保持一致。

preceding.en: The two preceding sentences state the main claim of the article.
preceding.zh: 前面的两句话陈述了文章的主要论点。

considerable.en: The reconstruction required considerable time and a modest budget.
considerable.zh: 这项重建需要相当多的时间和一笔不大的预算。

considerable.en: A considerable number of applications were rejected without explanation.
considerable.zh: 相当多的申请未加解释就被驳回了。

considerable.en: The discovery has had a considerable influence on later research in the field.
considerable.zh: 这一发现对该领域的后续研究产生了相当大的影响。

supplementary.en: Supplementary materials, including raw data, are available on the journal website.
supplementary.zh: 包括原始数据在内的补充材料可在期刊网站上获取。

supplementary.en: The council approved a supplementary budget for rural school construction.
supplementary.zh: 议会批准了一笔用于农村学校建设的补充预算。

supplementary.en: These findings should be read as supplementary to the main analysis.
supplementary.zh: 这些发现应被视为主要分析的补充。

fulfill.en: The scholarship program aims to fulfill the educational needs of rural students.
fulfill.zh: 该奖学金项目旨在满足农村学生的教育需求。

fulfill.en: The laboratory fulfilled every obligation listed in the research contract.
fulfill.zh: 该实验室履行了研究合同中列出的每一项义务。

fulfill.en: She hopes to fulfill her professional ambitions before retiring.
fulfill.zh: 她希望在退休前实现自己的职业抱负。

dictate.en: Corporate interests should not dictate public health policy decisions.
dictate.zh: 企业利益不应左右公共卫生政策的制定。

dictate.en: The schedule was dictated by the arrival of the international review panel.
dictate.zh: 日程安排由国际评审团的到来所决定。

dictate.en: The director dictated that the manuscript be revised within two weeks.
dictate.zh: 主任指示手稿须在两周内完成修订。

moderate.en: The region experienced moderate rainfall throughout the growing season.
moderate.zh: 整个生长季该地区的降雨量适中。

moderate.en: Doctors recommend moderate exercise rather than intense daily training.
moderate.zh: 医生建议进行适度运动，而不是每天高强度训练。

moderate.en: The policy raises existing university fees by a moderate amount.
moderate.zh: 该政策将现有大学学费适度上调。

modest.en: The researchers worked with a modest grant and limited technical support.
modest.zh: 研究人员仅有一笔有限的经费和少量的技术支持。

modest.en: Even a modest improvement in energy efficiency produced significant savings.
modest.zh: 即便能效有小幅提升，也带来了可观的节省。

modest.en: The telescope is available at a modest cost to partner institutions.
modest.zh: 合作机构只需支付不多的费用即可使用这台望远镜。

scheme.en: The government launched a subsidy scheme to support small businesses.
scheme.zh: 政府启动了一项补贴计划以支持小企业。

scheme.en: The color scheme of the new library reflects local architectural traditions.
scheme.zh: 新图书馆的配色方案体现了当地的建筑传统。

scheme.en: A pension scheme has been introduced for all part-time employees.
scheme.zh: 公司已为所有兼职员工引入了一项养老金计划。

alternate.en: The committee offered two alternate proposals before selecting a final design.
alternate.zh: 委员会在选定最终设计之前提出了两个备选方案。

alternate.en: Traffic flows in alternate directions during the construction period.
alternate.zh: 施工期间，交通轮流单向通行。

alternate.en: If the primary server fails, the system automatically switches to an alternate unit.
alternate.zh: 如果主服务器发生故障，系统会自动切换到备用设备。

rigid.en: The academy has historically maintained a rigid code of academic conduct.
rigid.zh: 该学院在历史上一直维持着一套严格的学术行为规范。

rigid.en: Her rigid attitude prevented the committee from reaching a practical compromise.
rigid.zh: 她僵化固执的态度使委员会无法达成务实的妥协。

rigid.en: The proposed schedule proved too rigid for teams working across time zones.
rigid.zh: 对于分布在不同时区的团队来说，拟定的进度安排显得过于僵化。

comment.en: The reviewer commented extensively on the structure of the argument.
comment.zh: 评审人对论证结构发表了大量评论。

comment.en: Two colleagues commented on the draft paper before it was submitted for review.
comment.zh: 稿件送审之前，两位同事对其发表了意见。

comment.en: The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation.
comment.zh: 部长拒绝对正在进行的调查发表评论。

incorporate.en: The revised protocol incorporates feedback from all three review panels.
incorporate.zh: 修订后的方案纳入了三个评审组的全部反馈意见。

incorporate.en: Students must incorporate at least ten sources into their literature review.
incorporate.zh: 学生必须在文献综述中至少纳入 10 个来源。

incorporate.en: The new framework incorporates regional data that earlier models had ignored.
incorporate.zh: 新框架纳入了早期模型所忽略的区域数据。

clarify.en: The author added a footnote to clarify the meaning of the third term.
clarify.zh: 作者加了一条脚注来阐明第三个术语的含义。

clarify.en: Could you clarify whether the deadline applies to doctoral students as well?
clarify.zh: 您能否说明这一截止日期是否也适用于博士生？

clarify.en: The diagram was simplified to clarify how the two models interact.
clarify.zh: 该图经过简化，以更清晰地说明两个模型如何相互作用。

illustrate.en: Recent data from coastal regions illustrate the wider effects of rising sea levels.
illustrate.zh: 来自沿海地区的最新数据说明了海平面上升的更广泛影响。

illustrate.en: This case illustrates why early intervention can save considerable resources.
illustrate.zh: 这个案例说明了为何及早干预能节省大量资源。

illustrate.en: Several graphs illustrate the seasonal variation in electricity demand.
illustrate.zh: 几张图表说明了电力需求的季节性变化。

subtle.en: There is a subtle difference between the two versions of the manuscript.
subtle.zh: 这份稿件的两个版本之间存在细微的差别。

subtle.en: Her argument rests on a subtle assumption that critics rarely question.
subtle.zh: 她的论点建立在一个批评者很少质疑的微妙假设之上。

subtle.en: The test detected a subtle shift in the sample's chemical composition.
subtle.zh: 该检测发现样品化学成分发生了细微变化。

pinpoint.en: Using satellite images, researchers pinpointed the origin of the wildfire.
pinpoint.zh: 研究人员利用卫星图像准确确定了这场野火的起火点。

pinpoint.en: The exact moment of the collapse cannot yet be pinpointed.
pinpoint.zh: 倒塌的确切时刻目前还无法确定。

pinpoint.en: These figures help pinpoint where the budget was spent inefficiently.
pinpoint.zh: 这些数据有助于准确找出预算使用效率低下的环节。

conventional.en: Conventional farming methods have gradually given way to sustainable alternatives.
conventional.zh: 传统耕作方法逐渐让位于可持续的替代方案。

conventional.en: Her lecture challenged conventional wisdom about early childhood education.
conventional.zh: 她的讲座挑战了关于幼儿教育的传统观念。

conventional.en: The engine uses conventional fuel rather than an electric battery.
conventional.zh: 这台发动机使用常规燃料，而非电动电池。

salient.en: The most salient finding was that treatment effects persisted after five years.
salient.zh: 最显著的发现是治疗效果在五年后依然持续存在。

salient.en: We highlighted the three salient differences between the two theoretical frameworks.
salient.zh: 我们突出了两个理论框架之间三处显著的差异。

salient.en: Photographs provide the most salient evidence for the argument presented.
salient.zh: 照片为文中提出的论点提供了最显著的证据。

elusive.en: The exact cause of the failure proved elusive despite months of investigation.
elusive.zh: 尽管调查了数月，失败的确切原因仍难以查明。

elusive.en: Researchers are searching for a shared definition that has remained elusive.
elusive.zh: 研究人员一直在寻找一个一直难以确定的共同定义。

elusive.en: Good documentation remains elusive in many small research laboratories.
elusive.zh: 在许多小型研究实验室中，良好的文档记录仍然难以获得。

precise.en: We cannot draw a precise conclusion without additional longitudinal data.
precise.zh: 没有额外的纵向数据，我们无法得出精确的结论。

precise.en: The report gives a precise account of how the error entered the system.
precise.zh: 该报告精确地叙述了错误是如何进入系统的。

precise.en: Her precise wording prevented any ambiguity in the final agreement.
precise.zh: 她精确的措辞使最终协议没有任何歧义。

hinder.en: Heavy snow hindered the delivery of medical supplies to remote villages.
hinder.zh: 大雪阻碍了医疗物资向偏远村庄的运送。

hinder.en: Lack of funding hindered the team's ability to conduct field trials.
hinder.zh: 资金不足阻碍了团队开展田间试验的能力。

hinder.en: Poor documentation hinders new members from contributing effectively to the project.
hinder.zh: 糟糕的文档管理使新成员难以有效地为项目做出贡献。

substantial.en: The university received a substantial grant for renewable energy research.
substantial.zh: 该大学获得了一笔用于可再生能源研究的大额拨款。

substantial.en: There has been a substantial improvement in the accuracy of the model.
substantial.zh: 该模型的准确度已有显著提高。

substantial.en: The reform would require a substantial restructuring of the national tax system.
substantial.zh: 这项改革需要对国家税收体系进行重大重组。

genuine.en: Laboratory tests confirmed that the manuscript contained a genuine medieval seal.
genuine.zh: 实验室检测确认该手稿中包含一枚真正的中世纪印章。

genuine.en: Her concern about student workload appears genuine rather than strategic.
genuine.zh: 她对学生课业负担的担忧似乎是真诚的，而非出于策略。

genuine.en: The interview revealed a genuine interest in public health research.
genuine.zh: 这次访谈显示出受访者对公共卫生研究的真正兴趣。

initially.en: The model was initially trained on a small dataset from two hospitals.
initially.zh: 该模型最初使用来自两家医院的小型数据集进行训练。

initially.en: Researchers initially expected the experiment to produce clearer results.
initially.zh: 研究人员最初预期该实验会产生更清晰的结果。

initially.en: The theory was initially controversial but later widely accepted.
initially.zh: 这一理论最初颇具争议，但后来得到了广泛认可。

routine.en: Morning inspections are a routine part of laboratory safety procedures.
routine.zh: 晨检是实验室安全流程中例行公事的一部分。

routine.en: After several months of careful routine maintenance, the instruments performed flawlessly.
routine.zh: 经过数月的细致日常维护，这些仪器运行得非常稳定。

routine.en: The committee reviewed the routine budget expenditure for the fiscal year.
routine.zh: 该委员会审查了本财政年度的常规预算支出。

essentially.en: The two proposals are essentially the same in both scope and cost.
essentially.zh: 这两份提案在范围和成本上本质上是相同的。

essentially.en: The vaccine is essentially unchanged from the version approved last year.
essentially.zh: 该疫苗与去年获批的版本基本没有变化。

essentially.en: What began as a local dispute became essentially an international dispute.
essentially.zh: 起初的局部争端最终本质上变成了国际争端。

claim.en: The authors claim that their method outperforms all previous approaches.
claim.zh: 作者声称他们的方法优于此前所有方法。

claim.en: No credible evidence supports the claim made in the press release.
claim.zh: 没有可信的证据支持新闻稿中提出的这一说法。

claim.en: Both parties claim to have been wronged by the regulatory decision.
claim.zh: 双方都声称自己受到了监管决定的损害。

thorough.en: A thorough review of the literature revealed several gaps in current research.
thorough.zh: 对文献的彻底回顾揭示了当前研究中的若干空白。

thorough.en: The patient required a thorough examination before treatment could begin.
thorough.zh: 在治疗开始之前，该患者需要接受全面检查。

thorough.en: Her thorough preparation ensured that every question from the panel was addressed.
thorough.zh: 她充分的准备确保了评审组的每个问题都得到了回应。

amenable.en: The raw data proved amenable to standard statistical analysis.
amenable.zh: 原始数据证明适用于标准的统计分析。

amenable.en: Students are generally more amenable to advice from trusted peers.
amenable.zh: 学生通常更愿意接受信任的同龄人的建议。

amenable.en: The question is not amenable to a simple yes or no answer.
amenable.zh: 这个问题不适合用简单的是或不是来回答。

inherent.en: Every design contains an inherent trade-off between speed and accuracy.
inherent.zh: 任何设计都包含速度与准确性之间固有的权衡。

inherent.en: The method has an inherent weakness that cannot be removed entirely.
inherent.zh: 该方法存在一种无法完全消除的固有弱点。

inherent.en: There are inherent risks in relying on a single supplier.
inherent.zh: 依赖单一供应商存在固有的风险。

novelty.en: The novelty of the device lies in its ability to self-calibrate.
novelty.zh: 该装置的新颖之处在于其自我校准的能力。

novelty.en: Despite its initial novelty, the approach is now widely used.
novelty.zh: 尽管最初很新奇，这种做法如今已得到广泛应用。

novelty.en: The exhibition used light to explore novelty in contemporary industrial design.
novelty.zh: 该展览借助灯光探索当代工业设计中的新意。

competitive.en: The company must remain competitive in a rapidly expanding international market.
competitive.zh: 该公司必须在一个迅速扩张的国际市场中保持竞争力。

competitive.en: A competitive examination determines admission to the national academy.
competitive.zh: 一场竞争性考试决定了国家学院的录取结果。

competitive.en: Competitive funding applications are reviewed by an independent panel.
competitive.zh: 竞争性资助申请由独立评审组进行审查。

dominant.en: The dominant theory explains the data more successfully than competing proposals.
dominant.zh: 主流理论比竞争性提案更成功地解释了这些数据。

dominant.en: Three firms hold a dominant position in the regional energy market.
dominant.zh: 三家公司占据该区域能源市场的主导地位。

dominant.en: English remains the dominant language of scientific publishing worldwide.
dominant.zh: 英语仍然是全球科学出版界占主导地位的语言。

additionally.en: Additionally, the sample size was too small to support firm conclusions.
additionally.zh: 此外，样本量太小，无法支持确凿的结论。

additionally.en: Additionally, the facility must install sensors to monitor structural vibration.
additionally.zh: 此外，该设施必须安装传感器来监测结构振动。

additionally.en: Additionally, the review committee requested access to the raw data.
additionally.zh: 另外，评审委员会要求查阅原始数据。

consequently.en: The funding was withdrawn; consequently, the entire project was suspended.
consequently.zh: 经费被撤销；因此，整个项目被暂停。

consequently.en: Rainfall dropped sharply and consequently the reservoir level fell considerably.
consequently.zh: 降雨量急剧下降，因此水库水位明显降低。

consequently.en: The evidence was inconclusive and consequently no decision could be justified.
consequently.zh: 证据不充分，因此无法为任何决定提供正当理由。

likewise.en: Other laboratories have likewise reported similar results in recent trials.
likewise.zh: 其他实验室最近也报告了类似的结果。

likewise.en: The second hypothesis implies, likewise, a measurable change in behavior.
likewise.zh: 第二个假设同样意味着行为上可测量的变化。

likewise.en: Students who prepare regularly tend, likewise, to perform better in examinations.
likewise.zh: 经常做准备的学生同样往往在考试中表现更好。

prohibit.en: The regulations prohibit the use of unlabeled chemicals in teaching laboratories.
prohibit.zh: 规定禁止在教学实验室中使用未贴标签的化学品。

prohibit.en: Strict copyright law prohibits reproducing the article without written permission.
prohibit.zh: 严格的版权法禁止在未经书面许可的情况下复制该文章。

prohibit.en: The court prohibited the company from selling products manufactured abroad.
prohibit.zh: 法院禁止该公司销售在海外生产的产品。

prerequisite.en: Completion of the introductory course is a prerequisite for advanced study.
prerequisite.zh: 完成入门课程是进行高阶学习的先决条件。

prerequisite.en: Sound ethical judgment is an essential prerequisite of academic leadership.
prerequisite.zh: 健全的伦理判断是学术领导力的必要前提。

prerequisite.en: Applicants must list every prerequisite they have already satisfied.
prerequisite.zh: 申请人必须列出他们已经满足的所有先决条件。

noteworthy.en: It is noteworthy that the two groups produced nearly identical results.
noteworthy.zh: 值得注意的是，两组实验得出了几乎相同的结果。

noteworthy.en: One noteworthy feature of the design is its unusually low energy consumption.
noteworthy.zh: 该设计一个值得注意的特点是能耗异常之低。

noteworthy.en: The most noteworthy finding concerns the decline in infant mortality.
noteworthy.zh: 最值得注意的发现与婴儿死亡率的下降有关。

analogous.en: The situation in coastal towns is analogous to that in drought regions.
analogous.zh: 沿海城镇的情况与干旱地区的情况类似。

analogous.en: The researchers drew an analogous conclusion from a separate set of data.
analogous.zh: 研究人员从另一组数据中得出了类似的结论。

analogous.en: His argument follows a pattern analogous to one used in economic theory.
analogous.zh: 他的论证采用了与经济理论中某种做法相似的模式。

compensate.en: Higher yields compensated for the drop in the price of exports.
compensate.zh: 更高的产量弥补了出口价格下跌造成的损失。

compensate.en: The hospital compensated patients who had received unnecessary treatment.
compensate.zh: 该医院对接受了不必要治疗的患者作出了赔偿。

compensate.en: Extra staff were hired to compensate for the increased workload during summer.
compensate.zh: 公司额外雇用了员工，以弥补夏季增加的工作量。

trigger.en: The decision to raise interest rates triggered a sharp fall in share prices.
trigger.zh: 加息的决定触发了股价的急剧下跌。

trigger.en: Dust and smoke can trigger severe asthma attacks in vulnerable patients.
trigger.zh: 灰尘和烟雾可能诱发敏感患者严重的哮喘发作。

trigger.en: Researchers are studying what triggered the sudden collapse of the colony.
trigger.zh: 研究人员正在研究究竟是什么触发了该菌落的突然崩溃。

compelling.en: The authors present a compelling argument for reforming the funding system.
compelling.zh: 作者提出了一个关于改革资助体系的有力论据。

compelling.en: The evidence for the treatment is compelling, though further trials are needed.
compelling.zh: 支持该疗法的证据很有说服力，但仍需进一步的试验。

compelling.en: The documentary offers a compelling portrait of life in the fishing village.
compelling.zh: 这部纪录片以动人的笔触描绘了渔村的生活。

compose.en: The committee is composed of twelve members from four institutions.
compose.zh: 该委员会由来自四个机构的 12 名成员组成。

compose.en: She composed herself before entering the negotiation room.
compose.zh: 她在进入谈判室之前让自己镇定下来。

compose.en: Water and dissolved minerals compose the bulk of plant sap.
compose.zh: 水和溶解于其中的矿物质构成了植物汁液的主要成分。

resemble.en: The findings of the second trial resemble those of the first.
resemble.zh: 第二次试验的结果与第一次相似。

resemble.en: Its structure closely resembles that of a nineteenth-century cathedral.
resemble.zh: 其结构与一座 19 世纪的大教堂非常相似。

resemble.en: The synthetic material resembles natural bone in density and strength.
resemble.zh: 这种合成材料在密度和强度上与天然骨骼相似。

paradox.en: It is a paradox that greater efficiency sometimes produces more waste.
paradox.zh: 效率提高有时反而带来更多浪费，这是一种悖论。

paradox.en: The apparent paradox disappears once the longer time horizon is considered.
paradox.zh: 一旦考虑到更长的时间跨度，这个表面的悖论就消失了。

paradox.en: Her essay explores the paradox of rapid growth and rising inequality.
paradox.zh: 她的文章探讨了快速增长与不平等加剧之间的悖论。

adhere to.en: All research teams must adhere to strict ethical guidelines when collecting human subjects' data.
adhere to.zh: 所有研究团队在收集人类受试者数据时都必须严格遵守伦理准则。

adhere to.en: Despite mounting pressure from shareholders, the board continued to adhere to its founding principles.
adhere to.zh: 尽管股东施加了越来越大的压力，董事会仍坚持其创始原则。

adhere to.en: Students who fail to adhere to the attendance policy will lose examination privileges.
adhere to.zh: 不遵守出勤政策的学生将失去考试资格。

seamless.en: The upgrade allows a seamless transition from the old system to the new platform.
seamless.zh: 此次升级实现了从旧系统到新平台的平滑过渡。

seamless.en: Users reported a seamless connection between the mobile application and the cloud database.
seamless.zh: 用户报告称该移动应用与云数据库之间的连接天衣无缝。

seamless.en: Our workflow integration is designed to be seamless, requiring no manual data entry at all.
seamless.zh: 我们的工作流集成旨在实现无缝衔接，完全无需手动录入数据。

proof.en: There is no proof that the proposed method improves accuracy under real conditions.
proof.zh: 没有证据表明所提出的方法在真实条件下能提高准确性。

proof.en: The prosecution presented photographs as proof of the defendant's presence at the scene.
proof.zh: 控方提交照片作为被告出现在犯罪现场的证据。

proof.en: The new proof settles a question that had resisted solution for fifty years.
proof.zh: 这一新证明解决了一个悬置 50 年的问题。

anomalous.en: The sensor recorded anomalous temperature spikes that engineers had never observed before.
anomalous.zh: 传感器记录到了异常的温度峰值，此前工程师从未观测到此类情况。

anomalous.en: Regulators opened a formal investigation after anomalous trading patterns appeared in the stock.
anomalous.zh: 该股票出现异常的交易模式后，监管机构启动了正式调查。

anomalous.en: Reviewers should flag any anomalous data points rather than quietly discarding them.
anomalous.zh: 评审者应当标记出任何异常数据点，而不是悄悄将其丢弃。

ultimately.en: The committee debated for three hours and ultimately approved the revised budget.
ultimately.zh: 委员会辩论了三小时，最终批准了修订后的预算。

ultimately.en: Both methods performed well initially, but the simpler approach ultimately proved more reliable.
ultimately.zh: 两种方法起初表现都不错，但更简单的做法最终被证明更可靠。

ultimately.en: The success of the project depended, ultimately, on collaboration rather than on funding.
ultimately.zh: 该项目的成功最终取决于协作而非资金。

illuminating.en: Her lecture on medieval trade routes was deeply illuminating for first-year history students.
illuminating.zh: 她关于中世纪贸易路线的讲座对一年级历史专业学生极有启发。

illuminating.en: The failed experiment provided illuminating insights into how the enzyme actually functions.
illuminating.zh: 这次失败的实验就该酶的实际运作方式提供了富有启发性的见解。

illuminating.en: Photographs from the archive document early construction on the cathedral in illuminating detail.
illuminating.zh: 档案馆的照片以极具启发性的方式翔实记录了这座大教堂早期的建造情况。

perceive.en: Customers often perceive a brand as more reliable when the service response time is short.
perceive.zh: 当服务响应时间较短时，顾客往往认为该品牌更值得信赖。

perceive.en: Many researchers perceive the peer review process as slow and somewhat opaque.
perceive.zh: 许多研究者认为同行评审流程缓慢且不够透明。

perceive.en: How students perceive failure strongly affects their willingness to attempt difficult tasks.
perceive.zh: 学生如何看待失败，会显著影响他们尝试困难任务的意愿。

unravel.en: Investigators worked for months to unravel the cause of the mysterious laboratory contamination.
unravel.zh: 调查人员工作了数月，以查明实验室中原因不明的污染的成因。

unravel.en: The mystery surrounding the missing funds was slowly unraveled through witness testimony.
unravel.zh: 随着证人作证，资金失踪之谜逐渐被解开。

unravel.en: Complex regulatory frameworks can unravel quickly when new legislation is introduced.
unravel.zh: 当新立法出台时，复杂的监管框架可能迅速瓦解。

instructive.en: The comparison of two unsuccessful campaigns proved highly instructive for junior analysts.
instructive.zh: 对两次失败活动的比较对初级分析员极具教育意义。

instructive.en: This textbook includes instructive case studies drawn from real court proceedings.
instructive.zh: 这本教科书收录了取材于真实庭审的有启发性案例研究。

instructive.en: Even an instructive failure can strengthen a team's understanding of system architecture.
instructive.zh: 即便是一次有教育意义的失败，也能加深团队对系统架构的理解。

inherit.en: She inherited a small print shop from her grandfather and modernized it entirely.
inherit.zh: 她从祖父那里继承了一家小印刷厂，并对其进行了全面现代化改造。

inherit.en: The new director inherits a research group with an impressive publication record.
inherit.zh: 这位新主任接手了一个出版记录骄人的研究团队。

inherit.en: Height is partly inherited, yet nutrition during childhood also shapes it considerably.
inherit.zh: 身高部分由遗传决定，但童年时期的营养状况也对其有相当大的影响。

commonly.en: Wireless sensors are commonly used to monitor structural health in aging bridges.
commonly.zh: 无线传感器常被用于监测老化桥梁的结构健康状况。

commonly.en: It is commonly assumed that larger samples automatically guarantee more reliable conclusions.
commonly.zh: 人们通常以为样本量越大就必然能得到更可靠的结论。

commonly.en: This species is commonly found in shallow coastal waters across the Mediterranean region.
commonly.zh: 该物种常见于地中海地区的浅海水域。

customarily.en: The department customarily holds its weekly seminar on Thursday afternoons.
customarily.zh: 该系通常在周四下午举行每周研讨会。

customarily.en: Overnight delivery is customarily included in the standard subscription price.
customarily.zh: 隔夜送达通常包含在标准订阅价格之内。

customarily.en: Witnesses customarily stated their full names before the committee began recording testimony.
customarily.zh: 在委员会开始记录证词前，证人通常会先陈述自己的全名。

plausible.en: The scientist offered a plausible explanation for the sudden decline in bird populations.
plausible.zh: 这位科学家为鸟类种群的突然减少提出了一个貌似合理的解释。

plausible.en: Although the account seems plausible, no independent evidence supports it.
plausible.zh: 尽管这一说法看似可信，但没有任何独立证据支持它。

plausible.en: Reviewers rejected the manuscript because its central claim was highly implausible.
plausible.zh: 审稿人退回了这篇稿件，因为其核心主张极不可信。

scrutinize.en: Auditors scrutinized the financial statements line by line for hidden irregularities.
scrutinize.zh: 审计人员逐行仔细审查财务报表，寻找隐藏的违规之处。

scrutinize.en: The committee scrutinized the proposal carefully before granting the research grant.
scrutinize.zh: 委员会在批准研究经费之前仔细审查了这份提案。

scrutinize.en: Undergraduate researchers should scrutinize their own statistical assumptions as well.
scrutinize.zh: 本科生研究者也应该仔细检验自身的统计假设。

detrimental.en: Prolonged exposure to bright screens is detrimental to healthy sleep patterns.
detrimental.zh: 长时间接触明亮屏幕有害于健康的睡眠模式。

detrimental.en: Excessive bureaucratic oversight proved detrimental to innovation within the research group.
detrimental.zh: 过度的官僚监督被证明对研究组内的创新有害。

detrimental.en: The company avoided synthetic preservatives, since they can be detrimental to product quality.
detrimental.zh: 该公司避免使用合成防腐剂，因为它们可能损害产品质量。

ubiquitous.en: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in university classrooms across the country.
ubiquitous.zh: 智能手机在全国各大学教室中已变得无处不在。

ubiquitous.en: Wireless sensors are now ubiquitous in modern industrial manufacturing plants.
ubiquitous.zh: 无线传感器如今在现代工业制造工厂中随处可见。

ubiquitous.en: Screens of every size have made digital advertising ubiquitous in public spaces.
ubiquitous.zh: 各种尺寸的屏幕使数字广告在公共空间变得无处不在。

extract.en: Researchers extracted DNA from ancient bone samples preserved in permafrost.
extract.zh: 研究人员从永久冻土中保存的古代骨骼样本中提取了 DNA。

extract.en: The new software can extract key themes from thousands of interview transcripts automatically.
extract.zh: 新软件可以从数千份访谈记录中自动提取关键主题。

extract.en: Miners extract several valuable minerals from each tonne of processed ore.
extract.zh: 矿业人员从每吨处理过的矿石中提取出数种有价值的矿物。

unveil.en: The university unveiled a new center for climate research this week.
unveil.zh: 该大学本周为一座新的气候研究中心举行了揭幕仪式。

unveil.en: Regulators unveiled new guidelines for disclosing algorithmic bias in financial systems.
unveil.zh: 监管机构公布了关于披露金融系统算法偏差的新指南。

unveil.en: The museum will unveil its long-restored medieval manuscript to the public in June.
unveil.zh: 博物馆将于六月向公众展出修复已久的这部中世纪手稿。

predominant.en: Coal remained the predominant energy source in the region until the 1980s.
predominant.zh: 直到 20 世纪 80 年代，煤炭仍是该地区的主要能源来源。

predominant.en: The predominant concern among reviewers was the study's small sample size.
predominant.zh: 评审者最担心的问题是该研究的样本量过小。

predominant.en: English is the predominant language of academic publishing worldwide.
predominant.zh: 英语是全世界学术出版的主要语言。

protocol.en: The laboratory followed a strict protocol for handling hazardous chemical samples.
protocol.zh: 实验室遵循严格的规程来处理危险化学样品。

protocol.en: The two universities signed a protocol establishing joint doctoral programs next spring.
protocol.zh: 两所大学签署了一项协议，将于明年春天启动联合博士项目。

protocol.en: Interview transcripts were coded according to the research protocol approved in advance.
protocol.zh: 访谈记录按事先批准的研究规程进行了编码。

consent.en: All participants signed a written consent form before the experiment began.
consent.zh: 所有参与者在实验开始前都签署了书面同意书。

consent.en: Researchers must obtain consent before recording any identifiable conversation.
consent.zh: 研究人员在录制任何可识别的对话之前必须获得同意。

consent.en: Publication of the dataset was possible only with the consent of the participating schools.
consent.zh: 只有在参与研究的学校的同意下，该数据集才得以公开。

context.en: Statistical results are meaningless without proper context and a clear baseline.
context.zh: 没有恰当的背景和明确的基准，统计结果毫无意义。

context.en: The author carefully situates the argument within its historical context.
context.zh: 作者谨慎地将这一论点置于其历史背景之中。

context.en: Any criticism of the policy should account for its economic context.
context.zh: 对该政策的任何批评都应当考虑其经济背景。

corroborate.en: Two independent witnesses corroborated the defendant's account of the evening.
corroborate.zh: 两名独立证人证实了被告对当晚情况的说法。

corroborate.en: Recent satellite data corroborate the model's prediction about coastal erosion.
corroborate.zh: 最新的卫星数据证实了该模型关于海岸侵蚀的预测。

corroborate.en: Audit records corroborate the figures that appeared in the annual financial statement.
corroborate.zh: 审计记录证实了年度财务报表中出现的数字。

simultaneous.en: The laboratory recorded simultaneous changes in temperature and pressure during the reaction.
simultaneous.zh: 实验室记录到反应过程中温度和压力的同时变化。

simultaneous.en: The simultaneous interpretation in three languages confused many of the conference guests.
simultaneous.zh: 三种语言同时进行的同声传译让许多会议来宾感到困惑。

simultaneous.en: The trial and the audit took place simultaneously in two different cities.
simultaneous.zh: 试验与审计在两个不同的城市同时进行。

infinite.en: The regression model cannot capture the infinite complexity of real-world linguistic variation.
infinite.zh: 该回归模型无法刻画现实语言变异的无限复杂性。

infinite.en: Traditional investors often assume that markets offer infinite opportunities for profit.
infinite.zh: 传统投资者常假定市场提供无限的获利机会。

infinite.en: The archive holds seemingly infinite stores of unpublished photographs.
infinite.zh: 该档案馆收藏着看似无穷无尽的未发表照片。

intermediate.en: Students must complete an intermediate statistics course before enrolling in the doctoral program.
intermediate.zh: 学生必须先修完中级统计学课程才能注册博士项目。

intermediate.en: The intermediate stage of the experiment produced the clearest images of the sample.
intermediate.zh: 实验的中间阶段产生了最清晰的样本图像。

intermediate.en: Teachers placed students in intermediate groups according to their written test scores.
intermediate.zh: 教师根据学生的笔试成绩将他们编入中等水平的小组。

ambiguous.en: The instructions were ambiguous, so several students completed the task incorrectly.
ambiguous.zh: 说明含糊不清，因此有几个学生错误地完成了任务。

ambiguous.en: The ambiguous wording of the contract allowed both firms to claim victory.
ambiguous.zh: 合同措辞含糊，使双方都可以宣称自己占了上风。

ambiguous.en: Reviewers requested clearer definitions because the key term remained ambiguous throughout the paper.
ambiguous.zh: 审稿人要求给出更清晰的定义，因为该关键术语在全文中始终含糊不清。

attribute to.en: Few historians are willing to attribute to drought alone the steady decline of the empire.
attribute to.zh: 很少有历史学家愿意把帝国持续的衰落仅仅归因于干旱。

attribute to.en: The team attributed its success to careful planning and generous collaboration.
attribute to.zh: 该团队将成功归因于周密的计划和慷慨的协作。

attribute to.en: Earlier critics attributed to the young scholar a maturity of style rarely seen at her age.
attribute to.zh: 早年的评论家认为这位年轻学者具有其年龄少见的成熟文风。

external.en: The building's external walls were repaired with sustainable materials.
external.zh: 该建筑的外墙使用可持续材料进行了修缮。

external.en: An external reviewer will evaluate the findings for objectivity and rigor.
external.zh: 一位外部评审将对研究结论的客观性与严谨性进行评估。

external.en: The vaccine relies on external funding that expires at the end of the year.
external.zh: 该疫苗项目依赖的外部资金将在年底到期。

decline.en: Enrollment in the graduate program has declined steadily over the past five years.
decline.zh: 该研究生项目的入学人数在过去五年里持续下降。

decline.en: The publisher declined to comment on the allegations raised by the editorial board.
decline.zh: 出版社拒绝对编辑委员会提出的指控发表评论。

decline.en: Public trust in traditional media declined sharply after the scandal became public.
decline.zh: 丑闻公开后，公众对传统媒体的信任急剧下降。

intrinsic.en: The intrinsic value of the manuscript far exceeds its market price.
intrinsic.zh: 这份手稿的内在价值远高于其市场售价。

intrinsic.en: Students should explore the intrinsic motivation behind their choice of discipline.
intrinsic.zh: 学生应该探究自己选择该学科的内在动机。

intrinsic.en: Researchers must separate intrinsic difficulty from poor teaching in their evaluations.
intrinsic.zh: 研究人员在评估时必须区分内在难度与教学不佳。

innovation.en: Technological innovation has transformed how rural clinics manage patient records.
innovation.zh: 技术创新改变了乡村诊所管理病历的方式。

innovation.en: The firm credits its success to patient innovation rather than aggressive marketing.
innovation.zh: 该公司将其成功归功于耐心而持续的创新，而非激进的营销。

innovation.en: Recent innovation in materials science now allows batteries to charge in under ten minutes.
innovation.zh: 材料科学领域近期的创新使电池如今能在 10 分钟内完成充电。

harvest.en: The research team began a data harvest from public archives across twenty countries.
harvest.zh: 研究团队开始从 20 个国家的公共档案中采集数据。

harvest.en: The crop harvest was unexpectedly strong despite weeks of insufficient rainfall.
harvest.zh: 尽管数周降雨不足，作物收成却出乎意料地好。

harvest.en: Economists were careful to harvest every available statistic before publishing their estimate.
harvest.zh: 经济学家在发布估计值之前谨慎地收集了所有可得的统计数据。

unavoidable.en: Some delay was unavoidable given the complexity of the statistical analysis required.
unavoidable.zh: 鉴于所需统计分析的复杂性，一定程度的延误是无法避免的。

unavoidable.en: Rising material costs make an increase in tuition unavoidable next autumn.
unavoidable.zh: 原材料成本上升使得明年秋季学费上涨无法避免。

unavoidable.en: Loss of memory in older adults is not entirely unavoidable, experts suggest.
unavoidable.zh: 专家表示，老年人记忆力的丧失并非完全无法避免。

unquestionable.en: The method has an unquestionable advantage: it requires no specialized equipment.
unquestionable.zh: 该方法有一项不容置疑的优势：无需任何专用设备。

unquestionable.en: Her reputation for accuracy remained unquestionable throughout a career of forty years.
unquestionable.zh: 在 40 年的职业生涯中，她以准确著称的声誉始终不容置疑。

unquestionable.en: It is unquestionable that climate change will affect agricultural yields worldwide.
unquestionable.zh: 气候变化将影响全球的农业产量，这一点是不容置疑的。

longitudinal.en: The researchers conducted a longitudinal study tracking students for eight years.
longitudinal.zh: 研究人员进行了一项纵向研究，跟踪学生长达八年。

longitudinal.en: The longitudinal data revealed that reading scores improved most during the third year.
longitudinal.zh: 纵向数据显示，阅读成绩在第三年提高幅度最大。

longitudinal.en: A longitudinal survey of coastal villages documents gradual changes in traditional livelihoods.
longitudinal.zh: 一项对沿海村庄的纵向调查记录了传统生计的逐渐变化。

exceed.en: Annual operating costs exceeded the original budget by nearly twelve percent.
exceed.zh: 年度运营成本超出原始预算近 12%。

exceed.en: The final results exceeded the expectations of both the research team and reviewers.
exceed.zh: 最终结果超出了研究团队和评审双方的预期。

exceed.en: Applicants whose proposed budgets exceed the upper limit will be flagged for review.
exceed.zh: 拟定预算超过上限的申请者将被标记以供审查。

due to.en: The shipment was delayed due to unusually strong coastal winds.
due to.zh: 由于沿海风力异常强劲，货物运输延误了。

due to.en: The seminar was canceled due to the unavailability of the visiting scholar.
due to.zh: 由于来访学者无法出席，研讨会取消了。

due to.en: Revenue rose sharply due to stronger demand for the company's consulting services.
due to.zh: 由于对公司咨询服务的需求上升，收入大幅增长。

owing to.en: Owing to heavy rainfall, the outdoor experiments were postponed by two days.
owing to.zh: 由于大雨，室外实验推迟了两天。

owing to.en: Owing to unclear guidelines, several students submitted incomplete assignments.
owing to.zh: 由于指导方针不明确，有几名学生提交了不完整的作业。

owing to.en: Owing to an unexpected shortage of funding, the research team reduced its scope.
owing to.zh: 由于资金意外短缺，研究团队缩减了研究范围。

incorporation.en: The incorporation of the new data into the model improved overall accuracy.
incorporation.zh: 将新数据并入模型提高了整体准确率。

incorporation.en: The incorporation of regional case studies strengthened the paper's argument.
incorporation.zh: 区域案例研究的纳入加强了论文的论证。

incorporation.en: After its incorporation into the university, the college expanded rapidly.
incorporation.zh: 该学院并入大学后迅速发展壮大。

fingerprint.en: Police collected the victim's fingerprint from the broken window.
fingerprint.zh: 警方从破碎的窗户上采集了受害者的指纹。

fingerprint.en: The texture of the painting carries a distinctive fingerprint of its maker.
fingerprint.zh: 这幅画的质感带着制作者独特的纹理特征。

fingerprint.en: Each dialect leaves a linguistic fingerprint on the regions it shapes.
fingerprint.zh: 每种方言都会在其塑造的地区留下语言上的印记。

state-of-the-art.en: The laboratory purchased state-of-the-art equipment for particle research.
state-of-the-art.zh: 该实验室购进了最先进的粒子研究设备。

state-of-the-art.en: This state-of-the-art method reduces error rates considerably in speech recognition.
state-of-the-art.zh: 这种最前沿的方法显著降低了语音识别的错误率。

state-of-the-art.en: Her state-of-the-art design won first prize at the exhibition.
state-of-the-art.zh: 她最先进的设计在展览会上赢得了一等奖。

promising.en: Early test results look promising for the treatment of chronic inflammation.
promising.zh: 早期测试结果表明，慢性炎症的治疗前景乐观。

promising.en: She is a promising graduate student with a strong publication record.
promising.zh: 她是一名很有出息的研究生，发表记录十分出色。

promising.en: The prototype offers a promising route to cheaper battery production.
promising.zh: 该原型为更廉价的电池生产提供了一条有前途的途径。

repetition.en: Frequent repetition of the vocabulary list improved the students' recall.
repetition.zh: 对词汇表的反复复习提高了学生的记忆效果。

repetition.en: The lecture avoided needless repetition of material covered last week.
repetition.zh: 讲座避免重复上周已经讲过的内容。

repetition.en: Successive repetitions of the experiment exposed a subtle sampling error.
repetition.zh: 多次重复该实验暴露出一个细微的抽样错误。

obstacle.en: Lack of funding remains the greatest obstacle to the project's completion.
obstacle.zh: 资金缺乏仍是该项目完成的最大障碍。

obstacle.en: The team overcame several technical obstacles during the field survey.
obstacle.zh: 团队在野外考察中克服了若干技术障碍。

obstacle.en: Language barriers proved a serious obstacle to cross-border cooperation.
obstacle.zh: 语言障碍被证明是跨境合作的一个严重障碍。

alternatively.en: We could reduce costs; alternatively, we could expand the sample size.
alternatively.zh: 我们可以降低成本；或者，我们可以扩大样本量。

alternatively.en: The director may approve the request, or alternatively defer it entirely.
alternatively.zh: 主管可以批准该申请，也可以将其完全推迟。

alternatively.en: Alternatively, the data can be processed on the university cluster.
alternatively.zh: 或者，也可以使用大学计算集群来处理这些数据。

ratio.en: The ratio of male to female respondents remained close to one.
ratio.zh: 男性与女性受访者的比例接近于一比一。

ratio.en: The debt to equity ratio fell sharply after the refinancing agreement.
ratio.zh: 再融资协议签订后，债务与权益之比大幅下降。

ratio.en: A low student-to-teacher ratio improves individual supervision considerably.
ratio.zh: 较低的师生比能显著改善个别辅导的质量。

bypass.en: Engineers bypassed the damaged pipeline and restored flow within hours.
bypass.zh: 工程师绕过了受损的管道，几个小时内就恢复了输送。

bypass.en: The new highway lets drivers bypass the town center entirely.
bypass.zh: 这条新公路让司机可以完全绕过市中心。

bypass.en: Directives cannot bypass the safeguards built into the security framework.
bypass.zh: 指令无法绕过安全框架中内置的保障措施。

constraint.en: Time and budget constraints limited the scope of the investigation.
constraint.zh: 时间和预算的限制缩小了调查的范围。

constraint.en: Dietary constraints made it difficult to follow the treatment plan.
constraint.zh: 饮食限制使得遵循该治疗方案变得困难。

constraint.en: The model imposes a constraint on how fast the system can respond.
constraint.zh: 该模型对系统响应速度施加了一项限制。

vital.en: Clean water is vital for the survival of the entire population.
vital.zh: 清洁的水对全体居民的生存至关重要。

vital.en: It is vital that every researcher verifies the raw data personally.
vital.zh: 每一位研究人员亲自核验原始数据是至关重要的。

vital.en: The vital component in the engine sits near the center of the frame.
vital.zh: 发动机中那个至关重要的部件位于框架的中央附近。

critical.en: The next few weeks will be critical for the entire negotiation.
critical.zh: 接下来的几周对整个谈判至关重要。

critical.en: Her critical review exposed several weaknesses in the published model.
critical.zh: 她的批判性评审暴露了已发表模型的若干弱点。

critical.en: Temperature control is critical when culturing these delicate microorganisms.
critical.zh: 培养这些脆弱微生物时，温度控制至关重要。

contradict.en: The new satellite images contradict the earlier account of the flood.
contradict.zh: 新的卫星图像与早先关于洪水的说法相矛盾。

contradict.en: The witness statement contradicts the physical evidence collected at the scene.
contradict.zh: 证人的陈述与现场收集到的物证相抵触。

contradict.en: Several reviewers contradicted the central claim of the paper.
contradict.zh: 几位审稿人反驳了这篇论文的核心论点。

cumulative.en: The cumulative effect of small improvements raised overall productivity.
cumulative.zh: 小幅改进的累积效应提高了整体生产率。

cumulative.en: The report presents cumulative rainfall figures for the past decade.
cumulative.zh: 该报告给出了过去 10 年的累计降雨量数据。

cumulative.en: Chronic exposure causes cumulative damage to the nervous system.
cumulative.zh: 长期暴露会对神经系统造成累积性损害。

pivotal.en: The discovery played a pivotal role in developing the new vaccine.
pivotal.zh: 这一发现在新型疫苗的研发中起到了关键作用。

pivotal.en: Her appointment was pivotal in transforming the struggling department.
pivotal.zh: 她的任命对扭转这个举步维艰的部门至关重要。

pivotal.en: That conference proved pivotal for the young researcher's career.
pivotal.zh: 那次会议对这位年轻研究者的职业生涯而言至关重要。

outline.en: The chapter provides a brief outline of the entire argument.
outline.zh: 本章对整个论证作了简要概述。

outline.en: He outlined the main objectives before the committee began its review.
outline.zh: 在委员会开始审议之前，他概述了主要目标。

outline.en: The lecture outlined a decade of research on renewable energy systems.
outline.zh: 该讲座概述了 10 年来关于可再生能源系统的研究。

exploit.en: The company exploited new satellite data to improve crop yield estimates.
exploit.zh: 公司利用新的卫星数据改进了作物产量估算。

exploit.en: Teachers should exploit every opportunity to encourage independent reading.
exploit.zh: 教师应利用一切机会鼓励自主阅读。

exploit.en: Several firms were accused of exploiting loopholes in the tax code.
exploit.zh: 几家公司被指控利用税法中的漏洞牟利。

clarity.en: The editor rewrote the passage to improve its clarity for students.
clarity.zh: 编辑重写了该段落，以使其对学生而言更清晰易懂。

clarity.en: The lecture lacked clarity, and several listeners left confused.
clarity.zh: 讲座缺乏清晰度，几位听众一头雾水地离开了。

clarity.en: Clarity of purpose helped the research team remain focused throughout.
clarity.zh: 目标明确使研究团队始终保持专注。

briefly.en: He briefly described the main findings of the experiment.
briefly.zh: 他简要说明了实验的主要发现。

briefly.en: The committee debated the proposal briefly before deferring it.
briefly.zh: 委员会简短讨论了这一提案，随后将其搁置。

briefly.en: Let me briefly outline the three stages of the treatment.
briefly.zh: 让我简要概述该治疗的三个阶段。

employ.en: The laboratory employs a statistical method that reduces sampling bias.
employ.zh: 该实验室采用一种能减少抽样偏差的统计方法。

employ.en: Engineers employ thermal imaging to detect hidden defects in the walls.
employ.zh: 工程师利用热成像技术探测墙体中的隐蔽缺陷。

employ.en: The institute employs twelve full-time statisticians and a similar number of field assistants.
employ.zh: 该研究所雇用了 12 名全职统计师和数量相当的外勤助理。

ingredient.en: The key ingredient in this remedy comes from a rare mountain herb.
ingredient.zh: 这种药方中的关键成分来自一种稀有的山草。

ingredient.en: Fresh ingredients greatly improve the taste of the soup.
ingredient.zh: 新鲜的食材能大大提升汤的味道。

ingredient.en: Trust and patience are essential ingredients in any long-term partnership.
ingredient.zh: 信任与耐心是任何长期合作关系中不可或缺的要素。

pioneering.en: Her pioneering work on DNA repair won international recognition.
pioneering.zh: 她在基因修复方面的开创性工作获得了国际认可。

pioneering.en: The laboratory's pioneering work on battery recycling attracted international attention.
pioneering.zh: 该实验室在电池回收方面的开创性工作引起了国际关注。

pioneering.en: Pioneering researchers demonstrated the technique for the first time in 1987.
pioneering.zh: 先驱研究者们于 1987 年首次演示了这一技术。

conversely.en: Rising interest rates dampen investment; conversely, falling rates tend to stimulate it.
conversely.zh: 利率上升抑制投资；反之，利率下降往往刺激投资。

conversely.en: Conversely, the second experiment produced results that supported the theory.
conversely.zh: 相反，第二个实验的结果支持了该理论。

conversely.en: Students who read widely write better; conversely, writers tend to read more.
conversely.zh: 广泛阅读的学生写得更好；反过来，写作者往往读得更多。

render.en: The injury rendered him unable to continue his research.
render.zh: 这次受伤使他无法继续研究。

render.en: Experienced staff readily rendered assistance to visitors unfamiliar with the equipment.
render.zh: 熟练的员工乐意为不熟悉设备者提供帮助。

render.en: The morning light renders the sandstone walls in deep shades of gold.
render.zh: 晨光将砂岩墙面映染成浓郁的金色。

benchmark.en: The company set this year's revenue as a benchmark for other firms.
benchmark.zh: 该公司把今年的收入设定为其他企业的对标标准。

benchmark.en: This new processor is twice as fast as the industry benchmark.
benchmark.zh: 这款新处理器的速度是行业基准的两倍。

benchmark.en: Students use the sample essay as a benchmark for their own writing.
benchmark.zh: 学生们把这篇范文作为自己写作的基准。

convergence.en: The two research groups achieved convergence on the interpretation of the data.
convergence.zh: 两个研究小组在对数据的解释上达成了趋同。

convergence.en: The convergence of multiple theories strengthened the overall explanation.
convergence.zh: 多种理论的趋同增强了整体解释力。

convergence.en: Annual conferences encourage the convergence of ideas across disciplines.
convergence.zh: 年度会议促进跨学科思想的汇聚。

capacity.en: The new battery has a capacity of roughly eighty kilowatt hours.
capacity.zh: 这块新电池的容量约为 80 千瓦时。

capacity.en: The factory has increased its production capacity by thirty percent.
capacity.zh: 该工厂已将生产能力提高了 30%。

capacity.en: Her capacity for careful analysis impressed every member of the panel.
capacity.zh: 她缜密分析的能力给评审组的每一位成员都留下了深刻印象。

capability.en: The software offers researchers a powerful capability for mapping genetic variation.
capability.zh: 该软件为研究人员提供了绘制遗传变异图谱的强大功能。

capability.en: Students must develop the capability to evaluate sources independently.
capability.zh: 学生必须培养独立评估信源的能力。

capability.en: The device lacks the capability to process high-resolution images.
capability.zh: 该设备缺乏处理高分辨率图像的能力。

extend.en: The team extended the study to include three additional coastal regions.
extend.zh: 团队将研究范围扩展到另外三个沿海地区。

extend.en: Warm currents extend the growing season across much of the peninsula.
extend.zh: 暖流使半岛大部分地区的生长季得以延长。

extend.en: The publisher extended the submission deadline by ten days.
extend.zh: 出版方将投稿截止日期延长了 10 天。

revised.en: The revised edition includes twenty new chapters and updated references.
revised.zh: 修订版新增了 20 个章节并更新了参考文献。

revised.en: Following peer review, the revised manuscript was accepted for publication.
revised.zh: 经过同行评审，修订稿获准发表。

revised.en: The revised budget allocates more funding to field research.
revised.zh: 修订后的预算为实地研究分配了更多经费。

proofread.en: Please proofread the final chapter before sending it to the publisher.
proofread.zh: 请在发给出版商之前校对最后一章。

proofread.en: The book was proofread by two graduate students over the summer.
proofread.zh: 这本书由两名研究生在暑假期间完成了校对。

proofread.en: A single proofread caught a missing reference in the introduction.
proofread.zh: 一次校对就发现了引言中缺失的一条参考文献。

extraneous.en: The final paper removed all extraneous references to earlier drafts.
extraneous.zh: 终稿删除了所有提及早期草稿的多余引述。

extraneous.en: Extraneous materials in the package delayed the shipment for several days.
extraneous.zh: 包裹中的多余物料使货物延误了数日。

extraneous.en: The reader ignored the extraneous footnotes and focused on the main text.
extraneous.zh: 读者略过了与主题无关的脚注，专注于正文。

ingenious.en: Her ingenious method of recycling waste reduced costs considerably.
ingenious.zh: 她巧妙的废弃物回收方法大幅降低了成本。

ingenious.en: The engineers devised an ingenious device that converts noise into power.
ingenious.zh: 工程师设计出一种把噪音转化为动力的精巧装置。

ingenious.en: His ingenious solution to the scheduling problem impressed the committee.
ingenious.zh: 他解决排期问题的巧妙方案给委员会留下了深刻印象。

spurious.en: The laboratory identified a spurious signal caused by nearby electrical equipment.
spurious.zh: 实验室发现了一个由附近电气设备引起的虚假信号。

spurious.en: The argument rested on a spurious correlation between two unrelated variables.
spurious.zh: 该论证建立在两个无关变量之间的虚假相关之上。

spurious.en: The report dismissed several widely circulated but spurious claims.
spurious.zh: 该报告驳斥了若干广为流传但站不住脚的说法。

residual.en: Residual moisture in the soil can affect the accuracy of laboratory measurements.
residual.zh: 土壤中残留的水分会影响实验室测量的准确性。

residual.en: The residual effects of the policy were still visible a decade later.
residual.zh: 10 年之后，这项政策的残余影响依然可见。

residual.en: Researchers measured residual levels of contamination in samples taken near the factory.
residual.zh: 研究人员在工厂附近采集的样本中测定了残留污染物的水平。

reciprocal.en: The two universities signed a reciprocal agreement allowing students to exchange credits.
reciprocal.zh: 两所大学签署了互惠协议，允许学生互认学分。

reciprocal.en: Reciprocal trust between departments significantly improved the pace of collaborative research.
reciprocal.zh: 院系之间的相互信任显著加快了合作研究的进度。

reciprocal.en: A reciprocal relationship between predator and prey shapes the stability of the whole ecosystem.
reciprocal.zh: 捕食者与猎物之间的相互关系塑造了整个生态系统的稳定性。

from scratch.en: The team rebuilt the entire pipeline from scratch after the data breach.
from scratch.zh: 数据泄露之后，团队从头重建了整条数据流程。

from scratch.en: She learned classical Chinese from scratch during her first year abroad.
from scratch.zh: 她在国外的第一年从零开始学习文言文。

from scratch.en: Writing the survey instrument from scratch gave researchers full control over wording.
from scratch.zh: 从头撰写问卷使研究者能够完全掌控措辞。

commence.en: The committee will commence its review of the proposal on Monday morning.
commence.zh: 委员会将于周一上午开始审查这份提案。

commence.en: Construction on the new laboratory will commence once the permits are issued.
commence.zh: 新实验室的建设将在许可证签发后动工。

commence.en: The lecture series commences with a short introduction to research ethics.
commence.zh: 该系列讲座以一场简短的研究伦理导论开始。

discipline.en: Years of discipline transformed his raw talent into professional mastery.
discipline.zh: 多年的自律将他的天赋打磨成了专业的精通。

discipline.en: Her academic discipline in medieval history shaped the questions she chose to ask.
discipline.zh: 她在中世纪历史这一学科上的专长，决定了她选择研究的问题。

discipline.en: Economic discipline kept inflation under control during the difficult second quarter.
discipline.zh: 经济上的纪律约束使通货膨胀在困难的第二季度保持在可控范围内。

akin.en: The symptoms of the two conditions are closely akin.
akin.zh: 这两种疾病的症状十分相近。

akin.en: Her approach to archival research is akin to that of medieval scholars.
akin.zh: 她研究档案的方法与中世纪学者颇为相似。

akin.en: Such a result would be akin to discovering an entirely new species.
akin.zh: 这样的结果无异于发现了一个全新的物种。

column.en: Enter the measurement in the final column of the spreadsheet.
column.zh: 请在电子表格的最后一列填入测量值。

column.en: She wrote a weekly column about urban planning in the newspaper.
column.zh: 她在报纸上撰写每周一篇的城市规划专栏。

column.en: The table contains five columns, one for each experimental condition.
column.zh: 该表格包含五列，分别对应每一种实验条件。

interpret.en: Historians continue to interpret the treaty very differently across regions.
interpret.zh: 历史学家们对这项条约的解读至今仍因地区而异。

interpret.en: The analyst interpreted the falling figures as evidence of renewed demand.
interpret.zh: 分析师把下降的数字解读为需求回暖的证据。

interpret.en: Participants were asked to interpret the ambiguous instructions in their own words.
interpret.zh: 参与者被要求用自己的话解释这些含糊的说明。

composite.en: The composite score combines accuracy, speed, and consistency into a single measure.
composite.zh: 综合得分把准确性、速度和稳定性合并为一项指标。

composite.en: Researchers developed a composite material from recycled fibres and bio-resin.
composite.zh: 研究人员用再生纤维和生物树脂开发出一种复合材料。

composite.en: Her writing style is composite, borrowing techniques from journalism and fiction.
composite.zh: 她的写作风格是综合式的，借鉴了新闻与小说的技巧。

analog.en: The maze task is considered a behavioral analog of everyday problem solving.
analog.zh: 该迷宫任务被视为日常问题解决行为的一种类比。

analog.en: The new protocol has no close analog in earlier research.
analog.zh: 新协议在早期研究中几乎没有相似的对应物。

analog.en: This historical case provides a useful analog for present policy debates.
analog.zh: 这个历史案例为当下的政策讨论提供了一个有用的参照。

tackle.en: The commission intends to tackle housing shortages through zoning reform.
tackle.zh: 委员会打算通过分区规划改革来解决住房短缺问题。

tackle.en: She tackled the difficult review with patience and clear thinking.
tackle.zh: 她以耐心和清晰的思路应对这场艰难的评审。

tackle.en: Governments must tackle climate risks before infrastructure budgets are exhausted.
tackle.zh: 政府必须在基础设施预算耗尽之前应对气候风险。

generic.en: The software offers a generic template that suits most research projects.
generic.zh: 该软件提供了一个通用模板，适用于大多数研究项目。

generic.en: Generic labels are less useful than specific descriptions in this catalog.
generic.zh: 在这份目录中，笼统的标签远不如具体的描述有用。

generic.en: Such generic guidance cannot replace careful judgment in each classroom.
generic.zh: 这类笼统的指导无法取代每个课堂中谨慎的判断。

leverage.en: Small firms can leverage social media to reach customers abroad.
leverage.zh: 小公司可以利用社交媒体触达海外客户。

leverage.en: The team leveraged existing datasets to shorten the development timeline.
leverage.zh: 团队借助已有的数据集来缩短开发周期。

leverage.en: Universities leverage partnerships with industry to fund applied research.
leverage.zh: 高校借助与产业界的合作关系来资助应用研究。

top-down.en: A top-down directive from headquarters delayed all regional decisions.
top-down.zh: 总部自上而下的指令延误了所有地区决策。

top-down.en: The agency abandoned its top-down model in favor of local discretion.
top-down.zh: 该机构放弃了自上而下的模式，转而赋予地方自主权。

top-down.en: Top-down reforms succeed only when frontline staff support them.
top-down.zh: 只有在一线员工的支持下，自上而下的改革才会成功。

bottom-up.en: A bottom-up approach lets researchers design the protocol around real needs.
bottom-up.zh: 自下而上的方法使研究者能够围绕实际需求设计研究方案。

bottom-up.en: The company grew through bottom-up innovation rather than top-down planning.
bottom-up.zh: 这家公司依靠自下而上的创新而非自上而下的规划成长起来。

bottom-up.en: Volunteers contributed a bottom-up effort that quickly spread across districts.
bottom-up.zh: 志愿者发起了一项自下而上的行动，很快在各区推广开来。

prohibitive.en: The cost of custom equipment proved prohibitive for most small laboratories.
prohibitive.zh: 定制设备的成本对大多数小型实验室而言高得难以负担。

prohibitive.en: Insurance premiums have become prohibitive for low-income households.
prohibitive.zh: 保险费用对低收入家庭来说已经高得难以承担。

prohibitive.en: Such an exclusive venue would carry prohibitive costs for a student conference.
prohibitive.zh: 这样一家高档场地对学生学术会议而言，费用高得令人望而却步。

provoke.en: The editorial provoked an angry response from readers across the country.
provoke.zh: 这篇社论激起了全国读者的愤怒回应。

provoke.en: Certain artificial sweeteners may provoke headaches in sensitive individuals.
provoke.zh: 某些人工甜味剂可能引起敏感人群的头痛。

provoke.en: The proposed tax reform was designed to provoke debate in parliament.
provoke.zh: 拟议中的税改旨在引发议会辩论。

parenthesis.en: Insert a parenthesis after the year to indicate the original source.
parenthesis.zh: 在年份后加一个括号以注明原始出处。

parenthesis.en: A misplaced parenthesis in the formula changed the entire result.
parenthesis.zh: 公式中一个位置放错的括号改变了整个结果。

parenthesis.en: She added a brief parenthesis explaining the unusual abbreviation.
parenthesis.zh: 她加了一处简短的括注来解释这个不常见的缩写。

implementation.en: The implementation of the new policy took longer than officials anticipated.
implementation.zh: 新政策的实施耗时比官员们预期的更长。

implementation.en: Poor implementation, not bad policy, caused the reform to fail.
implementation.zh: 导致改革失败的是执行不力，而非政策本身不好。

implementation.en: The team documented every stage of the implementation for future staff.
implementation.zh: 团队记录了实施的每一个环节，以供后来的员工参考。

by no means.en: The evidence is by no means sufficient to justify such a claim.
by no means.zh: 这些证据绝不足以支持这样的主张。

by no means.en: The experiment was by no means over when the funding ran out.
by no means.zh: 资金耗尽时，实验还远未结束。

by no means.en: He is by no means the only researcher to question these results.
by no means.zh: 对这些结果提出质疑的研究者绝不止他一人。

exceptional.en: She showed exceptional analytical skill during the final review.
exceptional.zh: 在终审中，她展现了卓越的分析能力。

exceptional.en: The laboratory recorded exceptional growth in demand for its specialist equipment.
exceptional.zh: 该实验室的专用设备需求出现了异乎寻常的增长。

exceptional.en: His exceptional performance earned him a place at the national institute.
exceptional.zh: 他出色的表现为他赢得国家研究所的一个名额。

permanently.en: The damaged section of the archive was permanently closed last spring.
permanently.zh: 档案馆受损的部分去年春天被永久关闭。

permanently.en: Salt concentrations in the sample changed permanently once the container opened.
permanently.zh: 容器一旦打开，样本中的盐浓度就发生了永久性的改变。

permanently.en: The hospital permanently adopted the new triage protocol in January.
permanently.zh: 该医院于一月正式永久采用了新的分诊流程。

witness.en: Two researchers witnessed the collision between the two experimental vehicles.
witness.zh: 两名研究员目击了两辆实验车辆相撞的过程。

witness.en: The committee invited colleagues who witnessed the events to testify.
witness.zh: 委员会邀请了目击事发经过的同事到场作证。

witness.en: Few historians have witnessed the slow decline of the region's dialects.
witness.zh: 很少有历史学家亲历过该地区方言的缓慢衰落。

reconcile.en: The mediator worked to reconcile the two departments over budget allocation.
reconcile.zh: 调解人努力就预算分配调解两个院系之间的分歧。

reconcile.en: She struggled to reconcile the experimental results with the published theory.
reconcile.zh: 她难以使实验结果与已发表的理论相吻合。

reconcile.en: The new director reconciled strict deadlines with the need for accuracy.
reconcile.zh: 新任主任兼顾了严格的截止日期与准确性要求。

apparatus.en: The laboratory purchased new glass apparatus for the chemistry experiments.
apparatus.zh: 实验室为化学实验购置了新的玻璃仪器。

apparatus.en: A simple apparatus of mirrors can demonstrate the principle clearly.
apparatus.zh: 一套简单的镜面装置就能清楚地演示这一原理。

apparatus.en: The apparatus was set up and tested within a single afternoon.
apparatus.zh: 这套仪器在一个下午便安装并测试完毕。

negligible.en: The difference between the two groups was statistically negligible in every trial.
negligible.zh: 在每次试验中，两组之间的差异在统计上都可以忽略不计。

negligible.en: The cost of repair proved negligible compared with replacing the equipment.
negligible.zh: 与更换设备相比，维修费用微不足道。

negligible.en: Such a negligible effect can safely be ignored when planning.
negligible.zh: 在制定计划时，这样微不足道的影响可以放心忽略。

rigorous.en: The team applied a rigorous statistical test to the collected data.
rigorous.zh: 团队对收集到的数据应用了严格的统计检验。

rigorous.en: His rigorous review of the literature changed the direction of the project.
rigorous.zh: 他对文献的缜密评述改变了项目的方向。

rigorous.en: Rigorous peer review remains the strongest safeguard against faulty claims.
rigorous.zh: 严谨的同行评审仍是防止错误结论的最有力保障。

therein.en: Further information regarding the method is contained therein.
therein.zh: 有关该方法的进一步信息已包含其中。

therein.en: The two systems differ mainly in the assumptions held therein.
therein.zh: 这两个系统的差异主要在于其中所持的假设。

therein.en: Researchers noted that the limitations discussed therein were unavoidable.
therein.zh: 研究人员指出，其中讨论的局限是无法避免的。

inevitably.en: Rising demand will inevitably place pressure on the production capacity.
inevitably.zh: 需求上升必然会给生产能力带来压力。

inevitably.en: Such shortcuts inevitably lead to errors in the final data.
inevitably.zh: 这样的捷径必然会导致最终数据出错。

inevitably.en: Any such expansion inevitably attracts attention from regulators.
inevitably.zh: 任何这样的扩张必然会引起监管部门的关注。

complimentary.en: The chairman offered complimentary remarks about the student's progress.
complimentary.zh: 主席对学生取得的进步给予了赞赏的评价。

complimentary.en: She received a complimentary review in the leading academic journal.
complimentary.zh: 她在一份顶尖学术期刊上得到了褒扬性的评述。

complimentary.en: A complimentary copy of the software was provided to every laboratory.
complimentary.zh: 每个实验室都获得了一份免费赠送的软件副本。

reconciliation.en: The reconciliation between the two departments took more than a year.
reconciliation.zh: 两个院系之间的和解花费了一年多时间。

reconciliation.en: Historians described the treaty as a remarkable reconciliation of conflicting interests.
reconciliation.zh: 历史学家称该条约是利益冲突的一次显著和解。

reconciliation.en: Financial reconciliation revealed several discrepancies in the reported figures.
reconciliation.zh: 财务对账揭示了报表数字中的若干不一致之处。

revelation.en: The release of the archive was a revelation to historians of the period.
revelation.zh: 档案的公开对研究该时期的历史学家来说是一个重大发现。

revelation.en: Her investigation produced a startling revelation about the missing funds.
revelation.zh: 她的调查就资金失踪一事揭露出了一个令人震惊的内幕。

revelation.en: The oral histories offered a revelation that reshaped our understanding.
revelation.zh: 这些口述历史揭示的真相重塑了我们的认识。

deduce.en: From the fragments we can deduce that the workshop was active.
deduce.zh: 从这些残片中我们可以推断出该作坊当时仍在运作。

deduce.en: Researchers deduced the original composition from the chemical residue.
deduce.zh: 研究人员从化学残留物推断出了原始成分。

deduce.en: It is reasonable to deduce that both teams shared the same supervisor.
deduce.zh: 有理由推断两个团队共用同一位导师。

recursive.en: The recursive definition calls the function again on a smaller input.
recursive.zh: 这个递归定义再次以更小的输入调用该函数。

recursive.en: Recursive models remain essential for describing hierarchical data structures.
recursive.zh: 递归模型对于描述层次化数据结构仍然不可或缺。

recursive.en: The programmer avoided recursive calls in the innermost loop for speed.
recursive.zh: 为提高速度，程序员在最内层循环中避免了递归调用。

iterative.en: An iterative process allows the design to improve gradually with each revision.
iterative.zh: 迭代过程使设计能够随着每次修订逐步改进。

iterative.en: The method combines an iterative search with a precise stopping condition.
iterative.zh: 该方法把迭代搜索与精确的停止条件结合起来。

iterative.en: Iterative testing revealed errors that a single final check had missed.
iterative.zh: 反复测试发现了仅靠最后一次检查会遗漏的错误。

indispensable.en: Clean water is indispensable for the survival of every living organism.
indispensable.zh: 清洁的水对每一个生物体的生存都必不可少。

indispensable.en: The lecture material proved indispensable for preparing her doctoral dissertation.
indispensable.zh: 事实证明，这些讲座材料对她准备博士论文必不可少。

indispensable.en: Effective communication remains an indispensable skill in every professional field.
indispensable.zh: 有效的沟通在每个职业领域都是一项不可或缺的技能。

merely.en: The committee rejected the proposal merely because it arrived after the deadline.
merely.zh: 委员会拒绝该提案，仅仅是因为它在截止日期之后才送达。

merely.en: He did not merely report the figures but also explained their significance in detail.
merely.zh: 他不仅仅报告了这些数字，还详细解释了它们的含义。

merely.en: Such a small sample size is merely suggestive and cannot support firm conclusions.
merely.zh: 如此小的样本量只是提示性的，无法支持确凿的结论。

barely.en: She barely had time to finish the abstract before the deadline arrived.
barely.zh: 在截止日期到来之前，她几乎没有时间完成摘要。

barely.en: The novel's central argument is barely intelligible to first-year undergraduates.
barely.zh: 这部小说的核心论点对一年级本科生来说几乎难以理解。

barely.en: Barely half of the participants reported regular physical activity during the survey.
barely.zh: 调查中只有不到一半的参与者报告经常进行体育活动。

representative.en: This specimen is a representative example of the region's volcanic rock.
representative.zh: 这个标本是该地区火山岩的代表性例子。

representative.en: Her career illustrates the representative obstacles faced by women in science.
representative.zh: 她的职业生涯展现了女性在科学领域面临的典型障碍。

representative.en: Each interviewee was asked to nominate a figure representative of their own generation.
representative.zh: 每位受访者被要求推荐一位能代表自己一代的人物。

accommodate.en: The new conference hall can accommodate up to eight hundred delegates.
accommodate.zh: 新的会议大厅最多可以容纳 800 名代表。

accommodate.en: The university renovated several dormitories to accommodate an increasing number of students.
accommodate.zh: 学校翻新了几栋宿舍楼，以容纳越来越多的学生。

accommodate.en: This flexible schedule should easily accommodate everyone's different working hours.
accommodate.zh: 这个灵活的日程安排应该能轻松适应每个人不同的工作时间。

twofold.en: The reform achieved a twofold increase in enrollment within three years.
twofold.zh: 这项改革在三年内使入学人数翻了一番。

twofold.en: The new method serves a twofold purpose: reducing costs and improving accuracy.
twofold.zh: 这种新方法有双重目的：降低成本并提高准确性。

twofold.en: The authors acknowledge a twofold limitation of the present study.
twofold.zh: 作者们承认当前研究存在两方面的局限。

feasible.en: Engineers concluded that the proposed expansion was technically feasible within two years.
feasible.zh: 工程师们得出结论，所提出的扩建方案在技术上是可行的，且可在两年内完成。

feasible.en: Given the available funding, a large-scale survey may not be feasible.
feasible.zh: 鉴于可用的资金，大规模调查可能并不可行。

feasible.en: The committee will consider any feasible alternative to the original design.
feasible.zh: 委员会将考虑原设计的任何可行替代方案。

intricate.en: The intricate network of tunnels beneath the temple required months of careful mapping.
intricate.zh: 寺庙下方错综复杂的隧道网络需要数月细致的测绘。

intricate.en: She explained the intricate relationship between temperature and reaction rate clearly.
intricate.zh: 她清楚地解释了温度与反应速率之间错综复杂的关系。

intricate.en: Solving the intricate scheduling problem required a more efficient algorithm.
intricate.zh: 解决这个复杂的调度问题需要一种更高效的算法。

interval.en: Measurements were recorded at regular intervals throughout the experiment.
interval.zh: 在整个实验过程中按固定间隔记录了测量数据。

interval.en: There was a long interval between the two published versions of the paper.
interval.zh: 该论文的两个已出版版本之间存在很长的时间间隔。

interval.en: Participants returned for testing at a twelve-week interval.
interval.zh: 参与者每 12 周返回进行一次测试。

preferable.en: Submitting the application online is preferable to delivering it by post.
preferable.zh: 在线提交申请比邮寄递交更可取。

preferable.en: For long documents, a printed copy is arguably preferable to a screen.
preferable.zh: 对于长篇文档来说，纸质版可以说比在屏幕上阅读更可取。

preferable.en: The panel considered a smaller sample preferable to a poorly controlled trial.
preferable.zh: 评审组认为较小的样本比控制不佳的试验更为可取。

hierarchical.en: The organization operates a hierarchical structure with clear lines of authority.
hierarchical.zh: 该组织实行等级分明的结构，权力关系清晰。

hierarchical.en: Hierarchical databases make it easier to locate related records efficiently.
hierarchical.zh: 层次化数据库使相关记录更容易被高效地检索。

hierarchical.en: Many universities still operate through a largely hierarchical system of decision-making.
hierarchical.zh: 许多大学的决策体系在很大程度上仍是等级化的。

fine-grained.en: Fine-grained analysis revealed subtle differences between the two prototypes.
fine-grained.zh: 细粒度的分析揭示了两个原型之间的细微差异。

fine-grained.en: The model employs fine-grained control to reproduce human speech patterns.
fine-grained.zh: 该模型采用精细的控制方式来重现人类的语音模式。

fine-grained.en: Access permissions are managed through fine-grained security rules in the database.
fine-grained.zh: 访问权限通过数据库中精细的安全规则进行管理。

legitimate.en: The court ruled that the search had been conducted without legitimate authority.
legitimate.zh: 法院裁定此次搜查是在没有合法授权的情况下进行的。

legitimate.en: Researchers must protect personal data collected for legitimate purposes.
legitimate.zh: 研究人员必须保护出于正当目的而收集的个人数据。

legitimate.en: Raising concerns about safety is a legitimate part of the consultation process.
legitimate.zh: 提出安全方面的担忧是协商程序中正当的一部分。

restrict.en: The regulation restricts access to sensitive personal records.
restrict.zh: 该规定限制了敏感个人记录的访问权限。

restrict.en: Narrow passageways restrict the movement of large equipment through the building.
restrict.zh: 狭窄的通道限制了大件设备在楼内的搬运。

restrict.en: She restricted her review to papers published after 2015.
restrict.zh: 她把综述范围限定在 2015 年之后发表的论文。

immerse.en: Graduate students immerse themselves in the literature before designing their experiments.
immerse.zh: 研究生们在设计实验之前会沉浸于相关文献之中。

immerse.en: He immersed himself in the local culture during his year abroad.
immerse.zh: 他在国外的那一年里完全沉浸于当地文化之中。

immerse.en: The program immerses new teachers in classroom practice from the first week.
immerse.zh: 该项目从第一周起就让新教师沉浸在课堂教学实践中。

plethora.en: The library holds a plethora of rare manuscripts on medieval trade.
plethora.zh: 图书馆收藏了大量关于中世纪贸易的珍贵手稿。

plethora.en: The journal published a plethora of studies on the topic last year.
plethora.zh: 该期刊去年发表了大量关于这一主题的研究。

plethora.en: The plethora of conflicting guidelines did more to confuse new reviewers than to help them.
plethora.zh: 过多而相互矛盾的指南与其说帮助了新评审员，不如说让他们更加困惑。

concomitant.en: The reform brought concomitant improvements in staff training and research funding.
concomitant.zh: 这项改革同时带来了员工培训和科研经费方面的改善。

concomitant.en: Rapid urban growth carried with it concomitant problems in waste management.
concomitant.zh: 快速的城市增长伴随着废物管理方面的种种问题。

concomitant.en: Every hypothesis is recorded together with its concomitant experimental conditions.
concomitant.zh: 每一个假设都与同时出现的实验条件一并记录在案。

necessarily.en: The two models are not necessarily in conflict with each other.
necessarily.zh: 这两个模型并不一定彼此矛盾。

necessarily.en: A larger sample size does not necessarily produce a more reliable result.
necessarily.zh: 更大的样本量并不一定能产生更可靠的结果。

necessarily.en: Increased funding does not necessarily improve the quality of teaching.
necessarily.zh: 增加经费并不一定能提高教学质量。

striking.en: The most striking feature of the painting is its unusual depth of color.
striking.zh: 这幅画最引人注目的特点是其非凡的色彩深度。

striking.en: There was a striking contrast between the two versions of the manuscript.
striking.zh: 手稿的两个版本之间存在显著的对比。

striking.en: Her striking decision to withdraw the paper struck the reviewers as remarkably bold.
striking.zh: 她撤下论文这一引人注目的决定让审稿人觉得格外大胆。

in situ.en: The fossils were examined in situ before any samples were removed.
in situ.zh: 在取下任何样本之前，这些化石都进行了原地检验。

in situ.en: Researchers left the sensors in situ to record changes over several months.
in situ.zh: 研究人员把传感器留在原地，以记录数月内的变化。

in situ.en: In situ conservation protects the mural without moving it from the wall.
in situ.zh: 原址保护在不将壁画从墙上移走的情况下对其加以保护。

pedagogical.en: The textbook was rewritten with pedagogical rather than purely archival purposes.
pedagogical.zh: 这本教材是出于教学目的而非纯粹的文献目的而重写的。

pedagogical.en: Teachers reported that the interactive exercises had clear pedagogical value.
pedagogical.zh: 教师们反映这些互动练习具有明确的教学价值。

pedagogical.en: Her lecture notes are praised for their clear pedagogical structure.
pedagogical.zh: 她的讲义因清晰的教学结构而受到称赞。

hallmark.en: Careful sourcing is a hallmark of serious academic writing.
hallmark.zh: 严谨的资料来源是严肃学术写作的显著特征。

hallmark.en: The building's stone arches are the hallmark of local architecture.
hallmark.zh: 这座建筑的石拱是当地建筑风格的标志。

hallmark.en: Rigorous peer review is a hallmark of quality in this journal.
hallmark.zh: 严格的同行评审是该期刊质量的一个标志。

well-defined.en: The study population must be described as a well-defined group of participants.
well-defined.zh: 研究对象必须被描述为一个界限清晰的参与者群体。

well-defined.en: Each category in the framework has a well-defined meaning and scope.
well-defined.zh: 该框架中的每个类别都有明确的含义和适用范围。

well-defined.en: A well-defined contract reduces disputes between the two departments.
well-defined.zh: 明确的合同条款减少了两部门之间的争议。

suspicious.en: The auditors grew suspicious when the totals did not match the receipts.
suspicious.zh: 当总数与收据不符时，审计人员起了疑心。

suspicious.en: Police described the package as suspicious but released it after inspection.
suspicious.zh: 警方称该包裹可疑，但检查后仍予以放行。

suspicious.en: Several researchers were suspicious of the claim's unusually favorable results.
suspicious.zh: 几位研究者对该说法异常有利的结果表示怀疑。

blurred.en: The boundary between research and commercial development has become increasingly blurred.
blurred.zh: 研究与商业开发之间的界线已变得越来越模糊。

blurred.en: Poor focus left the photographs blurred and difficult to interpret.
blurred.zh: 对焦不佳使照片模糊不清，难以解读。

blurred.en: The blurred lines of responsibility led to confusion during the emergency.
blurred.zh: 职责界限模糊导致应急期间出现了混乱。

prominent.en: She played a prominent role in establishing the national research center.
prominent.zh: 她在建立国家研究中心的过程中发挥了重要作用。

prominent.en: Economic inequality remains a prominent issue in contemporary public debate.
prominent.zh: 经济不平等仍然是当代公共辩论中的突出问题。

prominent.en: The building occupies a prominent position at the entrance to the campus.
prominent.zh: 这座建筑位于校园入口处十分显眼的位置。

notably.en: The study confirmed earlier findings, notably concerning adolescent sleep patterns.
notably.zh: 该研究证实了此前的发现，尤其是关于青少年睡眠模式的部分。

notably.en: Regional differences were small, notably in the northern provinces.
notably.zh: 地区差异很小，北部各省尤其如此。
