notably.en: Notably, the effect persisted even after the software was updated.
notably.zh: 值得注意的是，即使软件更新后这一影响仍然持续存在。

compatible.en: The two measurement systems are entirely compatible with one another.
compatible.zh: 这两套测量系统彼此完全兼容。

compatible.en: Remote work and existing office arrangements remain largely compatible today.
compatible.zh: 远程办公与现有的办公安排在目前基本可以共存。

compatible.en: Vegetarian diets can be compatible with a balanced nutritional plan.
compatible.zh: 素食饮食可以与均衡的营养计划相协调。

retain.en: The company hopes to retain most of its experienced staff after the merger.
retain.zh: 公司希望在合并后保留大多数有经验的员工。

retain.en: These plants retain moisture in their roots throughout the dry season.
retain.zh: 这些植物在整个旱季将水分保留在根部。

retain.en: Participants were asked to retain their original survey answers for verification.
retain.zh: 参与者被要求保留其原始问卷答案以供核查。

invoke.en: The speaker invoked an ancient tradition to justify the new policy.
invoke.zh: 演讲者援引了一项古老传统来为新政策辩护。

invoke.en: The photographs invoke memories of childhood summers in the countryside.
invoke.zh: 这些照片唤起了人们对童年乡村夏日的回忆。

invoke.en: Critics invoke constitutional arguments against the proposed restrictions.
invoke.zh: 批评者援引宪法论据来反对拟议中的限制措施。

paradigm.en: The case became a paradigm for successful experimental design.
paradigm.zh: 该案例成为成功实验设计的范例。

paradigm.en: The discovery caused a paradigm shift within the entire field.
paradigm.zh: 这一发现促成了整个领域的范式转变。

paradigm.en: Students analyzed several paradigm examples in the introductory seminar.
paradigm.zh: 学生们在入门研讨课上分析了几个典型范例。

concurrent.en: The two laboratories operate concurrent trials on different patient groups.
concurrent.zh: 两间实验室针对不同患者群体同时进行试验。

concurrent.en: Concurrent access to the database requires a secure password system.
concurrent.zh: 并发访问该数据库需要一套安全的密码系统。

concurrent.en: The program's success rests on concurrent investment in teaching and research.
concurrent.zh: 该项目的成功依赖于对教学与研究的同步投入。

manifest.en: The early symptoms of the disease manifest as fatigue and blurred vision.
manifest.zh: 该病的早期症状表现为疲劳和视力模糊。

manifest.en: The reforms manifest themselves in higher participation from rural students.
manifest.zh: 这些改革体现在农村学生参与度的提高上。

manifest.en: Stress often manifests in the workplace as reduced productivity.
manifest.zh: 压力在工作场所中往往表现为生产力下降。

encapsulate.en: The three principles encapsulate the central argument of the study.
encapsulate.zh: 这三条原则概括了研究的核心论点。

encapsulate.en: A single memorable phrase can encapsulate an entire theory.
encapsulate.zh: 一个令人难忘的短语就能浓缩一整套理论。

encapsulate.en: These abstracts encapsulate the findings for busy administrators.
encapsulate.zh: 这些摘要浓缩了研究结论，方便忙碌的管理者阅读。

collapse.en: The old bridge collapsed after the flood weakened its foundations.
collapse.zh: 洪水削弱了旧桥的地基，桥随后倒塌了。

collapse.en: Talks collapsed when the two governments refused to compromise.
collapse.zh: 由于两国政府拒绝妥协，谈判破裂了。

collapse.en: Under the weight of snow the tent collapsed in seconds.
collapse.zh: 在积雪的重压下，帐篷几秒内就塌了。

virtually.en: Virtually every student in the course completed the final survey.
virtually.zh: 课程中几乎每个学生都完成了最终问卷。

virtually.en: Students can walk through a virtually reconstructed forum and inspect each building in detail.
virtually.zh: 学生可以穿行于虚拟重建的古广场，逐栋细看每座建筑。

virtually.en: Online collaboration has virtually replaced many local meetings.
virtually.zh: 在线协作实际上已经取代了许多线下会议。

advantageous.en: It is advantageous to submit the application before the deadline.
advantageous.zh: 在截止日期前提交申请是有利的。

advantageous.en: The university offers advantageous terms for students from partner schools.
advantageous.zh: 该校为合作学校的学生提供优惠条件。

advantageous.en: Living near campus proved advantageous during the busy recruitment season.
advantageous.zh: 在招聘旺季住在校园附近被证明很有好处。

denote.en: In this table the symbol denotes a missing measurement.
denote.zh: 在此表格中，该符号表示数据缺失。

denote.en: The blue line denotes the boundary of the study area.
denote.zh: 蓝线表示研究区域的边界。

denote.en: Such terms often denote concepts that resist simple definition.
denote.zh: 这类术语往往表示难以简单定义的概念。

schematic.en: The schematic diagram shows every connection in the circuit.
schematic.zh: 这张示意图显示电路中的每一处连接。

schematic.en: A schematic drawing is more useful than a detailed plan here.
schematic.zh: 在这里，示意图比详细图纸更有用。

schematic.en: The report provides a schematic overview of the entire procedure.
schematic.zh: 该报告对整个流程给出了概略的说明。

diagram.en: Please label the components in the diagram before submission.
diagram.zh: 提交前请在图中标注各个部件。

diagram.en: The diagram illustrates how heat moves through the material.
diagram.zh: 这张图解说明了热量如何在材料中传导。

diagram.en: She drew a simple diagram to clarify the argument for students.
diagram.zh: 她画了一张简图，为学生澄清这一论点。

onerous.en: Preparing the annual report proved more onerous than expected.
onerous.zh: 准备年度报告被证明比预想的更加繁重。

onerous.en: The reviewers faced the onerous task of reading hundreds of submissions.
onerous.zh: 评审们面临阅读数百份投稿这一艰巨任务。

onerous.en: Current regulations place an onerous burden on small laboratories.
onerous.zh: 现行规定给小型实验室带来了沉重的负担。

inclined.en: Few economists are inclined to believe the trend will reverse soon.
inclined.zh: 很少有经济学家倾向于相信这一趋势会很快逆转。

inclined.en: She is inclined to accept the offer despite the modest salary.
inclined.zh: 尽管薪水不高，她仍倾向于接受这份工作。

inclined.en: The committee was inclined to postpone the decision until further evidence arrived.
inclined.zh: 委员会倾向于推迟决定，直到更多证据到来。

nevertheless.en: The method is complex; nevertheless, it produces highly reliable results.
nevertheless.zh: 这种方法很复杂，但它仍能产生非常可靠的结果。

nevertheless.en: Nevertheless, the authors acknowledge two significant limitations in their model.
nevertheless.zh: 尽管如此，作者承认其模型存在两项重大局限。

nevertheless.en: The evidence is limited, but nevertheless it points in one direction.
nevertheless.zh: 证据有限，但它仍指向同一个方向。

criterion.en: Cost efficiency was the main criterion used to rank the proposals.
criterion.zh: 成本效益是用于对提案排序的主要标准。

criterion.en: Applicants must meet every criterion listed in the official guidelines.
criterion.zh: 申请人必须满足官方指南中列出的每一项标准。

criterion.en: The committee revised its criterion for awarding the scholarship.
criterion.zh: 委员会修订了授予奖学金的标准。

owe.en: The discovery owes much to decades of careful fieldwork.
owe.zh: 这一发现很大程度上要归功于数十年的细致田野调查。

owe.en: She owes her career to a chance encounter with an advisor.
owe.zh: 她把职业生涯归功于与一位导师的一次偶遇。

owe.en: The early results owe much to better laboratory equipment.
owe.zh: 早期结果很大程度上得益于更好的实验设备。

evaluate.en: We must evaluate the risks before adopting the new method.
evaluate.zh: 采用新方法之前我们必须评估风险。

evaluate.en: The panel will evaluate each application against published standards.
evaluate.zh: 评审小组将依据公布的标准评估每一份申请。

evaluate.en: Researchers evaluate the data with statistical software to ensure accuracy.
evaluate.zh: 研究人员使用统计软件评估数据，以确保准确性。

arise.en: New ethical questions arise whenever the technology is applied in schools.
arise.zh: 该技术应用于学校时，总会产生新的伦理问题。

arise.en: The opportunity to collaborate arose unexpectedly during the conference.
arise.zh: 在会议期间，合作的机会出人意料地出现了。

arise.en: A separate dispute arose between the two departments last spring.
arise.zh: 去年春天两个部门之间又起了一场争端。

indicate.en: The temperature curve indicates a rapid warming over the past decade.
indicate.zh: 温度曲线显示过去 10 年快速升温。

indicate.en: Her tone indicated that further discussion would be unwelcome.
indicate.zh: 她的语气表明进一步的讨论不会受欢迎。

indicate.en: Figures indicate that most participants preferred the online format.
indicate.zh: 数据表明大多数参与者更喜欢线上形式。

cutting-edge.en: The laboratory uses cutting-edge imaging to observe cellular processes.
cutting-edge.zh: 该实验室使用前沿的成像技术观察细胞过程。

cutting-edge.en: Cutting-edge research has transformed our understanding of the disease.
cutting-edge.zh: 最前沿的研究改变了我们对该疾病的认识。

cutting-edge.en: Her lecture covered several cutting-edge developments in artificial intelligence.
cutting-edge.zh: 她的讲座介绍了人工智能领域的若干尖端进展。

fraction.en: Only a small fraction of the applications received external review.
fraction.zh: 只有一小部分申请获得了外部评审。

fraction.en: The result improved by a fraction of a percentage point.
fraction.zh: 结果提高的幅度还不到一个百分点的零头。

fraction.en: She spent only a fraction of the budget on laboratory equipment.
fraction.zh: 她只用了预算的一小部分购置实验设备。

endowed with.en: The region is endowed with rich mineral resources and abundant rainfall.
endowed with.zh: 该地区拥有丰富的矿产资源和充足的降雨。

endowed with.en: Students endowed with curiosity often become the most productive researchers.
endowed with.zh: 天生具备好奇心的学生往往成为最高产的研究者。

endowed with.en: This species is endowed with an unusually strong immune system.
endowed with.zh: 这一物种天生具有异常强大的免疫系统。

progressively.en: As the sample grew, the estimates progressively converged toward the predicted value.
progressively.zh: 随着样本增加，估计值逐步收敛到预测值。

progressively.en: The disease has progressively weakened the animal's ability to forage.
progressively.zh: 这种疾病逐渐削弱了该动物觅食的能力。

progressively.en: Costs have risen progressively since the program began in 2019.
progressively.zh: 自 2019 年项目启动以来，成本日益攀升。

immensely.en: The discovery has immensely improved our understanding of early oceans.
immensely.zh: 这一发现极大地提升了我们对早期海洋的认识。

immensely.en: Her meticulous preparation contributed immensely to the project's success.
immensely.zh: 她一丝不苟的准备对项目的成功作出了极大贡献。

immensely.en: The online archive is immensely valuable to researchers across many disciplines.
immensely.zh: 该在线档案对众多学科的研究人员极为宝贵。

suppress.en: Certain chemicals can suppress plant growth when applied in excess.
suppress.zh: 某些化学物质使用过量时会抑制植物生长。

suppress.en: The editor suppressed the inflammatory passages from the final manuscript.
suppress.zh: 编辑从最终稿中删去了那些煽动性的段落。

suppress.en: Try to suppress your frustration when the deadline is moved again.
suppress.zh: 当截止日期再次变动时，尽量压住你的沮丧情绪。

profoundly.en: The discovery profoundly altered how scientists understood plant communication.
profoundly.zh: 这一发现深刻地改变了科学家对植物交流方式的理解。

profoundly.en: Her work profoundly influenced the design of modern irrigation systems.
profoundly.zh: 她的工作深刻影响了现代灌溉系统的设计。

profoundly.en: The policy change had a profoundly negative effect on small businesses.
profoundly.zh: 这项政策变动对小企业产生了极为负面的影响。

exemplify.en: These cases exemplify the wider trends documented across the industry.
exemplify.zh: 这些案例体现了整个行业中更为广泛的趋势。

exemplify.en: Her career exemplifies what a lifelong commitment to research can achieve.
exemplify.zh: 她的职业生涯体现了毕生投入研究能够取得的成就。

exemplify.en: I will exemplify the argument with two recent field studies.
exemplify.zh: 我将用两项最新的田野研究来举例说明这一论点。

illustrative.en: The following table is illustrative only and does not show every case.
illustrative.zh: 下面的表格仅作说明之用，并未涵盖所有情况。

illustrative.en: We selected several illustrative examples from the survey responses.
illustrative.zh: 我们从问卷回答中挑选了几个具有例证说明作用的例子。

illustrative.en: The case is highly illustrative of how local institutions resist reform.
illustrative.zh: 这一案例极好地说明了地方机构如何抵制改革。

cornerstone.en: Trust between researchers remains the cornerstone of any successful collaboration.
cornerstone.zh: 研究者之间的信任仍是任何成功合作的基石。

cornerstone.en: The cornerstone of the reform strategy was improved access to public records.
cornerstone.zh: 改革策略的基石是更好地获取公共档案。

cornerstone.en: Early language education forms the cornerstone of later academic achievement.
cornerstone.zh: 早期语言教育是日后学业成就的奠基石。

discard.en: Reviewers should discard preliminary notes that no longer support the argument.
discard.zh: 评审者应当丢弃不再支持论点的初步笔记。

discard.en: The engineers discarded the design because it exceeded the weight limit.
discard.zh: 工程师们弃用了那个设计，因为它超过了重量限制。

discard.en: It is wise to discard outdated assumptions before beginning the analysis.
discard.zh: 在开始分析之前，明智的做法是抛弃过时的假设。

provisional.en: The figures are provisional and will be revised after the audit.
provisional.zh: 这些数据是暂定的，将在审计后修订。

provisional.en: The council issued a provisional ban on construction near the wetland.
provisional.zh: 市议会发布了一项针对湿地附近施工的临时禁令。

provisional.en: A provisional agreement was reached before the formal negotiation began.
provisional.zh: 在正式谈判开始前，双方达成了初步协议。

temporary.en: The laboratory was housed in a temporary building during the renovation.
temporary.zh: 翻修期间实验室设在一栋临时建筑里。

temporary.en: This solution provides only a temporary fix for the underlying problem.
temporary.zh: 这种办法只是对根本问题的临时修补。

temporary.en: The clinic operates from a temporary site until the new wing opens.
temporary.zh: 在新楼翼启用前，诊所在临时场所运营。

temporal.en: The study examines temporal changes in vegetation over three decades.
temporal.zh: 该研究考察了 30 年来植被的时间变化。

temporal.en: Temporal resolution determines how precisely the instrument can record events.
temporal.zh: 时间分辨率决定了仪器记录事件的精确程度。

temporal.en: The model accounts for both spatial and temporal variability in rainfall.
temporal.zh: 该模型同时考虑了降水的空间变异和时间变异。

distinctive.en: The species has a distinctive call that researchers use to identify it.
distinctive.zh: 该物种有独特的叫声，研究者据此识别它。

distinctive.en: Her distinctive approach earned her a place on the editorial board.
distinctive.zh: 她独特的方法使她得以进入编辑委员会。

distinctive.en: Each region has a distinctive architectural style that reflects its history.
distinctive.zh: 每个地区都有反映其历史的独特建筑风格。

distinct.en: There is a distinct difference between correlation and causation in the data.
distinct.zh: 数据中相关性与因果性之间存在明显区别。

distinct.en: It is distinct from other studies because it follows participants for ten years.
distinct.zh: 它与其他研究明显不同，因为它跟踪参与者 10 年。

distinct.en: The two treatments produced distinct effects on plant growth rates.
distinct.zh: 这两种处理方式对植物生长速率产生了明显不同的影响。

harbor.en: The new law may harbor hidden risks for small businesses.
harbor.zh: 这项新法律可能潜藏着小企业面临的风险。

harbor.en: The dataset may harbor subtle errors that routine checks miss.
harbor.zh: 该数据集中可能潜藏着常规检查难以发现的细微错误。

harbor.en: Such criticism harbors little more than a personal grudge against the ministry.
harbor.zh: 这种批评不过是出于对部委的个人不满。

overlook.en: Many reviewers overlooked the methodological flaws buried in the study's appendix.
overlook.zh: 许多评论者忽视了该研究附录中潜藏的方法论缺陷。

overlook.en: It would be unwise to overlook the warning signs that preceded the financial crisis.
overlook.zh: 忽视金融危机前出现的预警信号是不明智的。

overlook.en: Her contributions to the field were so subtle that historians long overlooked them.
overlook.zh: 她对该领域的贡献十分微妙，以至于历史学家长期未加注意。

cascade.en: The small decision triggered a cascade of changes throughout the entire organization.
cascade.zh: 这个微小的决定在整个组织中引发了一连串变革。

cascade.en: A cascade of failures in the supply chain forced the manufacturer to delay its launch.
cascade.zh: 供应链中接连不断的故障迫使制造商推迟了产品发布。

cascade.en: Researchers observed a cascade of effects as the new policy reduced regional inequality.
cascade.zh: 随着新政策减少了地区不平等，研究人员观察到了一连串效应。

crucial.en: Peer review is crucial for maintaining the credibility of published research.
crucial.zh: 同行评审对于维护已发表研究的公信力至关重要。

crucial.en: The missing consent forms were crucial to the validity of the entire trial.
crucial.zh: 缺失的知情同意书对整个试验的有效性至关重要。

crucial.en: Early investment in training proved crucial when the project faced rapid changes.
crucial.zh: 早期在培训上的投入在项目面临快速变化时被证明是至关重要的。

heuristic.en: The team developed a heuristic for estimating costs without a full market survey.
heuristic.zh: 团队制定了一套无需全面市场调查即可估算成本的启发式方法。

heuristic.en: Such heuristic reasoning works well for routine tasks but fails under pressure.
heuristic.zh: 这种启发式推理在日常任务中效果良好，但在压力之下会失效。

heuristic.en: Students apply a simple heuristic when choosing sources for their first essay.
heuristic.zh: 学生为第一篇论文选择资料时会套用一个简单的启发式规则。

fragile.en: The peace agreement remains fragile despite months of careful negotiation.
fragile.zh: 尽管经过了数月的谨慎谈判，协议仍然十分脆弱。

fragile.en: These conclusions are fragile because the sample size was quite small.
fragile.zh: 由于样本量很小，这些结论并不牢靠。

fragile.en: The exhibition requires fragile glass objects to be transported with extreme care.
fragile.zh: 这次展览要求易碎的玻璃器皿在运输中格外小心。

recipe.en: Mentorship and honest feedback form the recipe for long-term professional growth.
recipe.zh: 指导与诚实的反馈构成了职业长期成长的秘诀。

recipe.en: The team followed an unconventional recipe for rebuilding the aging infrastructure.
recipe.zh: 团队遵循了一套非常规的方法来重建老旧的基础设施。

recipe.en: Her success recipe combines rigorous training with a willingness to fail often.
recipe.zh: 她的成功秘诀结合了严格训练与不怕反复失败的意愿。

prestigious.en: Publishing in the journal offers access to a highly prestigious academic community.
prestigious.zh: 在该期刊发表论文可以进入一个享有盛名的学术共同体。

prestigious.en: He was appointed to a prestigious chair at the national research council.
prestigious.zh: 他被任命担任国家研究委员会中一个显赫的职位。

prestigious.en: The prestigious award encouraged many young scholars to keep pursuing their work.
prestigious.zh: 这一有声望的奖项鼓励许多年轻学者继续投入自己的研究。

excess.en: An excess of sugar in the diet is linked to several chronic conditions.
excess.zh: 饮食中糖分过量与多种慢性疾病有关。

excess.en: The laboratory reported an excess of false positives in its screening protocol.
excess.zh: 实验室报告称其筛查方案中假阳性过多。

excess.en: The lab discarded the excess reagents after the final assay run.
excess.zh: 实验室丢弃了最后一轮检测后剩余的多余试剂。

aforementioned.en: The aforementioned study provides strong evidence for this conclusion.
aforementioned.zh: 上述研究为这一结论提供了有力证据。

aforementioned.en: We return to the aforementioned issue in the final section of this chapter.
aforementioned.zh: 在本章最后一节，我们回到前面提到的那个问题。

aforementioned.en: The aforementioned costs must be recovered before any expansion can begin.
aforementioned.zh: 上述成本必须在任何扩张开始之前得到补偿。

disparate.en: The program brings together researchers from disparate fields such as physics and sociology.
disparate.zh: 该计划汇集了来自物理学与社会学等迥然不同领域的研究者。

disparate.en: Students with disparate learning backgrounds need additional scaffolding during the first term.
disparate.zh: 学习背景迥然不同的学生在第一学期需要额外的支架式支持。

disparate.en: These disparate datasets cannot be merged without a common classification scheme.
disparate.zh: 这些差异极大的数据集若没有统一的分类方案就无法合并。

paradigmatic.en: Her study of urban migration remains paradigmatic for later generations of historians.
paradigmatic.zh: 她关于城市移民的研究为后世历史学家树立了典范。

paradigmatic.en: The case became a paradigmatic illustration of institutional failure in public health.
paradigmatic.zh: 该案例成为公共卫生制度失灵的典型例证。

paradigmatic.en: Critics described his experiments as paradigmatic of the era's methodological limits.
paradigmatic.zh: 评论者称他的实验是该时代方法论局限的典型写照。

quantify.en: Researchers must quantify the emissions before comparing the two design proposals.
quantify.zh: 研究人员必须先量化排放量，然后才能比较这两种设计方案。

quantify.en: It is difficult to quantify the long-term benefit of early childhood education.
quantify.zh: 早期儿童教育的长期收益很难量化。

quantify.en: The report quantifies the financial risk of ignoring the aging infrastructure.
quantify.zh: 该报告量化了忽视基础设施老化所带来的财务风险。

self-contained.en: Each chapter is self-contained and can be read independently by students.
self-contained.zh: 每一章都自成一体，学生可以独立阅读。

self-contained.en: The village operates a self-contained energy system with no external supply.
self-contained.zh: 该村运行着一套完全自给自足、不依赖外部供应的能源系统。

self-contained.en: The review article is self-contained and requires no prior reading.
self-contained.zh: 这篇综述文章自成一体，无需事先阅读其他材料。

preliminary.en: Preliminary results suggest that the new compound reduces inflammation in laboratory models.
preliminary.zh: 初步结果表明这种新化合物可减少实验室模型中的炎症。

preliminary.en: A preliminary study of two hundred workers was conducted before the full trial.
preliminary.zh: 在全面试验之前，对 200 名工人进行了一项初步研究。

preliminary.en: The report offers preliminary conclusions, since long-term data are still pending.
preliminary.zh: 由于长期数据尚未到位，该报告只给出初步结论。

interchangeably.en: These two terms are often used interchangeably, although they differ subtly.
interchangeably.zh: 这两个术语常被互换使用，尽管它们有细微差别。

interchangeably.en: The drug and the supplement may be taken interchangeably for mild symptoms.
interchangeably.zh: 该药物与补充剂在缓解轻微症状时可交替使用。

interchangeably.en: In this framework, micro and nano scales are treated interchangeably for simplicity.
interchangeably.zh: 在这一框架中，出于简化考虑，微观与纳米尺度被等同处理。

popularize.en: Public lectures helped popularize quantum computing among high school teachers.
popularize.zh: 公开讲座帮助在高中教师中推广了量子计算。

popularize.en: The museum popularizes traditional weaving through hands-on workshops for children.
popularize.zh: 该博物馆通过面向儿童的动手工作坊推广传统编织技艺。

popularize.en: Her novel popularized the study of memory across a generation of readers.
popularize.zh: 她的小说在一代读者中普及了对记忆的研究。

primarily.en: The program was designed primarily to reduce regional disparities in healthcare access.
primarily.zh: 该项目主要旨在减少医疗服务获取方面的地区差距。

primarily.en: Revenue comes primarily from subscriptions rather than one-time purchases.
primarily.zh: 收入主要来自订阅而非一次性购买。

primarily.en: The exhibition focuses primarily on manuscripts produced during the sixteenth century.
primarily.zh: 该展览主要聚焦于 16 世纪产生的手稿。

specify.en: Please specify the sample size and the statistical model in your abstract.
specify.zh: 请在摘要中明确说明样本量和统计模型。

specify.en: The contract specifies that all data must be stored on approved servers.
specify.zh: 合同规定所有数据必须存储在经批准的服务器上。

specify.en: Researchers should specify their exclusion criteria before collecting any data.
specify.zh: 研究人员应在收集数据前明确说明其排除标准。

obstruct.en: Fallen branches obstructed the narrow mountain path for several hours.
obstruct.zh: 倒下的树枝堵塞了狭窄的山路达数小时之久。

obstruct.en: Large vehicles frequently obstruct traffic in the narrow streets downtown.
obstruct.zh: 大型车辆经常在市中心狭窄的街道上阻塞交通。

obstruct.en: The committee worried that political objections might obstruct the entire reform process.
obstruct.zh: 委员会担心政治反对意见会阻碍整个改革进程。

snapshot.en: The photograph provides a snapshot of rural life in the early twentieth century.
snapshot.zh: 这张照片提供了 20 世纪初乡村生活的一个快照。

snapshot.en: Our survey offers only a snapshot of current student attitudes.
snapshot.zh: 我们的调查只是对当前学生态度的即时快照。

snapshot.en: This application takes a snapshot of the screen whenever an error appears.
snapshot.zh: 该应用程序在出现错误时会截取屏幕快照。

spark.en: A single lecture provided the spark that ignited her interest in the history of medieval medicine.
spark.zh: 一场讲座提供了点燃她对中世纪医学史兴趣的火花。

spark.en: The discovery of the archive was the spark that launched her career.
spark.zh: 这批档案的发现成为开启她职业生涯的契机。

spark.en: The spark of curiosity in young readers is best nurtured through open-ended questions.
spark.zh: 年轻读者心中的好奇心火花最好通过开放式问题来培养。

diverse.en: The city hosts a diverse population from more than ninety different countries.
diverse.zh: 这座城市拥有来自九十多个国家的多元人口。

diverse.en: The seminar welcomes diverse academic backgrounds rather than a single tradition.
diverse.zh: 该研讨会欢迎多元的学术背景，而非局限于单一传统。

diverse.en: Policy makers must consider diverse needs when designing rural transport networks.
diverse.zh: 政策制定者在设计农村交通网络时必须考虑多样的需求。

encompass.en: The revised curriculum encompasses both theoretical and applied aspects of economics.
encompass.zh: 修订后的课程涵盖了经济学的理论与应用两个方面。

encompass.en: The summit's agenda encompassed climate, migration, and financial regulation.
encompass.zh: 峰会的议程涵盖了气候、移民和金融监管等议题。

encompass.en: Her research encompasses the history of medicine in three different cultures.
encompass.zh: 她的研究涵盖了三种不同文化中的医学史。

articulate.en: Effective leaders must articulate complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
articulate.zh: 有效的领导者必须向不同的受众清楚表达复杂观点。

articulate.en: She articulated her concerns about data privacy in a single paragraph.
articulate.zh: 她用一段话清楚表达了对数据隐私的担忧。

articulate.en: The report articulates why the proposed reforms are urgently needed.
articulate.zh: 该报告清楚地说明了为何迫切需要这些改革。

multifaceted.en: Climate change is a multifaceted problem spanning economics, science, and politics.
multifaceted.zh: 气候变化是一个涵盖经济、科学与政治的多方面问题。

multifaceted.en: The interview reveals a multifaceted personality combining warmth and sharp criticism.
multifaceted.zh: 这次访谈展现了一个兼具温情与尖锐批判的多面个性。

multifaceted.en: Assessing the case required a multifaceted approach drawn from several disciplines.
multifaceted.zh: 评估此案需要一种融合多个学科的多方面的方法。

instrumental.en: Mentorship was instrumental in her transition from technician to senior engineer.
instrumental.zh: 指导工作在她的从技术员到高级工程师的转变中起到了关键作用。

instrumental.en: Early exposure to laboratory work proved instrumental for developing her scientific curiosity.
instrumental.zh: 早期接触实验室工作对培养她的科学好奇心起到了重要作用。

instrumental.en: The mediators were instrumental in resolving the dispute between the two departments.
instrumental.zh: 调解人在解决两个部门之间的争端中发挥了关键作用。

underpin.en: Solid evidence underpins every conclusion drawn in the final chapter.
underpin.zh: 扎实可靠的证据构成了最后一章全部结论的基础。

underpin.en: Trust between researchers underpins the open publication model adopted by the journal.
underpin.zh: 研究者之间的信任构成了该期刊所采用的开放出版模式的基础。

underpin.en: Careful fieldwork underpins the argument that the trade route extended further north.
underpin.zh: 细致的田野调查支撑了贸易路线更向北延伸这一论点。

groundbreaking.en: Her groundbreaking work on gene editing reshaped research in the field.
groundbreaking.zh: 她在基因编辑方面的开创性工作重塑了该领域的研究。

groundbreaking.en: The institute announced a groundbreaking method for storing renewable energy.
groundbreaking.zh: 该研究所宣布了一种用于储存可再生能源的开创性方法。

groundbreaking.en: His groundbreaking paper remains required reading in doctoral seminars today.
groundbreaking.zh: 他那篇开创性的论文至今仍是博士研讨课的必读材料。

insofar as.en: The model is reliable insofar as the training data remain representative.
insofar as.zh: 就训练数据仍具有代表性而言，该模型是可靠的。

insofar as.en: She agrees insofar as the proposal addresses the funding problem directly.
insofar as.zh: 就该提案直接解决资金问题而言，她表示同意。

insofar as.en: The policy permits anonymized publication insofar as all identifying details have been removed.
insofar as.zh: 只要所有可识别身份的信息均已删除，该政策即允许以匿名方式发表。

nascent.en: Nascent industries require patient capital and long-term regulatory support.
nascent.zh: 新兴产业需要耐心的资本和长期的监管支持。

nascent.en: The nascent democracy movement quickly organized across the capital's university districts.
nascent.zh: 新兴的民主运动很快在首都的大学城区组织起来。

nascent.en: Researchers described the technology as a nascent field with few established methods.
nascent.zh: 研究人员把这项技术描述为一个尚无成熟方法的新兴领域。

advance.en: Public investment helped advance the deployment of clean energy across the region.
advance.zh: 公共投资促进了这个地区清洁能源的部署。

advance.en: The committee advanced the proposal after a lengthy and careful debate.
advance.zh: 经过长时间而细致的辩论，委员会推进了这项提案。

advance.en: New microscopy techniques advanced our understanding of cellular repair mechanisms.
advance.zh: 新的显微技术推进了我们对细胞修复机制的理解。

perspective.en: Studying the same archive from a different perspective revealed unexpected patterns.
perspective.zh: 从不同角度研究同一批档案，揭示了意想不到的规律。

perspective.en: Her interdisciplinary perspective strengthened the central argument considerably.
perspective.zh: 她的跨学科视角显著增强了核心论证的说服力。

perspective.en: Students gain valuable perspective by examining primary sources rather than summaries.
perspective.zh: 通过查阅原始资料而非摘要，学生能获得宝贵的视角。

radical.en: The proposal calls for radical reform of the way research grants are allocated.
radical.zh: 该提案要求对研究经费的分配方式做出根本性改革。

radical.en: Such a radical change would demand substantial investment and political courage.
radical.zh: 如此激进的变革需要大量投资和政治勇气。

radical.en: Critics worried that the radical tone of the article discouraged moderate debate.
radical.zh: 评论者担心这篇文章的激进语气妨碍了温和的讨论。

in-depth.en: The journal published an in-depth review of twenty years of climate data.
in-depth.zh: 该期刊发表了一篇关于 20 年气候数据的深入综述。

in-depth.en: Students must complete an in-depth analysis of one primary source.
in-depth.zh: 学生必须完成对一份原始资料的深入分析。

in-depth.en: Our in-depth interviews revealed how teachers adapted to the new curriculum.
in-depth.zh: 我们的深入访谈揭示了教师们如何适应新课程。

stimulate.en: Competitive funding grants stimulate research in neglected fields of study.
stimulate.zh: 竞争性资助资金能促进冷门研究领域的发展。

stimulate.en: The exhibition was designed to stimulate discussion about urban development.
stimulate.zh: 这次展览旨在激发关于城市发展的讨论。

stimulate.en: Lower interest rates may stimulate consumer spending during the coming quarter.
stimulate.zh: 较低的利率可能在下个季度刺激消费者支出。

diversify.en: Funds helped diversify the portfolio and reduce exposure to a single market.
diversify.zh: 这些资金帮助使投资组合多元化，降低了单一市场的风险敞口。

diversify.en: Universities should diversify their student recruitment beyond traditional feeder schools.
diversify.zh: 大学应将招生来源拓展到传统生源学校以外，实现多元化。

diversify.en: Smallholders diversify their crops to protect against unpredictable seasonal rainfall.
diversify.zh: 小农户通过作物多样化来抵御不可预测的季节性降雨。

sustain.en: The scholarship fund sustains the program for students from low-income families.
sustain.zh: 该奖学金基金维持着面向低收入家庭学生的项目运转。

sustain.en: Careful conservation work has sustained the forest ecosystem for decades.
sustain.zh: 细致的保护工作使这片森林生态系统维持了数十年。

sustain.en: The region cannot sustain such rapid growth without substantial investment in infrastructure.
sustain.zh: 没有对基础设施的大量投资，无法维持如此快速的增长。

invaluable.en: The archived interviews proved invaluable for reconstructing the early history of the movement.
invaluable.zh: 这些存档访谈对于重建该运动早期历史极为宝贵。

invaluable.en: Her feedback was invaluable when we were preparing the manuscript for publication.
invaluable.zh: 在我们准备出版手稿时，她的反馈极为宝贵。

invaluable.en: Students often find that peer discussion is an invaluable way to clarify difficult ideas.
invaluable.zh: 学生们常发现同伴讨论是澄清疑难概念的一种极有价值的方式。

superior.en: This method produces results that are superior to those obtained by conventional treatment.
superior.zh: 这种方法所得结果优于传统处理方法获得的结果。

superior.en: A superior court ruling clarified the obligations of the licensing board.
superior.zh: 上级法院的一项裁决明确了许可委员会的义务。

superior.en: She argued that the new framework offers a superior alternative to traditional classroom teaching.
superior.zh: 她认为这一新框架为传统课堂教学提供了更优的替代方案。

entail.en: Accepting the position entails a long-term commitment to fieldwork abroad.
entail.zh: 接受这个职位意味着要长期承诺在国外做实地研究。

entail.en: Such a decision inevitably entails considerable risk for the entire organization.
entail.zh: 这样的决定不可避免地会给整个组织带来相当大的风险。

entail.en: The revised model entails fewer assumptions than the original formulation.
entail.zh: 修订后的模型比原来的表述所包含的假设更少。

route.en: The most direct route to academic success lies in steady daily practice.
route.zh: 通往学术成功的最直接途径在于持之以恒的日常练习。

route.en: Diplomats searched for a route that would ease tensions between the two countries.
route.zh: 外交官们寻找一条能缓和两国紧张关系的途径。

route.en: Survey teams mapped the safest route across the collapsing glacier.
route.zh: 勘测队标出了穿越这座正在崩解的冰川的最安全路线。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding the limited funding, the team completed the survey ahead of schedule.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管资金有限，团队仍提前完成了调查。

notwithstanding.en: The agreement was signed notwithstanding objections raised by several committee members.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管数名委员会成员提出反对意见，协议仍被签署。

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding these initial setbacks, the laboratory produced consistent results thereafter.
notwithstanding.zh: 尽管起初遭遇挫折，实验室此后仍取得了稳定的实验结果。

versatile.en: This versatile instrument can measure temperature, pressure, and humidity simultaneously.
versatile.zh: 这台多用途仪器可以同时测量温度、气压和湿度。

versatile.en: She is a versatile researcher who works across linguistics and computer science.
versatile.zh: 她是一位多才多艺的研究者，涉足语言学与计算机科学两个领域。

versatile.en: The material is highly versatile and suits both industrial and domestic applications.
versatile.zh: 这种材料用途极为广泛，既适用于工业也适用于家庭用途。

catalog.en: The library catalog records every title acquired during the past decade.
catalog.zh: 图书馆的目录记录了过去 10 年间购入的所有藏书。

catalog.en: Researchers consulted the manuscript catalog before requesting rare documents.
catalog.zh: 研究人员在申请珍贵文献之前查阅了手稿目录。

catalog.en: The museum published a catalog of the exhibition, including detailed photographs.
catalog.zh: 博物馆出版了展览目录，其中包含详细照片。

notable.en: The journal published a notable study on early childhood language development.
notable.zh: 该期刊发表了一项关于早期儿童语言发展的值得注意的研究。

notable.en: Several notable scholars contributed chapters to the edited volume.
notable.zh: 几位知名学者为这部论文集撰写了章节。

notable.en: A notable exception to this rule appears in the third edition.
notable.zh: 这一规则的显著例外出现在第三版中。

scenario.en: The researchers simulated several scenarios to test the model's robustness.
scenario.zh: 研究人员模拟了若干情景来检验该模型的稳健性。

scenario.en: Under the worst-case scenario, the program would exceed its budget.
scenario.zh: 在最糟糕的情况下，该项目将超出预算。

scenario.en: This scenario assumes that public demand continues to grow for the next decade.
scenario.zh: 这一设想假定未来 10 年公众需求将持续增长。

evolution.en: The evolution of the language over three centuries is well documented.
evolution.zh: 该语言三个世纪以来的演变有充分的文献记录。

evolution.en: Darwin's theory of evolution transformed how biologists understand species.
evolution.zh: 达尔文的进化论改变了生物学家理解物种的方式。

evolution.en: The conference traced the evolution of modern accounting standards since 1970.
evolution.zh: 会议追溯了现代会计准则自 1970 年以来的演变。

exaggeration.en: The report dismisses widespread claims of disaster as gross exaggeration.
exaggeration.zh: 该报告认为有关灾难的普遍说法是严重夸大。

exaggeration.en: Careful handling of the data prevented exaggeration in the team's conclusions.
exaggeration.zh: 谨慎处理数据使团队在结论中避免了夸大其词。

exaggeration.en: Popular accounts of the trial often contain exaggeration and little factual accuracy.
exaggeration.zh: 关于该试验的通俗叙述往往夸大其词，且几乎没有事实准确性。

consist in.en: The success of the experiment consists in careful control of temperature.
consist in.zh: 实验的成功在于对温度的精确控制。

consist in.en: Its distinctive advantage consists in the clarity of the underlying method.
consist in.zh: 它的显著优势在于其底层方法的清晰性。

consist in.en: The value of the archive consists in the letters it preserves for historians.
consist in.zh: 该档案的价值在于它为历史学家保存下来的书信。

correspondence.en: There is a clear correspondence between rainfall levels and the growth of crops.
correspondence.zh: 降雨量与作物生长之间存在明显的对应关系。

correspondence.en: The new instrument establishes a direct correspondence between sound and electrical signals.
correspondence.zh: 这种新仪器在声音与电信号之间建立了直接对应关系。

correspondence.en: The editor's correspondence with her overseas peers spans three decades of the journal's history.
correspondence.zh: 这位编辑与海外同行的通信往来横跨该刊 30 年的历史。

collaborative.en: The project was built on a collaborative effort between four universities.
collaborative.zh: 该项目建立在四所大学协作努力的基础上。

collaborative.en: Teachers find that collaborative writing improves student engagement considerably.
collaborative.zh: 教师们发现合作式写作能显著提高学生的参与度。

collaborative.en: A collaborative agreement allows the two institutes to share laboratory facilities.
collaborative.zh: 一项合作协议允许这两个研究所共享实验设施。

interface.en: The user interface allows researchers to filter results by date and author.
interface.zh: 该用户界面使研究人员能够按日期和作者筛选结果。

interface.en: Data from the sensors enters the database through a standard interface.
interface.zh: 传感器收集的数据通过标准接口进入数据库。

interface.en: The interface between theory and practice remains poorly understood in this field.
interface.zh: 理论与实践之间的交汇关系在这一领域仍不甚明了。

concept.en: The concept of fairness must be defined before any ranking system can be evaluated.
concept.zh: 在评估任何排名体系之前，必须先界定公平这一概念。

concept.en: Students struggled to grasp the concept introduced in the opening lecture.
concept.zh: 学生们难以理解开场讲座中提出的概念。

concept.en: Her early work introduced the concept of memory that still guides cognitive science.
concept.zh: 她的早期工作提出了记忆的概念，该概念至今仍指导着认知科学的发展。

daunting.en: Reconstructing the original text posed a daunting challenge for the team.
daunting.zh: 重建原文对团队来说是一项令人畏惧的挑战。

daunting.en: She faced the daunting task of organizing the conference alone.
daunting.zh: 她独自承担了组织会议的艰巨任务。

daunting.en: The daunting list of remaining errors kept the reviewers working late.
daunting.zh: 剩余错误清单令人望而生畏，审稿人不得不加班工作。

long-standing.en: The university is addressing a long-standing complaint about faculty workloads.
long-standing.zh: 该大学正在处理一个关于教师工作量的长期投诉。

long-standing.en: This agreement resolves several long-standing disputes between the two companies.
long-standing.zh: 该协议解决了这两家公司之间几项由来已久的争端。

long-standing.en: The topic has attracted long-standing interest among historians of the period.
long-standing.zh: 这一主题长期以来吸引着研究该时期的历史学家。

progress.en: Steady progress in the laboratory has brought the project close to completion.
progress.zh: 实验室的稳步进展使该项目接近完成。

progress.en: The committee met to review progress toward the year's stated objectives.
progress.zh: 委员会开会审议朝向年度既定目标的进展。

progress.en: Despite limited funding, the team made considerable progress during the summer.
progress.zh: 尽管资金有限，团队在夏季仍取得了相当大的进展。

mounting.en: Mounting pressure from reviewers forced the authors to revise their argument.
mounting.zh: 来自审稿人的压力不断增大，迫使作者修改了论点。

mounting.en: There is mounting evidence that the new treatment reduces recovery time.
mounting.zh: 越来越多的证据表明这种新疗法可缩短恢复时间。

mounting.en: The company faces mounting costs as energy prices continue to rise.
mounting.zh: 随着能源价格持续上涨，该公司面临不断增加的成本。

intervene.en: The central bank intervened to stabilize the currency during the crisis.
intervene.zh: 央行在危机期间进行了干预以稳定货币。

intervene.en: A mediator was asked to intervene in the dispute between the two departments.
intervene.zh: 一名调解人被要求调停两个部门之间的争端。

intervene.en: Researchers intervened early, preventing the minor fault from spreading.
intervene.zh: 研究人员及早进行了干预，防止了小故障扩散。

suffice.en: The available evidence does not suffice to establish a causal link.
suffice.zh: 现有证据不足以确立因果联系。

suffice.en: A brief summary will suffice for purposes of the committee review.
suffice.zh: 就委员会审议而言，一份简要总结就足够了。

suffice.en: Two careful experiments suffice to confirm the pattern we observed.
suffice.zh: 两次细致的实验就足以证实我们观察到的规律。

contemporary.en: The exhibition juxtaposes contemporary art with seventeenth-century portraits.
contemporary.zh: 该展览将当代艺术与 17 世纪的肖像画并置展出。

contemporary.en: Contemporary scholarship has challenged the assumptions of the older literature.
contemporary.zh: 当代研究已对旧有文献中的假设提出质疑。

contemporary.en: Researchers checked the narrative against several contemporary chronicles and tax rolls.
contemporary.zh: 研究人员将该叙述与数部同时期的编年史和税册进行了核对。

concerned.en: Several faculty members are concerned about the proposed reduction in funding.
concerned.zh: 几位教师对拟议中的经费削减感到担忧。

concerned.en: The institutions concerned were asked to submit their figures before June.
concerned.zh: 有关机构被要求在六月之前提交其数据。

concerned.en: The committee was concerned over the inconsistent data in the appendix.
concerned.zh: 委员会对附录中前后不一致的数据感到担忧。

conservation.en: The law requires energy conservation in every industrial process.
conservation.zh: 法律要求在每一个工业过程中节约能源。

conservation.en: Conservation of momentum explains why the puck slows after the collision.
conservation.zh: 动量守恒解释了冰球在碰撞后为何减速。

conservation.en: Wetland conservation along the coast reduced flood damage in three towns.
conservation.zh: 沿海的湿地保护减轻了三个城镇的洪水损失。

evade.en: The suspect attempted to evade responsibility for the damage.
evade.zh: 嫌疑人试图逃避对损坏所应承担的责任。

evade.en: Taxpayers found creative ways to evade the new reporting requirement.
evade.zh: 纳税人想出各种办法规避这项新的申报要求。

evade.en: Careful questioning helped the investigators see through his attempt to evade the question.
evade.zh: 谨慎的盘问帮助调查人员看穿了他回避问题的企图。

cement.en: The agreement cemented a long-term relationship between the two research groups.
cement.zh: 该协议巩固了两个研究小组之间的长期关系。

cement.en: Their shared work cemented the reputation of the laboratory across Europe.
cement.zh: 他们的共同工作巩固了该实验室在整个欧洲的声誉。

cement.en: Restorers used a lime mortar to cement the loose stones back in place.
cement.zh: 修复人员用石灰砂浆把松动的石块重新黏合固定。

delineate.en: The authors delineate three distinct stages within the historical period studied.
delineate.zh: 作者勾勒出所研究的历史时期内的三个不同阶段。

delineate.en: The new report delineates the boundaries of the protected area clearly.
delineate.zh: 新报告清楚地划定了保护区的边界。

delineate.en: Her lecture delineated the differences between the two competing theories.
delineate.zh: 她的讲座阐明了两种相互竞争理论之间的差异。

specialize.en: She specializes in medieval history, particularly the history of monasteries.
specialize.zh: 她专攻中世纪史，尤其是修道院史。

specialize.en: The hospital specializes in cardiac surgery and serves a wide region.
specialize.zh: 这家医院专门从事心脏手术，服务于广大地区。

specialize.en: Many graduates specialize in areas where demand far exceeds supply.
specialize.zh: 许多毕业生专门从事需求远超供给的领域。

coincide.en: Her estimates coincide closely with figures from two independent surveys.
coincide.zh: 她的估算与两项独立调查的数据高度吻合。

coincide.en: Her arrival coincided with a sudden drop in enrollment numbers.
coincide.zh: 她的到来恰逢入学人数突然下降。

coincide.en: The anniversary coincides almost exactly with the outbreak of the epidemic.
coincide.zh: 这个纪念日几乎与疫情爆发的时间完全重合。

coincidence.en: It was pure coincidence that the two economists met on that flight.
coincidence.zh: 两位经济学家在那趟航班上相遇纯属巧合。

coincidence.en: The coincidence of rising costs and falling revenue worried the board.
coincidence.zh: 成本上升与收入下降同时出现使董事会深感担忧。

coincidence.en: The discovery was a remarkable coincidence, since both teams worked independently.
coincidence.zh: 这一发现是个非凡的巧合，因为两个团队各自独立工作。

designate.en: The government designated three areas as protected research zones.
designate.zh: 政府将三个区域指定为受保护的研究区。

designate.en: She was designated chair of the working group on scientific integrity.
designate.zh: 她被指定为科学诚信工作组的负责人。

designate.en: The map uses symbols to designate stations that remain open year-round.
designate.zh: 该地图用符号标示全年开放的站点。

assertion.en: His assertion that the data were falsified was never supported by evidence.
assertion.zh: 他关于数据被伪造的断言从未得到证据支持。

assertion.en: The paper begins with a clear assertion of its central claim.
assertion.zh: 该论文开篇明确断言了其核心论点。

assertion.en: An unsupported assertion carries little weight in academic debate.
assertion.zh: 毫无根据的断言在学术辩论中分量很轻。

otherwise.en: The experiment would fail otherwise, since the controls are essential.
otherwise.zh: 控制组必不可少，否则实验就会失败。

otherwise.en: Please submit the form promptly; otherwise the request will be rejected.
otherwise.zh: 请尽快提交表格，否则申请将被驳回。

otherwise.en: The two cohorts differed in age; otherwise the groups were remarkably alike.
otherwise.zh: 两个队列除年龄不同外，在其他方面惊人地相似。

unless.en: The grant cannot be renewed unless the committee reviews the final report.
unless.zh: 除非委员会审阅最终报告，否则该资助无法续期。

unless.en: Data will not be published unless all participants give informed consent.
unless.zh: 除非所有参与者给出知情同意，否则数据将不予公布。

unless.en: The course requires advanced statistics unless a student holds an exemption.
unless.zh: 除非学生获得豁免，否则该课程要求具备高等统计知识。

remainder.en: The remainder of the funding was transferred to the following year.
remainder.zh: 剩余的资金被结转到下一年。

remainder.en: Reviewers accepted the argument, with the remainder of the manuscript edited lightly.
remainder.zh: 审稿人接受了该论点，手稿的其余部分只做了轻微修改。

remainder.en: The remainder of the samples will be stored at minus eighty degrees.
remainder.zh: 剩余的样本将保存在零下 80 度的环境中。

provided that.en: Access is granted provided that the researcher signs the data agreement.
provided that.zh: 只要研究人员签署数据协议，即可获得访问权限。

provided that.en: The fee may be waived provided that the applicant meets the income threshold.
provided that.zh: 只要申请人符合收入门槛，该费用即可免除。

provided that.en: Publication may continue provided that all conflicts of interest are disclosed.
provided that.zh: 只要披露所有利益冲突，出版即可继续进行。

emergence.en: The emergence of new antibiotics has transformed modern medical practice.
emergence.zh: 新型抗生素的出现改变了现代医学实践。

emergence.en: Researchers noted the emergence of resistance among previously susceptible bacterial strains.
emergence.zh: 研究人员注意到原本敏感的菌株出现了耐药性。

emergence.en: The conference addressed the emergence of new industries in rural regions.
emergence.zh: 会议讨论了农村地区新兴产业的涌现。

successively.en: Three senior engineers successively led the project during the following decade.
successively.zh: 在随后 10 年中，三位资深工程师先后领导该项目。

successively.en: The specimens were successively immersed in solutions of increasing concentration.
successively.zh: 这些标本被依次浸入浓度递增的溶液中。

successively.en: Her novels appeared successively and were each translated into several languages.
successively.zh: 她的小说接连出版，每一部都被译成数种语言。

whereby.en: The researchers introduced a new protocol, whereby samples were prepared more efficiently.
whereby.zh: 研究人员引入了一种新方法，由此样本制备得更加高效。

whereby.en: They developed a teaching framework, whereby students learn to evaluate evidence directly.
whereby.zh: 他们开发了一套教学框架，借此学生学会直接评估证据。

whereby.en: The company offers flexible hours, whereby staff can choose their own schedules.
whereby.zh: 公司提供弹性工作时间，员工因此可以自行安排日程。

conceal.en: The researchers attempted to conceal the true results of the experiment.
conceal.zh: 研究人员试图隐瞒实验的真实结果。

conceal.en: Thick fog concealed the mountain from the observers on the ridge.
conceal.zh: 浓雾使山脊上的观测者看不见那座山。

conceal.en: His calm expression concealed a deep frustration with the proposal.
conceal.zh: 他平静的表情掩盖了对该提案深深的不满。

pertinent.en: Please keep your comments pertinent to the main topic of discussion.
pertinent.zh: 请让你的评论紧扣讨论的主要话题。

pertinent.en: The judge ruled that evidence about character was not pertinent here.
pertinent.zh: 法官裁定有关品格的证据在此案中并不相干。

pertinent.en: She raised a pertinent question about how the data were collected.
pertinent.zh: 她提出了一个关于数据如何收集的切中要害的问题。

probabilistic.en: Modern risk assessment relies heavily on probabilistic models of behavior.
probabilistic.zh: 现代风险评估严重依赖基于概率的行为模型。

probabilistic.en: The probabilistic forecast suggests a sharp rise in demand.
probabilistic.zh: 这一基于概率的预测表明需求将急剧上升。

probabilistic.en: Researchers compared two probabilistic methods for estimating population growth.
probabilistic.zh: 研究人员比较了两种估计人口增长的概率方法。

govern.en: New regulations govern how laboratories handle biological samples.
govern.zh: 新的法规规定了实验室处理生物样本的方式。

govern.en: A single council governs both research funding and ethical approval.
govern.zh: 一个统一的委员会同时管理科研资助与伦理审批。

govern.en: Strict accounting standards govern the disclosure of research funding sources.
govern.zh: 严格的会计准则规范了研究经费来源的披露。

refer to.en: The following chapters refer to the theoretical framework introduced earlier.
refer to.zh: 接下来的章节参照了此前介绍的理论框架。

refer to.en: Consultants frequently refer to the 1998 guidelines when evaluating regional growth.
refer to.zh: 顾问在评估区域增长时经常援引 1998 年的指南。

refer to.en: Policy briefs frequently refer to these figures as the baseline for comparison.
refer to.zh: 政策简报经常把这些数字称为比较的基准。

exaggerate.en: The advertisement exaggerates the results of a small clinical trial.
exaggerate.zh: 该广告夸大了一项小型临床试验的结果。

exaggerate.en: Historians warned that later accounts tend to exaggerate colonial violence.
exaggerate.zh: 历史学家警告说，后来的记述往往会夸大殖民时期的暴力。

exaggerate.en: He exaggerated the difficulty of the task to avoid further responsibility.
exaggerate.zh: 他夸大了任务的困难程度，以逃避进一步的责任。

overwhelming.en: The survey produced an overwhelming response from graduate students.
overwhelming.zh: 这项问卷在研究生中引起了压倒性的反响。

overwhelming.en: She faced an overwhelming amount of administrative work each week.
overwhelming.zh: 她每周都要面对多得令人应接不暇的行政工作。

overwhelming.en: There is overwhelming evidence that early intervention improves outcomes.
overwhelming.zh: 有充分的证据表明早期干预能改善结果。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, the proposed design increases both cost and processing time.
furthermore.zh: 此外，所提出的设计既增加了成本，也延长了处理时间。

furthermore.en: The results were replicated elsewhere; furthermore, they were independently verified.
furthermore.zh: 该结果在别处得到了复现，此外还经过了独立核实。

furthermore.en: Furthermore, students who attended tutorials scored significantly better overall.
furthermore.zh: 而且，参加辅导课的学生总体成绩明显更好。

perpetual.en: The laboratory suffered a perpetual shortage of trained research assistants.
perpetual.zh: 该实验室长期缺乏训练有素的研究助理。

perpetual.en: Perpetual motion has fascinated inventors for centuries without scientific support.
perpetual.zh: 几个世纪以来，永动机一直吸引着发明家，却从未获得科学支持。

perpetual.en: She described the delay as a perpetual source of frustration for her team.
perpetual.zh: 她把这种延误描述为令她的团队长期沮丧的根源。

singular.en: Every document in the archive is assigned a singular identifier by the database.
singular.zh: 档案中的每份文件都由数据库分配了唯一的标识符。

singular.en: The singular form of this noun appears only in the earliest manuscripts.
singular.zh: 这个名词的单数形式只出现在最早的手稿中。

singular.en: Her contribution was singular: no other scholar had assembled so vast a corpus.
singular.zh: 她的贡献极为非凡：没有哪位学者曾汇集如此庞大的语料。

merge.en: The two departments will merge into a single administrative unit next year.
merge.zh: 这两个部门明年将合并为一个行政单位。

merge.en: The revised edition merges the appendices into the main body of the text.
merge.zh: 修订版把附录并入了正文。

merge.en: Small publishers merged their distribution networks to reduce shipping costs.
merge.zh: 几家小出版社合并了各自的配送网络以降低运输成本。

ample.en: The laboratory has ample funding to expand its sample collection.
ample.zh: 该实验室有充足的资金来扩充样本收藏。

ample.en: There was ample evidence to support the researchers' original hypothesis.
ample.zh: 有充分的证据支持研究人员的最初假设。

ample.en: The conference room offers ample space for poster presentations and discussion.
ample.zh: 会议室有充足的空间用于海报展示和讨论。

surge.en: Applications for the fellowship surged after the announcement was published.
surge.zh: 公告发布后，该研究奖学金的申请数量急剧上升。

surge.en: A surge in demand pushed electricity prices higher throughout the region.
surge.zh: 需求激增使整个地区的电价上涨。

surge.en: Seawater surged over the sea wall during the winter storm.
surge.zh: 冬季风暴期间，海水涌过了海堤。

intuitive.en: Her intuitive understanding of the data guided the early stages of the analysis.
intuitive.zh: 她对数据的直觉理解指导了分析的早期阶段。

intuitive.en: New users need an intuitive interface that requires no formal training.
intuitive.zh: 新用户需要一个无需正式培训即可上手的直观界面。

intuitive.en: The explanation remains intuitive even for readers without statistical background.
intuitive.zh: 即使没有统计学背景的读者，这个解释也很直观。

reinforce.en: The replication study reinforces the original team's conclusions about the treatment.
reinforce.zh: 该复现研究进一步证实了原研究团队关于该治疗的结论。

reinforce.en: Engineers added steel bands to reinforce the arch damaged in the earthquake.
reinforce.zh: 工程师加装钢箍，以加固地震中受损的拱门。

reinforce.en: These findings reinforce the argument that early screening reduces long-term costs.
reinforce.zh: 这些发现进一步证实了早期筛查能够降低长期成本的观点。

trajectory.en: The satellite followed a stable trajectory around the earth for two years.
trajectory.zh: 该卫星沿稳定轨迹绕地球运行了两年。

trajectory.en: Rising costs altered the project's trajectory from expansion to consolidation.
trajectory.zh: 成本上升改变了该项目从扩张转为整合的走向。

trajectory.en: Researchers tracked the trajectory of the disease across three regions.
trajectory.zh: 研究人员追踪了该疾病在三个地区的传播轨迹。

coordinate.en: The two teams coordinate their efforts through a shared digital workspace.
coordinate.zh: 两个团队通过共享的数字化工作空间协调工作。

coordinate.en: City planners must coordinate housing, transport, and environmental policy together.
coordinate.zh: 城市规划者必须协调住房、交通与环境政策。

coordinate.en: She coordinated the collection of samples from six partner laboratories.
coordinate.zh: 她协调了从六家合作实验室采集样本的工作。

impose.en: The new policy imposes strict limits on the use of personal data.
impose.zh: 新政策对个人数据的使用施加了严格限制。

impose.en: Regulators imposed heavy fines on two companies for safety violations.
impose.zh: 监管机构因安全违规对两家公司处以重罚。

impose.en: The board imposed additional requirements on applicants for the research grant.
impose.zh: 董事会对研究资助的申请者提出了额外要求。

trait.en: Patience is an essential trait for successful field research.
trait.zh: 耐心是野外研究取得成功的一项基本特质。

trait.en: Her openness to criticism is a trait that leaders rarely acquire.
trait.zh: 虚心接受批评是领导者很少具备的一种品质。

trait.en: The traits of the sample population limit how broadly the findings generalize.
trait.zh: 样本总体的特征限制了研究结论的推广范围。

whereas.en: The first model performs well on large datasets, whereas the second excels at speed.
whereas.zh: 第一个模型在大数据集上表现良好，而第二个模型则以速度见长。

whereas.en: Earlier studies assumed stability, whereas recent work reveals considerable variation.
whereas.zh: 早期研究假定存在稳定性，而近期工作显示出相当大的差异。

whereas.en: Public funding supports open research, whereas private sponsors often demand exclusivity.
whereas.zh: 公共资金支持开放研究，而私人资助者往往要求独占权。

originate.en: This method of measurement originated in nineteenth-century laboratory practice.
originate.zh: 这种测量方法起源于 19 世纪的实验室实践。

originate.en: Most of the debate about urban transport originated in the 1960s.
originate.zh: 关于城市交通的多数争论起源于 20 世纪 60 年代。

originate.en: The practice of peer review originated within small academic publishing circles.
originate.zh: 同行评审的惯例起源于小型学术出版圈。

latter.en: The latter half of the chapter discusses statistical inference in considerable detail.
latter.zh: 该章的后半部分相当详细地讨论了统计推断。

latter.en: Of the two proposals, we recommend the latter despite its higher initial cost.
latter.zh: 在两个提案中，尽管后者初期成本更高，我们仍推荐后者。

latter.en: The latter stages of the trial produced results that differed sharply.
latter.zh: 试验的后期阶段产生的结果差异显著。

distinguish.en: Researchers distinguish between correlation and causation in every analysis.
distinguish.zh: 研究人员在每项分析中都区分相关性与因果关系。

distinguish.en: The color scheme helps distinguish the two categories in the chart.
distinguish.zh: 这种配色方案有助于在图表中区分这两个类别。

distinguish.en: She distinguished herself by releasing the complete dataset years ahead of schedule.
distinguish.zh: 她提前数年发布完整数据集，由此崭露头角。

confront.en: The department must confront the problem of declining student enrollment.
confront.zh: 该系必须面对学生人数下降的问题。

confront.en: New staff will confront several challenges during their first year.
confront.zh: 新员工在第一年将面临若干挑战。

confront.en: The report confronts the ethical risks associated with large-scale data collection.
confront.zh: 该报告直面大规模数据采集所带来的伦理风险。

coin.en: The phrase was coined by a journalist during an interview in 1994.
coin.zh: 这一说法是某位记者在 1994 年的一次采访中创造出来的。

coin.en: Researchers coined a new term to describe this unusual pattern of growth.
coin.zh: 研究人员创造了一个新术语来描述这种不寻常的增长模式。

coin.en: The marketing team coined the slogan during a late-night brainstorming session.
coin.zh: 市场营销团队在一次深夜头脑风暴中创造了这个标语。

via.en: The shipment reached the warehouse via Singapore rather than the usual port.
via.zh: 货物经由新加坡而非通常的港口抵达仓库。

via.en: Students can access the archive via the university library network.
via.zh: 学生可以通过大学图书馆网络访问档案。

via.en: The researchers communicated their findings via a preprint server.
via.zh: 研究人员通过预印本服务器发布了他们的研究结果。

revisit.en: The commission will revisit the question of funding for regional libraries.
revisit.zh: 委员会将重新审视为区域图书馆提供资金的问题。

revisit.en: We plan to revisit this theory once the new data arrive.
revisit.zh: 新数据到达后，我们计划重新审视这一理论。

revisit.en: Many scholars revisited the archive to check the disputed photographs.
revisit.zh: 许多学者重新查阅档案，以核实那些有争议的照片。

remarkable.en: The lab recorded a remarkable improvement in the quality of the measurements.
remarkable.zh: 实验室记录到测量质量的显著提升。

remarkable.en: It is remarkable that the two estimates agree within a fraction of a percent.
remarkable.zh: 值得注意的是，这两个估计值的差异不到 1%。

remarkable.en: Her remarkable ability to explain statistics won over the entire department.
remarkable.zh: 她非凡的统计学讲解能力赢得了整个系的好感。

analogy.en: The researcher drew an analogy between the immune system and a national defense system.
analogy.zh: 研究者把免疫系统与国防体系作了类比。

analogy.en: Teaching by analogy helps beginners grasp unfamiliar technical concepts quickly.
analogy.zh: 通过类比教学能帮助初学者迅速理解陌生的技术概念。

analogy.en: The analogy breaks down when applied to large software systems.
analogy.zh: 当应用于大型软件系统时，这一类比便不再成立。

speculate.en: Economists speculated that the downturn would end before the new year.
speculate.zh: 经济学家推测经济衰退会在新年前结束。

speculate.en: It would be unwise to speculate about the cause without direct evidence.
speculate.zh: 没有直接证据就推测原因是不明智的。

speculate.en: Several scholars have speculated on the origins of this ritual practice.
speculate.zh: 几位学者对这一仪式的起源作了推测。

devise.en: Engineers devised a new method for sealing leaks in underground pipes.
devise.zh: 工程师设计出了一种封堵地下管道泄漏的新方法。

devise.en: The committee devised a plan to reduce the processing time considerably.
devise.zh: 委员会制定了一项大幅缩短处理时间的方案。

devise.en: She devised an elegant way to organize the archival photographs.
devise.zh: 她巧妙地构思出了一种整理档案照片的好办法。

uniform.en: All participants followed a uniform protocol throughout the clinical trial.
uniform.zh: 所有参与者在整个临床试验中都遵循统一的方案。

uniform.en: The uniform distribution of the sample allowed clean statistical analysis.
uniform.zh: 样本的均匀分布使统计分析得以顺利进行。

uniform.en: The university requires uniform dress codes in all examination halls.
uniform.zh: 该大学要求所有考场实行统一的着装规范。

reproducible.en: The experiment must be reproducible before the findings can be trusted.
reproducible.zh: 在结果可信之前，实验必须是可复现的。

reproducible.en: Open data and clear code make the published analysis fully reproducible.
reproducible.zh: 开放数据和清晰的代码使已发表的分析完全可复现。

reproducible.en: Reproducible results allow other laboratories to test the same conclusions.
reproducible.zh: 可复现的结果让其他实验室能够检验相同的结论。

avenue.en: The conference offers a valuable avenue for collaboration between research groups.
avenue.zh: 这次会议为研究团队之间的合作提供了宝贵的途径。

avenue.en: Graduation remains the most direct avenue into the teaching profession.
avenue.zh: 毕业仍是进入教师职业最直接的途径。

avenue.en: The authors propose a new avenue for studying early language development.
avenue.zh: 作者为研究早期语言发展提出了一条新途径。

exploration.en: The exploration of the archive revealed previously unknown correspondence.
exploration.zh: 对该档案的探索揭示了此前无人知晓的通信往来。

exploration.en: Deep-sea exploration requires funding that few private foundations provide.
exploration.zh: 深海勘探需要资金，而私人基金会中能提供这笔资助的寥寥无几。

exploration.en: Her exploration of memory disorders shaped her doctoral research.
exploration.zh: 她对记忆障碍的探索影响了她的博士研究。

confirmation.en: We are still awaiting written confirmation of the reservation.
confirmation.zh: 我们仍在等待预订的书面确认。

confirmation.en: Confirmation bias affects how researchers interpret ambiguous evidence.
confirmation.zh: 确认偏差会影响研究者如何解读模棱两可的证据。

confirmation.en: Her confirmation of the results prompted a formal review of the study.
confirmation.zh: 她对研究结果的确认促使人们对该研究进行了正式审查。

misinterpret.en: Students often misinterpret statistical significance as practical importance.
misinterpret.zh: 学生常常把统计显著性误解为实际重要性。

misinterpret.en: Reviewers warned that the authors had misinterpreted the survey data.
misinterpret.zh: 审稿人警告说，作者们误读了调查数据。

misinterpret.en: The advertisement misinterprets the original findings of the clinical trial.
misinterpret.zh: 这则广告曲解了临床试验的原始研究结果。

lengthy.en: The lengthy review process delayed publication of the findings.
lengthy.zh: 漫长的评审流程推迟了研究结果的发表。

lengthy.en: The minister faced a lengthy debate before the committee reached a decision.
lengthy.zh: 在委员会作出决定之前，这位部长经历了一场冗长的辩论。

lengthy.en: Staff complained about the lengthy delay in receiving laboratory results.
lengthy.zh: 员工抱怨收到实验室结果的时间拖延得太久。

putative.en: The putative cause of the outbreak has not been confirmed.
putative.zh: 这一疫情暴发的假定原因尚未得到证实。

putative.en: No evidence supports the putative link between diet and the disease.
putative.zh: 没有证据支持饮食与该疾病之间那种推定的联系。

putative.en: Several putative authors have been proposed for the anonymous manuscript.
putative.zh: 人们已为这部匿名手稿提出了好几位据称的作者。

unintentional.en: The unintentional release of private data triggered an official investigation.
unintentional.zh: 私人数据的无意泄露引发了官方调查。

unintentional.en: Unintentional errors in the transcription were detected by the peer reviewers.
unintentional.zh: 同行评审发现了转录中的无心错误。

unintentional.en: The laboratory described the violation as unintentional and retrained its staff.
unintentional.zh: 实验室称这次违规是无意的，并对员工进行了重新培训。

debunk.en: The paper attempted to debunk a widely circulated nutritional myth.
debunk.zh: 该论文试图揭穿一个广为流传的营养学迷思。

debunk.en: Researchers debunked the claim that the virus spread through surfaces.
debunk.zh: 研究人员驳斥了病毒通过表面传播的说法。

debunk.en: Debunking popular misconceptions requires careful communication with the public.
debunk.zh: 揭穿流行的错误观念需要与公众进行审慎的沟通。

untenable.en: The committee concluded that the argument was untenable and required revision.
untenable.zh: 委员会认定该论点站不住脚，需要修改。

untenable.en: Without direct evidence, the hypothesis remains untenable and requires further testing.
untenable.zh: 没有直接证据，该假设依然难以成立，仍需进一步检验。

untenable.en: His claim of absolute certainty is untenable given the available data.
untenable.zh: 就现有数据而言，他关于绝对确定性的说法是站不住脚的。

imperative.en: It is imperative that the laboratory follow the revised safety protocol.
imperative.zh: 实验室必须遵守修订后的安全规程，这一点至关重要。

imperative.en: Immediate action became imperative after the equipment failure revealed a leak.
imperative.zh: 设备故障暴露了泄漏问题后，采取紧急行动变得十分迫切。

imperative.en: Officials stressed that it was imperative to publish the findings promptly.
imperative.zh: 官员强调，及时公布研究结果是一件极其重要的事。

persuasive.en: The researcher presented a persuasive argument for revising the treatment guidelines.
persuasive.zh: 研究人员提出了令人信服的论据，主张修订治疗指南。

persuasive.en: Her testimony was so persuasive that the board reversed its earlier decision.
persuasive.zh: 她的证词极具说服力，董事会因此推翻了先前的决定。

persuasive.en: Well-designed visual data can be more persuasive than long statistical tables.
persuasive.zh: 设计良好的可视化数据可能比冗长的统计表格更有说服力。

trenchant.en: His trenchant critique exposed the weaknesses in the study's methodology.
trenchant.zh: 他尖锐的评论揭露了该研究方法上的缺陷。

trenchant.en: She offered a trenchant analysis of the policy's hidden costs.
trenchant.zh: 她对这项政策隐藏的成本作出了犀利的分析。

trenchant.en: The editorial was written in a trenchant style that readers admired.
trenchant.zh: 这篇社论以犀利的笔法写成，令读者赞叹。

far-reaching.en: The reform had far-reaching effects on public health across the region.
far-reaching.zh: 这项改革对整个地区的公共健康产生了深远影响。

far-reaching.en: The scandal prompted far-reaching changes in corporate governance.
far-reaching.zh: 这起丑闻促成了公司治理方面的深远变革。

far-reaching.en: Scientists warned of far-reaching consequences if emissions continued to rise.
far-reaching.zh: 科学家警告说，如果排放继续上升，后果将十分深远。

occasionally.en: Researchers occasionally consult archived newspapers for historical context.
occasionally.zh: 研究人员偶尔会查阅报纸档案以了解历史背景。

occasionally.en: The museum's collection occasionally includes manuscripts that have never been published.
occasionally.zh: 该博物馆的馆藏中偶尔会出现从未出版过的手稿。

occasionally.en: She occasionally publishes short notes to clarify common points of confusion.
occasionally.zh: 她偶尔会发表短文，澄清常见的困惑之处。

gradually.en: The sample size gradually increased as new participants were recruited.
gradually.zh: 随着新参与者的招募，样本量逐渐扩大。

gradually.en: Rainfall gradually declined across the region over the following decade.
gradually.zh: 在此后 10 年中，该地区的降雨量逐渐减少。

gradually.en: These differences gradually disappeared after the software update was installed.
gradually.zh: 软件更新安装之后，这些差异逐渐消失了。

evolve.en: The research question evolved as the researchers encountered unexpected data.
evolve.zh: 随着研究人员遇到意料之外的数据，研究问题也随之演变。

evolve.en: Legal standards have evolved considerably over the past century.
evolve.zh: 过去一个世纪里，法律标准发生了巨大的演变。

evolve.en: The team allowed the experimental design to evolve rather than fixing it prematurely.
evolve.zh: 研究小组允许实验设计逐步演变，而不是过早将其固定下来。

commensurate.en: The funding granted was not commensurate with the scale of the project.
commensurate.zh: 所获资助与该项目的规模并不相称。

commensurate.en: Salary increases should be commensurate with years of professional experience.
commensurate.zh: 薪资增幅应与专业工作年限相称。

commensurate.en: The punishment imposed seemed wholly commensurate with the severity of the offense.
commensurate.zh: 所施加的惩罚似乎与罪行的严重程度完全相称。

vertical.en: The cliff face is nearly vertical and extremely dangerous to climb.
vertical.zh: 这处崖壁近乎垂直，攀登起来极其危险。

vertical.en: Vertical integration can reduce costs throughout the supply chain.
vertical.zh: 纵向一体化可以降低整个供应链的成本。

vertical.en: Researchers mapped the vertical distribution of pollutants in the water column.
vertical.zh: 研究人员绘制了水柱中污染物的垂直分布图。

prove.en: The method proved too slow for datasets of this size.
prove.zh: 事实证明，这种方法对于这种规模的数据集来说太慢了。

prove.en: Further experiments may prove that the observed effect is negligible.
prove.zh: 进一步的实验或许会证明观察到的效应可以忽略不计。

prove.en: The new instruments proved highly effective under field conditions.
prove.zh: 这些新仪器在野外条件下被证明非常有效。

sparse.en: Data from the region remain sparse and difficult to interpret.
sparse.zh: 来自该地区的数据仍然十分稀少，难以解读。

sparse.en: Vegetation on the cliff is sparse because rainfall there is minimal.
sparse.zh: 崖上的植被稀疏，因为那里的降雨极少。

sparse.en: Only sparse evidence supports the earlier chronological dating of the site.
sparse.zh: 只有零星的证据支持对该遗址年代更早的断代。

ideally.en: Ideally, the survey should include participants from every province.
ideally.zh: 理想情况下，这项调查应当涵盖每个省份的受访者。

ideally.en: The reactor should ideally be inspected at least twice a year.
ideally.zh: 反应堆理想情况下应每年至少检查两次。

ideally.en: Ideally, these measures would reduce costs as well as emissions.
ideally.zh: 理想情况下，这些措施既减少排放，也降低成本。

undoubtedly.en: The new evidence undoubtedly strengthens the case for institutional reform.
undoubtedly.zh: 新证据无疑加强了对机构改革的论证。

undoubtedly.en: Undoubtedly, the transition will be difficult for many small businesses.
undoubtedly.zh: 无疑，这一转变对许多小企业来说将是困难的。

undoubtedly.en: Such patterns undoubtedly reflect wider changes in the labor market.
undoubtedly.zh: 这类模式无疑反映了劳动力市场更广泛的变化。

asset.en: Her ability to explain technical findings was a genuine asset to the team.
asset.zh: 她解释技术性研究结果的能力是团队中的一项真正优势。

asset.en: The archive remains an invaluable asset for historians of the period.
asset.zh: 该档案仍是研究这一时期的历史学家们无价的宝贵资料。

asset.en: Debts consumed the family assets within a single decade.
asset.zh: 10 年之内，债务就耗尽了家里的全部财产。

qualitative.en: The study used qualitative interviews to explore participants' attitudes.
qualitative.zh: 该研究采用定性访谈来探究参与者的态度。

qualitative.en: Qualitative analysis revealed patterns that the numerical data had missed.
qualitative.zh: 定性分析揭示出数值数据所遗漏的规律。

qualitative.en: Graders should not confuse a qualitative judgment with a measured score.
qualitative.zh: 评分者不应把定性的判断与实测分数混为一谈。

sequence.en: The lecture introduced the sequence of events that led to the crisis.
sequence.zh: 这堂讲座介绍了导致危机的一系列事件。

sequence.en: Researchers examined the gene sequence for signs of mutation.
sequence.zh: 研究人员检查了该基因序列，寻找突变的迹象。

sequence.en: The documentary footage was edited into a tighter sequence for broadcast.
sequence.zh: 这段纪录片素材被剪辑成更紧凑的片段用于播出。

formula.en: The formula predicts the reaction rate at much higher temperatures.
formula.zh: 该公式可以预测在更高温度下的反应速率。

formula.en: The team derived a new formula for estimating groundwater recharge.
formula.zh: 研究小组推导出一个估算地下水补给量的新公式。

formula.en: This infant formula contains no added sugar or coloring agent.
formula.zh: 这种婴儿配方奶粉不含添加糖或色素。

prototypical.en: The low-cost water filter was recognized as a prototypical example of appropriate technology.
prototypical.zh: 这款低成本滤水器被视为适用技术的典型范例。

prototypical.en: This case is prototypical of the disputes that arise in collaborative research.
prototypical.zh: 这个案例是合作研究中常见争端的典型代表。

prototypical.en: Prototypical examples help students grasp the general principle quickly.
prototypical.zh: 典型的例子能帮助学生迅速理解一般原理。

adequate.en: The sample size was not adequate to detect such a small effect.
adequate.zh: 样本量不足以检测出如此微小的效应。

adequate.en: The laboratory lacked adequate ventilation during the summer months.
adequate.zh: 实验室在夏季数月里通风不足。

adequate.en: Existing funding proved adequate for the first phase of the project.
adequate.zh: 现有资金被证明足以支撑项目的第一阶段。

pronounced.en: There was a pronounced difference between the two experimental groups.
pronounced.zh: 两个实验组之间存在明显的差异。

pronounced.en: The temperature gradient showed a pronounced decline over the past decade.
pronounced.zh: 过去 10 年里，温度梯度呈现出明显的下降。

pronounced.en: The speaker's accent was so pronounced that we asked her to slow down.
pronounced.zh: 发言者的口音如此明显，以至于我们请她放慢语速。

albeit.en: The method is elegant, albeit slow when applied to large datasets.
albeit.zh: 这种方法虽然优美，但在应用于大数据集时速度较慢。

albeit.en: Funding for the program was renewed, albeit at a reduced level.
albeit.zh: 该项目的资金得到了续拨，尽管额度有所减少。

albeit.en: The results support the hypothesis, albeit with some methodological caveats.
albeit.zh: 结果支持该假设，尽管在方法上存在一些需要注意之处。

leap.en: Sales figures leapt by thirty percent in the final quarter.
leap.zh: 最后一个季度的销售数字猛增了 30%。

leap.en: The country leapt from obscurity into the ranks of leading economies.
leap.zh: 这个国家从默默无闻一跃跻身主要经济体之列。

leap.en: Her career leapt forward when the paper was widely cited.
leap.zh: 那篇论文被广泛引用后，她的职业生涯迅速跃升。

not to mention.en: The proposal is expensive, not to mention environmentally destructive.
not to mention.zh: 这项提案成本高昂，更不用说它还会破坏环境。

not to mention.en: He ignored the safety rules, not to mention the repeated warnings he received.
not to mention.zh: 他无视安全规定，更不用说那些他一再收到的警告了。

not to mention.en: The delay harmed the entire project, not to mention several junior researchers.
not to mention.zh: 延误损害了整个项目，更不用说好几位初级研究人员。

prevalent.en: This misconception remains prevalent among first-year undergraduates in economics.
prevalent.zh: 这种误解在经济学专业的一年级大学生中依然十分普遍。

prevalent.en: Malaria is still prevalent in several regions during the wet season.
prevalent.zh: 在雨季，疟疾在若干地区仍然流行。

prevalent.en: The trait is so prevalent in the population that screening is unnecessary.
prevalent.zh: 这种特征在该人群中如此普遍，以至于无需进行筛查。

mitigate.en: Planting trees can mitigate the effects of urban heat.
mitigate.zh: 植树能够缓解城市高温带来的影响。

mitigate.en: The company introduced flexible hours to mitigate staff turnover.
mitigate.zh: 该公司引入弹性工作时间，以减轻员工流失。

mitigate.en: Insurance schemes help mitigate the financial risk of crop failure.
mitigate.zh: 保险制度有助于减轻作物歉收带来的财务风险。

metaphor.en: The metaphor of the body as a machine shaped nineteenth-century physiology.
metaphor.zh: 把身体比作机器这一隐喻塑造了 19 世纪的生理学。

metaphor.en: Writers often rely on metaphor to make abstract ideas concrete.
metaphor.zh: 作家常常借助隐喻使抽象的概念变得具体。

metaphor.en: Her use of metaphor transformed an otherwise dry technical discussion.
metaphor.zh: 她对隐喻的运用把一场原本枯燥的技术讨论变得生动起来。

emulate.en: Junior researchers often try to emulate their supervisor's writing style.
emulate.zh: 青年研究者常常试图模仿导师的写作风格。

emulate.en: The laboratory sought to emulate the success of its Singapore branch.
emulate.zh: 该实验室试图效仿其新加坡分部的成功。

emulate.en: Engineers emulate natural patterns to design efficient structures.
emulate.zh: 工程师模仿自然界中的形态来设计高效的结构。

constitute.en: These three factors constitute the core of the theoretical framework.
constitute.zh: 这三个因素构成了该理论框架的核心。

constitute.en: Women constitute nearly half of the university's research staff.
constitute.zh: 女性占该大学研究人员的近一半。

constitute.en: The selection criteria constitute the first stage of the review process.
constitute.zh: 这些选拔标准构成评审流程的第一阶段。

merit.en: The proposal has considerable merit despite its technical flaws.
merit.zh: 尽管存在技术缺陷，这份提案仍有相当的价值。

merit.en: His essay on civic responsibility earned the annual merit award.
merit.zh: 他关于公民责任的论文获得了年度优秀奖。

merit.en: There is little merit in repeating an argument that has already failed.
merit.zh: 重复一个已经失败过的论点几乎没有价值。

adverse.en: The new policy faced strong adverse criticism from several senior researchers.
adverse.zh: 这项新政策遭到了多位资深研究者的强烈负面批评。

adverse.en: Adverse weather conditions delayed the experiment for nearly two months.
adverse.zh: 恶劣的天气条件使实验延误了近两个月。

adverse.en: Prolonged exposure to chemicals can have adverse effects on human health.
adverse.zh: 长期接触化学品可能对人类健康产生不利影响。

elucidate.en: The professor elucidated the theory in terms accessible to beginners.
elucidate.zh: 教授用初学者也能理解的方式阐明了这一理论。

elucidate.en: This brief report elucidates the main differences between the two approaches.
elucidate.zh: 这份简短的报告解释了这两种方法的主要差异。

elucidate.en: Additional experiments were needed to elucidate the mechanism behind the reaction.
elucidate.zh: 需要进一步的实验来阐明该反应背后的机制。

adjacent.en: The laboratory occupies a building adjacent to the main library.
adjacent.zh: 这间实验室位于紧邻主图书馆的一栋建筑里。

adjacent.en: Two adjacent plots of land were purchased by the university.
adjacent.zh: 大学购买了两块相邻的土地。

adjacent.en: The hotel provides adjacent rooms for families traveling together.
adjacent.zh: 该酒店为结伴出行的家庭提供相邻的房间。

prospect.en: The prospect of further economic growth remains uncertain this year.
prospect.zh: 今年经济进一步增长的前景仍不确定。

prospect.en: Few graduates saw the prospect of unemployment as a serious threat.
prospect.zh: 很少有毕业生把失业的可能性视为严重威胁。

prospect.en: They debated the prospect of relocating the entire research facility.
prospect.zh: 他们讨论了将整个研究设施迁址的前景。

reveal.en: The audit revealed serious errors in the university's financial records.
reveal.zh: 审计揭示了大学财务记录中的严重错误。

reveal.en: New genetic analysis reveals a link between the disease and sleep loss.
reveal.zh: 新的基因分析揭示了这种疾病与睡眠不足之间的联系。

reveal.en: The publisher refused to reveal the identity of the anonymous reviewer.
reveal.zh: 出版社拒绝透露那位匿名评论者的身份。

irrespective.en: All applicants are welcome, irrespective of their academic background.
irrespective.zh: 所有申请者都受欢迎，不论其学术背景如何。

irrespective.en: The grant covers travel costs, irrespective of the length of stay.
irrespective.zh: 该资助涵盖差旅费用，不论停留时间长短。

irrespective.en: The rules apply irrespective of whether the course is taken online.
irrespective.zh: 无论该课程是否在线进行，这些规则都适用。

obsolete.en: The laboratory replaced its obsolete equipment with modern digital instruments.
obsolete.zh: 实验室用现代数字仪器替换了过时的设备。

obsolete.en: Several vocabulary lists still contain obsolete words that no one uses.
obsolete.zh: 一些词汇表仍收录着无人使用的过时词语。

obsolete.en: The software interface has already become obsolete after only two years.
obsolete.zh: 该软件界面才两年就已被淘汰。

consensus.en: The panel reached a broad consensus on the need for reform.
consensus.zh: 专家组就改革的必要性达成了广泛共识。

consensus.en: There is growing consensus among economists that inflation will slow.
consensus.zh: 经济学家中日益形成通胀将会放缓的共识。

consensus.en: The report reflects the consensus of the entire editorial board.
consensus.zh: 该报告反映了整个编辑委员会的共识。

advocate.en: Many economists advocate raising interest rates to control inflation.
advocate.zh: 许多经济学家主张提高利率以控制通胀。

advocate.en: She advocates a stronger ethical framework in medical research.
advocate.zh: 她主张在医学研究中建立更有力的伦理框架。

advocate.en: NGOs advocate for greater access to clean water in rural areas.
advocate.zh: 非政府组织主张让农村地区获得更充足的清洁水源。

incremental.en: The company achieved steady incremental gains rather than dramatic changes.
incremental.zh: 该公司取得的是稳定的渐进式增长，而非剧烈的变革。

incremental.en: Each incremental improvement to the model reduced the error rate slightly.
incremental.zh: 对模型的每一次渐进式改进都略微降低了错误率。

incremental.en: The government prefers incremental reform to sweeping structural change.
incremental.zh: 政府更倾向于渐进式改革，而非大规模的结构性变革。

dilemma.en: The committee faced a dilemma between scientific integrity and funding deadlines.
dilemma.zh: 委员会在科学诚信与经费截止日期之间陷入两难。

dilemma.en: Students often face the dilemma of choosing a safe career or a risky dream.
dilemma.zh: 学生常常面临选择稳定职业还是冒险追梦的两难处境。

dilemma.en: The dilemma was resolved by conducting a small pilot study first.
dilemma.zh: 这个两难问题最终通过先开展一项小型试点研究来解决。

namely.en: Three factors explain the result, namely cost, timing and consumer demand.
namely.zh: 有三个因素解释了这一结果，即成本、时机和消费者需求。

namely.en: The policy applies to two regions, namely the north and the coastal islands.
namely.zh: 该政策适用于两个地区，即北部和沿海岛屿。

namely.en: The study examined one discipline, namely comparative linguistics.
namely.zh: 该研究考察了一个学科，即比较语言学。

expertise.en: Her expertise in molecular biology attracted international research partners.
expertise.zh: 她在分子生物学方面的专长吸引了国际研究合作伙伴。

expertise.en: Consulting firms provide expertise that the small laboratory simply cannot afford.
expertise.zh: 咨询公司提供了小型实验室根本负担不起的专业知识。

expertise.en: Years of fieldwork gave him expertise few other analysts could match.
expertise.zh: 多年的田野工作使他具备了少有分析员能匹敌的专业能力。

embed.en: The sensor is embedded deep inside the device to avoid external damage.
embed.zh: 传感器被深埋于设备内部，以免受到外部损坏。

embed.en: Teachers embedded the new vocabulary activities into everyday classroom routines.
embed.zh: 教师将新的词汇活动融入日常课堂教学流程之中。

embed.en: These values are deeply embedded in the organization's culture and identity.
embed.zh: 这些价值观深深植根于该组织的文化与认同之中。

ad hoc.en: An ad hoc committee was formed to handle the urgent data breach.
ad hoc.zh: 成立了一个临时委员会来处理这次紧急的数据泄露事件。

ad hoc.en: The ad hoc adjustments were later written into the official guidelines.
ad hoc.zh: 这些临时调整后来被写入了正式指南。

ad hoc.en: The team adopted an ad hoc approach rather than a long-term strategy.
ad hoc.zh: 该团队采取了临时性的做法，而非长期战略。

conflate.en: Many critics conflate the two proposals even though they differ substantially.
conflate.zh: 许多评论者把这两个提议混为一谈，尽管它们差异显著。

conflate.en: The report warns readers not to conflate correlation with causation.
conflate.zh: 该报告提醒读者不要把相关性与因果关系混为一谈。

conflate.en: Analysts should not conflate economic growth with human well-being.
conflate.zh: 分析者不应把经济增长与人类福祉混为一谈。

scope.en: The scope of the study was limited to three small villages.
scope.zh: 该研究的范围仅限于三个小村庄。

scope.en: This falls clearly outside the scope of our current contract.
scope.zh: 这显然超出了我们当前合同的约定范围。

scope.en: The committee widened the scope of the inquiry considerably.
scope.zh: 委员会大幅扩大了调查的范围。

historical.en: The archive preserves documents of great historical importance to the region.
historical.zh: 该档案保存着对该地区具有重大历史意义的文件。

historical.en: The novel reconstructs historical events with striking accuracy.
historical.zh: 这部小说以惊人的准确性重建了历史事件。

historical.en: Historical records suggest the settlement existed for several centuries.
historical.zh: 历史记录表明该聚落存在了数个世纪。

fruitful.en: The discussion proved fruitful and produced three new research questions.
fruitful.zh: 这次讨论很有成果，提出了三个新的研究问题。

fruitful.en: Years of patient work led to a fruitful collaboration between two laboratories.
fruitful.zh: 多年的耐心工作促成了两个实验室之间富有成果的合作。

fruitful.en: The interview was fruitful, revealing several promising leads for further inquiry.
fruitful.zh: 这次访谈很有收获，揭示了几条有希望的后续调查线索。

signal.en: Rising unemployment figures signal serious trouble for the economy.
signal.zh: 失业率上升的数据预示着经济的严重问题。

signal.en: The manager signaled her intention to restructure the department.
signal.zh: 经理明确表示了她重组该部门的意图。

signal.en: Researchers signal agreement on the need for further clinical trials.
signal.zh: 研究人员表示同意有必要进行进一步的临床试验。

fashion.en: The data were collected in a systematic fashion across all departments.
fashion.zh: 数据以系统化的方式在所有部门收集。

fashion.en: The two committees reached their decisions in much the same fashion.
fashion.zh: 两个委员会以大致相同的方式做出了决定。

fashion.en: Many of his older theories are no longer in fashion among economists.
fashion.zh: 他许多较旧的理论在经济学家中已不再流行。

unify.en: The new platform unifies data from twenty separate research databases.
unify.zh: 新平台将 20 个独立研究数据库的数据统一起来。

unify.en: A shared vocabulary can unify researchers working in very different fields.
unify.zh: 一套共同的术语能够统一从事完全不同领域的研究者。

unify.en: The reform aims to unify scattered regulations into a single coherent code.
unify.zh: 这项改革旨在把分散的规章整合为一套连贯的法典。

procedure.en: The committee followed a strict procedure when handling confidential complaints.
procedure.zh: 委员会在处理机密投诉时遵循严格的程序。

procedure.en: Engineers refined the manufacturing procedure to reduce material waste.
procedure.zh: 工程师改进了制造流程，以减少材料浪费。

procedure.en: The emergency procedure was tested twice before the facility opened.
procedure.zh: 该应急程序在设施开放前测试了两次。

consecutive.en: The team won five consecutive championships over the past decade.
consecutive.zh: 该队在过去 10 年里连续五次夺冠。

consecutive.en: Attendance declined for three consecutive years after the reform.
consecutive.zh: 改革之后，出席人数连续三年下降。

consecutive.en: Her research papers appeared in three consecutive issues of the journal.
consecutive.zh: 她的研究论文连续三期发表于该期刊。

empirical.en: The claim is supported by empirical evidence collected across twelve hospitals.
empirical.zh: 这一论断得到了在 12 家医院收集的经验证据支持。

empirical.en: Unlike earlier models, this approach rests on empirical observation.
empirical.zh: 与早先的模型不同，这一方法以经验观察为基础。

empirical.en: Critics demanded empirical justification before accepting the theory.
empirical.zh: 批评者要求在接受该理论之前给出经验论证。

computational.en: Computational models helped the team narrow down thousands of candidate molecules.
computational.zh: 计算模型帮助该团队从数千种候选分子中缩小了筛选范围。

computational.en: The lab invested heavily in computational resources and high-performance clusters.
computational.zh: 该实验室在计算资源和高性能集群上投入了大量资金。

computational.en: Computational analysis revealed patterns that human inspection had overlooked.
computational.zh: 计算分析揭示了人工检查所忽略的模式。

sophisticated.en: The instrument is a sophisticated device designed for precision measurement.
sophisticated.zh: 该仪器是一台用于精密测量的尖端设备。

sophisticated.en: Her argument was sophisticated and difficult for beginners to follow.
sophisticated.zh: 她的论证错综复杂，初学者难以跟上。

sophisticated.en: They admired the sophisticated instruments used in the university's new laboratory.
sophisticated.zh: 他们很欣赏该大学新实验室里精密的仪器。
