fabricate.en: The researcher was accused of fabricating data to support her conclusions.
fabricate.zh: 该研究员被指控伪造数据来支持她的结论。

fabricate.en: The workshop teaches students how to fabricate simple laboratory components.
fabricate.zh: 该工作坊教授学生如何制造简单的实验室零件。

fabricate.en: Journal editors now use software to detect whether references have been fabricated.
fabricate.zh: 期刊编辑现在使用软件检测参考文献是否被伪造。

complement.en: The two approaches complement each other rather than compete directly.
complement.zh: 这两种方法互相补充，而非直接竞争。

complement.en: A short summary complements the detailed report provided in the appendix.
complement.zh: 一份简短的摘要补充了附录中提供的详细报告。

complement.en: The classical analysis complements the statistical evidence gathered in the field.
complement.zh: 经典分析补充了实地收集的统计证据。

implement.en: The ministry will implement the new policy across all provinces next year.
implement.zh: 该部门将于明年在所有省份实施这项新政策。

implement.en: Our team implemented the software changes in three separate stages.
implement.zh: 我们的团队分三个阶段实施了这些软件变更。

implement.en: Failures to implement the recommendations were clearly documented in the audit.
implement.zh: 未能落实建议的情况在审计报告中被清楚记录。

outlook.en: The economic outlook for the coming year appears reasonably bright.
outlook.zh: 来年的经济前景看来相当乐观。

outlook.en: Analysts revised their outlook for regional trade after the new tariffs.
outlook.zh: 在新的关税措施之后，分析师修订了对区域贸易的展望。

outlook.en: The interviews documented the changing outlook of a generation on work and leisure.
outlook.zh: 这些访谈记录了一代人对工作与闲暇观念的变化。

purely.en: The changes were purely cosmetic and did not affect the underlying algorithm.
purely.zh: 这些改动纯属表面性的，并未影响底层算法。

purely.en: Her interest in the subject is purely academic rather than practical.
purely.zh: 她对该主题的兴趣纯粹是学术性的，而非实用性的。

purely.en: The decision was based purely on cost considerations rather than quality.
purely.zh: 该决定完全是基于成本考虑，而非质量因素。

subject.en: The subject of the seminar was the ethics of artificial intelligence.
subject.zh: 该研讨会的主题是人工智能的伦理问题。

subject.en: All research proposals are subject to approval by the ethics committee.
subject.zh: 所有研究提案都须经伦理委员会批准。

subject.en: Historians rarely agree on the causes of the events that are the subject of their study.
subject.zh: 历史学家很少能就其研究主题所涉及事件的原因达成一致。

pave.en: The pilot study paved the way for a large national trial.
pave.zh: 这项试点研究为全国性的大型试验铺平了道路。

pave.en: His early research paved the way for later developments in renewable energy.
pave.zh: 他早期的研究为后来可再生能源的发展铺平了道路。

pave.en: New asphalt will pave the highway connecting the two industrial parks.
pave.zh: 新的沥青将铺设连接两个工业园的高速公路。

expose.en: The investigation exposed serious errors in the laboratory's earlier data.
expose.zh: 这项调查暴露了实验室早期数据中的严重错误。

expose.en: Students should not expose themselves to unsafe chemicals without supervision.
expose.zh: 学生不应在无人监督的情况下让自己接触不安全的化学品。

expose.en: The photographs expose the damaging effects of pollution on marine life.
expose.zh: 这些照片揭示了污染对海洋生物的破坏性影响。

atmosphere.en: The warm atmosphere of the seminar encouraged everyone to ask questions.
atmosphere.zh: 研讨会轻松友好的气氛鼓励大家提问。

atmosphere.en: Carbon dioxide concentrations in the upper atmosphere continue to rise each year.
atmosphere.zh: 上层大气中的二氧化碳浓度每年持续上升。

atmosphere.en: The restaurant tried to create a romantic atmosphere with soft music.
atmosphere.zh: 这家餐厅试图用柔和的音乐营造浪漫的氛围。

migrate.en: Many rural families migrate to coastal cities in search of employment.
migrate.zh: 许多农村家庭为寻找工作迁往沿海城市。

migrate.en: The software allows users to migrate data between older and newer systems.
migrate.zh: 该软件允许用户在旧系统和新系统之间迁移数据。

migrate.en: Wild birds migrate thousands of miles every winter to warmer regions.
migrate.zh: 候鸟每年冬季迁徙数千英里前往温暖地区。

statistical.en: Statistical analysis revealed a significant difference between the two groups.
statistical.zh: 统计分析显示两组之间存在显著差异。

statistical.en: The report relies on statistical evidence rather than personal impressions.
statistical.zh: 该报告依赖统计证据而非个人印象。

statistical.en: Statistical tests showed that the observed effect was unlikely to result from chance alone.
statistical.zh: 统计检验表明，观察到的效应不太可能仅由偶然因素造成。

validity.en: The reviewers questioned the validity of the experiment's original findings.
validity.zh: 评审人员质疑该实验最初发现的有效性。

validity.en: Recent studies have confirmed the validity of this therapeutic approach.
validity.zh: 近期研究证实了这一治疗方法的有效性。

validity.en: Without proper documentation, the validity of the contract cannot be established.
validity.zh: 缺少适当文件，该合同的有效性就无法确立。

process.en: The selection process takes approximately six weeks from start to finish.
process.zh: 整个选拔过程从开始到结束大约需要六周。

process.en: Learning a second language is a gradual process that requires constant practice.
process.zh: 学习第二语言是一个需要持续练习的渐进过程。

process.en: The committee described each step of the approval process in detail.
process.zh: 委员会详细描述了审批过程的每一个步骤。

substitution.en: Direct substitution of renewable generation for coal reduced system emissions.
substitution.zh: 以可再生能源发电直接替代燃煤降低了系统排放。

substitution.en: The substitution of email for internal memos changed communication patterns.
substitution.zh: 电子邮件取代内部备忘录改变了沟通方式。

substitution.en: Substitution of cheaper materials affects the durability of the finished product.
substitution.zh: 使用更便宜的材料替代会影响成品的耐久性。

nonetheless.en: The data were limited; nonetheless, the results support our hypothesis.
nonetheless.zh: 数据有限；然而，结果仍支持我们的假设。

nonetheless.en: The project exceeded its budget; nonetheless, it was completed on schedule.
nonetheless.zh: 该项目超出了预算；尽管如此，它还是按期完成了。

nonetheless.en: She found the assignment difficult; nonetheless, she submitted it on time.
nonetheless.zh: 她觉得这项任务很难；尽管如此，她还是按时提交了。

reference.en: The author makes no reference to earlier studies on the subject.
reference.zh: 该作者完全没有提及此前关于这一主题的研究。

reference.en: Please use the attached reference when preparing the committee's final report.
reference.zh: 准备委员会最终报告时，请使用所附的参考资料。

reference.en: Her remarks were made with reference to last year's controversial review.
reference.zh: 她的评论是针对去年那篇有争议的评审意见发表的。

separate.en: The study treats income and education as separate variables in its model.
separate.zh: 该研究在模型中把收入和教育视为彼此独立的变量。

separate.en: Each department maintains a separate budget for its research activities.
separate.zh: 各部门为研究活动维持着各自的独立预算。

separate.en: The two committees produced separate reports that reached opposite conclusions.
separate.zh: 两个委员会分别提交了报告，结论却截然相反。

coefficient.en: The regression coefficient for education remained significant after the adjustment.
coefficient.zh: 调整后，教育的回归系数仍然显著。

coefficient.en: A positive correlation coefficient indicates that the two variables rise together.
coefficient.zh: 正相关系数表明两个变量同向变化。

coefficient.en: The correlation coefficient for this pair of measures is remarkably high.
coefficient.zh: 这一对测量值之间的相关系数非常高。

remain.en: Several concerns remain unresolved despite the committee's repeated attempts.
remain.zh: 尽管委员会多次努力，若干问题仍未解决。

remain.en: The researcher remained at the university for another decade after graduation.
remain.zh: 那位研究者毕业后在大学又待了 10 年。

remain.en: It remains unclear whether the proposed reform will reduce inequality.
remain.zh: 拟议中的改革能否减少不平等仍不清楚。

characterize.en: Rapid growth has characterized the digital economy over the past two decades.
characterize.zh: 过去 20 年的数字经济以快速增长为特征。

characterize.en: What characterizes this method is its ability to handle incomplete data.
characterize.zh: 这一方法的特点是能够处理不完整的数据。

characterize.en: Reviewers characterized the proposal as ambitious but poorly funded.
characterize.zh: 评审人员将该提案形容为雄心勃勃但资金不足。

broaden.en: The conference broadened the discussion to include environmental impacts.
broaden.zh: 这次会议将讨论范围拓宽到包括环境影响。

broaden.en: Researchers broadened their sample to include participants from rural areas.
broaden.zh: 研究者扩大了样本范围，将农村地区的参与者纳入其中。

broaden.en: Beyond the narrow gorge the river broadens into a slow, shallow pool.
broaden.zh: 出了狭窄的峡谷，河面变宽，成为一处平缓的水潭。

ongoing.en: The ongoing investigation has attracted attention from international regulators.
ongoing.zh: 正在进行的调查引起了国际监管机构的关注。

ongoing.en: Despite ongoing negotiations, the two sides have not reached an agreement.
ongoing.zh: 尽管谈判仍在继续，双方尚未达成协议。

ongoing.en: Her ongoing research examines how rural schools implement new curricula.
ongoing.zh: 她正在进行的研究考察乡村学校如何实施新课程。

in accordance with.en: All experiments were conducted in accordance with the approved safety guidelines.
in accordance with.zh: 所有实验均按照已批准的安全指南进行。

in accordance with.en: The company revised its reporting procedures in accordance with new regulations.
in accordance with.zh: 公司按照新法规修订了报告程序。

in accordance with.en: Payments must be made in accordance with the terms of the original contract.
in accordance with.zh: 付款必须依照原始合同的条款进行。

plateau.en: Enrollment growth reached a plateau after the first semester of classes.
plateau.zh: 开课第一学期后，招生增长进入平稳期。

plateau.en: The productivity curve shows several plateaus where output stopped rising.
plateau.zh: 生产率曲线显示出若干个产出停止上升的平台期。

plateau.en: Efforts to reduce costs have hit a plateau without new investment.
plateau.zh: 在没有新投资的情况下，降低成本的努力陷入停滞。

underlying.en: The underlying cause of the crisis remains unclear despite extensive research.
underlying.zh: 尽管研究广泛展开，这场危机的深层原因仍不清楚。

underlying.en: We must consider the underlying assumptions before applying this model widely.
underlying.zh: 在广泛应用该模型之前，我们必须考虑其隐含的假设。

underlying.en: An underlying disagreement about methods divided the two research groups.
underlying.zh: 关于方法的深层分歧使两个研究小组意见相左。

complexity.en: The complexity of the system makes it hard to predict failures.
complexity.zh: 该系统的复杂性使人难以预测故障。

complexity.en: Students often underestimate the complexity of writing a rigorous thesis.
complexity.zh: 学生常常低估撰写一篇严谨论文的复杂程度。

complexity.en: Advances in computation have helped researchers tackle immense complexity in biology.
complexity.zh: 计算方面的进步帮助研究者应对生物学中巨大的复杂性。

intense.en: The intense heat damaged several instruments left in the laboratory.
intense.zh: 酷热损坏了留在实验室里的几件仪器。

intense.en: Competition for the grant became so intense that collaboration seemed impossible.
intense.zh: 对该资助的竞争变得如此激烈，以至于合作似乎不可能。

intense.en: She focused her intense attention on the problem for several hours.
intense.zh: 她连续数小时把高度集中的注意力放在这个问题上。

flexible.en: A flexible timetable allows students to balance work with study.
flexible.zh: 灵活的课程时间表让学生能够兼顾工作与学习。

flexible.en: The agreement offers flexible terms for institutions with limited resources.
flexible.zh: 该协议为资源有限的机构提供了灵活的条件。

flexible.en: The catheter must stay flexible enough to pass through narrow arteries.
flexible.zh: 导管须保持足够柔韧，才能穿过狭窄的动脉。

scrutiny.en: The proposal came under intense scrutiny after the financial irregularities surfaced.
scrutiny.zh: 财务违规问题曝光后，该提案受到严格审查。

scrutiny.en: Public scrutiny of the agency's performance has increased considerably this year.
scrutiny.zh: 公众对该机构表现的审视今年大幅增加。

scrutiny.en: The design failed close scrutiny by independent safety engineers.
scrutiny.zh: 该设计未通过独立安全工程师的仔细审查。

emanate.en: A sense of confidence emanates from the young research team.
emanate.zh: 一种自信感从这个年轻的研究团队身上散发出来。

emanate.en: The speaker's calm authority emanated from the podium and filled the crowded auditorium.
emanate.zh: 演讲者沉稳的威严从讲台散发出来，弥漫在整个拥挤的礼堂中。

emanate.en: Warm light emanates from the windows of the old library.
emanate.zh: 温暖的光线从老图书馆的窗户中散发出来。

in conjunction with.en: The laboratory works in conjunction with hospitals across the region.
in conjunction with.zh: 该实验室与该地区的多家医院合作开展工作。

in conjunction with.en: Automatic detection is used in conjunction with manual review of each case.
in conjunction with.zh: 自动检测与对每个案例的人工审查结合使用。

in conjunction with.en: Machine learning models operate in conjunction with expert statistical analysis.
in conjunction with.zh: 机器学习模型与专家的统计分析共同发挥作用。

diagnose.en: Clinicians can now diagnose the condition much earlier using new imaging techniques.
diagnose.zh: 借助新的成像技术，临床医生现在能更早地诊断这种疾病。

diagnose.en: Engineers diagnosed a faulty valve as the primary cause of the pressure loss.
diagnose.zh: 工程师认定阀门故障是压力损失的主要原因。

diagnose.en: The test does not yet diagnose the infection reliably in its early stages.
diagnose.zh: 该检测目前尚不能在早期阶段可靠地诊断这种感染。

logic.en: The argument follows a clear logic that reviewers found convincing.
logic.zh: 该论证遵循一套清晰的逻辑，评审认为很有说服力。

logic.en: There is little logic in closing the program before its results are published.
logic.zh: 在结果公布之前就终止该项目是几乎没有道理的。

logic.en: Students learn the logic behind each step of the statistical calculation.
logic.zh: 学生要了解统计计算每一步背后的逻辑。

regime.en: The regime collapsed after months of public protests and strikes.
regime.zh: 在持续数月的公众抗议和罢工之后，该政权垮台了。

regime.en: Under the new regime, agricultural markets were opened to private buyers.
regime.zh: 在新体制下，农业市场向私人买家开放。

regime.en: The tax regime remained unchanged throughout the whole fiscal year.
regime.zh: 整个财政年度内税收体制保持不变。

resolve.en: Diplomats worked through the night to resolve the long-running dispute.
resolve.zh: 外交官们连夜工作，以解决这场旷日持久的争端。

resolve.en: Her firm resolved to publish the full dataset for further analysis.
resolve.zh: 她的公司决心公布完整数据集以供进一步分析。

resolve.en: The committee resolved that the current policy required substantial revision.
resolve.zh: 委员会决定现行政策需要大幅修订。

vary.en: Reaction times vary considerably depending on the difficulty of the task.
vary.zh: 反应时间随任务难度而有相当大的差异。

vary.en: Teachers should not vary the standards applied to different groups of students.
vary.zh: 教师不应对不同学生群体采用不同的标准。

vary.en: Vegetation tends to vary sharply along the ridge as altitude increases.
vary.zh: 随着海拔升高，沿山脊的植被变化显著。

respect.en: Participants were asked to respect the privacy of their colleagues throughout the study.
respect.zh: 参与者被要求在整个研究期间尊重同事的隐私。

respect.en: In this respect the two samples are closely comparable.
respect.zh: 就这方面而言，两个样本高度可比。

respect.en: Years of careful work made senior researchers respect her methods deeply.
respect.zh: 多年严谨的工作使资深研究者十分尊重她的方法。

proximity.en: The proximity of the laboratory to the hospital shortened sample transport times considerably.
proximity.zh: 实验室靠近医院大大缩短了样本运输时间。

proximity.en: Proximity to public transport raises the value of these apartments considerably.
proximity.zh: 临近公共交通提高了这些公寓的价值。

proximity.en: Researchers examined how geographic proximity shapes competition between universities.
proximity.zh: 研究者考察了地理邻近性如何塑造大学之间的竞争。

widespread.en: The discovery led to widespread adoption of the new testing procedure.
widespread.zh: 这一发现促使新的检测程序得到广泛应用。

widespread.en: Widespread criticism forced the agency to revise its reporting standards.
widespread.zh: 广泛的批评迫使该机构修订其报告标准。

widespread.en: Such plants remain widespread throughout the drier regions of the country.
widespread.zh: 这类植物在该国较干旱地区仍然分布广泛。

dissertation.en: Her dissertation examines how migration reshaped rural schooling in the twentieth century.
dissertation.zh: 她的学位论文研究了移民如何重塑 20 世纪的乡村教育。

dissertation.en: The doctoral dissertation was praised for its original archival research.
dissertation.zh: 这篇博士论文因其原创的档案研究而受到赞誉。

dissertation.en: He is currently finishing his master's dissertation on climate migration policy.
dissertation.zh: 他目前正在完成关于气候移民政策的硕士论文。

cease.en: Funding for the program will cease at the end of the fiscal year.
cease.zh: 该项目的资金将在本财政年度结束时终止。

cease.en: The two sides ceased hostilities after the mediation efforts succeeded.
cease.zh: 在调解努力取得成功后，双方停止了敌对行动。

cease.en: Noise complaints ceased once the machinery was relocated to another site.
cease.zh: 机械被迁至另一处地点后，噪声投诉便停止了。

premise.en: The argument rests on the premise that all participants were informed.
premise.zh: 该论证建立在所有参与者都已知情这一前提之上。

premise.en: His basic premise is that public institutions should be evaluated on outcomes.
premise.zh: 他的基本前提是公共机构应以结果来评估。

premise.en: The study's central premise has been challenged by recent field observations.
premise.zh: 该研究的核心前提受到了近期田野观察的质疑。

disperse.en: Heavy rain dispersed the crowd within minutes of the announcement.
disperse.zh: 公告发布后不到几分钟，人群就被大雨驱散了。

disperse.en: The seeds are dispersed by birds across a wide area.
disperse.zh: 这些种子由鸟类传播到广大区域。

disperse.en: Dust from the excavation dispersed across the courtyard within minutes.
disperse.zh: 基坑扬起的尘土几分钟内便弥漫到整个院子里。

construct.en: Engineers constructed a temporary bridge to restore traffic after the flood.
construct.zh: 工程师建造了一座临时桥梁，以在洪水后恢复交通。

construct.en: The theory is constructed on decades of field observation and careful measurement.
construct.zh: 这一理论建立在数十年的田野观察和精密测量之上。

construct.en: Investigators showed that two entries had been constructed to conceal the shortfall.
construct.zh: 调查人员查明，两条记录是为掩盖亏空而编造的。

formidable.en: The proposal faced a formidable challenge from the regulatory committee last Thursday.
formidable.zh: 上周四，该提案面对监管委员会提出的严峻挑战。

formidable.en: Her formidable reputation in econometrics attracted several doctoral students to the seminar.
formidable.zh: 她在计量经济学方面令人敬畏的声誉吸引了好几名博士生来参加研讨会。

formidable.en: Even formidable opponents struggled to answer questions raised by the review panel.
formidable.zh: 即便是难对付的对手，也难以回答评审小组提出的问题。

stringent.en: The journal imposed stringent standards for data transparency and statistical reporting.
stringent.zh: 该期刊对数据透明度和统计报告提出了严格的标准。

stringent.en: Facing a stringent regulatory framework, the company adopted stricter internal controls.
stringent.zh: 面对严格的监管框架，该公司采取了更为严密的内部控制措施。

stringent.en: Such a stringent exam would favor students who had mastered the syllabus.
stringent.zh: 这样一场苛刻的考试有利于那些真正掌握了考纲的学生。

availability.en: Conference abstracts must be submitted before the availability of presenters is confirmed.
availability.zh: 会议摘要必须在演讲者能否出席得到确认之前提交。

availability.en: Patients received information about the availability of treatment options at each clinic.
availability.zh: 患者在每家诊所都获得了有关治疗方案可获得性的信息。

availability.en: The availability of reliable data remains a serious obstacle to rigorous research.
availability.zh: 可靠数据的可获得性仍然是严谨研究的严重障碍。

reside.en: Many researchers who reside abroad maintain close ties with their home institutions.
reside.zh: 许多旅居国外的研究者与本国机构保持着密切联系。

reside.en: The core issue does not reside in the design but in the funding.
reside.zh: 核心问题并不在于设计，而在于资金。

reside.en: Most of the geothermal energy resides deep beneath the western plateau.
reside.zh: 大部分地热能蕴藏在西部高原的深处。

penalty.en: Late submission carries a penalty of fifteen percent of the final grade.
penalty.zh: 逾期提交将被扣除期末总评成绩的 15% 作为处罚。

penalty.en: The company faced a severe penalty for violating the environmental regulations.
penalty.zh: 该公司因违反环境保护法规而面临严厉处罚。

penalty.en: Financial penalties alone rarely deter large corporations from misconduct.
penalty.zh: 仅靠经济处罚很少能阻止大公司不当行为。

obviate.en: Clear labeling obviates the need for additional documentation in most cases.
obviate.zh: 在多数情况下，清晰的标注使额外文件变得没有必要。

obviate.en: Automation has largely obviated the manual sorting of incoming applications.
obviate.zh: 自动化已基本使来件申请无需再靠人工分类。

obviate.en: The new imaging method obviated repeated surgery for many patients.
obviate.zh: 这种新的影像检查方法使许多患者不再需要反复手术。

concise.en: The reviewer asked the authors to keep their abstract concise and precise.
concise.zh: 审稿人要求作者保持摘要简洁而精确。

concise.en: His concise explanation made a complex model accessible to first-year students.
concise.zh: 他简明扼要的讲解使一个复杂模型易于被一年级学生理解。

concise.en: Good abstracts are concise, informative, and free of unnecessary citations.
concise.zh: 好的摘要是简练的、信息量大的，并且没有多余的引用。

propel.en: Strong winds propelled the research vessel across the Atlantic in nine days.
propel.zh: 强风推动科考船在九天内横渡大西洋。

propel.en: A single bold decision propelled her career into senior management.
propel.zh: 一个大胆的决定把她的职业生涯推进到高级管理岗位。

propel.en: Rising demand propelled the company's revenue well beyond its original forecast.
propel.zh: 不断增长的需求推动公司营收远超最初的预测。

repel.en: The coating repels water effectively, preventing corrosion on the steel surface.
repel.zh: 这种涂层能有效排斥水分，防止钢制表面发生腐蚀。

repel.en: His aggressive tone tends to repel potential collaborators and reviewers alike.
repel.zh: 他咄咄逼人的语气往往使潜在的合作者与审稿人都敬而远之。

repel.en: Magnets of the same polarity repel each other and separate rapidly.
repel.zh: 同极性的磁体相互排斥并迅速分离。

recipient.en: Each recipient of the scholarship must submit a short progress report.
recipient.zh: 每位奖学金获得者都必须提交一份简短的进展报告。

recipient.en: The recipient was asked to acknowledge the donation in the annual newsletter.
recipient.zh: 受赠者被要求在年度通讯中对捐赠表示感谢。

recipient.en: Recipients of the grant reported substantial improvements in patient satisfaction.
recipient.zh: 该资助的受领者报告说患者满意度有了显著提高。

consistent.en: Her findings remain consistent with earlier studies conducted in other laboratories.
consistent.zh: 她的研究结果与其他实验室早期开展的研究仍然一致。

consistent.en: The reviewer insisted that the argument be internally consistent from start to finish.
consistent.zh: 审稿人坚持认为该论证从头到尾都应内在一致。

consistent.en: Consistent support from donors has allowed the archive to expand steadily.
consistent.zh: 捐助者始终如一的支持使档案得以稳步扩充。

disseminate.en: The team used social media to disseminate its findings to a wider audience.
disseminate.zh: 团队利用社交媒体把研究成果传播给更广泛的受众。

disseminate.en: Guidelines on data protection were disseminated to all departmental staff last month.
disseminate.zh: 数据保护指南上个月已传达给所有系部员工。

disseminate.en: Conference organizers disseminate accepted abstracts to registered participants automatically.
disseminate.zh: 会议组织者会自动把录用的摘要发送给注册参会者。

lay the foundation for.en: These early experiments laid the foundation for modern molecular genetics.
lay the foundation for.zh: 这些早期实验为现代分子遗传学奠定了基础。

lay the foundation for.en: Careful negotiation laid the foundation for a lasting regional partnership.
lay the foundation for.zh: 细致的谈判为持久的区域伙伴关系奠定了基础。

lay the foundation for.en: The library's digitization project laid the foundation for future digital scholarship.
lay the foundation for.zh: 该图书馆的数字化项目为未来的数字化学术研究奠定了基础。

comparative.en: The report offers a comparative analysis of three national health systems.
comparative.zh: 该报告对三个国家的医疗体系作了比较分析。

comparative.en: Comparative studies reveal significant differences in student achievement across regions.
comparative.zh: 比较研究显示各地区学生成绩存在显著差异。

comparative.en: She used comparative evidence to argue against the proposed policy change.
comparative.zh: 她利用对比证据反对所提议的政策变动。

composition.en: The chemical composition of the soil determines which plants can thrive.
composition.zh: 土壤的化学成分决定了哪些植物能够茁壮生长。

composition.en: The composition of the committee includes members from eleven different departments.
composition.zh: 委员会的构成包括来自 11 个不同部门的成员。

composition.en: An unexpected change in the painting's composition puzzled the art historians.
composition.zh: 这幅画构图上的意外变化使艺术史学家感到困惑。

regard.en: Many scholars regard the treaty as a turning point in regional diplomacy.
regard.zh: 许多学者把该条约视为地区外交的转折点。

regard.en: We regard these findings as preliminary and recommend further replication.
regard.zh: 我们认为这些发现尚属初步，并建议进一步复现。

regard.en: The committee declined to regard the proposal as a serious option.
regard.zh: 委员会拒绝把该提案视为一个严肃的选项。

regarding.en: Regarding the funding dispute, the board has scheduled a full review.
regarding.zh: 关于资金纠纷，董事会已安排全面审查。

regarding.en: Regarding the deadline, students may request an extension from the registrar.
regarding.zh: 关于截止日期，学生可向教务处申请延期。

regarding.en: Regarding safety, each laboratory must submit a monthly compliance report.
regarding.zh: 关于安全，每个实验室必须每月提交一份合规报告。

intelligible.en: The manual should be written in language intelligible to first-year students.
intelligible.zh: 手册应当用一年级学生能理解的语言来写。

intelligible.en: Her lecture was so intelligible that even visiting auditors followed every argument.
intelligible.zh: 她的讲解如此清楚易懂，连来访的旁听人员都跟上了每一个论据。

intelligible.en: Complex statistical tables remain largely unintelligible to non-specialist readers.
intelligible.zh: 复杂的统计表格对非专业读者来说在很大程度上仍难以理解。

faithful.en: The translator produced a faithful rendering of the original medieval text.
faithful.zh: 译者忠实地再现了这部中世纪原著。

faithful.en: A faithful record of the experiment allows other laboratories to reproduce it.
faithful.zh: 对实验的忠实记录使其他实验室能够重复该实验。

faithful.en: Employees remain faithful to company values even under intense competitive pressure.
faithful.zh: 即使在激烈的竞争压力下，员工仍忠于公司的价值观。

ignorance.en: Ignorance of basic statistical principles leads researchers to accept false results.
ignorance.zh: 对基本统计原理的无知会使研究者接受错误的结果。

ignorance.en: The lecture addressed widespread ignorance about the causes of the epidemic.
ignorance.zh: 这场讲座试图消除人们对流行病成因的普遍无知。

ignorance.en: Ignorance is not an acceptable excuse for violating research ethics.
ignorance.zh: 无知不能成为违反研究伦理的正当理由。

reservoir.en: The reservoir supplies drinking water to more than two million residents.
reservoir.zh: 这座水库向两百多万居民提供饮用水。

reservoir.en: The university maintains a reservoir of graduate students who mentor undergraduates.
reservoir.zh: 该校维持着一个由指导本科生的研究生组成的人才库。

reservoir.en: Drought years have reduced the reservoir's storage capacity considerably.
reservoir.zh: 旱灾年份使水库的蓄水能力大幅下降。

cast light on.en: The new documents cast light on the causes of the financial crisis.
cast light on.zh: 这些新文件阐明了金融危机的成因。

cast light on.en: Her recent work casts light on why some policies backfire.
cast light on.zh: 她近期的研究阐明了为什么某些政策会产生反效果。

cast light on.en: These testimonies cast light on the living conditions of factory workers.
cast light on.zh: 这些证词使人们了解到工厂工人的生活状况。

myriad.en: The archive contains myriad documents describing the city's nineteenth-century trade.
myriad.zh: 档案馆收藏了大量描述该市 19 世纪贸易的文献。

myriad.en: Myriad studies have attempted to replicate the original experiment.
myriad.zh: 无数研究试图复现最初的实验。

myriad.en: The scientist faced myriad technical problems while developing the prototype.
myriad.zh: 在开发原型机时，这位科学家面临大量的技术难题。

prone.en: Elderly patients are particularly prone to complications after surgery.
prone.zh: 老年患者在术后特别容易出现并发症。

prone.en: Young drivers are prone to overestimating their own reaction time.
prone.zh: 年轻驾驶员容易高估自己的反应速度。

prone.en: Dry climates are prone to water shortages during the summer months.
prone.zh: 干燥气候在夏季月份容易出现缺水。

redundant.en: The second dataset proved redundant, since it repeated earlier measurements.
redundant.zh: 第二个数据集被证明是多余的，因为它重复了先前的测量结果。

redundant.en: Editors asked the author to remove redundant sections from the manuscript.
redundant.zh: 编辑要求作者删去手稿中重复的部分。

redundant.en: Modern processors contain redundant circuits that improve manufacturing reliability.
redundant.zh: 现代处理器包含冗余电路，从而提高了制造的可靠性。

comprise.en: The final report comprises twelve chapters and forty appendices.
comprise.zh: 最终报告由 12 章和 40 个附录组成。

comprise.en: The delegation comprises experts from eleven universities across three continents.
comprise.zh: 该代表团由来自三大洲 11 所大学的专家组成。

comprise.en: The collection comprises manuscripts, printed books, and unpublished correspondence.
comprise.zh: 该收藏包括手稿、印本书籍以及未发表的往来书信。

substantially.en: The new policy substantially reduced waiting times across all regional hospitals.
substantially.zh: 新政策大幅缩短了所有区域医院的等待时间。

substantially.en: Our understanding of the mechanism has changed substantially since earlier studies.
substantially.zh: 自早期研究以来，我们对该机制的理解已发生了很大变化。

substantially.en: Substantially more participants reported improved sleep after the intervention.
substantially.zh: 干预之后，报告睡眠状况改善的参与者明显增多。

entity.en: The university operates as an independent legal entity with its own charter.
entity.zh: 该大学以拥有自己章程的独立法律实体运作。

entity.en: Each nonprofit must register as a separate entity with the regulator.
entity.zh: 每家非营利机构都必须作为独立实体向监管机构登记。

entity.en: The concept of a nation remains a contested entity in political theory.
entity.zh: 民族这一概念在政治理论中仍是一个有争议的实体。

content.en: The content of the interviews was coded into four broad themes.
content.zh: 访谈的内容被编码为四个宽泛的主题。

content.en: Content analysis of the archived documents revealed a clear shift in tone.
content.zh: 对存档文件的内容分析揭示出语气的明显转变。

content.en: Schedule B lists the content of each interview module in detail.
content.zh: 附表 B 详细列出了每个访谈模块的内容。

either.en: The replication study did not confirm the original effect either.
either.zh: 复现研究也未能证实原始效应。

either.en: Without a control group, the second trial cannot rule out bias either.
either.zh: 没有对照组，第二次试验同样无法排除偏差。

either.en: The survey was not representative, and the interview sample was not large either.
either.zh: 调查样本不具代表性，访谈样本也不算大。

dichotomy.en: The dichotomy between theory and practice often undermines genuine progress in the field.
dichotomy.zh: 理论与实践之间的二分法常常阻碍该领域的真正进步。

dichotomy.en: Marketing managers face a stark dichotomy between short-term sales and long-term brand building.
dichotomy.zh: 市场营销经理面临短期销售与长期品牌建设之间的鲜明对立。

dichotomy.en: The report rejects the false dichotomy that growth and sustainability cannot coexist.
dichotomy.zh: 该报告否定了增长与可持续性无法共存这一虚假的二分法。

tentative.en: We reached a tentative agreement, although several details still require negotiation.
tentative.zh: 我们达成了初步协议，尽管若干细节仍有待谈判。

tentative.en: The researcher presented tentative findings that will be refined after further fieldwork.
tentative.zh: 研究者公布了初步的研究发现，这些结果将在进一步实地研究后加以完善。

tentative.en: The committee offered only tentative support for the proposed budget increase.
tentative.zh: 委员会对拟议的预算增长仅表示了试探性的支持。

assign.en: The supervisor assigned each student a research topic for the semester.
assign.zh: 导师为每位学生分配了本学期的研究课题。

assign.en: Historians often assign responsibility for the crisis to long-term structural factors.
assign.zh: 历史学家常把这场危机的责任归于长期的结构性因素。

assign.en: The manager assigned two engineers to resolve the system failure before Friday.
assign.zh: 经理指派了两名工程师在周五前解决系统故障。

assignment.en: Students must submit the written assignment before the end of the week.
assignment.zh: 学生必须在本周结束前提交书面作业。

assignment.en: Her assignment as project coordinator requires considerable organizational skill.
assignment.zh: 她作为项目协调员的职责需要相当强的组织能力。

assignment.en: The tutorial provides a challenging assignment that combines theory with practice.
assignment.zh: 本教程提供了一项将理论与实践相结合、颇具挑战性的作业。

extrapolate.en: Researchers extrapolated from a small sample and cautiously predicted wider trends.
extrapolate.zh: 研究者从一个很小的样本进行了推断，并谨慎地预测了更广泛的趋势。

extrapolate.en: It would be unwise to extrapolate such findings to the entire population.
extrapolate.zh: 把这类研究结果外推到整个人群是不明智的。

extrapolate.en: The model allows analysts to extrapolate future demand from historical sales data.
extrapolate.zh: 该模型使分析人员能够根据历史销售数据推断未来的需求。

trend.en: The data reveal a downward trend in student enrollment over the past decade.
trend.zh: 数据显示过去 10 年学生入学人数呈下降趋势。

trend.en: Analysts noted a growing trend toward renewable sources in the energy sector.
trend.zh: 分析师注意到能源领域正出现转向可再生能源的日益明显的趋势。

trend.en: The report follows a broader trend in academic writing toward greater transparency.
trend.zh: 该报告顺应了学术写作中更加注重透明度的更广泛趋势。

eligible.en: Only registered voters are eligible to participate in the municipal consultation.
eligible.zh: 只有登记选民才有资格参与市政咨询。

eligible.en: Applicants must be at least eighteen to be eligible for this scholarship.
eligible.zh: 申请者必须年满 18 岁才有资格获得该奖学金。

eligible.en: The new criteria make thousands of households eligible for housing support.
eligible.zh: 新的标准使数千户家庭有资格获得住房援助。

under no circumstances.en: Under no circumstances should researchers fabricate or alter their data.
under no circumstances.zh: 在任何情况下，研究人员都不应伪造或篡改数据。

under no circumstances.en: Under no circumstances will the laboratory share its samples without prior consent.
under no circumstances.zh: 未经事先同意，实验室在任何情况下都不会分享其样本。

under no circumstances.en: Under no circumstances can we ignore the ethical implications of this technology.
under no circumstances.zh: 无论如何我们都不能忽视这项技术的伦理影响。

infer.en: From the available evidence, we can infer that the two groups differ significantly.
infer.zh: 根据现有证据，我们可以推断这两个群体存在显著差异。

infer.en: The authors infer a causal relationship that the data cannot fully support.
infer.zh: 作者们推断出一种数据无法完全支持的因果关系。

infer.en: It would be unsafe to infer a general rule from a single case.
infer.zh: 从单个案例推断出一般规律是不安全的。

compact.en: The device has a compact design that fits easily into a laptop bag.
compact.zh: 该设备采用紧凑的设计，可轻松放进笔记本电脑包中。

compact.en: A compact grammar book is often more useful than a thick reference volume.
compact.zh: 一本简明扼要的语法书往往比厚重的参考书更有用。

compact.en: Dense urban housing provides compact living space at a reasonable cost.
compact.zh: 密集的城市住宅以合理的成本提供了紧凑的居住空间。

susceptibility.en: Genetic factors may increase susceptibility to the disease among elderly patients.
susceptibility.zh: 遗传因素可能增加老年患者对该疾病的易感性。

susceptibility.en: The material shows high susceptibility to corrosion in salty environments.
susceptibility.zh: 这种材料在含盐环境中极易腐蚀。

susceptibility.en: Sensitivity to light determines the susceptibility of the film during storage.
susceptibility.zh: 对光的敏感程度决定了胶片在储存期间的易受影响程度。

mutual.en: The two departments signed a mutual agreement on shared research funding.
mutual.zh: 两个部门就研究经费共享签署了共同协议。

mutual.en: Both sides recognized a mutual interest in reducing long-term operating costs.
mutual.zh: 双方都认识到在降低长期运营成本方面的共同利益。

mutual.en: Mutual trust between negotiators allowed the deal to close ahead of schedule.
mutual.zh: 谈判者之间的相互信任使交易得以提前完成。

entangle.en: Fishing nets can easily entangle marine mammals in coastal waters.
entangle.zh: 渔网很容易在沿海水域缠住海洋哺乳动物。

entangle.en: The investigation entangles several unrelated legal disputes that will require separate hearings.
entangle.zh: 这项调查把几起互不相关的法律争议纠缠在一起，需要分别审理。

entangle.en: Thick ivy can entangle the old fence and weaken its structure considerably.
entangle.zh: 浓密的常春藤会缠住旧栅栏，显著削弱其结构。

disentangle.en: Researchers must disentangle genetic factors from environmental ones to draw valid conclusions.
disentangle.zh: 研究者必须将遗传因素与环境因素分离开来，才能得出可靠的结论。

disentangle.en: It took several hours to disentangle the ropes from the tangled anchor.
disentangle.zh: 花了几个小时才把绳子从缠成一团的锚上解下来。

disentangle.en: The editor helped disentangle the main argument from numerous side remarks.
disentangle.zh: 编辑帮助把主要论点和众多附带评论区分开来。

extrinsic.en: Extrinsic rewards such as prizes can weaken a student's intrinsic motivation to learn.
extrinsic.zh: 奖品等外在奖励可能削弱学生内在的学习动机。

extrinsic.en: The device's unusual shape is an extrinsic feature rather than a functional necessity.
extrinsic.zh: 该装置奇特的形状是外在特征，而非功能上的必要设计。

extrinsic.en: Many graduates choose jobs for extrinsic reasons such as salary and prestige.
extrinsic.zh: 许多毕业生出于薪资和声望等外在原因选择工作。

roughly.en: Roughly two thirds of the participants preferred the original experimental design.
roughly.zh: 大约三分之二的参与者更偏好最初的实验设计。

roughly.en: The repair cost is roughly estimated at five thousand dollars.
roughly.zh: 维修费用粗略估计为 5000 美元。

roughly.en: The field shelters were roughly built from salvaged timber and tarpaulin.
roughly.zh: 野外庇护所是用回收木料和防水布粗糙搭成的。

relevance.en: The lecturer questioned the relevance of the theory to current medical practice.
relevance.zh: 讲师质疑这一理论与当前医疗实践的相关性。

relevance.en: Critics argued that the finding had little relevance to real classroom settings.
relevance.zh: 批评者认为这一发现与真实课堂情境几乎无关。

relevance.en: Employers increasingly value the practical relevance of graduates' writing skills.
relevance.zh: 雇主日益看重毕业生写作技能的实际价值。

unique.en: Each specimen in the collection has a unique pattern of pigmentation.
unique.zh: 该收藏中的每件标本都有独特的色素沉着图案。

unique.en: Her approach to teaching combines several unique advantages rarely seen elsewhere.
unique.zh: 她的教学方法结合了其他地方很少见的多项独特优势。

unique.en: The village was unique in preserving its original medieval layout.
unique.zh: 这个村庄因保留着原来的中世纪布局而与众不同。

retraction.en: The journal issued a formal retraction of the article after an investigation.
retraction.zh: 该期刊在调查后正式撤回了这篇文章。

retraction.en: The retraction of the grant proposal prompted a search for alternative funding.
retraction.zh: 资助申请被撤回促使各方寻找替代资金来源。

retraction.en: Her retraction of the earlier statement was reported widely in the press.
retraction.zh: 她对此前声明的撤回被媒体广泛报道。

spur.en: The award spurred further research into renewable energy storage technologies.
spur.zh: 该奖项推动了可再生能源储存技术的进一步研究。

spur.en: Rising fuel costs spurred manufacturers to adopt more efficient production methods.
spur.zh: 燃料成本上涨促使制造商采用更高效的生产方法。

spur.en: The director's comments spurred an urgent review of the department's priorities.
spur.zh: 主管的评论促使该部门紧急重新审视其工作重点。

skepticism.en: The announcement was met with widespread skepticism among members of the board.
skepticism.zh: 这一公告在董事会成员中引起了广泛的怀疑。

skepticism.en: Her skepticism toward the survey data led her to conduct her own interviews.
skepticism.zh: 她对调查数据的怀疑促使她自己进行访谈。

skepticism.en: Considerable skepticism remains about whether the treatment produces lasting benefits.
skepticism.zh: 对于这种治疗是否产生持久益处，仍存在相当多的怀疑。

visibility.en: Public visibility increased dramatically after the campaign appeared on national television.
visibility.zh: 该活动出现在全国电视上之后，公众可见度大幅提升。

visibility.en: Low visibility of remote workers may prevent managers from noticing their struggles.
visibility.zh: 远程员工可见度低可能导致管理者察觉不到他们的困境。

visibility.en: The charity works to increase the visibility of rare diseases in public awareness campaigns.
visibility.zh: 该慈善机构通过公众宣传活动提高罕见病的关注度。

observation.en: Direct observation of animal behavior requires months of fieldwork in difficult terrain.
observation.zh: 对动物行为的直接观察需要在艰难地形中进行数月的实地工作。

observation.en: The lab technician records every observation in a standardized logbook each hour.
observation.zh: 实验室技术员每小时把每一条观察记录在标准化的日志簿上。

observation.en: Her key observation that the two variables were correlated shaped the entire study.
observation.zh: 她关于两个变量相关的关键观察塑造了整个研究。

account for.en: Seasonal fluctuations account for much of the variation in annual sales figures.
account for.zh: 年度销售数字变化的大部分可归因于季节性波动。

account for.en: Ministers must account to parliament for every sum spent in an emergency.
account for.zh: 部长们必须就紧急状态下的每一笔开支向议会负责。

account for.en: Renewable sources now account for nearly a third of national electricity output.
account for.zh: 可再生能源目前约占全国发电量的近三分之一。

aside.en: Aside from minor formatting errors, the manuscript is ready for publication.
aside.zh: 除了轻微的格式错误外，这份稿件已可以发表。

aside.en: Set this point aside for a moment and consider the wider economic context.
aside.zh: 暂且把这一点放到一边，考虑一下更广泛的经济背景。

aside.en: Aside from the two volunteers, everyone had already left the laboratory.
aside.zh: 除两名志愿者外，所有人都已离开实验室。

roadmap.en: The committee published a roadmap for reforming the national research funding system.
roadmap.zh: 委员会公布了一份改革国家研究资助体系的路线图。

roadmap.en: Engineers updated the project roadmap after the second milestone fell behind schedule.
roadmap.zh: 第二个里程碑延期后，工程团队更新了项目路线图。

roadmap.en: A clear roadmap helps new employees understand how their tasks contribute to larger goals.
roadmap.zh: 清晰的路线图有助于新员工理解自己的任务如何服务于更大的目标。

pertain.en: Several regulations pertain to the storage of hazardous chemical materials.
pertain.zh: 有几项法规涉及危险化学材料的储存。

pertain.en: Questions about funding pertain mainly to the second phase of the project.
pertain.zh: 关于资金的问题主要涉及项目的第二阶段。

pertain.en: The remarks pertained to public health rather than to economic policy.
pertain.zh: 这些言论涉及公共卫生而非经济政策。

stark.en: The report highlights the stark contrast between reported and actual revenues.
stark.zh: 该报告突出了申报收入与实际收入之间的鲜明对比。

stark.en: Residents face stark choices between unemployment and accepting poorly paid work.
stark.zh: 居民面临失业与接受低薪工作之间残酷的选择。

stark.en: The experiment produced a stark warning about the long-term effects of pollution.
stark.zh: 该实验就污染的长期影响发出了严峻的警告。

synchronize.en: The two laboratories synchronize their clocks before every remote experiment.
synchronize.zh: 两个实验室在每次远程实验前同步时钟。

synchronize.en: Automatic updates keep the databases synchronized across all regional offices.
synchronize.zh: 自动更新使各地区办事处的数据库保持同步。

synchronize.en: The director asked both teams to synchronize their research schedules for the coming year.
synchronize.zh: 主任要求两个团队就明年的研究安排保持同步。

uncover.en: Investigators uncovered evidence of systematic fraud within the procurement department.
uncover.zh: 调查人员发现了采购部门存在系统性舞弊的证据。

uncover.en: Archaeologists uncovered a previously unknown chamber beneath the temple floor.
uncover.zh: 考古学家在寺庙地板下发现了一个此前未知的密室。

uncover.en: The audit uncovered discrepancies that had been hidden for several years.
uncover.zh: 审计揭露了数年来一直被掩盖的差异。

unusual.en: The specimen displayed an unusual combination of physical and chemical properties.
unusual.zh: 该样本表现出物理与化学性质的不寻常组合。

unusual.en: It is unusual for a small research group to publish in this prestigious journal.
unusual.zh: 一个小型研究小组能在这一著名期刊上发表论文并不常见。

unusual.en: The library holds several unusual manuscripts dating from the ninth century.
unusual.zh: 图书馆收藏着几份不同寻常的 9 世纪手稿。

pathway.en: The study identified a clear pathway from early trauma to later social withdrawal.
pathway.zh: 该研究确定了从早期创伤到日后社交退缩的清晰路径。

pathway.en: Graduate school provides a pathway into careers in scientific research.
pathway.zh: 研究生教育为进入科研职业提供了一条路径。

pathway.en: Mentorship programs offer students a practical pathway toward professional confidence.
pathway.zh: 指导项目为学生提供了一条通向职业自信的务实路径。

elementary.en: The course provides an elementary introduction to statistical analysis for newcomers.
elementary.zh: 该课程为初学者提供统计分析的入门介绍。

elementary.en: At the elementary level, students learn the basic rules of academic citation.
elementary.zh: 在初级阶段，学生学习学术引用的基本规则。

elementary.en: Even at an elementary level, the software requires careful attention to user permissions.
elementary.zh: 即便在入门阶段，该软件也需要仔细注意用户权限设置。

invisible.en: Infrared radiation is invisible to the human eye but easily detected by thermal sensors.
invisible.zh: 红外辐射对人眼不可见，但热传感器能够轻易探测到。

invisible.en: The invisible barrier of social convention shapes how people behave in public.
invisible.zh: 社会惯例这道无形的屏障影响着人们在公共场合的行为方式。

invisible.en: Many economic costs remain invisible because they are paid by future generations.
invisible.zh: 许多经济成本是无形的，因为最终由后代承担。

raise.en: The new policy raises questions about fairness in the distribution of resources.
raise.zh: 新政策引发了关于资源分配公平性的疑问。

raise.en: Rising sea levels raise serious concerns for coastal infrastructure planning.
raise.zh: 海平面上升引起了对沿海基础设施规划的严重关切。

raise.en: The laboratory raised funds to expand its study of urban air quality.
raise.zh: 该实验室筹集资金以扩大对城市空气质量的研究。

feature.en: A key feature of the design is its ability to accommodate disabled users.
feature.zh: 该设计的一个关键特征是能够容纳残障用户。

feature.en: The magazine's latest feature examines the rise of open-access publishing.
feature.zh: 该杂志最新的专题报道探讨了开放获取出版的兴起。

feature.en: Researchers should select features that are measurable and relevant to the research question.
feature.zh: 研究者应选择可测量且与研究问题相关的特征。

building block.en: Trust between researchers and participants is a fundamental building block of ethical research.
building block.zh: 研究者与参与者之间的信任是伦理研究的基本构件。

building block.en: The curriculum treats reading fluency as a building block for later comprehension.
building block.zh: 该课程把阅读流利度视为后续阅读理解能力的基本构件。

building block.en: Each module provides a building block for the advanced degree in statistics.
building block.zh: 每个模块都为统计学高级学位提供一块基础构件。

categorize.en: Participants were asked to categorize each document according to its source.
categorize.zh: 参与者被要求根据来源对每份文件进行分类。

categorize.en: The survey data help researchers categorize responses into broad thematic groups.
categorize.zh: 调查数据帮助研究者将回答归入宽泛的主题类别。

categorize.en: It is difficult to categorize the findings of such a preliminary study.
categorize.zh: 很难对这样一项初步研究的结果进行归类。

eminent.en: The conference attracted eminent scholars from twelve countries this year.
eminent.zh: 今年会议吸引了来自 12 个国家的杰出学者。

eminent.en: Her eminent career in physics inspired an entire generation of researchers.
eminent.zh: 她在物理学领域卓越的事业激励了整整一代研究者。

eminent.en: The village has long been home to an eminent school of philosophy.
eminent.zh: 该村庄长期以来一直是著名哲学流派的故乡。

dual.en: The agreement carries a dual purpose: reducing costs and improving access.
dual.zh: 该协议具有双重目的：降低成本和改善可及性。

dual.en: The economy retains a dual structure of modern industry and subsistence farming.
dual.zh: 该经济体保留了现代工业与自给自足的农业并存的双重结构。

dual.en: The lecture will address the dual nature of the transformation in higher education.
dual.zh: 这场讲座将讨论高等教育变革的双重性质。

diverge.en: The two research groups diverged sharply in their interpretation of the data.
diverge.zh: 两个研究小组对数据的解释出现了严重分歧。

diverge.en: Rural and urban migration paths diverge significantly across regions.
diverge.zh: 城乡迁移路径在各地区之间存在显著差异。

diverge.en: Two trails diverge at the summit, each leading to a different waterfall.
diverge.zh: 两条小径在山顶分岔，各自通向不同的瀑布。

equivocal.en: The minister gave an equivocal answer that satisfied neither side of the debate.
equivocal.zh: 部长给出了一个含糊的回答，令辩论双方都不满意。

equivocal.en: The evidence remains equivocal, so the researchers advise further testing.
equivocal.zh: 证据仍然模棱两可，因此研究者建议进一步检测。

equivocal.en: His equivocal remarks obscured the committee's actual decision.
equivocal.zh: 他模棱两可的言论掩盖了委员会的真实决定。

unequivocal.en: The review panel issued an unequivocal report condemning the laboratory's data handling.
unequivocal.zh: 评审组发布了一份毫不含糊的报告，谴责该实验室的数据处理方式。

unequivocal.en: Her unequivocal support for open science changed the department's culture.
unequivocal.zh: 她对开放科学的明确支持改变了该系的学术氛围。

unequivocal.en: Researchers need unequivocal evidence before drawing strong conclusions.
unequivocal.zh: 研究者在得出有力结论之前需要明确的证据。

originally.en: The theory was originally proposed to explain a narrow puzzle in chemistry.
originally.zh: 该理论最初是为了解释化学中的一个狭窄难题而提出的。

originally.en: Originally intended for industrial use, the polymer now serves medical implants.
originally.zh: 这种聚合物最初是面向工业用途设计的，如今用于医疗植入物。

originally.en: The manuscript was originally written in German and later translated.
originally.zh: 该手稿最初用德语写成，后来才被翻译。

fertile.en: Fertile soils in the river delta support most of the country's rice production.
fertile.zh: 河三角洲肥沃的土壤支撑着该国大部分稻米产量。

fertile.en: The seminar provided fertile ground for young researchers to share early ideas.
fertile.zh: 这场研讨会为年轻研究者分享早期想法提供了沃土。

fertile.en: Seasonal floods leave fertile sediment across the floodplain each year.
fertile.zh: 季节性洪水每年都在洪泛平原上留下肥沃的沉积物。

overall.en: Overall, the evidence supports a modest effect of the new policy.
overall.zh: 总的来说，证据支持新政策具有适度的效果。

overall.en: The overall design of the system favors simplicity and easy maintenance.
overall.zh: 该系统的整体设计强调简洁和易于维护。

overall.en: Overall costs, including training and downtime, exceed the original estimate.
overall.zh: 包括培训和停机在内的总成本超出了最初估算。

drive.en: Rising fuel prices drive households toward more efficient vehicles.
drive.zh: 燃油价格上涨促使家庭转向更节能的车辆。

drive.en: The research team was driven by a desire to reduce post-operative complications.
drive.zh: 研究团队受到减少术后并发症这一目标的推动。

drive.en: Recurring drought continues to drive food prices sharply higher.
drive.zh: 反复出现的干旱持续推动食品价格大幅上涨。

favor.en: The committee favors proposals that can be implemented within two years.
favor.zh: 委员会倾向于支持两年内可以实施的方案。

favor.en: Public opinion surveys consistently favor stronger limits on industrial emissions.
favor.zh: 民意调查一致支持对工业排放实施更严格的限制。

favor.en: Her early research was favored by reviewers for its methodological clarity.
favor.zh: 她早期的研究因其方法上的清晰性而受到评审的青睐。

coercive.en: The court ruled that the coercive questioning had violated the suspect's rights.
coercive.zh: 法院裁定这种胁迫性讯问侵犯了嫌疑人的权利。

coercive.en: Governments should avoid coercive measures when voluntary compliance remains possible.
coercive.zh: 在自愿遵守仍然可行的情况下，政府应避免采取强制手段。

coercive.en: A coercive management style tends to reduce creativity and trust among staff.
coercive.zh: 强制性的管理风格往往会降低员工的创造力和信任度。

acquire.en: Participants acquired a second language through daily online conversation practice.
acquire.zh: 参与者通过每天的线上对话练习掌握了一门第二语言。

acquire.en: The laboratory acquired advanced imaging equipment from a European supplier.
acquire.zh: 该实验室从一家欧洲供应商处购得了先进的成像设备。

acquire.en: Students acquire disciplinary vocabulary gradually as they read specialist articles.
acquire.zh: 随着阅读专业文章，学生逐渐掌握学科术语。

repeatable.en: A repeatable procedure is essential for reliable comparison across laboratories.
repeatable.zh: 可复验的程序对于跨实验室的可靠比较至关重要。

repeatable.en: The result was not repeatable, so the team questioned the initial measurement.
repeatable.zh: 该结果无法复现，因此团队对最初的测量提出了质疑。

repeatable.en: The coding scheme proved repeatable, with two raters agreeing on nearly every transcript.
repeatable.zh: 编码方案被证明是可复验的，两名评分员在几乎每一份转写上都一致。

synonym.en: No exact synonym for this technical term appears in the standard dictionary.
synonym.zh: 标准词典中没有出现与这个技术术语完全对应的同义词。

synonym.en: Each synonym in the list carries a slightly different connotation for readers.
synonym.zh: 列表中的每个近义词对读者而言都带有略微不同的内涵。

synonym.en: The authors offer a workable synonym for a term no longer in common use.
synonym.zh: 作者为一个已不再常用的术语提供了一个可行的同义词。

manipulate.en: The analyst warned that the company could manipulate reported figures to hide losses.
manipulate.zh: 分析师警告说，该公司可能操纵公布的数字以掩盖亏损。

manipulate.en: Students learn to manipulate data responsibly rather than merely present it.
manipulate.zh: 学生学会负责任地处理数据，而不只是呈现数据。

manipulate.en: Marketing teams manipulate color and spacing to influence how consumers perceive products.
manipulate.zh: 营销团队通过操控色彩与间距来影响消费者对产品的感知。

compromise.en: The two departments compromised on the budget and approved the shared project.
compromise.zh: 两个部门在预算问题上作出妥协，批准了共同项目。

compromise.en: We must compromise without abandoning the principles that justify our research.
compromise.zh: 我们必须作出妥协，同时不能放弃支撑我们研究的原则。

compromise.en: The final design compromises between engineering cost and long-term durability.
compromise.zh: 最终的设计在工程成本与长期耐久性之间取得了折中。

a posteriori.en: A posteriori reasoning identifies the cause only after the effect has occurred.
a posteriori.zh: 由果及因的推理只有在结果发生后才能确定原因。

a posteriori.en: The claim was accepted a posteriori, once the field data supported it.
a posteriori.zh: 在现场数据支持之后，这项主张才通过由果及因的推断被接受。

a posteriori.en: Distinguishing a priori from a posteriori explanations is central to the course.
a posteriori.zh: 区分先验解释与由果及因的解释是本课程的核心。

validate.en: The ethics board validated the revised protocol before the study began.
validate.zh: 在研究开始之前，伦理委员会审核确认了修订后的方案。

validate.en: Independent reviewers validated the findings through a separate replication effort.
validate.zh: 独立评审通过单独的复现研究验证了这些发现。

validate.en: A signed certificate validates the device for clinical use throughout the region.
validate.zh: 签署的证书使该设备在整个地区获准用于临床。

concrete.en: The proposal remains too vague; we need concrete examples of measurable outcomes.
concrete.zh: 该提案仍然过于含糊，我们需要可衡量成果的具体例子。

concrete.en: Lab results showed a concrete improvement in the durability of the composite.
concrete.zh: 实验结果表明复合材料耐久性有切实的改善。

concrete.en: The architect combined concrete blocks with transparent glass walls.
concrete.zh: 建筑师把混凝土砌块与透明玻璃墙结合起来。

approximate.en: The approximate cost of the survey was two thousand euros per site.
approximate.zh: 该项调查的估算成本为每个站点 2000 欧元。

approximate.en: Approximate figures suggest that demand will double within five years.
approximate.zh: 粗略的数据表明需求将在五年内翻一番。

approximate.en: Use an approximate value when precision is unavailable in the published table.
approximate.zh: 当已发表表格中没有精确数值时，请使用近似值。

onto.en: The researchers projected the data onto a two-dimensional surface for comparison.
onto.zh: 研究者把数据投影到二维表面上以便比较。

onto.en: The cat jumped onto the counter and startled the entire kitchen.
onto.zh: 猫跳上柜台，惊动了整个厨房。

onto.en: The mapping algorithm moves each observation onto the closest matching region.
onto.zh: 该映射算法将每个观测值映射到最接近的匹配区域上。

indeed.en: The early results are indeed promising, but they require larger samples.
indeed.zh: 早期结果确实令人鼓舞，但仍需更大的样本。

indeed.en: The difficulty is indeed greater than the literature had suggested.
indeed.zh: 这一困难确实比文献中所暗示的更大。

indeed.en: It is indeed a serious concern for researchers working with archival data.
indeed.zh: 对于使用档案数据的研究者来说，这确实是一个严重的问题。

metric.en: The metric converts raw observations into a single comparable score.
metric.zh: 该指标将原始观测值转换为单一的可比较分数。

metric.en: Researchers selected the metric because it directly captures teaching quality.
metric.zh: 研究者选择该指标，因为它能直接反映教学质量。

metric.en: Because the metric is measured in millimeters, comparisons across models are straightforward.
metric.zh: 由于该指标以毫米计量，跨模型比较十分直接。

stagger.en: The team staggered the start times to reduce pressure on the shared equipment.
stagger.zh: 团队错开开始时间，以减轻共享设备的压力。

stagger.en: Staggered schedules allow every participant access to the laboratory instruments.
stagger.zh: 错开的日程使每位参与者都能使用实验室仪器。

stagger.en: The designer staggered the seating so that every speaker remained visible.
stagger.zh: 设计师将座位错开排列，使每位发言者都能被看见。

problematic.en: Using self-reported data proved problematic when participants forgot to record entries.
problematic.zh: 当参与者忘记记录时，使用自我报告数据被证明是有问题的。

problematic.en: The proposal is problematic because it ignores regional differences in infrastructure.
problematic.zh: 该提案成问题，因为它忽略了基础设施的地区差异。

problematic.en: Several reviewers considered the causal claim highly problematic given the sample size.
problematic.zh: 鉴于样本量，几位评审认为该因果主张存在严重问题。

enrich.en: Field visits enrich the curriculum with knowledge textbooks cannot provide.
enrich.zh: 实地考察用教科书无法提供的知识充实了课程。

enrich.en: The revised edition enriches the discussion with comparative data from six countries.
enrich.zh: 修订版用来自六个国家的比较数据充实了讨论。

enrich.en: Seasonal floods enrich the farmland with minerals carried from upstream.
enrich.zh: 季节性洪水把上游带来的矿物质沉积到农田中，使其更为肥沃。

exponential.en: The spread of the virus showed exponential growth during the first month.
exponential.zh: 病毒传播在第一个月呈现指数增长。

exponential.en: Exponential increases in data volumes are driving demand for cloud archiving.
exponential.zh: 数据量的指数级增长正在推动对云归档的需求。

exponential.en: The team modeled the population using an exponential curve fitted to historical records.
exponential.zh: 团队使用依据历史记录拟合的指数曲线对人口进行建模。

segment.en: The study divides respondents into segments according to age and income.
segment.zh: 该研究根据年龄和收入将受访者划分为不同的群体。

segment.en: Commercial traffic forms the fastest growing segment of the market.
segment.zh: 商业运输构成了市场中增长最快的部分。

segment.en: Each segment of the pipeline was tested separately to locate the failure.
segment.zh: 数据流程的每个环节都被单独测试以定位故障。

scale.en: The survey was conducted on a national scale across more than three hundred schools.
scale.zh: 该调查在全国范围内于三百多所学校进行。

scale.en: The scale on the left measures pressure in pascals, while the right records temperature.
scale.zh: 左侧刻度以帕斯卡计量压力，右侧记录温度。

scale.en: Rigorous evidence exists on a smaller scale than the public often assumes.
scale.zh: 严格证据的存在范围比公众常常以为的要小。

expedient.en: Regulators chose an expedient measure to contain the crisis immediately.
expedient.zh: 监管机构选择了一项应急措施以立即控制危机。

expedient.en: The expedient decision solved the budget problem but created long-term costs.
expedient.zh: 这项权宜的决定解决了预算问题，却带来了长期成本。

expedient.en: The team adopted an expedient strategy rather than seeking a permanent solution.
expedient.zh: 该团队采取了权宜策略，而没有寻求永久解决方案。

tricky.en: Translating technical jargon into plain language remains a tricky exercise.
tricky.zh: 将专业术语转化为通俗语言仍是一项棘手的任务。

tricky.en: The tricky part is separating genuine effects from seasonal variation in the data.
tricky.zh: 难点在于从数据的季节性波动中分离出真实效应。

tricky.en: Managing expectations among stakeholders was a tricky part of the project.
tricky.zh: 管理利益相关者的期望是该项目中颇为棘手的部分。

counterintuitive.en: It is counterintuitive that removing a restriction can improve environmental outcomes.
counterintuitive.zh: 取消一项限制反而能改善环境结果，这看似违反直觉。

counterintuitive.en: The researchers noted a counterintuitive pattern in the collected responses.
counterintuitive.zh: 研究者注意到收集到的回答中出现了反直觉的模式。

counterintuitive.en: Students often find the counterintuitive result difficult to reconcile with prior experience.
counterintuitive.zh: 学生常常觉得这一反直觉的结果难以与以往经验相调和。

realm.en: Digital marketing now occupies a realm that traditional advertising never occupied.
realm.zh: 数字营销如今占据着传统广告从未涉足的一个领域。

realm.en: The agreement opened a new realm of cooperation between the two universities.
realm.zh: 该协议开启了两所大学之间合作的新领域。

realm.en: Questions of artistic taste belong to a realm that empirical evidence cannot settle.
realm.zh: 审美趣味问题属于实证证据无法裁决的领域。

arena.en: Graduate students increasingly compete in the global arena of scientific publishing.
arena.zh: 研究生越来越多地在科学出版的全球竞技场中竞争。

arena.en: The proposal won broad support within the academic arena of environmental policy.
arena.zh: 该提案在环境政策这一学术领域获得了广泛支持。

arena.en: Debate about data privacy has moved firmly into the political arena.
arena.zh: 关于数据隐私的辩论已经明确进入了政治舞台。

anchor.en: Researchers anchor their arguments in previously published empirical evidence.
anchor.zh: 研究者把论证锚定于此前已发表的实证证据上。

anchor.en: A single reliable dataset can anchor the entire statistical model.
anchor.zh: 一个可靠的数据集就能为整个统计模型提供稳固的基础。

anchor.en: The keynote speech anchored the entire afternoon conference session.
anchor.zh: 这篇主旨演讲支撑起整个下午的会议环节。

territory.en: Traditional linguists once regarded written grammar as their exclusive territory.
territory.zh: 传统语言学家曾把书面语法视为自己的专属领域。

territory.en: The theory of evolution transformed the territory of early nineteenth-century biology.
territory.zh: 进化论改变了 19 世纪初生物学的疆域。

territory.en: Much of the scholarly territory remains contested among competing research groups.
territory.zh: 其中相当一部分学术领域仍在相互竞争的研究团体之间存在争议。

nominal.en: The reform delivered only nominal gains, since real incomes remained unchanged.
nominal.zh: 这项改革只带来了名义上的收益，因为实际收入并未改变。

nominal.en: Membership on the committee is largely nominal and carries little decision-making power.
nominal.zh: 委员会成员资格在很大程度上只是名义上的，几乎没有决策权。

nominal.en: The difference between the two proposals was nominal rather than substantial.
nominal.zh: 两个提案之间的差别是名义上的，而非实质性的。

exert.en: Regulators exerted considerable pressure on banks to disclose their risk exposures.
exert.zh: 监管机构对银行施加强大压力，要求披露风险敞口。

exert.en: The new director exerted her authority to reorganize the entire research unit.
exert.zh: 新主任运用她的职权重组了整个研究部门。

exert.en: Gravity exerts a powerful influence on the motion of every satellite in orbit.
exert.zh: 引力对轨道上每颗卫星的运动都施加着强大的影响。

viable.en: Solar power is now a viable alternative to fossil fuel in many regions.
viable.zh: 在许多地区，太阳能已成为化石燃料的可行替代方案。

viable.en: Without sufficient funding, the research project is unlikely to remain viable.
viable.zh: 没有充足的资金，该研究项目不太可能继续维持下去。

viable.en: The committee concluded that the proposed reform was technically and politically viable.
viable.zh: 委员会认为所提议的改革在技术上和政治上都是可行的。

disrupt.en: The unexpected announcement disrupted the carefully arranged program of the conference.
disrupt.zh: 这一出人意料的公告打乱了会议精心安排的议程。

disrupt.en: New digital platforms have disrupted traditional retail businesses across the country.
disrupt.zh: 新的数字平台颠覆了全国的传统零售业务。

disrupt.en: Noise from the construction site disrupted the experiment running in the adjacent laboratory.
disrupt.zh: 工地传来的噪音干扰了相邻实验室里正在进行的实验。

impetus.en: Her criticism provided the necessary impetus for a complete reform of the curriculum.
impetus.zh: 她的批评为课程的全面改革提供了必要的推动力。

impetus.en: The publication of the study gave fresh impetus to debates about statistical practice.
impetus.zh: 该研究的发表为关于统计实践的讨论注入了新的动力。

impetus.en: Financial constraints removed much of the impetus behind the original project proposal.
impetus.zh: 财政限制大大削弱了最初项目提案背后的动力。

onset.en: The onset of symptoms typically occurs within forty-eight hours.
onset.zh: 症状通常在 48 小时内发作。

onset.en: The onset of severe weather delayed the departure of the research vessel.
onset.zh: 恶劣天气的来临延误了科考船的出发。

onset.en: Since the onset of the crisis, enrollment in the program has declined sharply.
onset.zh: 自危机开始以来，该项目的入学人数急剧下降。

category.en: The classification assigns each observation to a single clearly defined category.
category.zh: 该分类将每个观测值归入一个明确界定的类别。

category.en: Books of this category rarely circulate outside specialist libraries and archives.
category.zh: 这一类别的书籍很少在专业图书馆和档案馆之外流通。

category.en: The scheme creates a new category for interdisciplinary research proposals.
category.zh: 该计划为跨学科研究提案设立了一个新类别。

accuracy.en: The accuracy of the final figures depends on the quality of the raw measurements.
accuracy.zh: 最终数据的准确性取决于原始测量的质量。

accuracy.en: Independent auditors verified the accuracy of the published financial statements.
accuracy.zh: 独立审计人员核查了已发布财务报表的准确性。

accuracy.en: Students praised the explanation for its clarity and historical accuracy.
accuracy.zh: 学生们称赞这一解释清晰明了且符合史实。

analyze.en: Researchers analyzed survey data from more than two thousand households.
analyze.zh: 研究者分析了两千多户家庭的调查数据。

analyze.en: The software analyzes large genomic datasets in a matter of hours.
analyze.zh: 该软件只需数小时即可分析庞大的基因组数据集。

analyze.en: It is necessary to analyze the causes rather than merely describe the symptoms.
analyze.zh: 有必要分析原因，而不只是描述症状。

approach.en: The research approach combines statistical modeling with qualitative interviews.
approach.zh: 这套研究方法把统计建模与定性访谈结合起来。

approach.en: Our chosen approach allows the data to be collected at a manageable scale.
approach.zh: 我们选用的做法使数据能够在可承受的规模上收集。

approach.en: The team approached the problem from a completely different angle.
approach.zh: 团队从完全不同的角度处理了这个问题。

apply.en: Clinicians may apply these results directly to practice in rural hospitals.
apply.zh: 临床医生可以把这些结果直接应用于乡村医院的实践。

apply.en: Researchers must apply for funding before continuing the long-term observation study.
apply.zh: 研究者必须申请资金，才能继续这项长期观察研究。

apply.en: Supervisors should apply the same method to datasets of any size.
apply.zh: 导师应当把同样的方法应用于各种规模的数据集。

assess.en: The panel will assess each proposal against clear scientific and ethical criteria.
assess.zh: 评审委员会将依据明确的科学与伦理标准评估每份提案。

assess.en: Doctors assess the severity of the patient's condition before deciding treatment.
assess.zh: 医生在决定治疗方案前评估病情的严重程度。

assess.en: It is difficult to assess the long-term impact of the policy change.
assess.zh: 很难评估这一政策变化的长期影响。

assume.en: The model assumes that demand for electricity will double over the next decade.
assume.zh: 该模型假定未来 10 年电力需求将翻一番。

assume.en: Early scholars assumed that the stars moved in perfect circular paths.
assume.zh: 早期学者假定星辰沿完美的圆周运行。

assume.en: The newly appointed chair assumed responsibility for the entire research program.
assume.zh: 新任主席承担了整个研究项目的责任。

calculate.en: Engineers calculated the total load before approving the final structural design.
calculate.zh: 工程师在批准最终结构设计之前计算了总负载。

calculate.en: The team calculated that the experiment would require another six months.
calculate.zh: 团队估算该实验还需要六个月时间。

calculate.en: It is difficult to calculate the social cost of such delays.
calculate.zh: 很难计算此类延误所带来的社会成本。

combine.en: The treatment combines traditional methods with recently developed genetic techniques.
combine.zh: 该疗法将传统方法与新近开发的基因技术结合起来。

combine.en: These two datasets can be combined to produce a much larger sample.
combine.zh: 这两个数据集可以合并，形成大得多的样本。

combine.en: The design combines simplicity with durability, and remains inexpensive to manufacture.
combine.zh: 该设计兼具简洁与耐用，而且制造成本依然低廉。

compare.en: The study compares rainfall patterns across four regions over thirty years.
compare.zh: 该研究比较了四个地区 30 年间的降雨模式。

compare.en: Compared with the previous model, the new one predicts outcomes far more accurately.
compare.zh: 与先前模型相比，新模型对结果的预测准确得多。

compare.en: Historians often compare the French Revolution to the American War of Independence.
compare.zh: 历史学家常常把法国大革命与美国独立战争相比较。

conclude.en: The authors concluded that further research is needed to confirm these findings.
conclude.zh: 作者得出结论，认为需要进一步研究来证实这些发现。

conclude.en: The review will conclude with a summary of recommendations for policymakers.
conclude.zh: 综述将以对政策制定者的建议摘要结束。

conclude.en: The two departments concluded a formal agreement on shared laboratory facilities.
conclude.zh: 两个系就共用实验室设施达成了正式协议。

conduct.en: The team conducted a controlled experiment with two matched groups of participants.
conduct.zh: 团队用两个匹配的参与者小组进行了一项对照实验。

conduct.en: An experienced officer conducted the interview in a calm and professional manner.
conduct.zh: 一位经验丰富的官员以冷静而专业的方式进行了访谈。

conduct.en: Good governance requires that researchers conduct their work with full transparency.
conduct.zh: 良好的治理要求研究者以完全透明的方式开展工作。

consider.en: The committee will consider all proposals before announcing its decision in June.
consider.zh: 委员会将在六月宣布决定之前考虑所有提案。

consider.en: Many economists consider high inflation a serious threat to long-term growth.
consider.zh: 许多经济学家认为高通胀是对长期增长的严重威胁。

consider.en: Please consider the ethical implications before publishing your results.
consider.zh: 在发表你的研究结果之前，请考虑其中的伦理影响。

contribute.en: Regular exercise contributes greatly to the prevention of chronic disease.
contribute.zh: 规律运动对预防慢性疾病大有帮助。

contribute.en: She contributed an article on medieval trade to the history journal.
contribute.zh: 她向历史学期刊投稿了一篇关于中世纪贸易的论文。

contribute.en: Several factors contribute to the gradual decline of the regional dialect.
contribute.zh: 若干因素促成了该地方方言的逐渐衰落。

define.en: The committee will define the criteria before accepting any new submissions.
define.zh: 委员会将在接受任何新投稿之前界定相关标准。

define.en: This case defines the boundary between commercial and academic research.
define.zh: 这一案例界定了商业研究与学术研究之间的界线。

define.en: Words like 'efficiency' can define an entire political program.
define.zh: 像「效率」这样的词可以界定整个政治纲领。

demonstrate.en: The experiment demonstrated that the new material conducts heat remarkably well.
demonstrate.zh: 实验证明这种新材料导热性能非常好。

demonstrate.en: The lecturer demonstrated how the device operates during the afternoon session.
demonstrate.zh: 讲师在下午的课上示范了该设备的工作原理。

demonstrate.en: The results demonstrate a clear link between diet and recovery speed.
demonstrate.zh: 研究结果证明了饮食与恢复速度之间的明确联系。

depend.en: Crop yields depend heavily on rainfall and the availability of fertile soil.
depend.zh: 作物产量在很大程度上取决于降雨量和肥沃土壤的可获得性。

depend.en: The success of the project depends on cooperation between the two laboratories.
depend.zh: 该项目的成功取决于两个实验室之间的合作。

depend.en: Funding for long-term research depends on sustained public and private commitment.
depend.zh: 长期研究的资金依赖于公共和私人方面的持续投入。

describe.en: The article describes how ancient trade routes shaped Mediterranean economies.
describe.zh: 该文章描述了古代贸易路线如何塑造地中海经济。

describe.en: Witnesses describe the hours following the earthquake as chaotic and terrifying.
describe.zh: 目击者形容地震后的几个小时既混乱又可怕。

describe.en: No single term adequately describes this unusual mixture of traditions.
describe.zh: 没有任何一个词能充分描述这种不同传统的独特混合。

design.en: The team designed a low-cost sensor for monitoring water quality in rural areas.
design.zh: 团队设计了一款用于监测乡村水质的低成本传感器。

design.en: The architect designed the new library around a central reading courtyard.
design.zh: 建筑师围绕中央阅读庭院设计了新图书馆。

design.en: She designed the study to measure long-term changes in student motivation.
design.zh: 她设计这项研究旨在衡量学生动机的长期变化。

determine.en: Genes alone do not determine a person's chances of developing the disease.
determine.zh: 仅凭基因并不能决定一个人罹患该病的可能性。

determine.en: Further experiments will determine whether the treatment works in practice.
determine.zh: 进一步的实验将确定该疗法在实践中是否有效。

determine.en: The committee determined that the proposal lacked sufficient methodological rigor.
determine.zh: 委员会认定该提案缺乏足够的方法论严谨性。

develop.en: The institute developed a new method for detecting trace amounts of pollutants.
develop.zh: 该研究所开发出一种检测痕量污染物的新方法。

develop.en: Over decades, the two regions developed distinctly different agricultural traditions.
develop.zh: 数十年来，这两个地区形成了截然不同的农业传统。

develop.en: She developed an interest in medieval history while studying in Edinburgh.
develop.zh: 她在爱丁堡求学时逐渐对中世纪历史产生了兴趣。

discuss.en: The panel discussed the ethical implications of publishing incomplete data.
discuss.zh: 评审组讨论了发表不完整数据所涉及的伦理问题。

discuss.en: The author discusses several possible explanations for the observed pattern.
discuss.zh: 作者讨论了针对所观察模式的几种可能解释。

discuss.en: We discussed the proposal informally before the formal meeting began.
discuss.zh: 我们在正式会议开始前非正式地讨论了该提案。

enhance.en: Regular feedback greatly enhances the quality of student writing.
enhance.zh: 经常性的反馈能大幅提升学生写作的质量。

enhance.en: The redesign enhances both comfort and energy efficiency in older buildings.
enhance.zh: 这项改造既提升了旧建筑的舒适度，也提高了其能源效率。

enhance.en: Careful editing enhances the clarity of the argument considerably.
enhance.zh: 细致的编辑显著增强了论证的清晰度。

ensure.en: The protocol ensures that every participant provides informed written consent.
ensure.zh: 该规程确保每位参与者都提供知情书面同意。

ensure.en: Careful archiving ensures that the original data remain accessible to future researchers.
ensure.zh: 妥善的归档确保原始数据可供未来研究者查阅。

ensure.en: Auditors ensure that published results comply with accepted standards of conduct.
ensure.zh: 审计人员确保已发表的结果符合公认的行为规范。

estimate.en: Researchers estimate that the glacier has retreated nearly two kilometers since 1990.
estimate.zh: 研究者估计自 1990 年以来该冰川已后退近两公里。

estimate.en: The contractor estimated the total cost of repairs at two million euros.
estimate.zh: 承包商估算维修总成本为 200 万欧元。

estimate.en: We estimate the remaining lifespan of the equipment at roughly five years.
estimate.zh: 我们估计该设备的剩余使用寿命约为五年。

examine.en: The inspector examined the structural damage before approving the certificate of occupancy.
examine.zh: 检查员在签发入住许可前检查了结构性损坏情况。

examine.en: The study examines how family income affects educational attainment across regions.
examine.zh: 该研究考察家庭收入如何影响不同地区的教育成就。

examine.en: Doctors examined the patient carefully and ordered additional laboratory tests.
examine.zh: 医生仔细检查了病人，并安排了额外的实验室检测。

exist.en: No reliable evidence exists to support that particular claim.
exist.zh: 没有可靠的证据支持那个特定的说法。

exist.en: Such a large research institute did not exist before the war years.
exist.zh: 在战争年代之前并不存在如此庞大的研究所。

exist.en: A delicate balance must exist between academic freedom and institutional responsibility.
exist.zh: 学术自由与机构责任之间必须保持一种微妙的平衡。

expect.en: Analysts expect the economy to expand by two percent next year.
expect.zh: 分析师预计明年经济将增长 2%。

expect.en: Participants expected the task to be difficult, yet they completed it quickly.
expect.zh: 参与者原以为这项任务很难，却很快完成了。

expect.en: The university expects a record number of applications for the new doctoral program.
expect.zh: 大学预计新博士项目的申请人数将创纪录。

explain.en: The lecturer explained how the two statistical measures differ in practice.
explain.zh: 讲师解释了这两种统计指标在实际应用中的差异。

explain.en: Genes alone cannot explain the observed differences in recovery times.
explain.zh: 仅凭基因无法解释康复时间上观察到的差异。

explain.en: He explained his reasoning in a short note attached to the manuscript.
explain.zh: 他在随稿件附上的简短说明中解释了自己的推理过程。

explore.en: The research team will explore the geological causes of the collapse.
explore.zh: 研究团队将探究这次坍塌的地质成因。

explore.en: Students should explore alternative theories rather than accept conventional wisdom.
explore.zh: 学生应当探索替代性理论，而不是接受传统观点。

explore.en: The divers explored the shipwreck in remarkable detail.
explore.zh: 潜水员们对沉船遗址进行了极为细致的勘察。

express.en: Participants were invited to express their views on the proposed reform.
express.zh: 参与者被邀请就拟议中的改革发表意见。

express.en: The poem expresses a deep sense of isolation.
express.zh: 这首诗表达了一种深切的孤独感。

express.en: She expressed her disagreement through a formal written statement.
express.zh: 她通过一份正式的书面声明表达了自己的异议。

focus.en: Researchers should focus on the long-term consequences of the policy.
focus.zh: 研究者应当关注这项政策的长期后果。

focus.en: Her lecture focused on the causes of regional inequality.
focus.zh: 她的讲座聚焦于地区不平等的成因。

focus.en: The committee decided to focus its efforts on renewable energy.
focus.zh: 委员会决定将工作重点放在可再生能源上。

generate.en: Renewable sources generate a third of the country's electricity.
generate.zh: 可再生能源发电占该国电力的三分之一。

generate.en: The experiment generated unexpected results that challenged existing theories.
generate.zh: 这项实验产生了出乎意料的结果，挑战了既有理论。

generate.en: The event generated considerable interest among young researchers.
generate.zh: 这场活动在青年研究者中引起了极大兴趣。

highlight.en: The report highlights the growing gap between rural and urban incomes.
highlight.zh: 该报告突出了城乡收入差距日益扩大的问题。

highlight.en: She highlighted the need for clearer guidelines in the industry.
highlight.zh: 她强调了该行业需要更明确的指导方针。

highlight.en: The stark contrast highlights the structural weakness of the bridge.
highlight.zh: 鲜明的对比凸显了桥梁的结构性缺陷。

identify.en: The study will identify three major causes of employee turnover.
identify.zh: 该研究将确定员工流失的三个主要原因。

identify.en: Researchers can identify a strong link between sleep and memory performance.
identify.zh: 研究者可以确认睡眠与记忆表现之间的密切联系。

identify.en: Can you identify the species of bird in this photograph?
identify.zh: 你能辨认出这张照片中鸟的种类吗？

include.en: The final report will include detailed financial projections for five years.
include.zh: 最终报告将包含未来五年的详细财务预测。

include.en: Please make sure to include all supporting documents in your submission.
include.zh: 请确保在提交材料中包含所有证明文件。

include.en: The package includes software, cables, and a two-year warranty.
include.zh: 该套件包括软件、数据线以及两年保修服务。

involve.en: The project will involve collaboration with universities in three countries.
involve.zh: 该项目将涉及与三国高校的合作。

involve.en: Such decisions inevitably involve difficult ethical questions for administrators.
involve.zh: 此类决定不可避免地涉及让管理者头疼的伦理问题。

involve.en: The role involves coordinating volunteers across regional offices.
involve.zh: 该职位需要协调各地区办公室的志愿者。

judge.en: The panel will judge each submission against published criteria.
judge.zh: 评审小组将依据公布的评分标准评判每份投稿。

judge.en: Readers should not judge the novel by its cover alone.
judge.zh: 读者不应仅凭封面来评判这部小说。

judge.en: Historians judge the reform's success by its lasting effects.
judge.zh: 历史学家以改革的持久影响来评判其成败。

label.en: Careful researchers label every sample with its source and date.
label.zh: 严谨的研究人员会给每个样本标注来源和日期。

label.en: Do not label a theory as proven without strong empirical evidence.
label.zh: 没有充分的实证证据，不要把某个理论标注为已获证实。

label.en: The museum will label each artwork with its date of acquisition.
label.zh: 博物馆将标注每件艺术品的入藏日期。

maintain.en: The university must maintain high standards in its doctoral programs.
maintain.zh: 该大学必须在其博士项目中保持高标准。

maintain.en: Regular inspection helps maintain the structural integrity of old bridges.
maintain.zh: 定期检查有助于保持老旧桥梁的结构完整性。

maintain.en: He maintains that the current evidence does not support that conclusion.
maintain.zh: 他坚持认为现有证据并不支持该结论。

measure.en: Researchers measure the growth of algae on the northern slopes.
measure.zh: 研究者测量北坡上藻类的生长情况。

measure.en: Economic output alone cannot measure the social wellbeing of a nation.
measure.zh: 仅靠经济产出无法衡量一个国家的社会福祉。

measure.en: Researchers measured policy outcomes over ten years.
measure.zh: 研究者用 10 年的时间衡量了政策成效。

obtain.en: Graduates can obtain the required certificate after completing the course.
obtain.zh: 毕业生完成课程后即可取得所需证书。

obtain.en: The team obtained permission to survey the protected wetland.
obtain.zh: 该团队获得了调查这片受保护湿地的许可。

obtain.en: The team obtained useful historical data from public archives.
obtain.zh: 团队从公共档案馆获得了有价值的历史数据。

occur.en: Such an error rarely occurs in carefully audited systems.
occur.zh: 这类错误在经过严格审计的系统中很少发生。

occur.en: The idea occurred to her while she was traveling abroad.
occur.zh: 她在国外旅行时突然想到了这个主意。

occur.en: Most of these changes occurred within a single decade.
occur.zh: 这些变化大多发生在短短 10 年之内。

perform.en: The team performed a series of controlled experiments over two years.
perform.zh: 该团队在两年间进行了一系列对照实验。

perform.en: She performs well under pressure during public presentations.
perform.zh: 她在公开演讲中面对压力时表现出色。

perform.en: The committee will perform an annual review of research ethics.
perform.zh: 委员会将每年对科研伦理进行一次审查。

predict.en: Models can predict rainfall with reasonable accuracy three days ahead.
predict.zh: 模型能够提前三天以合理精度预测降雨。

predict.en: Nobody could predict the scale of the financial crisis.
predict.zh: 没有人能预见到这场金融危机的规模。

predict.en: The algorithm predicts which students are likely to withdraw.
predict.zh: 该算法预测哪些学生可能会中途退学。

prevent.en: Simple hygiene measures prevent most infections in clinical settings.
prevent.zh: 简单的卫生措施可以预防临床环境中大多数感染。

prevent.en: Careful planning prevented the project from exceeding its budget.
prevent.zh: 周密的规划使该项目免于超出预算。

prevent.en: Nothing could have prevented the collapse of the fishery.
prevent.zh: 任何措施都无法阻止渔业走向崩溃。

provide.en: The government will provide subsidies to small farms this year.
provide.zh: 政府今年将向小型农场提供补贴。

provide.en: The survey provides strong evidence for this interpretation.
provide.zh: 这项调查为这种解释提供了有力证据。

provide.en: Hotels must provide adequate fire exits for every floor.
provide.zh: 酒店必须为每一层提供足够的消防出口。

realize.en: Only later did she realize the significance of the discovery.
realize.zh: 她直到后来才意识到这一发现的重要意义。

realize.en: The team realized that the assumptions of the model were flawed.
realize.zh: 团队意识到该模型的假设存在缺陷。

realize.en: They realized their lifelong dream after years of persistent effort.
realize.zh: 经过多年的坚持不懈，他们终于实现了毕生的梦想。

receive.en: Applicants will receive confirmation within five working days.
receive.zh: 申请者将在五个工作日内收到确认通知。

receive.en: The hospital received a donation of new medical equipment.
receive.zh: 这家医院收到了一批新的医疗设备捐赠。

receive.en: She received encouraging feedback on her first article.
receive.zh: 她的第一篇文章得到了令人鼓舞的反馈。

recognize.en: The committee recognized the outstanding contributions of the laboratory staff.
recognize.zh: 委员会表彰了实验室工作人员的杰出贡献。

recognize.en: Many scholars now recognize the limitations of this influential model.
recognize.zh: 如今许多学者承认这一影响力很大的模型存在局限。

recognize.en: I did not recognize her in the crowded reception hall.
recognize.zh: 在拥挤的接待大厅里，我没认出她来。

reduce.en: The new method reduces the risk of infection dramatically.
reduce.zh: 新方法大幅降低了感染风险。

reduce.en: We must reduce our dependence on imported energy.
reduce.zh: 我们必须减少对进口能源的依赖。

reduce.en: Prolonged exposure to noise reduced the workers' concentration sharply.
reduce.zh: 长时间接触噪声使工人们的注意力明显下降。

reflect.en: Rising temperatures clearly reflect changes in regional rainfall patterns.
reflect.zh: 气温上升明显反映了区域降水模式的变化。

reflect.en: The water surface reflects the evening sky perfectly.
reflect.zh: 水面完美地倒映着傍晚的天空。

reflect.en: She reflected on the ethical problems raised by her research.
reflect.zh: 她思考了这项研究带来的伦理问题。

report.en: The inspector reported serious safety failures at the plant.
report.zh: 检查员报告了该工厂存在的严重安全隐患。

report.en: Employees reported that the working conditions had steadily improved.
report.zh: 员工们报告说工作条件一直在稳步改善。

report.en: She reports regularly on economic developments across the region.
report.zh: 她定期报道该地区的经济发展情况。

respond.en: The company responded quickly to complaints about the faulty device.
respond.zh: 该公司迅速回应了关于该故障设备的投诉。

respond.en: Regulators responded to the scandal by tightening disclosure requirements.
respond.zh: 监管机构通过收紧信息披露要求来回应这一丑闻。

respond.en: Our team responded effectively to the sudden change in demand.
respond.zh: 我们的团队有效应对了需求的突然变化。

suggest.en: The data suggest a strong correlation between rainfall and crop yields.
suggest.zh: 数据表明降雨量与作物产量之间存在很强的相关性。

suggest.en: I suggest delaying the decision until we have more evidence.
suggest.zh: 我建议在获得更多证据之前暂缓决定。

suggest.en: Her expression suggested that she disagreed with the proposal.
suggest.zh: 她的表情表明她不同意这个提议。

summarize.en: The final chapter summarizes the findings of both field studies.
summarize.zh: 最后一章总结了两项实地研究的发现。

summarize.en: Could you summarize the main arguments in three sentences?
summarize.zh: 你能否用三句话概括主要论点？

summarize.en: This table summarizes the monthly costs of the project.
summarize.zh: 这张表概括了该项目每月的成本。

support.en: The evidence supports the hypothesis that the two species compete.
support.zh: 证据支持这两个物种存在竞争的假设。

support.en: These beams support the roof of the old mill.
support.zh: 这些横梁支撑着老磨坊的屋顶。

support.en: The scholarship program supports graduate students from underrepresented regions.
support.zh: 该奖学金项目资助来自代表性不足地区的研究生。

test.en: Researchers tested the hypothesis using a large sample of respondents.
test.zh: 研究者利用大量受访者样本检验了该假设。

test.en: The laboratory tests soil samples for heavy metals every month.
test.zh: 该实验室每月检测土壤样本中的重金属。

test.en: The written exam tests both grammar and reading comprehension.
test.zh: 该笔试同时考查语法和阅读理解。

trace.en: Researchers traced the contamination back to a single chemical plant.
trace.zh: 研究者追溯出污染源头是一家化工厂。

trace.en: The design of the bowl can be traced to ancient Greece.
trace.zh: 这种碗的造型可追溯到古希腊。

trace.en: She traced the decline of the industry over three decades.
trace.zh: 她追溯了 30 年来该产业的衰落历程。

transform.en: New technology transformed the way the lab processes samples.
transform.zh: 新技术改变了实验室处理样本的方式。
