prioritize.en: Planners should prioritize long-term infrastructure over short-term cosmetic improvements.
prioritize.zh: 规划者应当优先考虑长期基础设施，而非短期的表面改造。

prioritize.en: The hospital prioritized emergency cases while routine surgeries waited for additional staff.
prioritize.zh: 医院优先处理急诊病例，常规手术则等待增派人员。

attain.en: Through sustained effort, the laboratory attained a level of precision that rivals commercial instruments.
attain.zh: 通过持续努力，该实验室达到了可与商用仪器匹敌的精密度。

attain.en: Few students attain such scores without extensive practice and tutoring support.
attain.zh: 没有大量练习和辅导支持，很少有学生能取得这样的分数。

attain.en: The region's economy attained steady growth once the new port opened.
attain.zh: 新港口开放后，该地区经济实现了稳定增长。

ascertain.en: Investigators must ascertain the exact cause before publishing their findings.
ascertain.zh: 调查人员必须查明确切原因后才能公布调查结果。

ascertain.en: It was difficult to ascertain whether the effect persisted after the drug was withdrawn.
ascertain.zh: 很难确定药物停用后该效应是否仍然存在。

ascertain.en: Auditors ascertained that the reported revenue figures had been altered deliberately.
ascertain.zh: 审计人员查明所报告的收入数字是被故意篡改的。

comprehend.en: First-year students often struggle to comprehend the theoretical assumptions underlying the model.
comprehend.zh: 一年级学生常常难以理解该模型背后的理论假设。

comprehend.en: Even experienced reviewers failed to comprehend how the two variables interacted over time.
comprehend.zh: 即便是经验丰富的评审也未能理解这两个变量是如何随时间相互作用的。

comprehend.en: The infographic helps non-specialists comprehend a complex statistical technique quickly.
comprehend.zh: 这份信息图帮助非专业人士快速理解一项复杂的统计方法。

underscore.en: The report underscores the urgent need for investment in public health infrastructure.
underscore.zh: 该报告着重强调了投资公共卫生基础设施的迫切必要性。

underscore.en: Her lecture underscored how language shapes the way individuals categorize experience.
underscore.zh: 她的讲座强调了语言如何塑造人们组织经验的方式。

underscore.en: The decline in literacy underscores the importance of adult education programs.
underscore.zh: 识字率的下降凸显了成人教育项目的重要性。

foster.en: Small group discussions foster critical thinking among students in large lecture courses.
foster.zh: 在大班讲授课程中，小组讨论培养学生的批判性思维。

foster.en: The company fosters a culture of openness, encouraging employees to report risks early.
foster.zh: 该公司营造开放的文化，鼓励员工尽早报告风险。

foster.en: Well-designed urban parks foster social interaction between residents of different ages.
foster.zh: 设计良好的城市公园促进不同年龄段居民之间的社会互动。

rationale.en: The rationale behind the new policy was explained in a detailed appendix.
rationale.zh: 新政策背后的理论依据在一个详细的附录中得到了说明。

rationale.en: Without a clear rationale, reviewers cannot judge whether the proposed changes are reasonable.
rationale.zh: 缺乏明确的理论依据，评审就无法判断拟议的改动是否合理。

rationale.en: Her rationale for choosing qualitative interviews centered on the depth of data required.
rationale.zh: 她选择定性访谈的理由围绕着所需数据的深度。

indicator.en: The unemployment rate serves as a key indicator of economic health.
indicator.zh: 失业率是衡量经济健康状况的关键指标。

indicator.en: Early signs of recovery appear in several leading indicators this quarter.
indicator.zh: 本季度若干先行指标已显现出复苏的早期迹象。

indicator.en: Rising customer retention is a strong indicator that the redesign succeeded.
indicator.zh: 客户留存率上升是改版成功的有力指标。

taxonomy.en: The university adopted a new taxonomy of research outputs in 2023.
taxonomy.zh: 该大学于 2023 年采用了一套新的研究成果分类法。

taxonomy.en: Without a shared taxonomy, departments classify the same project very differently.
taxonomy.zh: 如果没有统一的分类体系，各院系对同一项目的归类会大相径庭。

taxonomy.en: This taxonomy separates genuine scientific discovery from incremental routine improvement.
taxonomy.zh: 这一分类体系将真正的科学发现与渐进的日常改进区分开来。

corpus.en: The corpus contains more than two million academic articles published since 1990.
corpus.zh: 该语料库包含自 1990 年以来发表的逾两百万篇学术文章。

corpus.en: Researchers must ensure the corpus reflects the linguistic diversity of actual usage.
corpus.zh: 研究人员必须确保语料库反映实际使用的语言多样性。

corpus.en: Each entry in the corpus was manually tagged by two trained annotators.
corpus.zh: 语料库中的每个条目都由两名受过训练的标注者手工标注。

discrepancy.en: A clear discrepancy emerged between the reported sales figures and the bank records.
discrepancy.zh: 报告的销售数字与银行记录之间出现了明显差异。

discrepancy.en: The discrepancy in temperature readings was traced to a faulty calibration device.
discrepancy.zh: 温度读数上的差异最终归因于一台有故障的校准设备。

discrepancy.en: Reviewers should note any discrepancy between the methods section and the results.
discrepancy.zh: 评审应当注意方法部分与结果之间的任何不一致。

trade-off.en: The main trade-off is between system accuracy and computational cost.
trade-off.zh: 主要的取舍在于系统准确度与计算成本之间。

trade-off.en: Rapid growth often involves a trade-off between product quality and customer service.
trade-off.zh: 快速增长往往伴随着产品质量与客户服务之间的取舍。

trade-off.en: Planners accepted the trade-off to keep the project within its deadline.
trade-off.zh: 规划者接受了这一取舍，以使项目能在期限内完成。

robustness.en: The robustness of the algorithm was tested against noisy and incomplete data.
robustness.zh: 该算法的稳健性已针对含噪且不完整的数据进行了测试。

robustness.en: Critics questioned the robustness of the findings given the small sample size.
robustness.zh: 鉴于样本量较小，批评者质疑了研究结论的稳健性。

robustness.en: Additional training improved the system's robustness against adversarial input.
robustness.zh: 额外训练提升了该系统抵御对抗性输入的稳健性。

bias.en: Sampling bias can distort every conclusion drawn from the resulting dataset.
bias.zh: 抽样偏差会使从所得数据集中得出的每一项结论都发生失真。

bias.en: The reviewers acknowledged a slight bias toward positive published findings.
bias.zh: 评审承认其中存在略微偏向已发表正面结果的偏差。

bias.en: Independent auditing helps reduce bias in the evaluation of submitted work.
bias.zh: 独立审计有助于减少对所提交工作评价中的偏差。

variance.en: Variance in the results decreased considerably after the equipment was recalibrated.
variance.zh: 设备重新校准后，结果的方差明显下降。

variance.en: The report attributes the large variance in student scores to inconsistent marking.
variance.zh: 该报告将学生成绩的巨大方差归因于评分不一致。

variance.en: Any variance between the two laboratories was well within acceptable tolerance.
variance.zh: 两个实验室之间的任何差异都在可接受的容差范围内。

threshold.en: Participants were excluded when their scores fell below a predefined threshold.
threshold.zh: 当参与者的得分低于预设阈值时，他们被排除在外。

threshold.en: The alert triggers once sensor readings exceed the warning threshold.
threshold.zh: 一旦传感器读数超过警告阈值，警报就会触发。

threshold.en: Setting a reasonable threshold reduces false alarms in the detection system.
threshold.zh: 设定合理的阈值可以减少检测系统中的误报。

pipeline.en: The data pipeline automatically cleans and aggregates records every night.
pipeline.zh: 该数据流水线每晚自动清理并汇总记录。

pipeline.en: A broken stage in the deployment pipeline delayed the product launch by two weeks.
pipeline.zh: 部署流水线中的一个环节故障使产品发布推迟了两周。

pipeline.en: Engineers documented each step of the research pipeline for future replication.
pipeline.zh: 工程师记录了研究流水线的每一个步骤，以便日后复现。

workflow.en: The revised workflow reduced the number of approval steps for routine requests.
workflow.zh: 修订后的工作流减少了常规请求的审批环节。

workflow.en: New employees follow a standard workflow when handling customer complaints.
workflow.zh: 新员工处理客户投诉时遵循标准工作流程。

workflow.en: Digitizing the workflow saved the department roughly twenty working hours weekly.
workflow.zh: 将该工作流数字化每周为该部门节省约 20 个工作小时。

stakeholder.en: Each stakeholder received a summary of the findings before the public meeting.
stakeholder.zh: 在公开会议之前，每位利益相关者都收到了调查结果摘要。

stakeholder.en: Consulting early with stakeholders prevents costly disputes later in the project.
stakeholder.zh: 尽早咨询利益相关者可避免项目后期代价高昂的争执。

stakeholder.en: The policy change affects regulators, suppliers, and internal staff as stakeholders.
stakeholder.zh: 这项政策变更影响着作为利益相关者的监管机构、供应商和内部员工。

compliance.en: The company increased compliance with international data protection standards.
compliance.zh: 该公司提高了对国际数据保护标准的遵守程度。

compliance.en: Regulators inspect the plant annually to ensure compliance with safety rules.
compliance.zh: 监管机构每年检查该工厂，以确保符合安全规定。

compliance.en: Non-compliance with the agreement resulted in substantial financial penalties.
compliance.zh: 违反协议造成了巨额经济处罚。

legislation.en: New legislation requires all platforms to disclose how their algorithms rank content.
legislation.zh: 新立法要求所有平台披露其算法如何对内容进行排序。

legislation.en: The proposed legislation passed the committee vote last Thursday.
legislation.zh: 拟议的立法于上周四通过了委员会表决。

legislation.en: Companies should review pending legislation before committing to long-term investment plans.
legislation.zh: 企业在制定长期投资计划前应审视待审议的立法。

governance.en: Good corporate governance requires independent oversight of the executive board.
governance.zh: 良好的公司治理要求对董事会进行独立监督。

governance.en: The reform reshaped the governance of public hospitals throughout the country.
governance.zh: 该改革重构了全国公立医院的治理方式。

governance.en: Weak governance allowed serious conflicts of interest to go unchallenged.
governance.zh: 治理薄弱使严重的利益冲突得以无人质疑地存在。

accountability.en: Clear lines of accountability ensure that mistakes are reported rather than hidden.
accountability.zh: 清晰的责任机制确保错误被报告而非隐藏。

accountability.en: The new policy establishes clear accountability for meeting sustainability targets.
accountability.zh: 新政策为实现可持续性目标确立了明确的责任机制。

accountability.en: Without meaningful accountability, even well-designed reforms will fail.
accountability.zh: 如果缺乏有效的问责，即使是精心设计的改革也会失败。

transparency.en: Transparency in the allocation of research funding increases public trust.
transparency.zh: 科研经费分配的透明度提升了公众信任。

transparency.en: The journal requires authors to declare conflicts of interest for transparency.
transparency.zh: 该期刊要求作者声明利益冲突以保持透明。

transparency.en: Consumers responded positively to greater transparency about pricing on the platform.
transparency.zh: 消费者对平台上更透明的价格信息反应积极。

sustainability.en: The long-term sustainability of the fund depends on stable annual contributions.
sustainability.zh: 该基金的长期可持续性取决于稳定的年度缴款。

sustainability.en: Engineers evaluated the sustainability of current materials before recommending alternatives.
sustainability.zh: 工程师在推荐替代材料前评估了现有材料的可持续性。

sustainability.en: Sustainability targets are now embedded in the organization's strategic planning process.
sustainability.zh: 可持续性目标现已嵌入该组织的战略规划流程。

resilience.en: The resilience of local economies during the crisis surprised many forecasters.
resilience.zh: 当地经济在危机中的韧性让许多预测人士感到意外。

resilience.en: Diversified supply chains increase a company's resilience against unexpected disruptions.
resilience.zh: 多元化的供应链增强了企业抵御意外中断的韧性。

resilience.en: Vegetated slopes contribute significantly to the resilience of coastal communities.
resilience.zh: 绿化过的坡地对沿海社区的恢复力有显著贡献。

infrastructure.en: The grant will fund upgrades to the region's transport infrastructure over five years.
infrastructure.zh: 该拨款将在五年内资助该地区交通基础设施的升级。

infrastructure.en: Digital infrastructure determines how quickly universities can adopt new research tools.
infrastructure.zh: 数字基础设施决定着高校采用新研究工具的速度。

infrastructure.en: Rural communities often lack the infrastructure needed for reliable internet access.
infrastructure.zh: 农村社区往往缺乏实现可靠互联网接入所需的基础设施。

ecosystem.en: Restoring wetlands strengthens the entire coastal ecosystem over time.
ecosystem.zh: 恢复湿地能够长期增强整个沿海生态系统。

ecosystem.en: The startup operates within a thriving ecosystem of investors and research partners.
ecosystem.zh: 这家初创企业活跃于一个充满投资人与研究伙伴的繁荣生态之中。

ecosystem.en: Pollution from manufacturing disrupted the balance of the local aquatic ecosystem.
ecosystem.zh: 制造业造成的污染扰动了当地水生生态系统的平衡。

literacy.en: The program aims to improve digital literacy among senior citizens in rural areas.
literacy.zh: 该项目旨在提高农村地区老年人的数字素养。

literacy.en: Functional literacy in statistics is increasingly necessary for reading published research.
literacy.zh: 具备基本的统计素养对于阅读已发表的研究正变得越来越必要。

literacy.en: Schools should treat media literacy as a core component of the standard curriculum.
literacy.zh: 学校应当把媒介素养视为标准课程的核心组成部分。

coherence.en: The essay was rejected because it lacked coherence between its argument and evidence.
coherence.zh: 这篇论文被驳回，因为其论点与证据之间缺乏连贯性。

coherence.en: Careful editing restored coherence to a report assembled from several departments.
coherence.zh: 细致的编辑使一份由多个部门拼合的报告恢复了连贯性。

coherence.en: Judges valued the coherence of the team's strategy across all three campaigns.
coherence.zh: 评委们看重该团队在全部三项活动中的策略一致性。

distinction.en: The distinction between correlation and causation is central to the analysis.
distinction.zh: 相关性与因果性之间的区别是分析的核心。

distinction.en: The proposal draws a clear distinction between routine maintenance and major renovation.
distinction.zh: 该提案明确区分了日常维护与重大翻修。

distinction.en: That distinction matters little once the sample size drops below fifty participants.
distinction.zh: 一旦样本量降至 50 人以下，这一区别就无关紧要了。

magnitude.en: The magnitude of the response surprised even the researchers who designed the experiment.
magnitude.zh: 反应之大甚至让设计该实验的研究人员也感到惊讶。

magnitude.en: We still do not understand the true magnitude of the social problem.
magnitude.zh: 我们仍未真正了解这一社会问题的严重程度。

magnitude.en: The magnitude of the losses was estimated at nearly two million dollars.
magnitude.zh: 损失的规模估计接近两百万美元。

dimension.en: The study examines three dimensions of organizational culture across public sector agencies.
dimension.zh: 该研究考察了公共部门机构中组织文化的三个维度。

dimension.en: Adding a temporal dimension to the model revealed unexpected seasonal variation in demand.
dimension.zh: 在模型中加入时间维度后，发现了需求出人意料的季节性变化。

dimension.en: The problem is not technical but political, and thus of a different dimension entirely.
dimension.zh: 这个问题不是技术性的，而是政治性的，因此完全属于另一个维度。

mechanism.en: The proposed mechanism explains how moderate inflation influences wage growth.
mechanism.zh: 所提出的机制解释了适度通货膨胀如何影响工资增长。

mechanism.en: Researchers proposed a mechanism linking sleep loss to impaired memory consolidation.
mechanism.zh: 研究者提出了一种将睡眠不足与记忆巩固受损联系起来的机制。

mechanism.en: Faulty gear mechanisms account for most of the reported production downtime.
mechanism.zh: 齿轮机构故障造成了所报告的大部分生产停机时间。

methodology.en: The methodology combines archival research with twenty semi-structured interviews.
methodology.zh: 该研究方法将档案研究与 20 次半结构化访谈相结合。

methodology.en: Critics questioned the methodology underlying the widely cited survey results.
methodology.zh: 批评者质疑了这一广受引用的调查结果背后的研究方法。

methodology.en: A mixed methodology was adopted to capture both quantitative and qualitative evidence.
methodology.zh: 研究采用了混合方法以同时获取定量和定性证据。

synthesis.en: The final chapter offers a synthesis of findings from four independent studies.
synthesis.zh: 最后一章综合了四项独立研究的研究发现。

synthesis.en: Chemical synthesis of the compound gave a final yield of eighty percent.
synthesis.zh: 该化合物的化学合成产率达到了 80%。

synthesis.en: Her essay provides a convincing synthesis of competing theoretical frameworks.
synthesis.zh: 她的论文对相互竞争的理论框架作出了令人信服的综述。

nuance.en: The translator preserved every nuance of the original diplomatic correspondence.
nuance.zh: 译者保留了原始外交函件中的每一处细微差别。

nuance.en: Interpreters often miss the nuance that distinguishes similar legal terms.
nuance.zh: 口译员常常会忽略区分相近法律术语的微妙之处。

nuance.en: The article captures the nuance of public opinion remarkably well.
nuance.zh: 这篇文章极为出色地把握了公众舆论的微妙之处。

precedent.en: The ruling set an important precedent for future data protection cases.
precedent.zh: 该裁决为今后的数据保护案件确立了重要先例。

precedent.en: No precedent exists for handling disputes involving autonomous vehicles.
precedent.zh: 在处理涉及自动驾驶汽车的纠纷方面尚无先例。

precedent.en: His decision to publish early established a precedent within the research group.
precedent.zh: 他提前发表的做法在该研究小组内确立了先例。

notation.en: The notation used in this paper follows standard conventions in econometrics.
notation.zh: 本文所用的记号遵循计量经济学的标准惯例。

notation.en: Students must master the notation before attempting complex calculations.
notation.zh: 学生在进行复杂计算之前必须掌握这些符号体系。

notation.en: A revised notation makes the equations considerably easier to follow.
notation.zh: 经过修订的符号体系使这些方程式更容易理解。

abstraction.en: The abstraction of key variables allowed the model to generalize across datasets.
abstraction.zh: 对关键变量的抽象使模型能够推广到不同的数据集。

abstraction.en: High levels of abstraction often hinder communication with non-specialist audiences.
abstraction.zh: 高度的抽象往往会妨碍与非专业受众的沟通。

abstraction.en: Some theorists regard the rational agent as an unhelpful abstraction.
abstraction.zh: 一些理论家认为，理性人假设不过是一种无益的抽象。

granularity.en: The data are recorded at a granularity of one second for accurate analysis.
granularity.zh: 数据以一秒的粒度记录，以便进行精确分析。

granularity.en: Increasing the granularity of the survey revealed important subgroup differences.
granularity.zh: 提高调查的精细程度揭示了重要的子群体差异。

granularity.en: Users can adjust the granularity of the timeline to suit their needs.
granularity.zh: 用户可以调整时间轴的粒度以满足自身需求。

attribution.en: Proper attribution of sources reduces plagiarism in academic writing.
attribution.zh: 正确标注来源可以减少学术写作中的抄袭现象。

attribution.en: The attribution of blame to individual actors ignores structural causes.
attribution.zh: 把责任归于个人行为者忽视了结构性原因。

attribution.en: Data attribution remains difficult when models combine several datasets.
attribution.zh: 当模型结合多个数据集时，数据归因仍然很困难。

correlation.en: A strong correlation exists between sleep duration and academic performance.
correlation.zh: 睡眠时长与学业表现之间存在很强的相关性。

correlation.en: Correlation does not imply causation, and the distinction matters greatly.
correlation.zh: 相关并不等同于因果关系，这一区别非常重要。

correlation.en: The researchers reported a negative correlation with statistical significance.
correlation.zh: 研究者报告了一个具有统计显著性的负相关关系。

deviation.en: Standard deviation of the measurements exceeded the tolerance allowed by engineers.
deviation.zh: 测量值的标准偏差超出了工程师允许的容差范围。

deviation.en: Any deviation from the approved protocol must be documented and justified.
deviation.zh: 任何偏离既定方案的做法都必须记录并说明理由。

deviation.en: The observed deviation in temperature suggested a faulty sensor.
deviation.zh: 观察到的温度偏差表明传感器可能存在故障。

calibration.en: Regular calibration of the instruments ensures consistent and reliable measurements.
calibration.zh: 定期校准仪器可确保测量结果的一致性与可靠性。

calibration.en: The calibration curve allowed researchers to convert signals into accurate concentrations.
calibration.zh: 校准曲线使研究者能够把信号转化为准确的浓度值。

calibration.en: Sensor calibration was performed twice before each experimental session.
calibration.zh: 每次实验开始前都进行了两次传感器校准。

feasibility.en: The committee assessed the feasibility of expanding the research program.
feasibility.zh: 委员会评估了扩展该研究计划的可行性。

feasibility.en: A pilot study was conducted to test the feasibility of the approach.
feasibility.zh: 开展了一项试点研究以检验该方法的可行性。

feasibility.en: Despite its technical feasibility, the project lacks sufficient funding.
feasibility.zh: 尽管该项目在技术上可行，但资金不足。

resolution.en: The committee adopted a resolution condemning the manipulation of the data.
resolution.zh: 委员会通过了一项谴责数据操纵行为的决议。

resolution.en: Higher resolution imaging revealed fine structures previously invisible to researchers.
resolution.zh: 更高分辨率的成像揭示了此前研究者无法看到的精细结构。

resolution.en: He made a firm resolution to complete the thesis by December.
resolution.zh: 他下定决心要在 12 月前完成论文。

comprehension.en: Reading comprehension scores among second-language learners remain low nationally.
comprehension.zh: 全国范围内，二语学习者的阅读理解得分仍然偏低。

comprehension.en: Careful comprehension of the methodology is essential before replication.
comprehension.zh: 在复现该研究之前，仔细理解其研究方法至关重要。

comprehension.en: Students demonstrated stronger lexical comprehension than grammatical comprehension.
comprehension.zh: 学生表现出的词汇理解能力强于语法理解能力。

traceability.en: Full traceability of the product requires recording every stage of manufacture.
traceability.zh: 实现产品的完全可追溯性需要记录每一个制造环节。

traceability.en: Improved traceability allows regulators to identify the source of contaminated batches.
traceability.zh: 可追溯性的提升使监管机构能够查明受污染批次的来源。

traceability.en: The certification scheme rewards exporters who can demonstrate full traceability.
traceability.zh: 该认证计划奖励能够证明完全可追溯性的出口商。

authenticity.en: Museum curators test the authenticity of documents before displaying them publicly.
authenticity.zh: 博物馆策展人在公开展出文件前会检验其真实性。

authenticity.en: The authenticity of the recording was questioned by several expert reviewers.
authenticity.zh: 该录音的真实性受到几位专家评审的质疑。

authenticity.en: Doubts about the dataset's authenticity delayed its publication considerably.
authenticity.zh: 对该数据集真实性的疑虑大大推迟了它的发表。

integrity.en: The laboratory ensures the integrity of every sample during long-term storage.
integrity.zh: 实验室在长期储存过程中确保每个样本的完整性。

integrity.en: Academic integrity policies prohibit the falsification of experimental results.
integrity.zh: 学术诚信政策禁止伪造实验结果。

integrity.en: Encryption protects data integrity during transmission between remote servers.
integrity.zh: 加密技术可保护数据在远程服务器之间传输时的完整性。

provenance.en: The provenance of archival materials must be recorded before they are displayed.
provenance.zh: 档案材料展出之前必须记录其来源信息。

provenance.en: The provenance of these specimens traces back to a nineteenth-century expedition.
provenance.zh: 这些标本的来源可追溯到 19 世纪的一次考察。

provenance.en: Clear provenance records help buyers verify the authenticity of rare manuscripts.
provenance.zh: 清晰的来源记录有助于买家核实珍贵手稿的真伪。

redundancy.en: Redundancy in the system protects against unexpected component failures.
redundancy.zh: 系统中的冗余可防范意外出现的部件故障。

redundancy.en: The editorial team removed redundancy to tighten the argument considerably.
redundancy.zh: 编辑团队删去冗余内容，使论证紧凑了不少。

redundancy.en: Redundancy in recruitment is common when grants fund multiple similar projects.
redundancy.zh: 当资助金支持多个相似项目时，重复招聘的情况很常见。

throughput.en: Higher throughput depends on reducing latency in the request processing pipeline.
throughput.zh: 更高的吞吐量取决于降低请求处理管道中的延迟。

throughput.en: The upgrade doubled the system's throughput during peak trading hours.
throughput.zh: 这次升级使系统在交易高峰期的吞吐量翻了一番。

throughput.en: Throughput remains limited by the number of available processing cores.
throughput.zh: 吞吐量仍然受可用处理核心数量的限制。

perception.en: Public perception of the policy changed sharply after the televised debate.
perception.zh: 电视辩论之后，公众对该政策的看法发生了急剧变化。

perception.en: Color perception varies considerably between individuals and display devices.
perception.zh: 色彩感知在个体之间以及不同显示设备之间差异明显。

perception.en: Risk perception strongly influences whether households purchase insurance.
perception.zh: 风险认知显著影响家庭是否购买保险。

robust.en: The robust framework survived repeated stress tests without structural failure.
robust.zh: 这个稳健的框架经受住了多次压力测试而未发生结构性失效。

robust.en: Her robust argument convinced even the most skeptical members of the committee.
robust.zh: 她有力的论证说服了委员会中最持怀疑态度的成员。

robust.en: A robust economy absorbs external shocks better than a fragile one.
robust.zh: 稳健的经济体比脆弱的经济体更能吸收外部冲击。

coherent.en: The paper presents a coherent account of the causes of the crisis.
coherent.zh: 该论文对危机成因提出了连贯的解释。

coherent.en: To remain coherent, the report must avoid contradictory claims about the data.
coherent.zh: 为了保持一致，报告必须避免对数据作出自相矛盾的主张。

coherent.en: Their coherent strategy linked research funding to measurable social outcomes.
coherent.zh: 他们连贯的策略把科研经费与可衡量的社会成效联系起来。

comprehensive.en: The study offers a comprehensive review of four decades of clinical evidence.
comprehensive.zh: 该研究对 40 年的临床证据作了全面的综述。

comprehensive.en: Comprehensive reforms will require sustained investment in rural infrastructure.
comprehensive.zh: 全面的改革需要对农村基础设施的持续投入。

comprehensive.en: Her comprehensive bibliography includes over two hundred scholarly sources.
comprehensive.zh: 她那份全面的参考文献目录收录了两百多篇学术文献。

implicit.en: The report contains an implicit assumption that demand will remain stable.
implicit.zh: 该报告隐含地假定需求将保持稳定。

implicit.en: Implicit bias may shape which applicants receive funding from agencies.
implicit.zh: 内隐偏差可能影响哪些申请者获得机构资助。

implicit.en: Much of the contract's risk was implicit rather than explicitly stated.
implicit.zh: 该合同的大部分风险是隐含的而非明确写出的。

novel.en: The novel approach reduces training time without sacrificing accuracy.
novel.zh: 这种新颖的方法在不影响准确性的前提下减少了训练时间。

novel.en: Her novel theory challenged decades of accepted scientific thought.
novel.zh: 她的新颖理论挑战了几十年来被公认的科学观点。

novel.en: The company developed a novel method for detecting structural damage.
novel.zh: 该公司开发了一种检测结构损伤的全新方法。

conclusive.en: No single study produced conclusive results, so a meta-analysis was commissioned.
conclusive.zh: 没有哪项研究得出确凿的结果，因此又委托开展了一项元分析。

conclusive.en: Researchers called for a larger trial to provide conclusive proof of benefit.
conclusive.zh: 研究者呼吁开展更大规模的试验以提供确凿的疗效证明。

conclusive.en: The audit gave conclusive answers on every disputed point.
conclusive.zh: 审计对所有争议点都给出了确定性的结论。

arbitrary.en: The deadline for submission appeared completely arbitrary to the reviewing panel.
arbitrary.zh: 对评审小组而言，提交截止日期显得完全是随意设定的。

arbitrary.en: Choosing an arbitrary threshold produced results that contradicted earlier findings.
arbitrary.zh: 选择一个任意的阈值所得出的结果与早前的发现相矛盾。

arbitrary.en: Decisions based on arbitrary criteria are difficult to defend publicly.
arbitrary.zh: 基于武断标准作出的决定很难在公众面前得到辩护。

heterogeneous.en: The sample was heterogeneous, combining participants from diverse regions and backgrounds.
heterogeneous.zh: 该样本是异质的，涵盖了来自不同地区和背景的参与者。

heterogeneous.en: Heterogeneous data require careful treatment before any statistical modeling.
heterogeneous.zh: 异质数据在任何统计建模之前都需要谨慎处理。

heterogeneous.en: The heterogeneous collection of documents makes automated classification difficult.
heterogeneous.zh: 这些文件的混杂性使得自动分类变得困难。

homogeneous.en: The treatment and control groups should form a homogeneous population.
homogeneous.zh: 实验组与对照组应当构成同质的总体。

homogeneous.en: A homogeneous sample strengthens the internal validity of the experiment.
homogeneous.zh: 同质样本能增强实验的内部效度。

homogeneous.en: The region is culturally homogeneous, which simplifies our fieldwork considerably.
homogeneous.zh: 该地区在文化上是同质的，这大大简化了我们的田野工作。

optimal.en: The algorithm searches for the optimal solution under the stated constraints.
optimal.zh: 该算法在既定约束条件下搜索最优解。

optimal.en: Researchers identified the optimal temperature for preserving the biological samples.
optimal.zh: 研究者确定了保存这些生物样本的最佳温度。

optimal.en: This design achieves an optimal balance between accuracy and computational cost.
optimal.zh: 这一设计在准确性与计算成本之间取得了最佳平衡。

partial.en: Only partial data were available when the analysis was first conducted.
partial.zh: 初次进行分析时只能获得部分数据。

partial.en: The report offers a partial explanation for the discrepancies in the records.
partial.zh: 该报告对记录中的差异给出了部分的解释。

partial.en: Partial coverage of the sampling area limits the reliability of the estimates.
partial.zh: 对抽样区域的局部覆盖限制了估计结果的可靠性。

systematic.en: A systematic review of three hundred studies was conducted last year.
systematic.zh: 去年开展了一项涵盖 300 项研究的系统综述。

systematic.en: Systematic errors in the calibration procedure distorted the final measurements.
systematic.zh: 校准程序中的系统性误差扭曲了最终的测量结果。

systematic.en: The team adopted a systematic approach to identifying and prioritizing the risks.
systematic.zh: 团队采用系统化方法来识别风险并确定其优先级。

transparent.en: The review process must remain transparent to maintain public trust.
transparent.zh: 评审过程必须保持透明，才能维持公众信任。

transparent.en: The report gives a transparent account of how the data were collected.
transparent.zh: 该报告对数据采集方式作了清晰的说明。

transparent.en: Transparent governance helps to reduce corruption within public institutions.
transparent.zh: 透明的治理有助于减少公共机构中的腐败。

holistic.en: A holistic approach considers environmental, social and economic factors together.
holistic.zh: 整体性的方法会同时考虑环境、社会和经济因素。

holistic.en: The clinic offers holistic care rather than treating symptoms separately.
holistic.zh: 该诊所提供整体性的照护，而不是孤立地治疗症状。

holistic.en: She adopted a holistic view of student wellbeing across the whole school.
holistic.zh: 她采用全校范围的整体视角来看待学生福祉。

interdisciplinary.en: The interdisciplinary team combined expertise from physics, chemistry and engineering.
interdisciplinary.zh: 这个跨学科团队融合了物理、化学和工程方面的专长。

interdisciplinary.en: Interdisciplinary research often produces findings that single disciplines cannot explain.
interdisciplinary.zh: 跨学科研究常常产生单一学科无法解释的发现。

interdisciplinary.en: Funding schemes should reward interdisciplinary collaboration between laboratories.
interdisciplinary.zh: 资助计划应当奖励各实验室之间的跨学科合作。

nuanced.en: Her nuanced analysis avoided oversimplifying the causes of the conflict.
nuanced.zh: 她细致的分析避免了对冲突成因的过度简化。

nuanced.en: The review offered a nuanced assessment of the policy's actual impact.
nuanced.zh: 这篇综述对政策的实际影响作出了细致入微的评判。

nuanced.en: Judges valued the defendant's nuanced understanding of the cultural context.
nuanced.zh: 法官们看重被告对文化背景细致入微的理解。

quantitative.en: Quantitative analysis revealed a strong relationship between the two variables.
quantitative.zh: 定量分析显示这两个变量之间存在密切关系。

quantitative.en: The course combines quantitative methods with qualitative fieldwork techniques.
quantitative.zh: 该课程把定量方法与定性田野调查技术结合起来。

quantitative.en: Funding decisions should rely on quantitative evidence rather than anecdote alone.
quantitative.zh: 资助决定应当依据定量证据，而不能仅凭轶事。

methodological.en: Her methodological approach to data collection greatly strengthened the validity of the study.
methodological.zh: 她在数据收集方面采用的方法论有力地增强了该研究的效度。

methodological.en: Reviewers criticized the paper for lacking methodological rigor in sample selection.
methodological.zh: 评论者批评该论文在样本选择上缺乏方法上的严谨性。

methodological.en: The team revised its methodological design after the pilot study revealed serious flaws.
methodological.zh: 试点研究暴露出严重缺陷后，团队修订了研究设计。

sustainable.en: The university adopted a sustainable model for managing its research funding.
sustainable.zh: 该大学采用了一套可持续的科研经费管理模式。

sustainable.en: Sustainable agriculture practices can reduce soil erosion and conserve water.
sustainable.zh: 可持续的农业做法能够减少土壤侵蚀并节约水资源。

sustainable.en: Without renewable energy sources, such growth will not be sustainable in the long term.
sustainable.zh: 如果没有可再生能源，这种增长从长远来看将无法持续。

cohesive.en: The research team maintained a cohesive argument throughout the entire dissertation.
cohesive.zh: 研究团队在整篇论文中保持了一个连贯统一的论证。

cohesive.en: Effective planning produced a cohesive strategy that united all department goals.
cohesive.zh: 有效的规划制定出一项凝聚各部门目标的连贯战略。

cohesive.en: The committee worked as a cohesive unit to approve the new budget.
cohesive.zh: 该委员会作为一个有凝聚力的整体通过了新预算。

discrete.en: The signal can be decomposed into a series of discrete components for analysis.
discrete.zh: 该信号可以分解为一系列离散的成分用于分析。

discrete.en: Each discrete stage of the pipeline was tested independently by the engineers.
discrete.zh: 流水线的每个独立阶段都由工程师单独测试。

discrete.en: The model treats these variables as discrete rather than continuous.
discrete.zh: 该模型把这些变量视为离散变量而非连续变量。

succinct.en: Her succinct summary made the complex findings accessible to a broad audience.
succinct.zh: 她简洁的总结使复杂的研究成果为广大读者所理解。

succinct.en: The reviewers requested a succinct statement of the study's main contribution.
succinct.zh: 评论者要求对该研究的主要贡献作出简明的陈述。

succinct.en: A succinct abstract is often all that reviewers read before deciding.
succinct.zh: 在决定之前，评论者往往只读一段简明的摘要。

substantive.en: The committee made a substantive change to the proposal after lengthy discussion.
substantive.zh: 经过长时间讨论，委员会对提案作出了实质性的修改。

substantive.en: The seminar offered substantive criticism rather than superficial praise.
substantive.zh: 这次研讨课给出的是实质性的批评而非表面的赞扬。

substantive.en: Her contribution to the debate was substantive and well documented.
substantive.zh: 她对这场辩论的贡献是实质性的，并且有充分文献支持。

tangible.en: The grant provided tangible support for graduate students conducting fieldwork.
tangible.zh: 这项资助为从事田野调查的研究生提供了实实在在的支持。

tangible.en: Policy makers want tangible evidence that the reform reduced unemployment.
tangible.zh: 政策制定者希望看到确凿证据，证明改革确实降低了失业率。

tangible.en: The agreement produced tangible results within a single year.
tangible.zh: 该协议在一年内就取得了实际成果。

transient.en: The early gains proved transient once the subsidy was removed.
transient.zh: 补贴取消后，早期的收益被证明只是短暂的。

transient.en: Most of the transient effects disappeared within a few weeks.
transient.zh: 这些短暂的影响大部分在几周内就消退了。

transient.en: Researchers distinguished transient noise from persistent signal in the data.
transient.zh: 研究人员将数据中的瞬时噪声与持续信号区分开来。

sequential.en: The sequential nature of the experiment means each trial depends on the previous one.
sequential.zh: 该实验的顺序性意味着每次试验都依赖于前一次试验。

sequential.en: Teachers presented the material in sequential order to build student understanding.
sequential.zh: 教师按顺序呈现材料，以逐步建立学生的理解。

sequential.en: Sequential approval is required before the grant funds can be released.
sequential.zh: 在拨款释放之前必须获得逐级批准。

overarching.en: An overarching theme of the volume is the relationship between technology and social change.
overarching.zh: 该文集的一个总括性主题是技术与社会变革之间的关系。

overarching.en: The overarching goal of the project is to reduce carbon emissions across the region.
overarching.zh: 该项目的根本目标是减少整个地区的碳排放。

overarching.en: These specific findings support the overarching argument of the paper.
overarching.zh: 这些具体发现支持了论文的总括性论点。

pervasive.en: Social media has become a pervasive influence on political opinion worldwide.
pervasive.zh: 社交媒体已成为对全球政治意见无处不在的影响力量。

pervasive.en: There was a pervasive smell of chemicals throughout the manufacturing plant.
pervasive.zh: 整个制造厂弥漫着刺鼻的化学品气味。

pervasive.en: The pervasive use of automation raises difficult questions about employment.
pervasive.zh: 自动化的普遍使用提出了关于就业的棘手问题。

profound.en: The discovery had a profound effect on the entire field of medicine.
profound.zh: 这一发现对整个医学领域产生了深远的影响。

profound.en: Her lecture offered profound insights into language acquisition.
profound.zh: 她的讲座对语言习得提出了深刻的见解。

profound.en: The war caused profound economic hardship across the region for decades.
profound.zh: 这场战争数十年来给该地区造成了深重的经济困境。

thereby.en: The researchers reduced sample sizes, thereby lowering costs and shortening timelines.
thereby.zh: 研究人员缩小了样本量，从而降低了成本并缩短了时间。

thereby.en: Refining the model improved accuracy, thereby strengthening the study's conclusions.
thereby.zh: 改进模型提高了准确度，从而强化了该研究的结论。

thereby.en: The team published its data openly, thereby encouraging independent replication.
thereby.zh: 该团队公开其数据，从而鼓励了独立的复现。

respectively.en: The two groups scored 82 and 74 points on the comprehension test, respectively.
respectively.zh: 两组在理解测试中分别得到 82 分和 74 分。

respectively.en: Growth and unemployment fell by three and two percent, respectively.
respectively.zh: 增长率和失业率分别下降了 3% 和 2%。

respectively.en: The first and second groups received five and ten hours of training, respectively.
respectively.zh: 第一组和第二组分别接受了 5 小时和 10 小时的培训。

similarly.en: Similarly, students in rural areas reported less access to laboratory resources.
similarly.zh: 同样地，农村地区的学生表示获得实验室资源的机会更少。

similarly.en: The second experiment produced similarly strong evidence for the hypothesis.
similarly.zh: 第二次实验为该假设提供了同样有力的证据。

similarly.en: Similarly, other studies have confirmed the link between sleep and memory.
similarly.zh: 同样地，其他研究也证实了睡眠与记忆之间的联系。

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, other laboratories continued gathering data on the same species.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，其他实验室仍在收集同一物种的数据。

meanwhile.en: The talks continued for three days; meanwhile, the fieldwork was postponed.
meanwhile.zh: 会谈持续了三天，与此同时野外调查被推迟了。

meanwhile.en: Meanwhile, the government introduced subsidies for farmers facing severe drought.
meanwhile.zh: 与此同时，政府为面临严重干旱的农民发放了补贴。

arguably.en: This is arguably the most important limitation of the proposed framework.
arguably.zh: 这可以说是该拟议框架最重要的局限。

arguably.en: Her approach is arguably more suitable for small samples than large ones.
arguably.zh: 可以说，她的方法更适合小样本而非大样本。

arguably.en: It is arguably unfair to judge the design on its first year alone.
arguably.zh: 仅凭第一年的表现就评判这项设计可以说是不公平的。

presumably.en: The authors presumably had access to the original archival records.
presumably.zh: 这些作者大概可以查阅原始档案记录。

presumably.en: Presumably, the delay resulted from incomplete data supplied by the agency.
presumably.zh: 大概这一延迟是由于该机构提供的数据不完整所致。

presumably.en: The missing samples are presumably still stored in the university laboratory.
presumably.zh: 那些缺失的样品大概仍存放在该大学的实验室里。

predominantly.en: The sample consisted predominantly of graduate students from engineering disciplines.
predominantly.zh: 样本主要由工程学科的研究生组成。

predominantly.en: The findings apply predominantly to large urban institutions rather than small colleges.
predominantly.zh: 这些发现主要适用于大型城市院校，而非小型学院。

predominantly.en: Participants were predominantly drawn from households with high incomes.
predominantly.zh: 参与者主要来自高收入家庭。

simultaneously.en: The imaging system simultaneously recorded activity in twelve separate brain regions.
simultaneously.zh: 该成像系统同时记录了 12 个不同脑区的活动。

simultaneously.en: Two laboratories simultaneously tested the compound using slightly different protocols.
simultaneously.zh: 两个实验室同时用略有不同的方案测试该化合物。

simultaneously.en: The platform simultaneously tracks shipments, inventory levels, and customer returns.
simultaneously.zh: 该平台同时跟踪货运、库存水平与客户退货。

markedly.en: Recovery was markedly faster in households that received direct cash payments.
markedly.zh: 获得现金补助的家庭的复苏明显更快。

markedly.en: The revised design markedly improved the durability of the outer coating.
markedly.zh: 重新设计的方案明显提高了外层的耐久性。

markedly.en: Male and female participants differed markedly in their willingness to disclose.
markedly.zh: 男性和女性参与者在披露意愿上存在明显差异。

jointly.en: The two universities jointly supervise the doctoral program and share facilities.
jointly.zh: 这两所大学共同指导该博士项目并共享实验设施。

jointly.en: The agencies jointly funded the project and published a shared report.
jointly.zh: 这些机构联合资助了该项目并发布了一份共同报告。

jointly.en: The authors jointly developed the model and divided the writing equally.
jointly.zh: 作者们共同开发了该模型，并平等分担了写作工作。

mutually.en: The two agreements are mutually dependent and cannot be enforced separately.
mutually.zh: 这两份协议相互依存，无法单独执行。

mutually.en: Both sides remain mutually committed to the ceasefire and to further negotiations.
mutually.zh: 双方仍相互承诺遵守停火协议并继续谈判。

mutually.en: The criteria are mutually exclusive, so no candidate satisfies all of them.
mutually.zh: 这些标准彼此互斥，因此没有候选人能同时满足全部条件。

collectively.en: Taken collectively, the studies provide strong evidence for the original claim.
collectively.zh: 总体来看，这些研究为最初的论断提供了有力证据。

collectively.en: The departments collectively agreed to share a single data repository.
collectively.zh: 各部门一致同意共享同一个数据存储库。

collectively.en: Collectively, the team members raised nearly half of the required funding.
collectively.zh: 团队成员合计筹集了所需资金近一半。

uniformly.en: Measurements were uniformly high across all twelve laboratories involved in the trial.
uniformly.zh: 参与试验的 12 家实验室的测量结果一律偏高。

uniformly.en: Students performed uniformly better after receiving individualized feedback from instructors.
uniformly.zh: 在得到教师个性化反馈后，学生的表现一致地有所提高。

uniformly.en: Uniformly applied rules ensure that every applicant is evaluated on the same basis.
uniformly.zh: 统一适用的规则确保每位申请者都按同一标准接受评估。

by contrast.en: By contrast, the second cohort showed almost no improvement over the same period.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，第二个队列在同一时期几乎没有改善。

by contrast.en: By contrast, rural clinics reported far shorter waiting times than urban hospitals.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，乡村诊所报告的等候时间远短于城市医院。

by contrast.en: By contrast, the smaller model achieved higher accuracy while using fewer parameters.
by contrast.zh: 相比之下，较小的模型在参数更少的情况下达到了更高的准确率。

in contrast.en: In contrast, coastal ecosystems recovered more slowly after the warming event.
in contrast.zh: 与之形成对比的是，海岸生态系统在变暖事件后恢复得更慢。

in contrast.en: In contrast to earlier estimates, the new survey produced considerably lower figures.
in contrast.zh: 与早先的估计相比，新调查得出的数字要低得多。

in contrast.en: Male applicants dominated engineering, in contrast to nursing and primary education.
in contrast.zh: 与护理和初等教育不同，工程专业的申请者以男性居多。

in addition.en: In addition, the authors provide the raw data for independent verification.
in addition.zh: 此外，作者们还提供了原始数据以供独立验证。

in addition.en: The method reduces costs, in addition to shortening the waiting time for applicants.
in addition.zh: 该方法除了缩短申请者的等待时间外，还降低了成本。

in addition.en: In addition to funding, the foundation offers technical assistance to small enterprises.
in addition.zh: 除提供资金外，该基金会还为小型企业提供技术援助。

hence.en: The instrument lacked calibration; hence all readings from that week were discarded.
hence.zh: 仪器未经过校准，因此那一周的所有读数都被弃用了。

hence.en: Enrollment fell sharply; hence the university merged two smaller departments.
hence.zh: 入学人数急剧下降，因此该大学合并了两个较小的院系。

hence.en: The data were collected inconsistently; hence the authors recommend a cautious interpretation.
hence.zh: 数据收集不一致，因此作者建议谨慎解读。

given that.en: Given that the results were replicated twice, the finding appears highly reliable.
given that.zh: 鉴于该结果已被复现两次，这一发现看起来非常可靠。

given that.en: Given that funding may be withdrawn, the team decided to archive all materials.
given that.zh: 鉴于资金可能被撤回，团队决定将所有材料存档。

given that.en: Given that each participant met the criteria, the sample was highly homogeneous.
given that.zh: 鉴于每位参与者都符合标准，该样本高度同质。

even if.en: Even if the pilot fails, the lessons will inform the full trial.
even if.zh: 即使试点失败，这些经验也将为完整试验提供参考。

even if.en: Even if costs rise, the laboratory must maintain adequate sample storage.
even if.zh: 即便成本上升，实验室也必须维持足够的样本存储条件。

even if.en: Even if reviewers disagree, the authors believe the interpretation is defensible.
even if.zh: 即使评论者持不同意见，作者仍认为这一解读站得住脚。

even though.en: Even though the sample was small, the effect size was remarkably large.
even though.zh: 尽管样本量较小，效应量却相当大。

even though.en: Even though revenue grew, the company reported its first operating loss.
even though.zh: 尽管营收增长，该公司仍报告了首次经营亏损。

even though.en: Even though the two systems differ, they produce nearly identical outputs.
even though.zh: 虽然这两个系统存在差异，但它们产生的输出几乎完全相同。

so that.en: The instructions were written clearly so that graduate students could follow them.
so that.zh: 说明书写得很清楚，以便研究生能够照着操作。

so that.en: We added a control group so that the effect could be measured separately.
so that.zh: 我们增加了对照组，以便单独测量该效应。

so that.en: The form was shortened so that participants would complete it quickly.
so that.zh: 表格被缩短了，以便参与者能迅速填完。

as long as.en: As long as the sample remains sealed, the findings will remain reproducible.
as long as.zh: 只要样本保持密封，研究结果就仍然可以复现。

as long as.en: As long as funding continues, the archive will remain open to scholars.
as long as.zh: 只要资金持续供应，档案馆就会继续向学者开放。

as long as.en: As long as the assumptions hold, the estimate remains a reasonable approximation.
as long as.zh: 只要假设成立，该估计仍然是一个合理的近似值。

rather than.en: The team revised the hypothesis rather than discarding the original dataset.
rather than.zh: 团队修改了假设，而不是丢弃原始数据集。

rather than.en: We should measure energy loss rather than simply report total output.
rather than.zh: 我们应当测量能量损耗，而不是仅仅报告总产出。

rather than.en: The author argues for structural reform rather than incremental adjustment.
rather than.zh: 该作者主张进行结构改革，而不是逐步调整。

investigate.en: Regulators investigated the factory after receiving complaints about chemical discharges.
investigate.zh: 监管机构在接到关于化学品排放的投诉后调查了这家工厂。

investigate.en: The committee will investigate how the error entered the published dataset.
investigate.zh: 委员会将调查该错误是如何进入已发表数据集的。

investigate.en: Graduates should investigate primary sources before relying on secondary summaries.
investigate.zh: 毕业生在依赖二手概述之前应当查阅原始资料。

justify.en: The researchers must justify their choice of instrumentation before the review panel.
justify.zh: 研究人员必须在评审组面前说明选择该仪器设备的理由。

justify.en: The cost increase does not justify abandoning the long-term study.
justify.zh: 成本上升并不足以成为放弃长期研究的理由。

justify.en: Later critics questioned whether the original authors could justify their conclusions.
justify.zh: 后来的批评者质疑原作者能否证明其结论是合理的。

maximize.en: The scheduling algorithm aims to maximize the number of completed sessions.
maximize.zh: 该排程算法的目标是使已完成的会议数量最大化。

maximize.en: Farmers can maximize their yield by adjusting irrigation to local rainfall patterns.
maximize.zh: 农民可以通过调整灌溉来适应当地降雨模式，使产量最大化。

maximize.en: The design team restructured the interface to maximize efficiency during data entry.
maximize.zh: 设计团队重新设计了界面，使数据录入时的效率最大化。

minimize.en: Careful calibration helps minimize measurement error across the entire sample.
minimize.zh: 仔细校准有助于使整个样本的测量误差最小化。

minimize.en: The new protocol minimizes patient discomfort without sacrificing diagnostic accuracy.
minimize.zh: 新的操作规程在不影响诊断准确性的前提下尽量减轻患者不适。

minimize.en: Shipping by rail minimizes the carbon footprint of long-distance transport.
minimize.zh: 采用铁路运输可使长途运输的碳足迹降至最低。

modify.en: Researchers modified the original questionnaire after the pilot interviews revealed ambiguity.
modify.zh: 在试点访谈暴露出歧义后，研究人员修改了原始问卷。

modify.en: Engineers modified the housing to reduce noise from the adjacent road.
modify.zh: 工程师改造了住房，以减少相邻道路带来的噪声。

modify.en: The committee decided to modify the draft before circulating it to members.
modify.zh: 委员会决定在分发给成员之前对草案进行修改。

monitor.en: Researchers monitored the wetland for three years to track its recovery.
monitor.zh: 研究人员对该湿地进行了三年监测，以追踪其恢复情况。

monitor.en: Regulators must monitor emissions from factories located near residential neighborhoods.
monitor.zh: 监管机构必须监测居民区附近工厂排放的废气。

monitor.en: We monitor patient symptoms daily and adjust the dosage accordingly.
monitor.zh: 我们每日监测患者症状，并据此调整剂量。

optimize.en: Engineers optimized the algorithm to reduce processing time significantly.
optimize.zh: 工程师对算法进行了优化，显著缩短了处理时间。

optimize.en: Firms optimize their supply chains to lower costs and shorten delivery times.
optimize.zh: 企业优化供应链以降低成本并缩短交付时间。

optimize.en: Careful planning can optimize both performance and energy consumption.
optimize.zh: 周密规划可以同时优化性能和能耗。

presume.en: We presume that the missing data reflect recording errors rather than reality.
presume.zh: 我们推测缺失的数据反映的是记录错误，而非实际情况。

presume.en: The author presumes the reader already understands basic statistical methods.
presume.zh: 这位作者假定读者已经理解基本的统计方法。

presume.en: It would be unwise to presume that one trial proves the general case.
presume.zh: 认为一次试验就能证明普遍规律是不明智的。

promote.en: The university launched a campaign to promote academic integrity among students.
promote.zh: 该校发起了一场旨在促进学生学术诚信的活动。

promote.en: Regular exercise promotes both physical health and mental well-being.
promote.zh: 规律运动能促进身体健康和心理健康。

promote.en: Several senators promoted legislation aimed at reducing ocean pollution.
promote.zh: 几位参议员推动旨在减少海洋污染的立法。

propose.en: The committee proposed new standards for reporting clinical trial data.
propose.zh: 该委员会提出了临床试验数据报告的新标准。

propose.en: Economists proposed raising interest rates to control runaway inflation.
propose.zh: 经济学家提议提高利率以控制失控的通货膨胀。

propose.en: Several researchers proposed a simpler method for measuring soil quality.
propose.zh: 几位研究者提出了一种更简单的土壤质量测量方法。

refute.en: The evidence refuted the hypothesis that the two variables were unrelated.
refute.zh: 这些证据驳斥了「两个变量互不相关」这一假设。

refute.en: She refuted the critic's claim with three published studies.
refute.zh: 她用三项已发表的研究反驳了评论者的论断。

refute.en: New observations refuted earlier conclusions about the region's climate history.
refute.zh: 新的观测结果推翻了关于该地区气候历史的早期结论。

substantiate.en: The researcher substantiated her argument with data from two decades.
substantiate.zh: 这位研究者用 20 年的数据为自己的论点提供了实证支持。

substantiate.en: Claims about health benefits must be substantiated by reliable clinical evidence.
substantiate.zh: 有关健康益处的说法必须有可靠的临床证据加以证实。

substantiate.en: A single photograph could not substantiate the journalist's serious allegations.
substantiate.zh: 一张照片无法证实记者那些严重的指控。

undermine.en: Rumors about the accounting scandal undermined investor confidence in the company.
undermine.zh: 关于财务丑闻的传言削弱了投资者对该公司的信心。

undermine.en: Missing citations undermine the credibility of any published argument.
undermine.zh: 引用缺失会削弱任何已发表论点的可信度。

undermine.en: The new evidence appears to undermine earlier conclusions about regional rainfall.
undermine.zh: 新证据似乎削弱了关于该地区降雨量的早期结论。

utilize.en: Farmers utilize satellite images to predict crop yields more accurately.
utilize.zh: 农民利用卫星图像更准确地预测作物产量。

utilize.en: The laboratory utilizes advanced microscopes for material analysis.
utilize.zh: 该实验室使用先进的显微镜进行材料分析。

utilize.en: Small businesses can utilize shared cloud services instead of buying software.
utilize.zh: 小企业可以采用共享的云服务，而不必购买软件。

gauge.en: Researchers gauge public opinion by conducting monthly surveys.
gauge.zh: 研究人员通过每月开展调查来评估公众意见。

gauge.en: It is difficult to gauge the true scale of the damage.
gauge.zh: 很难准确评估破坏的严重程度。

gauge.en: Investors gauge the market's mood by tracking trading volumes.
gauge.zh: 投资者通过观察成交量来判断市场情绪。

harness.en: The company harnesses solar energy to power its manufacturing plants.
harness.zh: 该公司利用太阳能为其制造工厂供电。

harness.en: Teachers can harness digital tools to encourage collaborative learning.
harness.zh: 教师可以调动数字工具来促进协作学习。

harness.en: He harnessed public support to fund the new research center.
harness.zh: 他利用公众支持为新的研究中心筹集资金。

deploy.en: Engineers deployed a sensor network across the forest to measure moisture.
deploy.zh: 工程师在森林中部署了传感器网络来测量湿度。

deploy.en: The agency deployed extra staff during the emergency response.
deploy.zh: 该机构在应急响应期间调配了额外人员。

deploy.en: The startup deployed its new algorithm to millions of users.
deploy.zh: 这家初创公司向数百万用户推出了其新算法。

eliminate.en: The redesign eliminated most of the errors in data entry.
eliminate.zh: 这次重新设计消除了大部分数据录入错误。

eliminate.en: We eliminated unnecessary steps from the approval process entirely.
eliminate.zh: 我们彻底去掉了审批流程中不必要的步骤。

eliminate.en: The new treatment eliminated the symptoms within two weeks.
eliminate.zh: 这种新疗法在两周内消除了症状。

embody.en: The constitution embodies the values of equality and justice.
embody.zh: 宪法体现了平等与正义的价值观。

embody.en: Her leadership style embodies the ideals of collaborative research.
embody.zh: 她的领导风格体现了合作研究的理想。

embody.en: This museum's design embodies the cultural heritage of the entire region.
embody.zh: 这座博物馆的设计体现了整个地区的文化遗产。

endorse.en: Several leading scientists endorsed the statement published in Nature.
endorse.zh: 几位顶尖科学家赞同了《自然》杂志上发表的这份声明。

endorse.en: The board endorsed the proposal to expand the scholarship program.
endorse.zh: 董事会支持了扩展奖学金计划的提案。

endorse.en: The union endorsed the new contract after a lengthy negotiation.
endorse.zh: 经过漫长的谈判，工会认可了这份新合同。

augment.en: The new funding will augment the laboratory's existing research capacity.
augment.zh: 新拨付的资金将增强该实验室现有的研究能力。

augment.en: Teachers augment classroom lessons with interactive videos and discussion.
augment.zh: 教师用互动视频和讨论来丰富课堂内容。

augment.en: Combined data from both trials augmented the evidence for the treatment.
augment.zh: 两项试验的数据合并后加强了支持该疗法的证据。

impede.en: Poor internet access impedes progress for students in rural areas.
impede.zh: 网络接入不畅阻碍了农村学生的学业进展。

impede.en: Heavy rain may impede the researchers' ability to collect samples.
impede.zh: 大雨可能妨碍研究者采集样本。

impede.en: Bureaucratic delays often impede the implementation of effective policies.
impede.zh: 官僚主义的拖延常常妨碍有效政策的实施。

juxtapose.en: The exhibition juxtaposes traditional craft techniques with modern industrial design.
juxtapose.zh: 展览将传统手工艺技法与现代工业设计并置对照。

juxtapose.en: The author juxtaposes two conflicting accounts to highlight the disagreement.
juxtapose.zh: 作者把两种相互矛盾的叙述并置，以突出其中的分歧。

juxtapose.en: The professor juxtaposed economic data with public opinion polls.
juxtapose.zh: 教授将经济数据与民意调查结果进行了对照。

rectify.en: The auditor rectified the accounting errors before the report was published.
rectify.zh: 审计员在报告发表前纠正了账目错误。

rectify.en: The company quickly rectified the safety defect that regulators had identified.
rectify.zh: 公司迅速整改了监管机构发现的安全缺陷。

rectify.en: To rectify the imbalance, the fund allocated more grants to rural schools.
rectify.zh: 为纠正这种不平衡，基金会向农村学校分配了更多拨款。

temper.en: The central bank raised rates to temper rising inflation.
temper.zh: 中央银行提高利率以抑制不断上升的通货膨胀。

temper.en: She tempered her criticism with praise for the team's effort.
temper.zh: 她以对该团队努力的赞扬来缓和自己的批评。

temper.en: Adding shade trees helps temper the afternoon heat in the courtyard.
temper.zh: 种植遮荫树木有助于缓和庭院里午后的高温。

transcend.en: The debate over borders transcends national boundaries and political affiliations.
transcend.zh: 关于边界的争论超越了国界和政治立场。

transcend.en: Her poetry transcends cultural barriers and speaks to a global audience.
transcend.zh: 她的诗歌超越文化障碍，面向全球听众发出声音。

transcend.en: Some of the most useful ideas in science transcend narrow disciplines.
transcend.zh: 科学中一些最有用的思想超越了狭窄的学科界限。

warrant.en: The evidence warrants a full investigation into the reported misconduct.
warrant.zh: 这些证据足以对所报告的不当行为进行全面调查。

warrant.en: Such sweeping claims warrant closer scrutiny before they appear in print.
warrant.zh: 如此笼统的论断在付印之前有必要接受更仔细的审查。

warrant.en: The damage to the collection warrants immediate restoration work.
warrant.zh: 藏品所受的损坏有必要立即进行修复。

probe.en: Investigators probed the financial records for signs of hidden transactions.
probe.zh: 调查人员审查了财务记录，寻找隐藏交易的迹象。

probe.en: The mission will probe the ice layers for ancient air samples.
probe.zh: 这次考察将钻探冰层以获取古代空气样本。

probe.en: Reporters probed the minister about the funding decision repeatedly.
probe.zh: 记者反复追问部长关于资金决定的问题。

offset.en: Higher sales in Asia offset the decline in European markets.
offset.zh: 亚洲销量的增长抵消了欧洲市场的下滑。

offset.en: Energy efficiency can offset the rising cost of raw materials.
offset.zh: 能源效率的提高可以抵消原材料成本的上涨。

offset.en: A small grant helped offset the laboratory's mounting operating costs.
offset.zh: 一笔小额拨款帮助抵消了实验室不断上升的运营成本。

mean.en: The red warning light means the reactor has exceeded safe pressure levels.
mean.zh: 红色警示灯表示反应堆已超过安全压力水平。

mean.en: What do you mean by that vague phrase in the report?
mean.zh: 你所说的报告里那个含糊的措辞是什么意思？

mean.en: The survey results mean that most students prefer online coursework.
mean.zh: 调查结果表明，大多数学生更偏好线上课程。

generalize.en: It is risky to generalize from such a small sample size.
generalize.zh: 从如此小的样本量得出普遍结论是有风险的。

generalize.en: The theory generalizes well across cultures and historical periods.
generalize.zh: 该理论在不同文化和历史时期都有很好的适用性。

generalize.en: The team generalized the pilot results to the whole district.
generalize.zh: 团队将试点结果推广到了整个地区。

paraphrase.en: The journalist paraphrased the author's argument rather than quoting it directly.
paraphrase.zh: 这位记者转述了作者的观点，而非直接引用。

paraphrase.en: Could you paraphrase the main idea of the article in one sentence?
paraphrase.zh: 你能用一句话改述这篇文章的主要观点吗？

paraphrase.en: The lecture paraphrased several complex theories in accessible language.
paraphrase.zh: 这次讲座用通俗的语言转述了几个复杂的理论。

quote.en: The scholar quoted an ancient manuscript to support her interpretation.
quote.zh: 这位学者引用了一份古代手稿来支持她的解读。

quote.en: In his report, he quotes several witnesses describing the incident.
quote.zh: 在他的报告中，他引用了数位目击者对事件的描述。

quote.en: The article quotes a former official criticizing the policy.
quote.zh: 文章引用了一位前官员对该政策的批评。

caveat.en: The author added a caveat about the small sample size.
caveat.zh: 作者补充说明了一个关于样本量过小的限定条件。

caveat.en: One caveat: the data were collected before the policy took effect.
caveat.zh: 需要说明的是：数据是在该政策生效之前收集的。

caveat.en: We accept the estimate with the caveat that it lacks peer review.
caveat.zh: 我们接受这一估算，但要注意它尚未经过同行评审。

confound.en: Age may confound the relationship between diet and recovery.
confound.zh: 年龄可能混淆饮食与康复之间的关系。

confound.en: The researchers treated background noise as a confound in the experiment.
confound.zh: 研究者将背景噪声视为实验中的一个混杂因素。

confound.en: A major confound in the study was the absence of a control group.
confound.zh: 该研究的一个主要混杂因素是缺少对照组。

dataset.en: The team cleaned a dataset containing two million patient records.
dataset.zh: 团队清洗了一个包含 200 万份患者记录的数据集。

dataset.en: Access to a public dataset allows researchers to reproduce the results.
dataset.zh: 获取公开数据集使研究者能够复现实验结果。

dataset.en: Training models require larger datasets than most universities can gather.
dataset.zh: 训练模型所需的数据集比大多数大学能够收集的更大。

disparity.en: The report documents a widening disparity in access to health care.
disparity.zh: 该报告记录了医疗可及性上日益扩大的差距。

disparity.en: Income disparity between regions has grown significantly over the past decade.
disparity.zh: 过去 10 年里地区之间的收入差距显著扩大。

disparity.en: Scholars examined the disparity in exam scores across rural schools.
disparity.zh: 学者们考察了农村学校之间考试成绩的差异。

discourse.en: Academic discourse often rewards confident claims over careful evidence.
discourse.zh: 学术话语往往看重自信的论断而非细致的证据。

discourse.en: The conference addressed the discourse surrounding artificial intelligence in education.
discourse.zh: 会议讨论了围绕教育领域人工智能的话语。

discourse.en: Public discourse became polarized after the report was published.
discourse.zh: 报告发表后，公共话语变得两极分化。

distribution.en: The distribution of income in the country is highly unequal.
distribution.zh: 该国的收入分配极不平等。

distribution.en: Engineers changed the distribution of resources among the servers.
distribution.zh: 工程师改变了各服务器之间的资源分配。

distribution.en: The map shows the distribution of rainfall across the region.
distribution.zh: 这张地图显示了降雨在该地区的分布情况。

diversity.en: The team values diversity in background, training, and research interests.
diversity.zh: 该团队重视背景、训练和研究兴趣上的多样性。

diversity.en: Urban forests contribute greatly to the diversity of local wildlife.
diversity.zh: 城市森林极大丰富了当地野生动物的多样性。

diversity.en: The course highlights the diversity of opinions within the field.
diversity.zh: 这门课程突显了该领域内观点的多样性。

endpoint.en: The sensor records the endpoint of each trip for billing purposes.
endpoint.zh: 该传感器为计费目的记录每段行程的终点。

endpoint.en: Researchers set a clear endpoint for the clinical trial.
endpoint.zh: 研究者为这项临床试验设定了明确的终点。

endpoint.en: The API defines the endpoint that clients call to fetch data.
endpoint.zh: 该接口定义了客户端获取数据时调用的端点。

error.en: The model introduced a small error when rounding the final value.
error.zh: 模型在最终数值取整时产生了一个小误差。

error.en: Human error accounted for most of the discrepancies in the report.
error.zh: 人为错误是报告中大部分差异的原因。

error.en: Standard error bars show the uncertainty around each estimate.
error.zh: 标准误差棒显示了每个估计值周围的不确定性。

evaluation.en: The evaluation revealed that the new curriculum improved retention.
evaluation.zh: 评估显示新课程提高了学生的留存率。

evaluation.en: Performance evaluation for managers occurs twice a year here.
evaluation.zh: 这里对管理者的绩效考核每年进行两次。

evaluation.en: Her evaluation of the theory was thorough and impartial.
evaluation.zh: 她对该理论的评价全面而公正。

fidelity.en: The model maintains high fidelity to the original manuscript.
fidelity.zh: 该模型对原始手稿保持了较高的保真度。

fidelity.en: Low audio fidelity made the recording difficult to understand.
fidelity.zh: 音频保真度低使这段录音难以听懂。

fidelity.en: The translator's fidelity to the author's tone was remarkable.
fidelity.zh: 这位译者对作者语调的忠实程度令人印象深刻。

finding.en: The main finding challenges earlier assumptions about regional development.
finding.zh: 这一主要发现挑战了关于区域发展的早期假设。

finding.en: Her laboratory reported a significant finding about the chemical compound.
finding.zh: 她的实验室报告了关于该化合物的一项重要发现。

finding.en: The research team's findings have been published in several journals.
finding.zh: 该研究团队的发现已在数家期刊上发表。

gap.en: There remains a significant gap in our understanding of early neural development.
gap.zh: 我们对早期神经发育的理解仍存在显著空白。

gap.en: The pay gap between senior and junior staff widened considerably last year.
gap.zh: 去年高级员工与初级员工之间的薪酬差距明显扩大。

gap.en: This review identifies a gap in the literature regarding adolescent sleep patterns.
gap.zh: 这篇综述指出了现有文献在青少年睡眠模式方面的研究空白。

gradient.en: The gradient of the hill becomes much steeper beyond the second ridge.
gradient.zh: 越过第二道山脊后，山坡的坡度变得陡峭得多。

gradient.en: Researchers measured the concentration gradient across the river estuary over time.
gradient.zh: 研究人员沿河口测量了浓度梯度随时间的变化。

gradient.en: A sharp gradient in temperature can cause thermal stress for coral reefs.
gradient.zh: 水温梯度过大会对珊瑚礁造成热应激。

heterogeneity.en: Substantial heterogeneity in treatment effects was observed across the twelve participating clinics.
heterogeneity.zh: 在 12 家参与诊所之间观察到了治疗效果的显著异质性。

heterogeneity.en: The index was designed to capture heterogeneity within the population rather than averages.
heterogeneity.zh: 该指标旨在捕捉总体内部的不均一性，而非平均水平。

heterogeneity.en: Inter-rater heterogeneity reduced the overall reliability of the qualitative coding.
heterogeneity.zh: 评分者之间的差异降低了定性编码的整体信度。

incidence.en: The incidence of the disease has declined sharply since vaccination programs began.
incidence.zh: 自疫苗接种项目启动以来，该病的发生率大幅下降。

incidence.en: These estimates of incidence rely on hospital records collected over fifteen years.
incidence.zh: 这些发生率估算依赖于 15 年间收集的医院记录。

incidence.en: Higher incidence of respiratory infection was reported among older residents.
incidence.zh: 老年居民中呼吸道感染的发生率更高。

inference.en: The inference from experimental data to real-world outcomes requires careful reasoning.
inference.zh: 从实验数据推断现实结果需要谨慎的推理。

inference.en: Bayesian inference allows researchers to update beliefs as new data arrive.
inference.zh: 贝叶斯推断使研究者能够随新数据的到来更新信念。

inference.en: Any inference drawn from a single small sample should be treated cautiously.
inference.zh: 任何基于单个小样本得出的推论都应谨慎对待。

intervention.en: A targeted intervention reduced hospital readmissions among patients with chronic conditions.
intervention.zh: 一项有针对性的干预措施减少了慢性病患者的再次住院率。

intervention.en: The policy intervention was piloted in three districts before national rollout.
intervention.zh: 该政策干预在三个地区先行试点，然后才在全国推行。

intervention.en: Early intervention in the classroom improved long-term literacy outcomes considerably.
intervention.zh: 课堂上的早期干预显著改善了长期的读写能力结果。

justification.en: The authors provide a clear justification for choosing this particular dataset.
justification.zh: 作者为选择这一特定数据集给出了清晰的理由。

justification.en: No compelling justification was offered for excluding participants from the analysis.
justification.zh: 对于将参与者排除在分析之外，并未给出令人信服的理由。

justification.en: The ethical committee demanded further justification of the proposed procedure.
justification.zh: 伦理委员会要求对所提议的程序作出进一步的理由说明。

limitation.en: A major limitation of the study is its relatively small sample size.
limitation.zh: 该研究的一个主要局限在于样本量相对较小。

limitation.en: The authors acknowledge several limitations concerning measurement and geographic representativeness.
limitation.zh: 作者承认了测量和地理代表性方面的若干局限。

limitation.en: This limitation restricts the conclusions that can reasonably be drawn.
limitation.zh: 这一局限限制了可以合理得出的结论。

literature.en: The literature on climate adaptation has grown rapidly over the past decade.
literature.zh: 关于气候适应的文献在过去 10 年中迅速增长。

literature.en: A comprehensive review of the literature reveals considerable disagreement among scholars.
literature.zh: 对文献的综合评述显示学者之间存在相当大的分歧。

literature.en: Students must engage with the primary literature before writing their essays.
literature.zh: 学生在撰写论文之前必须研读原始文献。

margin.en: The margin of error in the estimate is roughly three percentage points.
margin.zh: 该估计值的误差范围约为三个百分点。

margin.en: Profit margin improved significantly after the company restructured its supply chain.
margin.zh: 公司重组供应链后，利润率显著提高。

margin.en: There is very little margin for delay in this tight schedule.
margin.zh: 在这份紧凑的日程安排中，几乎没有延误的余地。

narrative.en: The author constructs a compelling narrative around a single family's experience.
narrative.zh: 作者围绕一个家庭的经历构建了引人入胜的叙事。

narrative.en: Quantitative data alone cannot capture the narrative behind these statistics.
narrative.zh: 仅凭定量数据无法呈现这些统计数据背后的叙事。

narrative.en: The final chapter shifts the narrative focus to rural communities.
narrative.zh: 最后一章将叙事的焦点转向农村社区。

outlier.en: We removed each outlier only after confirming the measurement error.
outlier.zh: 只有在确认测量误差后，我们才剔除每一个离群值。

outlier.en: This extreme outlier skewed the mean and distorted the trend line.
outlier.zh: 这个极端离群值使均值发生偏移并扭曲了趋势线。

outlier.en: A formal outlier analysis revealed three observations that required further investigation.
outlier.zh: 离群值分析揭示出三个需要进一步调查的观测值。

oversight.en: Regulatory oversight of the laboratory ensured compliance with safety standards.
oversight.zh: 对该实验室的监管确保了安全标准的遵守。

oversight.en: The error resulted from a simple lack of oversight during the night shift.
oversight.zh: 这一错误源于夜班期间缺乏监督。

oversight.en: Recent oversight reforms have strengthened accountability across the public sector.
oversight.zh: 近期的监管改革加强了公共部门的问责。

phenomenon.en: This linguistic phenomenon occurs in every major language studied so far.
phenomenon.zh: 这一语言现象出现在迄今为止研究过的所有主要语言中。

phenomenon.en: The emergence of new trade routes was a gradual phenomenon spanning centuries.
phenomenon.zh: 新贸易路线的出现是一个延续数百年的渐进现象。

phenomenon.en: Scientists still debate whether the observed phenomenon reflects a genuine effect.
phenomenon.zh: 科学家仍在争论所观察到的现象是否反映了真实效应。

prevalence.en: The prevalence of diabetes has increased steadily over the past decade.
prevalence.zh: 过去 10 年中糖尿病的患病率持续上升。

prevalence.en: Estimates of prevalence were derived from a nationally representative survey.
prevalence.zh: 患病率估计值来自一项具有全国代表性的调查。

prevalence.en: High prevalence of the condition makes early screening clinically valuable.
prevalence.zh: 该疾病的高患病率使早期筛查具有临床价值。

proportion.en: A large proportion of respondents reported working more than fifty hours weekly.
proportion.zh: 很大一部分受访者报告每周工作 50 小时以上。

proportion.en: The proportion of women in senior positions rose to thirty percent.
proportion.zh: 担任高级职务的女性比例上升到了 30%。

proportion.en: Only a small proportion of the total sample received the intervention.
proportion.zh: 总样本中只有一小部分接受了干预。

proxy.en: Income is often used as a proxy for household consumption in developing regions.
proxy.zh: 在发展中地区，收入常被用作家庭消费的代理指标。

proxy.en: Tree rings serve as a useful proxy for historical rainfall over centuries.
proxy.zh: 年轮可作为数百年来历史降雨情况的有用替代指标。

proxy.en: Researchers warned that the proxy variable may introduce serious measurement error.
proxy.zh: 研究人员警告说，该替代变量可能引入严重的测量误差。

regression.en: Multiple regression analysis revealed that income explained most of the variation.
regression.zh: 多元回归分析显示，收入解释了大部分变异。

regression.en: The new model showed no regression in accuracy over the past year.
regression.zh: 新模型在过去一年中精度没有出现倒退。

regression.en: Further regression testing confirmed that the software upgrade fixed the original bug.
regression.zh: 进一步的回归测试确认软件升级修复了原有的缺陷。

reliability.en: Inter-rater reliability exceeded eighty percent across both coders in this study.
reliability.zh: 在本研究中，两位编码者的评分者间信度超过 80%。

reliability.en: The reliability of the instrument improves substantially after extensive pilot testing.
reliability.zh: 经过大量预试后，该工具的可靠性显著提高。

reliability.en: Reviewers questioned the reliability of self-reported data collected by email.
reliability.zh: 审稿人质疑了通过电子邮件收集的自报数据的可靠性。

reproducibility.en: The reproducibility of published findings is a cornerstone of good scientific practice.
reproducibility.zh: 已发表结果的可复现性是良好科学实践的基石。

reproducibility.en: The journal now requires full reproducibility of computational analyses where possible.
reproducibility.zh: 该期刊现要求在可能的情况下实现计算分析完全可复现。

reproducibility.en: Improving reproducibility reduces duplicated effort across research laboratories worldwide.
reproducibility.zh: 提高可复现性可以减少全球各研究实验室的重复劳动。

retrospective.en: This retrospective analysis examined records collected between 1998 and 2012.
retrospective.zh: 这项回顾性分析考察了 1998 年至 2012 年间收集的记录。

retrospective.en: A retrospective review of the data revealed a previously unnoticed seasonal pattern.
retrospective.zh: 对数据的回顾发现了一个此前未被注意到的季节性模式。

retrospective.en: The team adopted a retrospective design because no baseline data existed.
retrospective.zh: 由于不存在基线数据，团队采用了回顾性设计。

sample.en: The convenience sample was drawn from students at a single university.
sample.zh: 便利样本取自一所大学的学生。

sample.en: Each soil sample was analyzed in triplicate by the laboratory.
sample.zh: 实验室对每个土壤样品进行了三次平行分析。

sample.en: The sample size was determined through a formal power calculation.
sample.zh: 样本量通过正式的效能计算确定。

saturation.en: Data collection continued until saturation was reached in the interview transcripts.
saturation.zh: 数据收集持续进行，直到访谈转录文本达到饱和。

saturation.en: Market saturation in developed economies has slowed revenue growth considerably.
saturation.zh: 发达经济体的市场饱和已明显减缓了收入增长。

saturation.en: Oxygen saturation remained stable throughout the entire experimental procedure.
saturation.zh: 在整个实验过程中血氧饱和度保持稳定。

sensitivity.en: The instrument demonstrated good sensitivity for detecting early signs of disease.
sensitivity.zh: 该工具在检测疾病早期迹象方面表现出良好的灵敏度。

sensitivity.en: A sensitivity analysis showed that the results were robust to alternative assumptions.
sensitivity.zh: 敏感性分析表明，结果对替代假设而言是稳健的。

sensitivity.en: Researchers reported high sensitivity but only moderate specificity in the test.
sensitivity.zh: 研究人员报告该检测的敏感性很高，但特异性仅为中等。

specificity.en: The high specificity of the test means few false positives occur.
specificity.zh: 该检测的高特异性意味着假阳性很少出现。

specificity.en: A specificity analysis confirmed that the marker distinguishes closely related cell types.
specificity.zh: 特异性分析证实该标记物能够区分密切相关的细胞类型。

specificity.en: Critics questioned the specificity of these findings across different populations.
specificity.zh: 批评者质疑这些发现在不同人群中是否具有特异性。

spectrum.en: Electromagnetic radiation covers a wide spectrum of wavelengths beyond visible light.
spectrum.zh: 电磁辐射涵盖可见光以外宽广的波长谱。

spectrum.en: The findings represent one end of the spectrum of possible interpretations.
spectrum.zh: 这些发现代表了由各种可能解释构成的连续体中的一端。

spectrum.en: Researchers analyzed the whole spectrum of responses from the participants.
spectrum.zh: 研究人员分析了参与者的全部反应类型。

statistic.en: This statistic summarizes the central tendency of the observed measurements.
statistic.zh: 该统计量概括了观测测量值的集中趋势。

statistic.en: The reported statistic was calculated from only a handful of observations.
statistic.zh: 所报告的统计量仅根据少数几个观测值计算得出。

statistic.en: Before quoting a statistic, always report the sample size and units.
statistic.zh: 引用统计量之前，总要报告样本量和计量单位。

tension.en: There is growing tension between economic growth and environmental protection.
tension.zh: 经济增长与环境保护之间的紧张关系日益加剧。

tension.en: The negotiations were marked by considerable tension between the two delegations.
tension.zh: 谈判中两个代表团之间存在相当大的紧张关系。

tension.en: The film explores the tension between tradition and modernity in rural communities.
tension.zh: 该影片探讨了农村社区中传统与现代之间的矛盾。

theorem.en: The proof of this theorem rests on a well-established lemma.
theorem.zh: 该定理的证明建立在一个公认引理的基础之上。

theorem.en: The theorem has been generalized in several subsequent papers.
theorem.zh: 该定理在随后的几篇论文中已被推广。

theorem.en: Applying the theorem to real data requires additional assumptions about error.
theorem.zh: 将该定理应用于真实数据需要关于误差的额外假设。

uncertainty.en: The model quantifies uncertainty through bootstrap confidence intervals around each estimate.
uncertainty.zh: 该模型通过每个估计值周围的自助法置信区间来量化不确定性。

uncertainty.en: Honest reporting of uncertainty strengthens the credibility of published research.
uncertainty.zh: 如实报告不确定性可以增强已发表研究的可信度。

uncertainty.en: Policy decisions must account for genuine uncertainty in the underlying evidence.
uncertainty.zh: 政策决策必须考虑底层证据中真实存在的不确定性。

verification.en: Independent verification of the results confirmed the original laboratory findings.
verification.zh: 对结果的独立验证证实了实验室最初的发现。

verification.en: The audit included verification of all reported financial figures.
verification.zh: 这次审计包括对所有已报告财务数据的核实。

verification.en: Document verification is required before any claim can be published.
verification.zh: 在任何主张发表之前都必须进行文件核查。

boundary.en: The boundary between private and public funding remains blurred in practice.
boundary.zh: 私人资助与公共资助之间的界限在实践中仍然模糊。

boundary.en: The study examines the boundary conditions under which the effect holds.
boundary.zh: 该研究考察了效应成立所需的边界条件。

boundary.en: Marking the boundary of the study area helped standardize field measurements.
boundary.zh: 标出研究区域的边界有助于统一野外测量标准。

baseline.en: All participants were assessed at baseline before receiving the treatment.
baseline.zh: 所有参与者在接受治疗前都接受了基线评估。

baseline.en: The baseline data allowed us to compare subsequent outcomes across the two groups.
baseline.zh: 基线数据使我们能够比较两组之后的结局。

baseline.en: The new method performs better than the baseline model on every dataset.
baseline.zh: 在每个数据集上，新方法都优于基线模型。

consistency.en: There is a marked consistency in the findings across three independent laboratories.
consistency.zh: 三个独立实验室的结果具有显著的一致性。

consistency.en: The internal consistency of the scale was assessed with an appropriate coefficient.
consistency.zh: 该量表的内部一致性以恰当的系数进行了评估。

consistency.en: Reviewers praised the consistency of the argument throughout the manuscript.
consistency.zh: 审稿人赞赏了全稿论证的一致性。

precision.en: The instrument achieves a precision of two decimal places.
precision.zh: 该仪器的精度达到小数点后两位。

precision.en: Greater measurement precision improved the accuracy of the estimated effect.
precision.zh: 更高的测量精确度提升了效应估计的准确性。

precision.en: In this context, precision is less important than validity.
precision.zh: 在这一情境下，精确性不如效度重要。

population.en: The study population included adults aged forty and above.
population.zh: 研究总体包括 40 岁及以上的成年人。

population.en: Higher population density influences the cost of delivering health services.
population.zh: 较高的人口密度会影响提供医疗服务的成本。

population.en: The population of the region has declined steadily over the past decade.
population.zh: 该地区的人口在过去 10 年中持续下降。

coverage.en: Insurance coverage for mental health services remains limited in many countries.
coverage.zh: 在许多国家，心理健康服务的保险覆盖仍然有限。

coverage.en: Data coverage varied considerably across the participating regions.
coverage.zh: 各参与地区的数据覆盖范围差异相当大。

coverage.en: The review achieved full coverage of all published studies.
coverage.zh: 该综述实现了对所有已发表研究的完整覆盖。

replication.en: Direct replication of the study in a second laboratory confirmed the effect.
replication.zh: 在第二个实验室对该研究的直接复现证实了效应。

replication.en: A replication of the analysis confirmed that the estimates remained stable.
replication.zh: 对分析的复现证实了估计值保持稳定。

replication.en: The crisis exposed serious gaps in the replication of published results.
replication.zh: 这场危机暴露了已发表结果复现方面的严重缺陷。

retention.en: Employee retention improved markedly after the company introduced flexible working arrangements.
retention.zh: 公司引入弹性工作安排后，员工留存率明显提高。

retention.en: Water retention in sandy soils depends largely on organic matter content.
retention.zh: 沙质土壤的保水能力在很大程度上取决于有机质含量。

retention.en: The study examined retention rates across three successive cohorts of participants.
retention.zh: 该研究考察了连续三个参与者队列的留存率。

significance.en: The significance of the findings for public policy remains widely debated.
significance.zh: 这些发现对公共政策的重要性仍广受争议。

significance.en: Researchers must report the statistical significance of every correlation they observe.
significance.zh: 研究人员必须报告所观察到的每个相关性的统计显著性。

significance.en: The discovery was of great significance to modern physics.
significance.zh: 这一发现对现代物理学具有重大意义。

probability.en: The probability of receiving funding increases with a longer publication record.
probability.zh: 发表记录越长，获得资助的可能性就越大。

probability.en: There is a high probability that the regression estimates are biased.
probability.zh: 回归估计值存在偏差的可能性很高。

probability.en: Forecasters assign a probability of forty percent to heavy rainfall tomorrow.
probability.zh: 预报员认为明天下大雨的概率为 40%。

publication.en: Her latest publication examines gender bias in engineering departments.
publication.zh: 她最新的出版物研究了工程系中的性别偏差。

publication.en: The findings reached a wide readership upon publication in 2019.
publication.zh: 这些发现于 2019 年发表后得到了广泛读者的关注。

publication.en: Publication of the survey results was delayed by a lengthy review.
publication.zh: 调查结果的发表因漫长的审查而被推迟。

insight.en: Field interviews provided valuable insight into student learning strategies.
insight.zh: 实地访谈为了解学生的学习策略提供了宝贵洞察。

insight.en: The discussion offers a deeper insight into the causes of inequality.
insight.zh: 该讨论为深入理解不平等的成因提供了洞见。

insight.en: Participants gained insight into their own attitudes during the exercise.
insight.zh: 参与者在这次练习中领悟到了自己的态度。

formulation.en: The problem requires a clearer formulation before any solution can be tested.
formulation.zh: 在测试任何解决方案之前，该问题需要更清晰的表述。

formulation.en: Her formulation of the problem challenged assumptions widely held by economists.
formulation.zh: 她对问题的表述挑战了经济学家普遍持有的假设。

formulation.en: The policy formulation process involved consultations in twelve provinces.
formulation.zh: 政策制定过程包括了在 12 个省份开展的咨询。

contradiction.en: There is an apparent contradiction between the two theoretical frameworks.
contradiction.zh: 这两个理论框架之间存在明显的矛盾。

contradiction.en: The contradiction was resolved by repeating the experiment with larger samples.
contradiction.zh: 通过用更大样本重复实验，这一矛盾得到了解决。

contradiction.en: Notice the contradiction in his argument about market efficiency.
contradiction.zh: 注意他关于市场效率的论证中的矛盾之处。

comparison.en: The comparison between pretest and posttest scores revealed modest improvement.
comparison.zh: 前测与后测成绩的比较显示出了小幅提升。

comparison.en: A direct comparison with earlier studies is essential for interpretation.
comparison.zh: 与早期研究的直接比较对解读结果至关重要。

comparison.en: The report draws a careful comparison of regional wage trends.
comparison.zh: 该报告对各地区工资趋势作了细致的比较。

dependence.en: The results suggest a strong dependence on rainfall during the growing season.
dependence.zh: 结果提示存在对生长季降雨量的强烈依赖。

dependence.en: Excessive dependence on a single supplier creates serious operational risk.
dependence.zh: 过度依赖单一供应商会造成严重的运营风险。

dependence.en: Dependence on imported energy declined after the new agreements took effect.
dependence.zh: 新协议生效后，对进口能源的依赖有所下降。

causation.en: Correlation alone does not establish causation between the two variables.
causation.zh: 仅有相关并不能确立两个变量之间的因果关系。

causation.en: The experiment was designed to test causation rather than mere association.
causation.zh: 该实验旨在检验因果关系，而非仅仅检验关联。

causation.en: Policy makers warned that causation claims need stronger evidence.
causation.zh: 政策制定者警告说，因果主张需要更有力的证据。

estimation.en: Current estimation of the population relied on incomplete census records.
estimation.zh: 目前对该人口的估计依赖于不完整的人口普查记录。

estimation.en: The final estimation of costs exceeded the original budget by half.
estimation.zh: 最终的成本估算比原预算高出一半。

estimation.en: Estimation errors were reduced by repeating the survey twice.
estimation.zh: 通过重复调查两次，估算误差得到了降低。

prediction.en: The model generates a reliable prediction of future energy demand.
prediction.zh: 该模型能够对未来的能源需求作出可靠预测。

prediction.en: Her prediction about market recovery proved accurate within six months.
prediction.zh: 她关于市场复苏的预测在六个月内被证明是准确的。

prediction.en: Predictions based on historical averages often fail during unusual years.
prediction.zh: 基于历史平均值的预测在异常年份常常失效。

citation.en: Each citation in the review refers to peer-reviewed journal articles.
citation.zh: 该综述中的每条引文都指向经过同行评审的期刊文章。

citation.en: The author received a formal citation for distinguished scholarly work.
citation.zh: 该作者因其杰出的学术工作获得了正式表彰。

citation.en: Missing citations weakened the argument considerably during peer review.
citation.zh: 缺失的引注在同行评审中大幅削弱了论证的说服力。

introduction.en: The introduction outlines the research problem and its practical significance.
introduction.zh: 引言概述了研究问题及其实际意义。

introduction.en: The introduction of the new policy transformed the entire department.
introduction.zh: 新政策的引入彻底改变了整个部门。

introduction.en: An introduction to the method appears at the end of the chapter.
introduction.zh: 本章末尾附有对该方法的介绍。

summary.en: The summary captures the main argument in fewer than two hundred words.
summary.zh: 摘要用不到 200 字概括了主要论点。

summary.en: Please provide a short summary of the survey findings by Friday.
summary.zh: 请在周五之前提供调查结果的简要总结。

summary.en: The executive summary was written for readers without technical training.
summary.zh: 这份执行摘要是为缺乏技术背景的读者撰写的。

background.en: The background of the study explains how the research question emerged.
background.zh: 研究背景说明了这一研究问题是如何产生的。

background.en: Applicants must provide a detailed background of their previous experience.
background.zh: 申请人必须详细说明以往经历。

background.en: The historical background reveals patterns that repeat across centuries.
background.zh: 历史背景揭示了跨越数个世纪反复出现的模式。

instrument.en: The questionnaire was validated as a reliable research instrument.
instrument.zh: 该问卷已被验证为一份可靠的研究工具。

instrument.en: This measurement instrument records temperature with remarkable precision.
instrument.zh: 这台测量仪器以极高的精度记录温度。

instrument.en: Researchers adapted the instrument for use with younger participants.
instrument.zh: 研究者调整了该工具，以便用于年龄更小的参与者。

respondent.en: Each respondent received a small incentive for completing the survey.
respondent.zh: 每位受访者因完成问卷而获得了一点小奖励。

respondent.en: Respondents who skipped the income question were excluded from analysis.
respondent.zh: 跳过收入问题的受访者被排除在分析之外。
