respondent.en: One respondent described the experience as transformative and surprisingly pleasant.
respondent.zh: 一位受访者形容这段经历带来了深刻转变，而且出人意料地愉快。

participant.en: Each participant attended an orientation session before the trials began.
participant.zh: 每位参与者在实验开始前都参加了说明会。

participant.en: Participants were randomly assigned to either the control or treatment group.
participant.zh: 参与者被随机分配到对照组或处理组。

participant.en: Compensation helped every participant finish the lengthy task on time.
participant.zh: 报酬帮助每位参与者按时完成了冗长的任务。

survey.en: The survey revealed widespread dissatisfaction with the current delivery service.
survey.zh: 调查揭示了人们对当前配送服务的普遍不满。

survey.en: A follow-up survey measured whether attitudes changed after the intervention.
survey.zh: 一项后续调查测量了干预之后态度是否发生变化。

survey.en: Results from the national survey were published without a full dataset.
survey.zh: 全国调查的结果在未附完整数据集的情况下发表了。

questionnaire.en: The questionnaire contained twenty closed questions on customer satisfaction.
questionnaire.zh: 该问卷包含 20 道关于顾客满意度的封闭式问题。

questionnaire.en: Pilot testing revealed that several questionnaire items were ambiguous.
questionnaire.zh: 预试显示问卷中有若干题目含义模糊。

questionnaire.en: All participants completed the questionnaire within fifteen minutes.
questionnaire.zh: 所有参与者都在 15 分钟内完成了问卷。

cohort.en: The 1980 cohort reported significantly higher rates of job stability.
cohort.zh: 1980 年出生的队列报告了明显更高的职业稳定率。

cohort.en: Each cohort of students followed a similar curriculum during that decade.
cohort.zh: 在那 10 年里，每一个学生队列都遵循相似的课程设置。

cohort.en: Researchers compared outcomes across three age cohorts in the sample.
cohort.zh: 研究者比较了样本中三个年龄队列的结果。

treatment.en: The treatment group received the new medication for eight weeks.
treatment.zh: 处理组连续八周接受了这种新药。

treatment.en: Careful treatment of the samples preserved their chemical properties.
treatment.zh: 对样本的妥善处理保留了其化学特性。

treatment.en: The treatment effects remained stable even after controlling for age.
treatment.zh: 即使控制年龄变量，处理效应仍然保持稳定。

iteration.en: The third iteration of the design reduced costs by nearly a third.
iteration.zh: 该设计的第三次迭代将成本降低了近三分之一。

iteration.en: Each iteration of the algorithm improves accuracy on noisy data sets.
iteration.zh: 算法的每一次迭代都能提高在含噪数据集上的准确率。

iteration.en: Rapid iteration allowed the team to respond quickly to user feedback.
iteration.zh: 快速的迭代使团队能够迅速回应用户反馈。

proposition.en: The central proposition of the paper challenges conventional economic theory.
proposition.zh: 该论文的核心命题挑战了传统经济理论。

proposition.en: Every argument rests on a proposition that requires separate justification.
proposition.zh: 每一个论证都建立在一个需要单独给出依据的命题之上。

proposition.en: The experiment was designed to test a falsifiable proposition clearly.
proposition.zh: 该实验旨在清晰地检验一个可证伪的命题。

constituent.en: Several variables are constituents of the standard vulnerability index.
constituent.zh: 若干变量是标准脆弱性指数的构成要素。

constituent.en: Each constituent part of the composite index was weighted separately.
constituent.zh: 综合指数的每一个组成部分都被单独赋予权重。

constituent.en: Hydrogen is a constituent element of water and organic molecules.
constituent.zh: 氢是水和有机分子的组成元素。

periphery.en: Rural communities on the periphery received little government investment.
periphery.zh: 处于边缘的农村社区很少得到政府投资。

periphery.en: The country remained firmly at the periphery of European negotiations.
periphery.zh: 该国始终处于欧洲谈判的边缘地位。

periphery.en: Those issues have long occupied the periphery of academic debate.
periphery.zh: 那些问题长期以来处于学术辩论的边缘。

elasticity.en: Demand elasticity increased sharply after the product became more widely available.
elasticity.zh: 该产品变得更加普及之后，需求弹性明显上升。

elasticity.en: The material retains considerable elasticity even at low temperatures.
elasticity.zh: 即使在低温下，这种材料仍保持相当好的弹性。

elasticity.en: Elasticity of labor supply varies considerably between regions and sectors.
elasticity.zh: 劳动供给的弹性在不同地区和行业之间差异很大。

workload.en: The workload increased sharply without a corresponding rise in staffing.
workload.zh: 工作量大幅增加，而人员编制并未相应增加。

workload.en: Nurses reported excessive workload and frequent burnout after the reorganization.
workload.zh: 重组之后，护士们反映工作量过大、频繁出现职业倦怠。

workload.en: The team reduced its workload by automating routine reporting tasks.
workload.zh: 该团队通过将常规报告任务自动化来减轻工作量。

applicable.en: These findings are applicable to schools in rural districts.
applicable.zh: 这些发现适用于农村地区的学校。

applicable.en: The rule applies only where applicable regulations have been formally adopted.
applicable.zh: 只有在相应法规正式通过的地方，该规则才适用。

applicable.en: Findings from the pilot study may not be applicable in larger organizations.
applicable.zh: 试点研究的结果在规模更大的组织中可能并不适用。

deterministic.en: The deterministic model produces the same output for identical inputs.
deterministic.zh: 该确定性模型对相同的输入产生相同的结果。

deterministic.en: Real biological systems are rarely deterministic at the molecular level.
deterministic.zh: 真实的生物系统在分子层面很少是确定性的。

deterministic.en: A deterministic approach simplifies analysis but ignores environmental uncertainty.
deterministic.zh: 确定性方法简化了分析，但忽视了环境的不确定性。

fundamental.en: Access to clean water remains a fundamental right under international law.
fundamental.zh: 根据国际法，获得清洁水源仍是一项基本权利。

fundamental.en: The study questions a fundamental assumption behind the standard economic model.
fundamental.zh: 该研究质疑了标准经济模型背后的一个基本假设。

fundamental.en: Such a change would require a fundamental reorganization of the department.
fundamental.zh: 这样的变革需要对该部门进行根本性重组。

meaningful.en: The discussion generated several meaningful insights into rural employment patterns.
meaningful.zh: 该讨论就农村就业模式提出了若干有意义的见解。

meaningful.en: Teachers reported meaningful improvement in student writing after two terms.
meaningful.zh: 教师们反映，经过两个学期后学生写作水平有了明显的改善。

meaningful.en: Without adequate funding the project produced no meaningful result.
meaningful.zh: 缺乏充足资金，该项目没有取得有意义的成果。

multidimensional.en: Poverty is a multidimensional problem that requires coordinated intervention.
multidimensional.zh: 贫困是一个多维度的问题，需要协调一致的干预措施。

multidimensional.en: The model captures multidimensional relationships among several measured variables.
multidimensional.zh: 该模型捕捉了多个测量变量之间的多维关系。

multidimensional.en: Urban housing quality is a multidimensional concept assessed by several indicators.
multidimensional.zh: 城市住房质量是一个通过若干指标来评估的多维概念。

operational.en: The laboratory lacks the operational capacity to process all samples.
operational.zh: 该实验室缺乏处理全部样本的运行能力。

operational.en: Operational costs increased after the new regulations took effect.
operational.zh: 新规定生效后，运营成本上升了。

operational.en: The database remains fully operational despite the recent network failure.
operational.zh: 尽管最近发生网络故障，该数据库仍完全正常运行。

systemic.en: Climate change represents a systemic risk to global financial markets.
systemic.zh: 气候变化对全球金融市场构成系统性风险。

systemic.en: The report highlights systemic inequalities embedded in the welfare system.
systemic.zh: 该报告强调福利制度中嵌入的系统性不平等。

systemic.en: Systemic failure in one supplier could affect the entire production chain.
systemic.zh: 某一供应商的系统性故障可能影响整条生产链。

unified.en: The agency adopted a unified policy for handling all research requests.
unified.zh: 该机构采用了一套统一的政策来处理所有研究申请。

unified.en: A unified framework allows researchers to compare results across diverse disciplines.
unified.zh: 统一的框架使研究者能够比较不同学科的结果。

unified.en: Participants reported a more unified sense of identity after the program.
unified.zh: 参与者在项目结束后报告了更为一致的认同感。

random.en: The sample included a random selection of households from three provinces.
random.zh: 样本包括从三个省份随机抽取的家庭户。

random.en: Random assignment ensured that groups differed only in the treatment.
random.zh: 随机分配确保各组之间仅在处理上存在差异。

random.en: Errors in the data were introduced deliberately at random intervals.
random.zh: 数据中的错误是以随机间隔故意加入的。

experimental.en: The experimental group received the therapy twice per week.
experimental.zh: 实验组每周接受两次这种治疗。

experimental.en: Experimental results must be replicated before they support clinical conclusions.
experimental.zh: 实验结果在支持临床结论之前必须得到复现。

experimental.en: The design remains experimental and has not been widely validated.
experimental.zh: 该设计仍属试验性质，尚未得到广泛验证。

comparable.en: The two studies used comparable measures of emotional stress.
comparable.zh: 这两项研究采用了可比的情绪压力测量方法。

comparable.en: Schools with comparable resources produced broadly similar examination results.
comparable.zh: 资源相当的学校取得了大致相似的考试结果。

comparable.en: We need a comparable dataset from an earlier period for verification.
comparable.zh: 我们需要一个来自更早时期的可比数据集以供核验。

respective.en: Each team reported its findings to the respective ministry in March.
respective.zh: 各团队于三月向各自的主管部门汇报了研究结果。

respective.en: The researchers returned to their respective institutions after the conference.
respective.zh: 会议结束后，研究者们各自回到了自己的机构。

respective.en: The two departments published their respective studies in the same journal.
respective.zh: 两个部门在同一家期刊上发表了各自的研究。

ancillary.en: Ancillary materials were provided to support the main lecture.
ancillary.zh: 提供了辅助材料以配合主讲内容。

ancillary.en: The study treats income as an ancillary factor rather than a primary cause.
ancillary.zh: 该研究把收入视为次要因素，而非主要成因。

ancillary.en: Each volume includes ancillary documents that clarify the historical context.
ancillary.zh: 每一卷都收录了有助于阐明历史背景的附属文献。

observational.en: Observational data cannot always establish a causal relationship between variables.
observational.zh: 观察性数据并不总能确立变量之间的因果关系。

observational.en: Her observational skills allowed her to detect subtle changes in the sample.
observational.zh: 她敏锐的观察力使她能够发现样本中的细微变化。

observational.en: Observational studies were chosen because controlled experiments were impractical.
observational.zh: 之所以选择观察性研究，是因为受控实验并不可行。

cross-sectional.en: A cross-sectional design measured language proficiency across three age groups.
cross-sectional.zh: 一项横断面设计测量了三个年龄组的语言熟练度。

cross-sectional.en: Cross-sectional comparisons of the two cohorts revealed a widening gap.
cross-sectional.zh: 对两个队列的横断面比较显示出差距在不断拉大。

cross-sectional.en: The cross-sectional survey collected responses from employees in several departments.
cross-sectional.zh: 这项横断面调查收集了多个部门员工的回答。

dependent.en: Attendance is dependent on weather conditions during the construction period.
dependent.zh: 出席率取决于施工期间的天气状况。

dependent.en: Many variables in the model are dependent on one another.
dependent.zh: 模型中的许多变量彼此依赖。

dependent.en: The project received funding that was dependent on annual congressional approval.
dependent.zh: 该项目获得的资金取决于国会每年的批准。

correspondingly.en: As enrollment grew, the number of faculty increased correspondingly.
correspondingly.zh: 随着入学人数增长，教师人数也相应增加。

correspondingly.en: Fuel consumption rose correspondingly when the vehicle load became heavier.
correspondingly.zh: 车辆载荷变重时，燃油消耗量也随之上升。

correspondingly.en: Study participants reported higher stress, and their heart rates rose correspondingly.
correspondingly.zh: 研究参与者报告的压力更高，他们的心率也相应上升。

empirically.en: The theory must be tested empirically before it can be widely accepted.
empirically.zh: 这一理论必须经过实证检验，才能被广泛接受。

empirically.en: Empirically, the intervention produced a modest reduction in hospital admissions.
empirically.zh: 从实证角度看，该干预措施使住院人数小幅下降。

empirically.en: Researchers compared the model empirically against archived observational records.
empirically.zh: 研究人员用存档的观测记录对模型进行了实证比较。

implicitly.en: The guidelines implicitly discourage researchers from publishing incomplete results.
implicitly.zh: 该指南含蓄地不鼓励研究者发表不完整的结果。

implicitly.en: Her agreement implicitly accepted the terms described in the proposal.
implicitly.zh: 她的同意实际上接受了提案中所描述的条款。

implicitly.en: Such statements implicitly assume that all participants share identical prior knowledge.
implicitly.zh: 这类说法隐含地假定所有参与者都具备完全相同的先验知识。

principally.en: The sample was drawn principally from urban public hospitals.
principally.zh: 样本主要取自城市公立医院。

principally.en: Her research focuses principally on the economic consequences of migration.
principally.zh: 她的研究主要关注迁移所带来的经济后果。

principally.en: Water usage increased principally because of unusually warm summer temperatures.
principally.zh: 用水量增加主要是因为夏季气温异常偏高。

quantitatively.en: Results were reported quantitatively, allowing direct comparison across laboratories.
quantitatively.zh: 结果以定量方式报告，从而可以在各实验室之间直接比较。

quantitatively.en: Qualitative themes were then examined quantitatively through frequency counts.
quantitatively.zh: 随后通过频次统计对定性主题进行了定量分析。

quantitatively.en: The model was tested quantitatively against measured reaction times.
quantitatively.zh: 该模型针对实测的反应时间进行了定量检验。

qualitatively.en: Interviews revealed qualitatively different experiences among the three groups.
qualitatively.zh: 访谈显示三组之间的经历存在质的差异。

qualitatively.en: The two approaches differ qualitatively rather than merely in scale.
qualitatively.zh: 这两种方法在性质上不同，而不仅仅是规模上的差异。

qualitatively.en: Her findings changed qualitatively once control-group data became available.
qualitatively.zh: 一旦拿到对照组数据，她的发现便发生了质的变化。

retrospectively.en: Retrospectively, the warning signs of the crisis were easy to identify.
retrospectively.zh: 事后看来，危机的预警信号是很容易辨认的。

retrospectively.en: Patients were assessed retrospectively using records from the previous decade.
retrospectively.zh: 研究者利用过去 10 年的记录对患者进行了回顾性评估。

retrospectively.en: Retrospectively, the experiment seems poorly controlled and largely uninformative.
retrospectively.zh: 事后看来，这个实验似乎控制不佳，基本没有参考价值。

significantly.en: Treatment reduced symptom severity significantly over the twelve-week trial period.
significantly.zh: 在 12 周的试验期内，治疗显著减轻了症状的严重程度。

significantly.en: The significantly revised manuscript was accepted without further revisions.
significantly.zh: 这份经过大幅修改的稿件未经进一步修改便被接受了。

significantly.en: Attitudes toward the policy differed significantly between the two groups.
significantly.zh: 两组对该政策的态度存在显著差异。

tentatively.en: The committee tentatively approved the budget pending a detailed audit.
tentatively.zh: 委员会在等待详细审计期间暂时批准了预算。

tentatively.en: These early results should be interpreted tentatively until replication is complete.
tentatively.zh: 在复现完成之前，这些早期结果只宜作试探性解读。

tentatively.en: She tentatively accepted the position, pending approval from the committee.
tentatively.zh: 在等待委员会批准期间，她暂时接受了这个职位。

largely.en: The error was largely attributable to outdated entries in the database.
largely.zh: 该错误在很大程度上归因于数据库中的过期条目。

largely.en: Attendance at the seminar was largely determined by the weather.
largely.zh: 研讨会的出席情况在很大程度上取决于天气。

largely.en: Most complaints largely concerned scheduling rather than the content itself.
largely.zh: 大多数投诉主要涉及的是日程安排，而非内容本身。

precisely.en: The two datasets do not overlap precisely, which complicates direct comparison.
precisely.zh: 这两个数据集并不精确重合，这使直接比较变得复杂。

precisely.en: The gap narrows precisely when participation rates are adjusted.
precisely.zh: 恰恰在对参与率进行调整时，这一差距才有所收窄。

precisely.en: The measurement procedure precisely captured changes of less than a millisecond.
precisely.zh: 该测量程序精确地捕捉到了不足一毫秒的变化。

rapidly.en: Urban populations grew rapidly during the second half of the century.
rapidly.zh: 在该世纪的后半叶，城市人口迅速增长。

rapidly.en: The research team rapidly revised its design after the pilot study.
rapidly.zh: 在试点研究之后，研究团队迅速修改了研究设计。

rapidly.en: Resistance to the treatment developed rapidly among older patients.
rapidly.zh: 在年长患者中，对该治疗的抵抗迅速形成。

comparatively.en: The newer method is comparatively cheap and requires little technical training.
comparatively.zh: 较新的方法成本相对低廉，且几乎不需要技术培训。

comparatively.en: Rural schools enrolled comparatively few students during that period.
comparatively.zh: 在那一时期，农村学校招收的学生相对较少。

comparatively.en: The second trial is comparatively simple, but its interpretation is harder.
comparatively.zh: 第二次试验相对简单，但其解释更为困难。

for example.en: Several factors influence this outcome, for example, temperature and substrate concentration.
for example.zh: 有若干因素会影响这一结果，例如温度和底物浓度。

for example.en: Many cells respond to stress, for example, by producing protective proteins.
for example.zh: 许多细胞会以产生保护性蛋白等方式来应对应激。

for example.en: The archive contains photographs, for example, of the original laboratory.
for example.zh: 该档案馆收藏着照片，例如最初那间实验室的照片。

for instance.en: Several disciplines use this method, for instance, economics and sociology.
for instance.zh: 有多个学科使用这种方法，例如经济学和社会学。

for instance.en: Certain bacteria resist antibiotics, for instance, methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus.
for instance.zh: 某些细菌对抗生素具有耐药性，例如耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌。

for instance.en: The survey covered several regions, for instance, coastal and inland provinces.
for instance.zh: 这项调查涵盖了几个地区，例如沿海省份和内陆省份。

in general.en: Graduate students, in general, work closely with their supervisors.
in general.zh: 一般来说，研究生与导师的合作十分紧密。

in general.en: In general, rural clinics face greater staffing shortages than urban hospitals.
in general.zh: 通常情况下，乡村诊所面临的人员短缺比城市医院更为严重。

in general.en: Cold-water fish, in general, grow more slowly than warm-water species.
in general.zh: 一般来说，冷水鱼的生长速度比暖水鱼慢。

in fact.en: The two theories are, in fact, mathematically equivalent.
in fact.zh: 这两个理论实际上在数学上是等价的。

in fact.en: In fact, most participants reported no change in their daily routines.
in fact.zh: 事实上，大多数参与者表示其日常作息没有变化。

in fact.en: The problem was, in fact, an issue of timing rather than funding.
in fact.zh: 这个问题实际上是时机问题，而不是资金问题。

in particular.en: Economic factors shaped migration, in particular, differences in regional wages.
in particular.zh: 经济因素塑造了人口迁移，尤其是地区工资差异。

in particular.en: Students struggled with the terminology, in particular the statistical notation.
in particular.zh: 学生们在术语上感到困难，尤其是统计符号。

in particular.en: The treatment reduced costs, in particular for rural clinics.
in particular.zh: 该治疗降低了成本，对乡村诊所而言尤其如此。

in terms of.en: In terms of cost, the second design is considerably more expensive.
in terms of.zh: 就成本而言，第二种设计要贵得多。

in terms of.en: The two journals differ in terms of peer review and acceptance rates.
in terms of.zh: 这两份期刊在同行评审和录用率方面有所不同。

in terms of.en: In terms of practical impact, the pilot program had limited reach.
in terms of.zh: 从实际影响来看，该试点项目的覆盖面有限。

with respect to.en: The study examined regional inequality with respect to access to healthcare.
with respect to.zh: 该研究考察了地区在医疗可及性方面的不平等。

with respect to.en: Reviewers disagreed with respect to the strength of the evidence.
with respect to.zh: 评审者们在证据的强度问题上意见不一。

with respect to.en: The committee issued no statement with respect to the reported irregularities.
with respect to.zh: 委员会就所报告的违规问题未发表任何声明。

compared with.en: Compared with last year, enrollment among graduate students increased by twelve percent.
compared with.zh: 与去年相比，研究生入学人数增长了 12%。

compared with.en: Compared with the previous design, the new device consumes far less power.
compared with.zh: 与先前的设计相比，新设备耗电少得多。

compared with.en: Rural incomes rose slowly compared with national averages.
compared with.zh: 与全国平均水平相比，农村收入增长缓慢。

versus.en: Cost was the main argument for consolidation versus maintaining separate regional offices.
versus.zh: 成本是主张合并、而非保留各地区独立办事处的主要论据。

versus.en: The evidence supports collaboration versus competition between the two laboratories.
versus.zh: 证据支持这两个实验室之间的合作而非竞争。

versus.en: The warranty covers repairs versus replacement of defective parts.
versus.zh: 该保修涵盖维修，而非更换有缺陷的部件。

despite.en: Despite the delay, the team delivered the report on time.
despite.zh: 尽管有延误，团队还是按时提交了报告。

despite.en: The treatment remained effective despite the high dropout rate.
despite.zh: 尽管退出率很高，该治疗仍然有效。

despite.en: Despite widespread criticism, the proposal was approved by the committee.
despite.zh: 尽管广受批评，该提案还是获得了委员会批准。

until.en: The manuscript remained under review until the committee reached a decision.
until.zh: 该稿件一直处于评审之中，直到委员会作出决定。

until.en: Water samples were collected until the ice melted completely.
until.zh: 水样一直采集到冰完全融化为止。

until.en: Researchers continued the survey until they had interviewed two hundred respondents.
until.zh: 研究者继续进行调查，直到访谈了 200 名受访者。

on the other hand.en: The method is inexpensive; on the other hand, it requires considerable training.
on the other hand.zh: 这种方法成本低廉；另一方面，它需要大量培训。

on the other hand.en: On the other hand, dropout rates fell substantially after the reminders were introduced.
on the other hand.zh: 另一方面，在发出提醒之后，退出率大幅下降。

on the other hand.en: The findings support the first hypothesis; on the other hand, they contradict the second.
on the other hand.zh: 研究结果支持第一个假设；相反，这些结果与第二个假设相矛盾。

in other words.en: The policy shifts responsibility to local governments, in other words, to taxpayers.
in other words.zh: 该政策把责任转移给地方政府，也就是纳税人。

in other words.en: In other words, the correlation does not imply any causal relationship.
in other words.zh: 换句话说，相关性并不蕴含因果关系。

in other words.en: The outcome was unchanged, in other words, the intervention had no measurable effect.
in other words.zh: 结果没有变化，也就是说该干预没有产生可测量的效果。

as a result.en: Funding was cut sharply; as a result, several long studies were suspended.
as a result.zh: 资金被大幅削减；结果几项长期研究被迫暂停。

as a result.en: As a result of the delay, the final report missed the original deadline.
as a result.zh: 由于延误，最终报告错过了原定的截止日期。

as a result.en: Recruitment improved after the advertisement, and as a result the sample doubled.
as a result.zh: 发布广告后招募情况好转，结果样本数量翻了一番。

in conclusion.en: In conclusion, the evidence supports modest changes to existing clinical guidelines.
in conclusion.zh: 总之，现有证据支持对现行临床指南作出适度修改。

in conclusion.en: In conclusion, further research is needed to confirm these preliminary findings.
in conclusion.zh: 总之，还需要进一步研究来证实这些初步发现。

in conclusion.en: In conclusion, the panel recommended that the current policy remain unchanged.
in conclusion.zh: 总之，专家组建议现行政策保持不变。

in short.en: In short, the project demonstrated that small interventions can have large effects.
in short.zh: 简言之，该项目表明小幅度的干预可以带来大的影响。

in short.en: In short, we lack enough evidence to abandon the existing treatment.
in short.zh: 简而言之，我们缺乏足够的证据来放弃现有的治疗方法。

in short.en: In short, the study offers a practical guide for new researchers.
in short.zh: 简而言之，该研究为新入行的研究者提供了一份实用指南。

to sum up.en: To sum up, three factors explain most of the variation observed.
to sum up.zh: 总而言之，三个因素解释了观察到的绝大部分差异。

to sum up.en: To sum up, the theory needs revision and further empirical testing.
to sum up.zh: 概括地说，该理论需要修订并接受进一步的实证检验。

to sum up.en: To sum up, collaboration across departments would greatly speed the work.
to sum up.zh: 概括地说，跨部门的合作会大大加快工作进度。

that is.en: The result was unexpected, that is, it contradicted every previous trial.
that is.zh: 这个结果出乎意料，也就是说，它与此前的每一次试验都相矛盾。

that is.en: That is, the sample size limits the conclusions we can draw.
that is.zh: 也就是说，样本量限制了我们所能得出的结论。

that is.en: The committee voted to postpone, that is, to delay the decision by six months.
that is.zh: 委员会投票决定推迟，也就是说将决定延后六个月。

correspond.en: These figures correspond closely to the results reported by other laboratories.
correspond.zh: 这些数字与其他实验室报告的结果高度吻合。

correspond.en: Each entry in the table corresponds to a specific observation recorded in the field.
correspond.zh: 表中的每一项都对应着实地记录的一次具体观测。

correspond.en: Her account of the meeting does not correspond with the official minutes.
correspond.zh: 她对会议的描述与官方会议记录并不相符。

comply.en: All laboratories must comply with the revised safety guidelines.
comply.zh: 所有实验室都必须遵守修订后的安全准则。

comply.en: The manufacturer agreed to comply with the regulator's request for additional testing.
comply.zh: 制造商同意遵从监管机构提出的额外检测要求。

comply.en: Exporters who fail to comply with the labeling rules face heavy penalties.
comply.zh: 不遵守标签规定的外贸企业将面临重罚。

establish.en: The team established a new protocol for recording laboratory results.
establish.zh: 该团队建立了一套记录实验室结果的新流程。

establish.en: Researchers established that the two variables were strongly correlated.
establish.zh: 研究者证实这两个变量之间存在很强的相关性。

establish.en: The council established a working group to review the guidelines.
establish.zh: 委员会成立了一个工作组来审查这些准则。

facilitate.en: Shared data platforms can facilitate collaboration between laboratories in different countries.
facilitate.zh: 共享数据平台能够促进不同国家实验室之间的合作。

facilitate.en: The revised forms facilitate the accurate collection of blood pressure readings.
facilitate.zh: 修订后的表格有助于准确收集血压读数。

facilitate.en: A short orientation session was introduced to facilitate new students' transition to the program.
facilitate.zh: 引入了一次简短的入门辅导，以帮助新生适应该项目。

note.en: We note that the observed differences exceed the range of ordinary variation.
note.zh: 我们注意到，观察到的差异超出了正常变异的范围。

note.en: Researchers note a significant improvement in the second half of the trial.
note.zh: 研究者指出，在试验的后半程出现了显著的改善。

note.en: The director asked us to note several limitations in the report.
note.zh: 主任要求我们指出报告中的若干局限之处。

present.en: The researchers present their findings at the annual conference next month.
present.zh: 研究人员将在年会上介绍他们的研究结果。

present.en: This study presents strong evidence that the intervention reduces readmission rates.
present.zh: 本研究提供了有力证据，表明该干预措施能降低再入院率。

present.en: Professor Chen will present the revised proposal to the funding committee on Friday.
present.zh: 陈教授将于周五向资助委员会提交修订后的提案。

record.en: The nurse records the patient's blood pressure and temperature every morning.
record.zh: 护士每天早晨记录病人的血压和体温。

record.en: Historians rely on archives that record the economic conditions of earlier centuries.
record.zh: 历史学家依赖记录了前几个世纪经济状况的档案。

record.en: The experiment recorded a significant decline in energy consumption over six months.
record.zh: 实验记录到六个月内能耗的显著下降。

seek.en: The committee seeks external advice before approving the new policy.
seek.zh: 委员会在批准新政策之前寻求外部建议。

seek.en: Many graduates seek employment in the rapidly expanding technology sector.
seek.zh: 许多毕业生在快速扩张的科技行业寻求就业机会。

seek.en: Researchers seek to establish whether the two variables are genuinely correlated.
seek.zh: 研究者试图确定这两个变量是否确实存在相关性。

show.en: The data show a clear decline in air pollution over the past decade.
show.zh: 数据表明，过去 10 年空气污染明显下降。

show.en: Experiments showed that regular exercise improves cognitive performance significantly.
show.zh: 实验表明，规律运动能显著提升认知表现。

show.en: The documentary shows how rural communities adapted to rapid environmental change.
show.zh: 这部纪录片展示了农村社区如何适应迅速的环境变化。

tend.en: Students who attend lectures tend to perform better in final examinations.
tend.zh: 去听课的学生在期末考试中往往表现更好。

tend.en: Economic growth tends to slow when interest rates rise sharply.
tend.zh: 利率急剧上升时，经济增长往往会放缓。

tend.en: Older participants tended to rely more on physical rather than visual cues.
tend.zh: 年长参与者往往更多地依赖身体线索而非视觉线索。

view.en: The prevailing view among economists is that the effect is temporary.
view.zh: 经济学界的主流看法是这一效应只是暂时的。

view.en: A competing view holds that the policy will increase inequality.
view.zh: 另一种对立的看法认为该政策会加剧不平等。

view.en: Historians view the period as a turning point in modern governance.
view.zh: 历史学家把这一时期视为现代治理的转折点。

concern.en: A primary concern of the review board was the length of the recruitment period.
concern.zh: 评审委员会的首要关切是招募周期过长。

concern.en: Data protection was the second concern raised by the ethics committee.
concern.zh: 数据保护是伦理委员会提出的第二项关切。

concern.en: Rising sea levels concern coastal planners who design drainage systems.
concern.zh: 海平面上升让设计排水系统的沿海规划者深感担忧。

enable.en: Digital archives enable researchers to access rare manuscripts from anywhere.
enable.zh: 数字档案使研究者能够从任何地方获取珍贵手稿。

enable.en: The new grant scheme enables early career scientists to lead independent research.
enable.zh: 新的资助计划使青年科学家能够主持独立研究。

enable.en: Improved broadband connectivity enables real-time collaboration between international laboratories.
enable.zh: 宽带连接的改善使国际实验室之间的实时协作成为可能。

lack.en: Rural hospitals often lack the equipment needed for advanced diagnostic procedures.
lack.zh: 乡村医院往往缺乏高级诊断程序所需的设备。

lack.en: The study lacks a control group, which weakens the strength of its conclusions.
lack.zh: 该研究缺少对照组，这削弱了其结论的说服力。

lack.en: Students who lack academic support often face significant barriers to completion.
lack.zh: 缺乏学业支持的学生常常面临完成学业的重重障碍。

aim.en: The primary aim of this survey is to measure regional differences in educational access.
aim.zh: 本次调查的主要目的是测量各地区在教育获取方面的差异。

aim.en: Our long-term aim is to develop therapies that require minimal clinical supervision.
aim.zh: 我们的长期目标是开发出只需极少临床监督即可使用的疗法。

aim.en: The aim of the review is to synthesize evidence from diverse disciplinary perspectives.
aim.zh: 该综述旨在综合来自不同学科视角的证据。

case.en: This case illustrates how regulatory changes affect small manufacturing businesses.
case.zh: 这个案例说明了监管变化如何影响小型制造企业。

case.en: Researchers use a longitudinal case to examine long-term language development.
case.zh: 研究者利用一个纵向案例考察长期的语言发展。

case.en: In most cases, the proposed model predicts the observed outcome reasonably well.
case.zh: 在大多数情况下，所提出的模型能较好地预测观测结果。

point.en: The author makes a compelling point about the ethics of genetic screening.
point.zh: 作者就基因筛查的伦理问题提出了令人信服的观点。

point.en: Let me clarify my point before the discussion moves to the next topic.
point.zh: 在讨论进入下一个议题之前，让我澄清一下我的观点。

point.en: There is some point to his criticism, although it is overstated in places.
point.zh: 他的批评有几分道理，尽管在某些地方言过其实。

type.en: Researchers classified the samples into three types based on their chemical composition.
type.zh: 研究者依据化学成分将样本分为三种类型。

type.en: This type of uncertainty is common in early stages of clinical trials.
type.zh: 这类不确定性在临床试验的早期阶段很常见。

type.en: The analysis distinguishes between two distinct types of social stratification.
type.zh: 该分析区分了两种不同类型的社会分层。

field.en: She has made significant contributions to the field of cognitive neuroscience.
field.zh: 她在认知神经科学领域作出了重要贡献。

field.en: The field of environmental economics has grown remarkably over the past decades.
field.zh: 环境经济学领域在过去几十年里有了显著的发展。

field.en: Interviews revealed that practitioners were uncertain about the findings in this field.
field.zh: 访谈显示，从业者对该领域的研究发现感到不确定。

degree.en: She earned her doctoral degree in economics from a university in Toronto.
degree.zh: 她在多伦多的一所大学获得了经济学博士学位。

degree.en: The results demonstrate a high degree of consistency across all participating laboratories.
degree.zh: 结果表明所有参与实验室之间具有高度的一致性。

degree.en: The extent of the damage was difficult to judge because of the high degree of humidity.
degree.zh: 由于湿度很高，损害程度很难判断。

imply.en: The survey results imply that most respondents prefer online learning.
imply.zh: 调查结果表明，大多数受访者更倾向于在线学习。

imply.en: Failure to disclose conflicts of interest implies a serious breach of protocol.
imply.zh: 未披露利益冲突意味着严重违反了研究规范。

imply.en: Such patterns imply broader structural problems within the healthcare system.
imply.zh: 这类模式表明医疗体系内部存在更广泛的结构性问题。

posit.en: The authors posit a hypothesis linking sleep quality to academic performance.
posit.zh: 作者提出一个假设，将睡眠质量与学业表现联系起来。

posit.en: It is often useful to posit competing explanations and then test each one.
posit.zh: 通常先提出若干相互竞争的解释，再逐一加以检验会很有帮助。

posit.en: Critics posit that the policy benefits mainly urban industries.
posit.zh: 批评者主张，这项政策主要使城市产业受益。

converge.en: Results from independent laboratories converge on the same conclusion.
converge.zh: 各个独立实验室的研究结果都指向同一结论。

converge.en: The two research traditions converge when applied to language acquisition.
converge.zh: 这两种研究传统应用于语言习得问题时趋于一致。

converge.en: As the sample grows, estimated coefficients converge around a stable value.
converge.zh: 随着样本量增加，估计系数逐渐稳定在某个数值附近。

contextualize.en: We contextualize these findings within the history of regional migration.
contextualize.zh: 我们结合区域迁移的历史来解读这些发现。

contextualize.en: Without proper data, educators struggle to contextualize curriculum reforms.
contextualize.zh: 缺乏恰当的数据时，教育工作者难以将课程改革置于其背景中加以理解。

contextualize.en: Reviewers asked authors to contextualize the intervention within existing evidence.
contextualize.zh: 审稿人要求作者将这一干预措施放在现有证据的背景中加以说明。

normalize.en: Researchers normalize the data before comparing groups across regions.
normalize.zh: 研究者在比较不同地区的组别之前对数据进行标准化处理。

normalize.en: Standard protocols help analysts normalize measurements from different instruments.
normalize.zh: 标准流程有助于分析人员统一来自不同仪器的测量数据。

normalize.en: We normalized the scores so that the mean equaled zero.
normalize.zh: 我们对分数进行了归一化处理，使其均值为零。

standardize.en: The agency standardized its reporting format to improve data comparability.
standardize.zh: 该机构统一了报告格式，以提高数据的可比性。

standardize.en: Standardized tests can reduce teacher bias during annual evaluation.
standardize.zh: 标准化测验可以减少年度评估中的教师偏差。

standardize.en: Hospitals standardized their procedures after the safety review.
standardize.zh: 安全审查之后，各医院统一了操作流程。

stratify.en: We stratified the sample by age and educational attainment before analysis.
stratify.zh: 在分析之前，我们按年龄和受教育程度对样本进行了分层。

stratify.en: Stratified random sampling ensures every subgroup is adequately represented.
stratify.zh: 分层随机抽样可确保每个子群体都得到充分代表。

stratify.en: Analysts stratify income data to examine inequality across regions.
stratify.zh: 分析人员对收入数据进行分层，以考察各地区之间的不平等。

impute.en: We imputed missing values using multiple imputation techniques.
impute.zh: 我们使用多重插补技术填补了缺失值。

impute.en: Imputing values that are not missing at random may bias results.
impute.zh: 对非随机缺失的数据进行插补可能会使结果产生偏倚。

impute.en: Researchers impute absent scores to preserve the original sample size.
impute.zh: 研究者对缺失分数进行插补，以保持原有的样本量。

triangulate.en: We triangulated interview data with survey responses and administrative records.
triangulate.zh: 我们将访谈资料与问卷回答及行政记录进行了交叉验证。

triangulate.en: Triangulating three sources strengthens the credibility of the conclusions.
triangulate.zh: 对三种来源进行三角互证可以增强结论的可信度。

triangulate.en: Independent reviewers triangulate findings from three separate databases.
triangulate.zh: 独立评审者利用三个不同的数据库对研究发现进行交叉核验。

saturate.en: Additional interviews failed to saturate the emerging categories of the analysis.
saturate.zh: 补充访谈未能使分析中逐渐形成的主题类别达到饱和。

saturate.en: The market rapidly saturated once low-cost competitors entered the sector.
saturate.zh: 一旦低成本竞争者进入该行业，市场很快便达到饱和。

saturate.en: Soil samples became saturated after several days of continuous rainfall.
saturate.zh: 连续降雨数日后，土壤样本达到饱和状态。

overestimate.en: Self-reported data often overestimate actual physical activity levels.
overestimate.zh: 自我报告的数据往往高估了实际的身体活动水平。

overestimate.en: Analysts who overestimate demand may order excessive inventory.
overestimate.zh: 高估需求的分析人员可能会订购过多的库存。

overestimate.en: The model tends to overestimate error rates in small subgroups.
overestimate.zh: 该模型往往会高估小子群组中的误差率。

underestimate.en: Many studies underestimate the true prevalence of the condition.
underestimate.zh: 许多研究低估了这一病症的真实患病率。

underestimate.en: Managers often underestimate the time required to complete the migration.
underestimate.zh: 管理者常常低估完成迁移所需的时间。

underestimate.en: Researchers underestimate how quickly social networks reshape consumer behavior.
underestimate.zh: 研究者低估了社会网络重塑消费者行为的速度。

enforce.en: Regulators enforce the new reporting requirements across all licensed institutions.
enforce.zh: 监管机构在所有持证机构中强制执行新的报告要求。

enforce.en: Schools that fail to enforce attendance policies see poorer outcomes.
enforce.zh: 未能执行出勤政策的学校往往取得较差的结果。

enforce.en: The court will enforce the settlement agreement reached last month.
enforce.zh: 法院将强制执行上个月达成的和解协议。

regress.en: Test scores regress toward the mean after several weeks of instruction.
regress.zh: 经过数周教学后，测试分数回归均值。

regress.en: Researchers regress the outcome on several continuous predictor variables.
regress.zh: 研究者将因变量对若干连续预测变量进行了回归分析。

regress.en: When extreme initial estimates regress toward the mean on retesting, additional trials should be conducted.
regress.zh: 当极端的初始估计值在复测中向均值回归时，应当开展更多次试验。

control.en: Every participant in the control group received the standard treatment.
control.zh: 对照组的每位参与者都接受了标准治疗。

control.en: Researchers controlled the temperature throughout the trial.
control.zh: 研究人员在整个试验期间控制着温度。

control.en: Randomly assigning participants to conditions controls for known confounders.
control.zh: 将参与者随机分配到各条件组可以控制已知的混杂因素。

verify.en: Editors should verify every citation against the original source.
verify.zh: 编辑应当对照原始来源核实每一条引文。

verify.en: The checksum allows users to verify the file's integrity.
verify.zh: 校验和可以让用户核实文件的完整性。

verify.en: We can verify the model's predictions using independent field data.
verify.zh: 我们可以用独立的实地数据核实该模型的预测。

operationalize.en: The team worked to operationalize the abstract policy into measurable daily procedures.
operationalize.zh: 团队努力将这项抽象政策具体化为可衡量的日常流程。

operationalize.en: Managers must operationalize the new strategy across every regional office.
operationalize.zh: 管理者必须将新战略在各个区域办公室落实为具体行动。

operationalize.en: Her study operationalized the vague notion of quality into twenty measurable indicators.
operationalize.zh: 她的研究将模糊的质量概念具体化为 20 项可测量的指标。

effect.en: Small changes in sleep had a noticeable effect on the team's performance.
effect.zh: 睡眠的小幅变化对团队的表现产生了明显的影响。

effect.en: The new policy had the desired effect of reducing classroom absences considerably.
effect.zh: 新政策达到了预期效果，大幅减少了课堂缺席。

effect.en: Little is known about the long-term effect of the treatment on patients.
effect.zh: 关于该疗法对患者的长期影响，人们知之甚少。

parameter.en: Users can adjust each parameter until the model output matches their expectations.
parameter.zh: 用户可以调整每个参数，直到模型输出与他们的预期相符。

parameter.en: Cost and time are important parameters when choosing between two research designs.
parameter.zh: 在两种研究设计之间做选择时，成本和时间是重要参数。

parameter.en: The proposal is valid only within a narrow range of parameter values.
parameter.zh: 该提案仅在较窄的参数取值范围内才成立。

anomaly.en: The monitoring system flagged an anomaly in the temperature readings at midnight.
anomaly.zh: 监测系统标记出午夜温度读数中的异常。

anomaly.en: Researchers investigated the anomaly but found no systematic error in the instruments.
anomaly.zh: 研究人员调查了这一异常，但未在仪器中发现系统性误差。

anomaly.en: This case is not an anomaly; it reflects a broader regional trend.
anomaly.zh: 这一案例并非异常现象，而是反映了更广泛的地区趋势。

replicate.en: An independent team replicated the experiment and obtained nearly identical results.
replicate.zh: 一个独立团队复现了该实验，得到了几乎完全相同的结果。

replicate.en: The findings were replicated across four laboratories in three different countries.
replicate.zh: 这些发现在三个不同国家的四所实验室中得到了复现。

replicate.en: Scientists must replicate their results before drawing broad scientific conclusions.
replicate.zh: 科学家在得出广泛科学结论之前必须复现自己的结果。

document.en: Researchers document every decision made during the data cleaning process.
document.zh: 研究人员记录了数据清理过程中所做的每一项决定。

document.en: Please document the consent procedure so reviewers can verify compliance.
document.zh: 请记录知情同意流程，以便评审者核查其合规性。

document.en: Case notes document changes in the patient's condition over six months.
document.zh: 病历记录了患者六个月来的病情变化。

attribute.en: We attribute the improvement to targeted training rather than increased funding.
attribute.zh: 我们把这一改善归因于有针对性的培训，而非资金投入的增加。

attribute.en: Historians attribute the decline to several interacting economic factors.
attribute.zh: 历史学家把这一衰落归因于若干相互起作用的经济因素。

attribute.en: Do not attribute an observed effect to a single cause without controlling for confounders.
attribute.zh: 在未控制混杂因素之前，不要将观察到的效应归因于单一原因。

convention.en: Academic convention requires that the sample size be reported.
convention.zh: 学术惯例要求报告样本量。

convention.en: The annual convention attracted two thousand researchers from abroad.
convention.zh: 这次年度大会吸引了来自国外的 2000 名研究者。

convention.en: By convention, the first author maintains the final manuscript.
convention.zh: 按照惯例，第一作者负责维护最终稿。

post hoc.en: Post hoc comparisons were conducted only after the omnibus test reached significance.
post hoc.zh: 只有在总体检验达到显著水平之后，才进行了事后比较。

post hoc.en: Post hoc analysis confirmed the pattern seen in the exploratory data.
post hoc.zh: 事后分析证实了探索性数据中所见的模式。

post hoc.en: Researchers interpreting the data should avoid post hoc reasoning when evaluating preregistered hypotheses.
post hoc.zh: 在解读数据并评估预注册假设时，研究者应避免事后推理。

power.en: The study had insufficient statistical power to detect moderate effects.
power.zh: 该研究的统计功效不足以检测出中等程度的效应。

power.en: Increasing the sample size substantially improves the power of the test.
power.zh: 增大样本量能显著提高检验的统计功效。

power.en: Researchers should report the power calculation alongside their hypothesis.
power.zh: 研究者应当在提出假设的同时报告功效计算结果。

interpretation.en: The interpretation of these results depends on the assumption we adopted.
interpretation.zh: 对这些结果的解释取决于我们所采用的假设。

interpretation.en: Alternative interpretations of the data have appeared in recent journals.
interpretation.zh: 近期期刊中出现了对这些数据的其他解读。

interpretation.en: Her interpretation of the poem shaped the entire discussion period.
interpretation.zh: 她对这首诗的阐释塑造了整个讨论环节。

equivalent.en: There is no direct equivalent in the target language for this term.
equivalent.zh: 该术语在目标语言中没有直接的对等物。

equivalent.en: This instrument is a rough equivalent of the validated clinical scale.
equivalent.zh: 这一量表大致相当于经过效度验证的临床量表。

equivalent.en: A doctoral degree is often treated as equivalent to five years of professional experience.
equivalent.zh: 博士学位通常被视为等同于五年的职业经验。

imbalance.en: A serious imbalance in the sample limited the strength of the analysis.
imbalance.zh: 样本的严重失衡限制了分析的效力。

imbalance.en: The researchers reported an imbalance between treatment and control groups.
imbalance.zh: 研究者报告了治疗组与对照组之间的不平衡。

imbalance.en: Correcting the design imbalance required recruiting additional older participants.
imbalance.zh: 纠正设计上的失衡需要额外招募年长的参与者。

inverse.en: The inverse of the correlation matrix was computed for every model.
inverse.zh: 为每个模型计算了相关系数矩阵的逆矩阵。

inverse.en: We take the inverse of the transformation to recover the original values.
inverse.zh: 我们取该变换的逆运算，以还原原始数值。

inverse.en: His conclusion is the exact inverse of his colleague's earlier claim.
inverse.zh: 他的结论与同事早先的主张恰好完全相反。

span.en: The time span of the study covered nearly twenty years of records.
span.zh: 该研究的时间跨度涵盖了近二十年的记录。

span.en: Attention spans have shortened considerably among younger digital users.
span.zh: 在年轻的数字用户群体中，注意力的持续时间已明显缩短。

span.en: The span of the data varies widely across regional databases.
span.zh: 数据的跨度在各地区数据库之间差异很大。

spread.en: The spread of the phenomenon differed sharply between urban and rural areas.
spread.zh: 这一现象的分布在城乡之间差异明显。

spread.en: Income spread within each province narrowed over the past decade.
spread.zh: 过去 10 年中，各省内部的收入差距有所缩小。

spread.en: Social networks accelerate the spread of information across communities.
spread.zh: 社交网络加速了信息在各社区之间的传播。

subset.en: A subset of respondents reported frequent delays in service delivery.
subset.zh: 一部分受访者报告了服务提供经常延误的情况。

subset.en: The analysis focuses on a subset of the full clinical dataset.
subset.zh: 该分析聚焦于完整临床数据集中的一个子集。

subset.en: Each participant belongs to a subset defined by age and location.
subset.zh: 每位参与者都属于按年龄和地点划分出的某个子集。

skew.en: Data skew may reduce the effectiveness of certain parametric tests.
skew.zh: 数据偏斜可能会削弱某些参数检验的效果。

skew.en: The report acknowledges a mild skew in the distribution of scores.
skew.zh: 报告承认分数分布存在轻微的偏斜。

skew.en: Researchers applied a transformation to correct the observed skew.
skew.zh: 研究者采用了一种变换方法来纠正观察到的偏斜。

weight.en: The final model assigns greater weight to recent observations.
weight.zh: 最终模型给较近期的观测值赋予更大的权重。

weight.en: Each survey wave receives an equal weight in the national estimate.
weight.zh: 在国家层面的估计中，每一轮调查都获得相等的权重。

weight.en: Weight and size were recorded for every captured fish specimen.
weight.zh: 每件捕获的鱼类标本都记录了重量和体长。

algorithm.en: The recommendation algorithm suggests items based on previous viewing behavior.
algorithm.zh: 该推荐算法依据以往的观看行为推荐内容。

algorithm.en: We compared two clustering algorithms across several benchmark datasets.
algorithm.zh: 我们在多个基准数据集上比较了两种聚类算法。

algorithm.en: Any algorithm used in scoring should be documented in the appendix.
algorithm.zh: 用于评分的任何算法都应在附录中加以说明。

covariate.en: Age was included as a covariate in the regression model.
covariate.zh: 年龄被作为协变量纳入回归模型。

covariate.en: Researchers adjusted for each covariate before testing the main effect.
covariate.zh: 研究者在检验主效应之前对每个协变量都进行了校正。

covariate.en: Sleep duration emerged as the strongest covariate in the final analysis.
covariate.zh: 在最终分析中，睡眠时长成为最强的协变量。

stratum.en: Each sampling stratum must include participants from diverse backgrounds.
stratum.zh: 每个抽样层都必须包含来自不同背景的参与者。

stratum.en: Participants were recruited from every stratum of the population.
stratum.zh: 参与者是从总体的每一层中招募来的。

stratum.en: The stratum for rural clinics required twice the planned sample.
stratum.zh: 乡村诊所这一层所需的样本量是原计划的两倍。

sampling.en: The sampling strategy prioritized hospitals serving low-income populations.
sampling.zh: 该抽样策略优先考虑了服务低收入人群的医院。

sampling.en: Probability sampling improves the generalizability of the survey findings.
sampling.zh: 概率抽样提高了调查发现的可推广性。

sampling.en: Snowball sampling was useful for reaching hidden populations in the region.
sampling.zh: 滚雪球抽样有助于接触该地区的隐蔽人群。

recruitment.en: Participant recruitment took place at three metropolitan universities.
recruitment.zh: 参与者招募在三所大城市的大学进行。

recruitment.en: Recruitment difficulties delayed the start of the clinical trial.
recruitment.zh: 招募困难延误了临床试验的启动。

recruitment.en: The team adjusted its recruitment materials to appeal to younger volunteers.
recruitment.zh: 团队调整了招募材料，以吸引更年轻的志愿者。

dropout.en: Every dropout was recorded with a reason and the date.
dropout.zh: 每一例脱落都记录了原因和日期。

dropout.en: High dropout rates forced researchers to extend the recruitment period.
dropout.zh: 高脱落率迫使研究者延长了招募期。

dropout.en: Reminders sent by text message reduced dropout among enrolled students.
dropout.zh: 通过短信发送的提醒减少了在读学生的脱落。

attrition.en: Attrition in the control group reached nearly fifteen percent by year end.
attrition.zh: 到年底，对照组的流失率接近 15%。

attrition.en: Differential attrition between groups may bias the treatment comparison.
attrition.zh: 各组之间流失率的差异可能使疗效比较产生偏倚。

attrition.en: The protocol included strategies to minimize attrition in long follow-up.
attrition.zh: 该方案包含了在长期随访中减少流失的策略。

ethics.en: The study was approved by the university research ethics committee.
ethics.zh: 该研究已获得大学研究伦理委员会批准。

ethics.en: Research ethics requires that participants be allowed to withdraw at any time.
ethics.zh: 研究伦理要求参与者可以随时退出。

ethics.en: The researchers discussed research ethics before collecting any data.
ethics.zh: 研究人员在收集任何数据之前讨论了研究伦理问题。

anonymity.en: We ensured anonymity by removing all identifying information before analysis.
anonymity.zh: 我们在分析之前删除所有身份信息，以确保匿名性。

anonymity.en: Anonymity of participants was protected through a third-party data custodian.
anonymity.zh: 参与者的匿名性通过第三方数据保管机构得到保护。

anonymity.en: Respondents mentioned anonymity as a reason for answering honestly.
anonymity.zh: 受访者提到匿名性是他们如实作答的原因之一。

interview.en: Each in-depth interview lasted approximately ninety minutes on average.
interview.zh: 每次深度访谈平均持续约 90 分钟。

interview.en: The interview protocol included open questions about daily routines.
interview.zh: 访谈方案包含了关于日常作息的开放式问题。

interview.en: Interview recordings were transcribed and coded by two researchers.
interview.zh: 访谈录音由两名研究者转录并进行了编码。

setting.en: The ethnographic study examined daily life in an institutional setting.
setting.zh: 这项民族志研究考察了机构场景中的日常生活。

setting.en: Results from this clinical setting may not generalize to rural practice.
setting.zh: 来自这一临床场景的结果未必能推广到乡村医疗实践中。

setting.en: The learning setting strongly influenced students' willingness to participate.
setting.zh: 学习环境显著影响了学生参与的意愿。

confounding.en: Age and education were considered potential confounding variables in the analysis.
confounding.zh: 年龄和教育程度在分析中被视为潜在的混杂变量。

confounding.en: Unmeasured confounding can distort the estimated treatment effect.
confounding.zh: 未测量的混杂因素可能会歪曲治疗效应的估计。

confounding.en: Researchers reduced confounding by randomizing participants across both conditions.
confounding.zh: 研究者通过在两种条件下随机分配参与者来减少混杂。

mediating.en: Sleep quality was found to be a mediating variable between job stress and employee turnover.
mediating.zh: 研究发现，睡眠质量是工作压力与员工流失之间的中介变量。

mediating.en: The mediating role of supervisor support cannot be ignored when explaining employee wellbeing.
mediating.zh: 在解释员工福祉时，主管支持所起的中介作用不可忽视。

mediating.en: Language ability plays a mediating role between education and employment outcomes.
mediating.zh: 语言能力在教育与就业结果之间起着中介作用。

moderating.en: Team size has a moderating effect on the relationship between training and productivity.
moderating.zh: 团队规模对培训与生产率之间的关系具有调节效应。

moderating.en: Prior experience played a moderating role in the link between training load and performance gains.
moderating.zh: 先前经验在训练负荷与成绩提升之间的关系中起到了调节作用。

moderating.en: The moderating influence of leadership support remained stable across three separate samples.
moderating.zh: 领导支持的调节影响在三个独立样本中保持稳定。

policy.en: The new policy aims to reduce waiting times in public hospitals nationwide.
policy.zh: 这项新政策旨在降低全国公立医院的候诊时间。

policy.en: Policy implementation often fails when local agencies lack adequate resources and authority.
policy.zh: 当地方机构缺乏足够的资源和权限时，政策执行往往失败。

policy.en: Economists debate whether the monetary policy stance will reduce inflation this year.
policy.zh: 经济学家们争论今年的货币政策立场是否会降低通货膨胀。

institutional.en: Institutional support strongly influences how new teachers adopt classroom practices.
institutional.zh: 制度支持对新教师如何采用课堂教学方式有着显著影响。

institutional.en: The study examines trust in institutional bodies across four European countries.
institutional.zh: 本研究考察了四个欧洲国家中人们对公共机构的信任。

institutional.en: Institutional investors shifted their portfolios after the market volatility last autumn.
institutional.zh: 去年秋季市场波动之后，机构投资者调整了他们的投资组合。

organizational.en: Organizational culture often resists change even when new technology is available.
organizational.zh: 即使有新技术可用，组织文化也常常抗拒变革。

organizational.en: The organizational structure of the firm was reorganized to improve communication.
organizational.zh: 该公司的组织结构经过重组，以改善沟通。

organizational.en: Managers reported that organizational commitment had declined noticeably over two years.
organizational.zh: 管理者报告说，员工的组织承诺在两年内明显下降。

societal.en: Societal attitudes toward migration have shifted considerably over the past decade.
societal.zh: 过去 10 年里，社会对移民的态度发生了很大变化。

societal.en: Technological innovation continues to reshape societal expectations of public services.
societal.zh: 技术创新持续重塑社会对公共服务的期待。

societal.en: The author argues that inequality produces deep societal costs for future generations.
societal.zh: 作者认为，不平等会给后代带来深刻的社会成本。

demographic.en: Demographic change has slowed population growth across most European regions.
demographic.zh: 人口结构变化减缓了欧洲大多数地区的人口增长。

demographic.en: The aging demographic presents serious challenges for pension systems worldwide.
demographic.zh: 老龄化人口对全球养老金体系构成了严峻挑战。

demographic.en: Marketing teams analyzed demographic data before entering the new market.
demographic.zh: 市场团队在进入新市场前分析了人口统计数据。

inclusion.en: The inclusion of rural schools in the reform program widened access to resources.
inclusion.zh: 将农村学校纳入改革计划扩大了资源获取的范围。

inclusion.en: Social inclusion remains a central goal of housing policy in many countries.
inclusion.zh: 社会包容仍然是许多国家住房政策的核心目标。

inclusion.en: The committee reviewed the inclusion of minority researchers in grant panels.
inclusion.zh: 该委员会审查了少数族裔研究者在科研资助评审小组中的纳入情况。

disproportionate.en: The reform had a disproportionate impact on low-income households across the country.
disproportionate.zh: 该改革对全国低收入家庭产生了不成比例的影响。

disproportionate.en: A disproportionate share of the funding was directed toward urban research centers.
disproportionate.zh: 城市研究中心获得了远超其比例的资金份额。

disproportionate.en: Regulators penalized the firm for its disproportionate treatment of part-time employees.
disproportionate.zh: 监管机构因该公司对兼职员工不成比例的差别对待而对其处以罚款。

inferential.en: The use of inferential statistics allows researchers to draw conclusions beyond the raw data.
inferential.zh: 推断统计使研究者能够超出原始数据本身得出结论。

inferential.en: Students often confuse descriptive reporting with inferential claims about causality.
inferential.zh: 学生常常把描述性报告与关于因果关系的推论混为一谈。

inferential.en: The paper uses inferential techniques to test whether the effect persists over time.
inferential.zh: 该论文运用推断技术检验这一效应是否随时间持续存在。

norm.en: Social norms strongly influence how individuals respond to environmental regulations.
norm.zh: 社会规范显著影响个人对环境法规的反应。

norm.en: The study compared professional norms across five different legal systems.
norm.zh: 该研究比较了五个不同法律体系下的专业规范。

norm.en: Such behavior violates the unwritten norm of academic honesty.
norm.zh: 此类行为违反了不成文的学术诚信规范。

solely.en: The delay was solely due to a shortage of laboratory equipment.
solely.zh: 延误完全是由于实验室设备短缺造成的。

solely.en: This measure should not be viewed as solely an economic intervention.
solely.zh: 不应仅仅把这项措施视为一种经济干预。

solely.en: The model was trained solely on data collected from European archives.
solely.zh: 该模型完全使用从欧洲档案馆收集的数据进行训练。

statistically.en: The correlation was statistically significant at the five percent level.
statistically.zh: 该相关关系在 5% 水平上具有统计显著性。

statistically.en: Statistically, the two groups did not differ on any measured outcome.
statistically.zh: 在统计意义上，两组在任何测量结果上都没有差异。

statistically.en: Differences between regions were statistically insignificant after controlling for income.
statistically.zh: 在控制收入变量后，地区之间的差异在统计上并不显著。

analytically.en: Analytically, the framework separates descriptive questions from causal ones.
analytically.zh: 在分析上，该框架把描述性问题与因果性问题区分开来。

analytically.en: The two approaches are analytically distinct, even if they share vocabulary.
analytically.zh: 这两种方法在分析上截然不同，尽管共享相同的术语。

analytically.en: This case is analytically useful for understanding how institutions respond to shocks.
analytically.zh: 这个案例在分析上对于理解机构如何应对冲击很有价值。

conceptually.en: Conceptually, the theory links individual choices to wider structural conditions.
conceptually.zh: 在概念上，该理论把个人选择与更宏观的结构条件联系起来。

conceptually.en: The reviewers found the argument conceptually sound but empirically untested.
conceptually.zh: 评审者认为该论证在概念上是合理的，但未经实证检验。

conceptually.en: Conceptually, classification and explanation require quite different kinds of evidence.
conceptually.zh: 在概念上，分类与解释需要相当不同类型的证据。

evidently.en: The protocol was, evidently, adapted from an earlier study.
evidently.zh: 该方案显然改编自一项早期研究。

evidently.en: The early results evidently exceeded the expectations of the research team.
evidently.zh: 早期结果显然超出了研究团队的预期。

evidently.en: Evidently, the training program did little to change daily practice.
evidently.zh: 显然，该培训项目对改变日常实践作用甚微。

ostensibly.en: The ostensibly neutral rule actually reinforced existing inequalities.
ostensibly.zh: 这条表面上中立的规则实际上强化了既有的不平等。

ostensibly.en: The reform was ostensibly designed to reduce administrative delays for citizens.
ostensibly.zh: 这项改革据称旨在减少公民办理事务时的行政延误。

ostensibly.en: Although ostensibly voluntary, the scheme was supported by subtle financial incentives.
ostensibly.zh: 尽管名义上是自愿的，该计划背后却有不易察觉的经济激励。

seemingly.en: The two variables that appear unrelated show a seemingly random pattern.
seemingly.zh: 这两个看似无关的变量呈现出一种看似随机的模式。

seemingly.en: The seemingly minor issue eventually became a major point of contention.
seemingly.zh: 看似微不足道的问题却演变成了主要的争论焦点。

seemingly.en: Participants often prefer the seemingly simpler explanation for complex findings.
seemingly.zh: 参与者往往偏好那种看似更简单、能够解释复杂结果的说明。

interviewer.en: A trained interviewer asked each participant the same set of questions.
interviewer.zh: 经过培训的访谈者向每位参与者提出了完全相同的问题。

interviewer.en: The interviewer recorded the participants' answers verbatim on a tablet.
interviewer.zh: 访谈者用平板逐字记录下了参与者的回答。

interviewer.en: Interviews conducted by a trained interviewer showed consistent results across sites.
interviewer.zh: 由经过培训的访谈者所做的访谈在各研究中心都得到了一致的结果。

measurement.en: Each measurement was repeated three times to reduce random error.
measurement.zh: 每次测量都重复三次，以减少随机误差。

measurement.en: The measurement of temperature was performed with a calibrated sensor.
measurement.zh: 温度测量使用的是经过校准的传感器。

measurement.en: Measurement uncertainty was reported for every value in the table.
measurement.zh: 表中每一个数值都报告了测量不确定度。

percentage.en: A large percentage of the participants preferred the shorter survey format.
percentage.zh: 相当大比例的参与者更偏好简短的问卷形式。

percentage.en: The percentage of missing data was below five percent in each group.
percentage.zh: 各组数据缺失的百分比都低于 5%。

percentage.en: We report the percentage change rather than the absolute values.
percentage.zh: 我们报告的是变化的百分比，而不是绝对数值。

frequency.en: The frequency of the adverse events was recorded throughout the trial.
frequency.zh: 整个试验期间都记录了不良事件的发生频率。

frequency.en: Table two shows the frequency of each response category.
frequency.zh: 表二列出了每个回答类别的频数。

frequency.en: The high frequency of the pattern suggests a systematic effect.
frequency.zh: 该模式出现频率很高，提示存在系统性影响。

exposure.en: Exposure to the pollutant was measured across three residential areas.
exposure.zh: 在三个居民区都测量了对该污染物的暴露水平。

exposure.en: Long-term exposure to fine particles is linked to respiratory illness.
exposure.zh: 长期暴露于细颗粒物与呼吸系统疾病有关。

exposure.en: The study adjusted for exposure to prior antiviral treatment.
exposure.zh: 研究对先前接受过抗病毒治疗的情况进行了校正。

risk.en: Participants at risk of dropout were contacted weekly by telephone.
risk.zh: 有脱落风险的参与者每周都会收到电话联系。

risk.en: The risk of bias was assessed with a validated instrument.
risk.zh: 采用经过验证的工具对偏倚风险进行了评估。

risk.en: No increase in risk was observed after the intervention ended.
risk.zh: 干预结束后未观察到风险上升。

determinant.en: Access to funding was a major determinant of participation.
determinant.zh: 能否获得经费是参与程度的一个主要决定因素。

determinant.en: The analysis identifies sleep duration as a key determinant of performance.
determinant.zh: 该分析把睡眠时长识别为表现的一个关键决定因素。

determinant.en: Study design is an important determinant of the generalizability of findings.
determinant.zh: 研究设计是结果能否推广的一个重要决定因素。

mediator.en: The mediator accounted for half of the observed treatment effect.
mediator.zh: 该中介变量解释了所观察到的治疗效应的一半。

mediator.en: We tested whether motivation could act as a mediator between training and outcome.
mediator.zh: 我们检验了动机能否在训练与结果之间充当中介变量。

mediator.en: Mediation analysis indicated that self-efficacy was a significant mediator.
mediator.zh: 中介效应分析表明，自我效能是一个显著的中介变量。

moderator.en: Age was tested as a moderator of the relationship between stress and sleep.
moderator.zh: 年龄被检验为压力与睡眠关系的调节变量。

moderator.en: The moderator analysis revealed no significant interaction between the two factors.
moderator.zh: 调节效应分析显示两个因子之间没有显著交互作用。

moderator.en: Baseline severity served as a moderator of treatment response.
moderator.zh: 基线严重程度充当了治疗反应的调节变量。

replicability.en: The replicability of these findings across three laboratories was confirmed.
replicability.zh: 这些发现在三个实验室之间的可复现性得到了确认。

replicability.en: We provide the code and data needed to assess replicability.
replicability.zh: 我们提供了评估可复现性所需的代码与数据。

replicability.en: Concerns about replicability have reshaped how results are reported.
replicability.zh: 对可复现性的关注改变了结果报告的方式。

generalizability.en: The generalizability of the results is limited by the narrow sample.
generalizability.zh: 样本范围狭窄限制了结果的可推广性。

generalizability.en: A multi-site design was chosen to improve generalizability.
generalizability.zh: 研究采用多中心设计以提高可推广性。

generalizability.en: Reviewers questioned the generalizability of the conclusions.
generalizability.zh: 审稿人质疑了这些结论的可推广性。

response.en: The response rate in the second wave was sixty-eight percent.
Each response was coded into one of four categories.
response.zh: 每份回答都被归入四个类别之一。

response.en: We examined whether response length predicted a correct answer.
response.zh: 我们考察了回答长度能否预测作答是否正确。

follow-up.en: A follow-up survey was conducted six months after discharge.
follow-up.zh: 在出院六个月后进行了一次随访调查。

follow-up.en: The follow-up revealed a sustained improvement in symptom severity.
follow-up.zh: 随访显示症状严重程度持续改善。

follow-up.en: Long-term follow-up is required before drawing firm conclusions.
follow-up.zh: 在得出确切结论之前，需要进行长期随访。

meta-analysis.en: A meta-analysis of twelve trials confirmed the treatment effect.
meta-analysis.zh: 一项纳入 12 项试验的元分析证实了治疗效应。

meta-analysis.en: The meta-analysis pooled results from studies with similar endpoints.
meta-analysis.zh: 该元分析合并了终点指标相近的研究结果。

meta-analysis.en: Our meta-analysis reports substantial heterogeneity across the included trials.
meta-analysis.zh: 我们的元分析报告了纳入试验间存在较大的异质性。

disaggregate.en: Analysts should disaggregate the results by relevant subgroups.
disaggregate.zh: 分析者应当按相关子群分解结果。

disaggregate.en: It is essential to disaggregate aggregated statistics when reporting them.
disaggregate.zh: 报告汇总统计量时，分解这些数据是必要的。

disaggregate.en: The authors disaggregate the combined totals into four age bands.
disaggregate.zh: 作者把合并后的总数拆分为四个年龄组。

multicollinearity.en: Multicollinearity inflated the standard errors of both coefficients.
multicollinearity.zh: 多重共线性使两个系数的标准误被放大。

multicollinearity.en: We checked for multicollinearity by examining the correlation matrix.
multicollinearity.zh: 我们通过检查相关矩阵来检验多重共线性。

multicollinearity.en: Severe multicollinearity made the individual predictors hard to interpret.
multicollinearity.zh: 严重的多重共线性使各个预测变量难以解释。

efficiency.en: The efficiency of the algorithm improves with larger training sets.
efficiency.zh: 该算法的效率随训练集增大而提升。

efficiency.en: We compared the efficiency of two competing statistical approaches.
efficiency.zh: 我们比较了两种相互竞争的统计方法的效率。

efficiency.en: Operational efficiency declined slightly during the peak season.
efficiency.zh: 运营效率在旺季略有下降。

deductive.en: Deductive reasoning moves from general principles to specific conclusions.
deductive.zh: 演绎推理从一般原理出发走向具体结论。

deductive.en: The study combines deductive hypothesis testing with inductive exploration.
deductive.zh: 该研究把演绎式假设检验与归纳式探索结合起来。

deductive.en: His deductive argument identifies a flaw in the second premise.
deductive.zh: 他的演绎论证指出了第二个前提中的缺陷。

inductive.en: Inductive reasoning builds general patterns from specific observations.
inductive.zh: 归纳推理从具体观察出发建立一般模式。

inductive.en: The authors adopt an inductive approach to theory development.
inductive.zh: 作者在理论建构上采用了归纳式路径。

inductive.en: Inductive coding categories were refined during the pilot study.
inductive.zh: 归纳式编码类别在试点研究过程中得到了细化。

contribution.en: The contribution of this study to the field is its longitudinal design.
contribution.zh: 这项研究对该领域的贡献在于其纵向设计。

contribution.en: Each author's contribution to the final manuscript is listed in the appendix.
contribution.zh: 每位作者对最终稿的贡献都列在附录中。

contribution.en: The contribution of funding agencies must be acknowledged in every paper.
contribution.zh: 资助机构的贡献必须在每篇论文中致谢说明。

operationalization.en: The operationalization of quality differed across the participating laboratories.
operationalization.zh: 各参与实验室对质量的操作化方式并不相同。

operationalization.en: Without a clear operationalization, the concept cannot be measured reliably.
operationalization.zh: 没有清晰的操作化，这一概念就无法被可靠测量。

operationalization.en: The operationalization of the construct required three validated indicators.
operationalization.zh: 该概念的操作化需要三个经过验证的指标。

confounder.en: Age was treated as a potential confounder in the regression models.
confounder.zh: 年龄在回归模型中被作为潜在混杂变量处理。

confounder.en: Randomization alone does not remove every confounder, even in a well-conducted trial.
confounder.zh: 即便在开展规范的试验中，仅靠随机化也不能排除所有混杂变量。

confounder.en: The authors discuss how each confounder was identified and controlled.
confounder.zh: 作者讨论了每个混杂变量是如何被识别与控制的。

falsify.en: A single contradictory result cannot falsify the entire theory.
falsify.zh: 一个矛盾的结果不足以证伪整个理论。

falsify.en: We designed the analysis to falsify our own initial hypothesis.
falsify.zh: 我们把分析设计成能够证伪自己最初的假设。

falsify.en: Popper argued that science advances by attempting to falsify accepted claims.
falsify.zh: 波普尔主张科学通过尝试证伪已被接受的论断而进步。

mediation.en: Mediation analysis revealed that sleep quality accounted for most of the effect.
mediation.zh: 中介效应分析显示，睡眠质量解释了大部分效应。

mediation.en: The mediation effect of self-efficacy was significant in the structural model.
mediation.zh: 在结构模型中，自我效能的中介效应显著。

mediation.en: We tested the mediation pathway linking stress, support, and sleep quality.
mediation.zh: 我们检验了连接压力、支持与睡眠质量的中介路径。

moderation.en: Moderation analysis showed that gender altered the strength of the effect.
moderation.zh: 调节效应分析显示性别改变了效应的强度。

moderation.en: The moderation of the intervention effect by baseline severity was small.
moderation.zh: 基线严重程度对干预效应的调节作用很小。

moderation.en: A moderation test was prespecified to avoid selective reporting.
moderation.zh: 研究预先设定了一个调节效应检验，以避免选择性报告。

endogeneity.en: Instrumental variables were used to address endogeneity in the estimates.
endogeneity.zh: 研究使用工具变量来处理估计中的内生性问题。

endogeneity.en: Concerns about endogeneity led us to re-estimate the model with fixed effects.
endogeneity.zh: 对内生性的担忧促使我们用固定效应重新估计了模型。

endogeneity.en: The severity of endogeneity determines the degree of bias in the estimates.
endogeneity.zh: 内生性的严重程度决定了估计值的偏差程度。

propensity.en: Each participant received a propensity score from the fitted model.
propensity.zh: 每位参与者都从拟合模型中得到一个倾向得分。

propensity.en: Propensity score matching balanced the observed characteristics of the two groups.
propensity.zh: 倾向得分匹配使两组的可观测特征达到平衡。

propensity.en: The propensity to participate was higher among younger respondents.
propensity.zh: 年轻受访者参与的倾向更高。

placebo.en: All participants received an identical placebo during the control phase.
placebo.zh: 在对照阶段，所有参与者都服用了成分相同的安慰剂。

placebo.en: The placebo effect cannot explain the difference between the two conditions.
placebo.zh: 安慰剂效应无法解释两种条件之间的差异。

placebo.en: Participants who guessed they were receiving the active treatment reported more side effects than those confident they had taken the placebo.
placebo.zh: 猜到自己正接受活性治疗的参与者，比确信自己服下安慰剂的参与者报告了更多副作用。

blinding.en: Single blinding was applied so that participants could not identify their group.
blinding.zh: 研究采用单盲法，使参与者无法辨认自己所在的组。

blinding.en: The blinding of outcome assessors reduced the risk of observer bias.
blinding.zh: 对结局评估者实施盲法降低了观察者偏倚的风险。

blinding.en: Breaking the blinding revealed that allocation had not been fully concealed.
blinding.zh: 揭盲显示随机分配并未被完全隐藏。

allocation.en: Random allocation concealed the treatment assignment from all participants.
allocation.zh: 随机分配向所有参与者隐藏了治疗分组。

allocation.en: The allocation of resources across departments followed a transparent formula.
allocation.zh: 各部门之间的资源配置遵循一套透明的公式。

allocation.en: Allocation concealment is essential in any properly randomized trial.
allocation.zh: 分配隐藏是任何规范随机试验的必备环节。

case-control.en: The case-control design efficiently examined rare outcomes in the population.
case-control.zh: 病例对照设计高效地考察了人群中的罕见结局。

case-control.en: In this case-control study, controls were matched on age and site.
case-control.zh: 在这项病例对照研究中，对照组按年龄与研究中心进行了匹配。

case-control.en: A case-control comparison identified exposure differences between the two groups.
case-control.zh: 病例对照比较识别出了两组之间的暴露差异。

effect size.en: The effect size was small but statistically significant in the primary analysis.
effect size.zh: 在主要分析中，效应量虽小但具有统计显著性。

effect size.en: We report the effect size alongside the confidence interval for every outcome.
effect size.zh: 我们为每个结局同时报告效应量与置信区间。

effect size.en: Reporting the effect size prevents small findings from appearing more important than they are.
effect size.zh: 报告效应量可以避免让微小的发现显得过于重要。

mixed-method.en: The mixed-method design combined survey data with in-depth interviews.
mixed-method.zh: 该混合方法设计把问卷数据与深度访谈结合起来。

mixed-method.en: Findings from both strands of the mixed-method study converged on the same conclusion.
mixed-method.zh: 这项混合方法研究的两个部分都得出了相同的结论。

mixed-method.en: A mixed-method approach captures both the scale and the experience of the phenomenon.
mixed-method.zh: 混合方法路径同时捕捉到该现象的规模与体验。

cluster.en: Cluster analysis identified four distinct groups within the survey responses.
cluster.zh: 聚类分析在问卷回答中识别出四个不同的群体。

cluster.en: Participants were assigned to a cluster by their clinic site of enrollment.
cluster.zh: 参与者按入组所在的诊所站点被分配到各个群组。

cluster.en: Standard errors were adjusted for correlation within each cluster.
cluster.zh: 标准误已针对每个群组内部的相关性进行了校正。

panel.en: The expert panel reviewed the draft and recommended substantial revisions.
panel.zh: 专家组审阅了草稿并建议进行大幅修改。

panel.en: Panel data tracking the same firms over ten years were analyzed.
panel.zh: 研究分析了追踪同一批企业 10 年的面板数据。

panel.en: Members of the review panel worked independently before meeting to reach consensus.
panel.zh: 评审组的成员先独立工作，然后开会达成共识。

pooled.en: The pooled estimate combined data from nine independent clinical trials.
pooled.zh: 合并估计值综合了九项独立临床试验的数据。

pooled.en: Pooled results confirmed the direction of the effect observed at each site.
pooled.zh: 合并结果证实了各研究中心所观察到的效应方向。

pooled.en: We present the pooled analysis alongside the individual study estimates.
pooled.zh: 我们同时呈现合并分析与各单项研究的估计值。

prospective.en: The prospective cohort followed participants for eight years after enrollment.
prospective.zh: 这个前瞻性队列在入组后随访了参与者八年。

prospective.en: A prospective design avoids the biases that plague retrospective records.
prospective.zh: 前瞻性设计避免了困扰回顾性记录的那些偏倚。

prospective.en: Prospective data were collected before any outcome was observed.
prospective.zh: 前瞻性数据在任何结局被观察到之前就已采集。

pragmatic.en: A pragmatic trial measures outcomes that matter to routine practice.
pragmatic.zh: 务实型试验测量的是对日常实践真正重要的结局。

pragmatic.en: The authors defend a pragmatic approach to evaluating complex interventions.
pragmatic.zh: 作者主张以务实的路径评估复杂干预措施。

pragmatic.en: Pragmatic decisions were made as new evidence arrived during the project.
pragmatic.zh: 项目推进中每有新的证据出现，就会作出务实的决策。

reflexivity.en: The paper reflects on researcher reflexivity and its effect on the analysis.
reflexivity.zh: 论文反思了研究者的自反性及其对分析的影响。

reflexivity.en: Reflexivity is central to qualitative research because the researcher shapes the data.
reflexivity.zh: 由于研究者本身塑造了资料，自反性在定性研究中居于核心地位。

reflexivity.en: Journals can foster reflexivity when researchers record how their choices shape the data.
reflexivity.zh: 当研究者记录自己的选择如何塑造数据时，日志能培养自反性。

positionality.en: The researcher's positionality shaped which questions were asked in interviews.
positionality.zh: 研究者的位置性影响了访谈中提出哪些问题。

positionality.en: Stating positionality helps readers evaluate the claims of the analysis.
positionality.zh: 说明自身的位置性有助于读者评判分析的论断。

positionality.en: The discussion treats positionality as a resource rather than a limitation.
positionality.zh: 讨论把位置性视为一种资源而非局限。

critique.en: The panel published a critique of the study's sampling design.
critique.zh: 评审组发表了对该研究抽样设计的批评。

critique.en: Her critique of the framework reshaped how the team defined the problem.
critique.zh: 她对该框架的批评重塑了团队对问题的定义。

critique.en: The article offers a critique of quantitative indicators in policy evaluation.
critique.zh: 该文章对政策评估中的定量指标提出了批评。

normative.en: The paper draws a normative conclusion about how research should be funded.
normative.zh: 该文就研究应如何获得资助提出了规范性结论。

normative.en: Distinguishing descriptive from normative claims clarifies the argument considerably.
normative.zh: 区分描述性论断与规范性论断能大大厘清论证。

normative.en: The normative framework sets out the values that the policy should respect.
normative.zh: 该规范框架阐明了政策应当尊重的价值观。

interpretive.en: The interpretive approach treats the text as a situated social practice.
interpretive.zh: 解释性路径把文本视为一种处于具体语境中的社会实践。

interpretive.en: Interpretive analysis requires careful attention to the context of each quotation.
interpretive.zh: 诠释分析要求对每段引文的语境给予细致关注。

interpretive.en: The interpretive stance shapes which meanings the researcher foregrounds.
interpretive.zh: 解释性立场会影响研究者凸显哪些意义。

adoption.en: The adoption of the new protocol varied widely across participating sites.
adoption.zh: 新方案在各参与点的采纳情况差异很大。

adoption.en: Adoption of the guideline was highest where local champions provided training.
adoption.zh: 在有本地骨干提供培训的地方，指南的采纳率最高。

adoption.en: Rapid adoption depends on cost, training, and compatibility with existing routine.
adoption.zh: 快速采纳取决于成本、培训以及与现有流程的兼容性。

uptake.en: The uptake of the intervention was highest among younger clinicians.
uptake.zh: 这项干预在年轻临床医生中的接受度最高。

uptake.en: Low uptake limited the impact of the program despite a modest cost.
uptake.zh: 尽管成本不高，较低的接受度仍限制了项目效果。

uptake.en: We measured uptake by counting the clinics that registered for the scheme.
uptake.zh: 我们通过统计登记参加该方案的诊所数量来衡量接受度。

adherence.en: Adherence to the protocol was monitored through weekly diary reviews.
adherence.zh: 对研究方案的依从性通过每周的日记复核来监测。

adherence.en: Poor adherence reduces the effective dose and dilutes the treatment effect.
adherence.zh: 依从性差会降低有效剂量并削弱治疗效应。

adherence.en: Participants who received reminders showed markedly better adherence over time.
adherence.zh: 收到提醒的参与者，其依从性随时间推移明显改善。

dissemination.en: Dissemination of the findings included workshops, articles, and open repositories.
dissemination.zh: 研究结果的传播包括研讨会、论文和开放知识库。

dissemination.en: A dissemination plan should name the audiences and the channels in advance.
dissemination.zh: 传播计划应事先明确目标受众与传播渠道。

dissemination.en: The team funded additional dissemination to reach practitioners in other regions.
dissemination.zh: 团队为把成果传播到其他地区的从业者提供了额外经费。

scalability.en: The scalability of the intervention was tested in three additional regions.
scalability.zh: 该干预措施的可扩展性在另外三个地区进行了检验。

scalability.en: Scalability depends on whether local staff can deliver it without specialist support.
scalability.zh: 可扩展性取决于当地人员能否在没有专家支持的情况下实施。

scalability.en: The pilot was designed to demonstrate the scalability of the approach.
scalability.zh: 这项试点旨在证明该路径的可规模化程度。

equity.en: The intervention improved health equity across income groups in the region.
equity.zh: 该干预改善了当地不同收入群体之间的健康公平。

equity.en: Equity was assessed by comparing outcomes for the most and least advantaged.
equity.zh: 公平性通过比较最有利与最不利人群的结局来评估。

equity.en: Cost barriers remain the greatest threat to equity in access to care.
equity.zh: 在医疗服务可及性方面，费用门槛仍是对公平的最大威胁。

bottleneck.en: Data entry remains the main bottleneck in the analysis pipeline.
bottleneck.zh: 数据录入仍是分析流程中的主要瓶颈。

bottleneck.en: The committee identified recruitment as the principal bottleneck for the study.
bottleneck.zh: 委员会认定招募是这项研究的主要制约环节。

bottleneck.en: Removing that bottleneck cut the total processing time nearly in half.
bottleneck.zh: 移除该瓶颈使总处理时间几乎减半。

alignment.en: Strategic alignment between the ministry and the universities improved the outcome.
alignment.zh: 部委与高校之间的战略协同改善了结果。

alignment.en: The alignment of the curriculum with national standards took two years.
alignment.zh: 课程与国家标准的一致化花了两年时间。

alignment.en: The study shows the alignment between stated goals and actual practice was weak.
alignment.zh: 研究显示既定目标与实际做法之间的一致性很弱。

overlap.en: The overlap between the two samples was estimated before pooling the data.
overlap.zh: 在合并数据之前，研究估计了两个样本的重叠程度。

overlap.en: There is substantial overlap in the topics covered by both reviews.
overlap.zh: 两篇综述所涵盖的主题存在大量重叠。

overlap.en: The two curricula overlap considerably, which creates unnecessary duplication.
overlap.zh: 两套课程内容重叠严重，造成了不必要的重复。

milestone.en: The first major milestone was the completion of the pilot study.
milestone.zh: 第一个重要里程碑是完成试点研究。

milestone.en: Each milestone was reviewed against the criteria agreed with the funder.
milestone.zh: 每个里程碑都依据与资助方商定的标准进行审查。

milestone.en: Passing this milestone secures the next three years of funding.
milestone.zh: 通过这个里程碑就能锁定未来三年的资助。

blueprint.en: The report offers a blueprint for reforming graduate research training.
blueprint.zh: 该报告为改革研究生科研训练提供了一份蓝本。

blueprint.en: This blueprint for policy design has been adopted by several agencies.
blueprint.zh: 这份政策设计蓝本已被多个机构采纳。

blueprint.en: The working group produced a blueprint that other departments can adapt.
blueprint.zh: 工作组产出了一份其他部门可以借鉴调整的范本。

tipping point.en: The ecosystem reached a tipping point during the unusually warm summer.
tipping point.zh: 在异常温暖的夏季，该生态系统到达了临界点。

tipping point.en: The data suggest the system has passed a tipping point for recovery.
tipping point.zh: 数据显示该系统已越过恢复的临界点。

tipping point.en: Identifying a tipping point early allows managers to intervene before collapse.
tipping point.zh: 及早识别临界点可以让管理者在崩塌前进行干预。

explicate.en: The authors explicate the mechanism that links job insecurity to lower well-being.
explicate.zh: 作者阐明了工作不安全感与幸福感下降之间的作用机制。

explicate.en: Several concepts in the draft need to be explicated before the review panel meets.
explicate.zh: 评审组开会前，草稿中的几个概念需要进一步阐明。

explicate.en: Her lecture explicated why the two constructs are often confused in the literature.
explicate.zh: 她的讲座解释了为什么文献中常把这两个构念混为一谈。

enumerate.en: The study enumerates five distinct barriers to the uptake of remote learning.
enumerate.zh: 该研究列举了远程学习推广所面临的五项不同障碍。

enumerate.en: Reviewers are asked to enumerate the methodological limitations of each design.
enumerate.zh: 评审人被要求逐一列出每种研究设计的方法学局限。

enumerate.en: The appendix enumerates all cases that were excluded after data cleaning.
enumerate.zh: 附录逐一列出了数据清理后被排除的全部案例。

discern.en: It is difficult to discern a genuine effect from sampling noise in a single study.
discern.zh: 在单项研究中很难从抽样噪声中分辨出真正的效应。

discern.en: From the interview transcripts we discern a clear shift in participants' language.
discern.zh: 从访谈记录中，我们分辨出参与者用语的明显转变。

discern.en: The pattern is visible in the raw data but hard to discern in the aggregated figures.
discern.zh: 这一模式在原始数据中可见，但在汇总数据中难以分辨。

elicit.en: Follow-up interviews were used to elicit explanations for the inconsistent results.
elicit.zh: 研究者利用后续访谈来引出对不一致结果的解释。

elicit.en: Careful wording is needed to elicit honest answers about sensitive topics.
elicit.zh: 在敏感话题上需要谨慎的措辞才能引出诚实的回答。

elicit.en: The survey design was revised to elicit responses from non-native speakers.
elicit.zh: 调查设计经过修订，以引出非母语者的回答。

illuminate.en: These data illuminate the conditions under which the intervention actually works.
illuminate.zh: 这些数据阐明了该干预真正发挥作用的条件。

illuminate.en: A single well-designed case can illuminate a pattern that surveys tend to obscure.
illuminate.zh: 一个精心设计的案例就能阐明调查往往掩盖的模式。

illuminate.en: The discussion illuminates how theory and practice diverge in everyday settings.
illuminate.zh: 讨论阐明了理论与实践在日常情境中如何产生偏离。

preclude.en: The small sample size precludes any firm conclusion about the population.
preclude.zh: 样本量过小使人无法对总体情况得出确定结论。

preclude.en: Its wording precludes the possibility of a neutral reading of the contract.
preclude.zh: 这一措辞排除了对合同作中立解读的可能。

preclude.en: Funding rules preclude the two teams from sharing raw participant data.
preclude.zh: 资助规定不允许两个团队共享参与者的原始数据。

surmount.en: The intervention was redesigned so that participants could surmount the technical barriers.
surmount.zh: 该干预经过重新设计，使参与者能够克服技术障碍。

surmount.en: Small grants often help early-career researchers surmount the barrier of data access costs.
surmount.zh: 小额资助常常帮助职业早期研究者克服获取数据的费用障碍。

surmount.en: The chapter explains how local institutions surmounted political resistance to reform.
surmount.zh: 该章解释了地方机构如何克服了对改革的政治阻力。

undertake.en: The team agrees to undertake a systematic review of forty years of published evidence.
undertake.zh: 该团队同意对 40 年间已发表的证据开展一项系统综述。

undertake.en: Participants undertake a short battery of cognitive tasks each morning.
undertake.zh: 参与者每天早晨完成一组简短的认知任务。

undertake.en: Any researcher undertaking this protocol must complete the ethics training first.
undertake.zh: 任何开展该研究方案的研究者都必须先完成伦理培训。

necessitate.en: The scale of the problem necessitates a coordinated response across departments.
necessitate.zh: 问题的规模使各部门协同应对成为必要。

necessitate.en: Such claims would necessitate far more evidence than the study provides.
necessitate.zh: 这样的主张所需的证据远超本研究所提供的范围。

necessitate.en: Growing demand has necessitated a revision of the eligibility criteria.
necessitate.zh: 需求增长使资格标准不得不作出修订。

alleviate.en: Targeted subsidies can alleviate the financial burden on low-income households.
alleviate.zh: 有针对性的补贴可以减轻低收入家庭的经济负担。

alleviate.en: The guidance was revised to alleviate confusion among first-time applicants.
alleviate.zh: 指南经过修订，以减轻初次申请者的困惑。

alleviate.en: Short breaks during long interviews helped alleviate fatigue among participants.
alleviate.zh: 长时间访谈中的短暂休息有助于缓解参与者的疲劳。

deviate.en: These results deviate sharply from what the mainstream model predicts.
deviate.zh: 这些结果与主流模型的预测存在明显偏离。

deviate.en: Where the coding scheme deviates from the original protocol, we note the change explicitly.
deviate.zh: 凡编码方案偏离原研究方案之处，我们都明确标注。

deviate.en: Schools that deviate from the national curriculum still have to meet minimum standards.
deviate.zh: 偏离国家课程的学校仍须达到最低标准。

consolidate.en: A larger replication would consolidate the evidence for this effect.
consolidate.zh: 更大规模的复现研究将巩固这一效应的证据基础。
