consolidate.en: The two-year program consolidates scattered local initiatives into a single framework.
consolidate.zh: 这个为期两年的项目把分散的地方举措整合到一个统一框架之中。

consolidate.en: The final chapter consolidates the findings of the four empirical chapters.
consolidate.zh: 最后一章整合了四个实证章节的发现。

conceptualization.en: The conceptualization of resilience differs sharply across the four case studies.
conceptualization.zh: 对韧性的概念化在四个案例研究中差异显著。

conceptualization.en: A clearer conceptualization is needed before the scale can be validated.
conceptualization.zh: 在量表得到验证之前，需要更清晰的概念化。

conceptualization.en: Her conceptualization of trust draws on both economics and sociology.
conceptualization.zh: 她对信任的概念化同时借鉴了经济学与社会学。

quantification.en: The quantification of uncertainty remains the weakest part of the analysis.
quantification.zh: 对不确定性的量化仍然是该分析中最薄弱的部分。

quantification.en: Careful quantification of the costs is essential for a credible policy recommendation.
quantification.zh: 对成本进行审慎量化，是提出可信政策建议的前提。

quantification.en: The paper offers a defensible method of quantification for qualitative data.
quantification.zh: 本文提出了一种对定性数据进行量化的可靠方法。

preregistration.en: Preregistration of hypotheses helps to separate genuine findings from noise.
preregistration.zh: 对假设进行预注册有助于把真正的发现与噪声区分开来。

preregistration.en: Since 2020 the journal has required preregistration for all confirmatory studies.
preregistration.zh: 自 2020 年起，该期刊要求所有验证性研究都必须进行预注册。

preregistration.en: The authors posted their preregistration before collecting any data.
preregistration.zh: 作者在收集任何数据之前就公布了他们的预注册方案。

disclosure.en: Full disclosure of conflicts of interest is required by the journal.
disclosure.zh: 期刊要求充分披露利益冲突。

disclosure.en: The disclosure of raw data allows other teams to check the arithmetic.
disclosure.zh: 原始数据的公开让其他团队得以核查计算过程。

disclosure.en: Non-disclosure of adverse events remains a serious methodological problem.
disclosure.zh: 不披露不良事件仍是一个严重的方法学问题。

confidentiality.en: The confidentiality of participant data is protected by an anonymous coding scheme.
confidentiality.zh: 参与者数据的保密性由匿名编码方案加以保护。

confidentiality.en: Breaches of confidentiality are reported to the ethics board within 48 hours.
confidentiality.zh: 违反保密规定的情况须在 48 小时内报告伦理委员会。

confidentiality.en: Reviewers must sign a confidentiality agreement before reading the draft manuscript.
confidentiality.zh: 评审人在阅读草稿手稿前必须签署保密协议。

plagiarism.en: The journal screens every submission with dedicated plagiarism detection software.
plagiarism.zh: 该期刊用专门的查重软件筛查每一篇投稿。

plagiarism.en: Careful citation is the surest defense against accidental plagiarism.
plagiarism.zh: 谨慎引用是防止无意识抄袭最可靠的保障。

plagiarism.en: Instances of plagiarism lead to retraction of the affected article.
plagiarism.zh: 抄袭行为会导致相关论文被撤稿。

register.en: The register of the paper shifts noticeably between the introduction and the conclusion.
register.zh: 该论文的语域在引言与结论之间发生了明显变化。

register.en: Students learn to adjust their register when writing for a specialist audience.
register.zh: 学生学习在面向专业读者写作时调整自己的语域。

register.en: A formal register is expected in the methods section of the report.
register.zh: 报告的方法部分要求使用正式的语体。

genre.en: Each academic genre imposes its own conventions on length and structure.
genre.zh: 每一种学术体裁对篇幅与结构都有各自的惯例要求。

genre.en: The article borrows conventions from the research proposal genre.
genre.zh: 这篇文章借用了研究计划书这一体裁的惯例。

genre.en: Genre differences partly explain why the two reviews differ in emphasis.
genre.zh: 体裁差异在一定程度上解释了两篇综述在侧重点上的不同。

counterargument.en: The authors address the most plausible counterargument in their final section.
counterargument.zh: 作者在最后一节回应了最有可能成立的反驳意见。

counterargument.en: A strong counterargument can strengthen a paper rather than weaken it.
counterargument.zh: 有力的反驳意见反而能让论文更扎实。

counterargument.en: Any serious proposal must anticipate the standard counterargument about cost.
counterargument.zh: 任何严肃的方案都必须预见到关于成本的标准反驳。

cohesion.en: Clear signposting improves cohesion in long argumentative texts.
cohesion.zh: 清晰的篇章过渡提示能提升长篇论证文本的连贯性。

cohesion.en: The report suffers from weak cohesion between the literature review and the methods.
cohesion.zh: 该报告在文献综述与方法部分之间连贯性薄弱。

cohesion.en: Cohesion depends on the reader's ability to infer the underlying argument.
cohesion.zh: 连贯性取决于读者推断隐含论点的能力。

wording.en: The wording of the consent form was revised to be more accessible.
wording.zh: 知情同意书的措辞经过修订，变得更易理解。

wording.en: A few changes in wording can shift the tone of the whole argument.
wording.zh: 措辞上的少许改动就能改变整个论点的语气。

wording.en: Reviewers should comment on the wording, not only on the substance of the text.
wording.zh: 评审人应当对措辞提出意见，而不仅仅针对文本内容。

triangulation.en: Methodological triangulation was used to check the reliability of the findings.
triangulation.zh: 研究者采用方法学三角互证来检验结果的可靠性。

triangulation.en: Triangulation of interviews and diaries reduces the risk of a single-source bias.
triangulation.zh: 访谈与日记的三角互证降低了单一来源偏差的风险。

triangulation.en: The chapter discusses when triangulation strengthens a qualitative design.
triangulation.zh: 该章讨论了三角互证在何种情况下能增强定性研究设计。

conceptual.en: The conceptual framework links resource-based and dynamic capabilities.
conceptual.zh: 该概念框架把资源基础观与动态能力观联系起来。

conceptual.en: A purely conceptual contribution still requires empirical support in this field.
conceptual.zh: 在本领域，纯粹的概念性贡献仍需要经验证据支持。

conceptual.en: The paper moves from a conceptual model to a set of testable propositions.
conceptual.zh: 该论文从概念模型推进到一组可检验的命题。

multidisciplinary.en: The team is deliberately multidisciplinary, combining economics, sociology and statistics.
multidisciplinary.zh: 该团队刻意采用多学科构成，融合了经济学、社会学与统计学。

multidisciplinary.en: Multidisciplinary collaboration raises the cost but also the impact of the work.
multidisciplinary.zh: 多学科合作提高了成本，但也提升了研究的影响力。

multidisciplinary.en: A multidisciplinary clinic was established to treat the condition holistically.
multidisciplinary.zh: 一家多学科诊所成立，以整体方式治疗该病症。

thematic.en: A thematic analysis of the interviews identified three recurring concerns.
thematic.zh: 对访谈的主题分析识别出三个反复出现的关注点。

thematic.en: The thematic structure of the corpus changed after the second wave of data collection.
thematic.zh: 第二轮数据收集之后，语料库的主题结构发生了变化。

thematic.en: Thematic coding was done by two researchers independently.
thematic.zh: 主题编码由两名研究者独立完成。

rhetorical.en: The rhetorical strategy of the article is to concede the weakest objection early.
rhetorical.zh: 该文的修辞策略是尽早承认最薄弱的反对意见。

rhetorical.en: Rhetorical choices such as repetition shape how readers remember an argument.
rhetorical.zh: 重复等修辞选择会影响读者如何记住一段论证。

rhetorical.en: The review distinguishes between a rhetorical claim and an empirical one.
rhetorical.zh: 该综述区分了修辞性主张与经验性主张。

exploratory.en: An exploratory study identified which factors are worth testing in a larger sample.
exploratory.zh: 一项探索性研究确定了哪些因素值得在更大样本中检验。

exploratory.en: Because the design is exploratory, no confirmatory claims are made.
exploratory.zh: 由于该设计属于探索性质，研究未提出任何验证性主张。

exploratory.en: Exploratory interviews helped refine the wording of the main survey.
exploratory.zh: 探索性访谈帮助细化了主问卷的措辞。

influential.en: Peer review remains the most influential check on the quality of published work.
influential.zh: 同行评审仍是对已发表研究质量最具影响力的把关机制。

influential.en: The most influential factor was the time available to the participants.
influential.zh: 最具影响力的因素是参与者可支配的时间。

influential.en: This paper has been influential in the design of later surveys.
influential.zh: 该论文对后续调查的设计产生了深远影响。

require.en: Addressing climate adaptation will require sustained investment across multiple sectors.
require.zh: 应对气候适应需要在多个部门进行持续投资。

require.en: The committee requires that all manuscripts be submitted in English.
require.zh: 委员会要求所有稿件以英文提交。

require.en: These findings require careful interpretation before any policy conclusions are drawn.
require.zh: 在得出任何政策结论之前，这些发现需要谨慎解读。

confirm.en: A second experiment confirmed the pattern observed in the pilot study.
confirm.zh: 第二次实验证实了试点研究中观察到的模式。

confirm.en: The interview data confirm that teachers interpret the policy in markedly different ways.
confirm.zh: 访谈数据证实，教师们对该政策的解读存在显著差异。

confirm.en: Replication by an independent laboratory confirmed the original result.
confirm.zh: 一个独立实验室的复现实验证实了最初的结果。

assert.en: The author asserts that institutional culture shapes research practice more than funding does.
assert.zh: 作者断言，机构文化对研究实践的影响超过经费。

assert.en: Critics have asserted that the model rests on an oversimplified view of migration.
assert.zh: 批评者断言，该模型建立在对移民的过度简化理解之上。

assert.en: Participants frequently asserted their right to withdraw from the study at any stage.
assert.zh: 参与者经常主张他们有权在任何阶段退出研究。

emphasize.en: The report emphasizes the need for longitudinal designs in future research.
emphasize.zh: 该报告强调未来研究需要采用纵向设计。

emphasize.en: Several contributors emphasize the role of local context in shaping outcomes.
emphasize.zh: 多位撰稿人强调地方环境在塑造结果中的作用。

emphasize.en: It is worth emphasizing that the sample was drawn from a single institution.
emphasize.zh: 值得强调的是，样本取自单一机构。

underlie.en: The assumptions that underlie the model are examined in Section 3.
underlie.zh: 构成该模型基础的假设在第 3 节中检验。

underlie.en: Economic factors underlie much of the variation in school attainment.
underlie.zh: 经济因素是学业成绩差异的主要根源。

underlie.en: A shared methodological commitment seems to underlie both studies.
underlie.zh: 两项研究似乎都以共同的方法论承诺为基础。

constrain.en: Small sample sizes constrain the generalizability of the findings.
constrain.zh: 样本量小限制了研究结论的普适性。

constrain.en: The analysis is constrained by the availability of archival records.
constrain.zh: 这项分析受限于档案史料的可获得性。

constrain.en: Regulatory frameworks constrain how firms can respond to market shocks.
constrain.zh: 监管框架限制了企业应对市场冲击的方式。

ground.en: The framework is grounded in sociocultural theories of learning.
ground.zh: 该框架以社会文化学习理论为依据。

ground.en: Interview questions were grounded in the pilot phase findings.
ground.zh: 访谈问题的设计立足于试点阶段的发现。

ground.en: Their critique remains grounded in the primary sources throughout.
ground.zh: 他们的批评始终立足于原始资料。

domain.en: The framework has since been applied in domains ranging from health to finance.
domain.zh: 该框架此后被应用于从卫生到金融等多个领域。

domain.en: Expertise in one domain does not automatically transfer to another.
domain.zh: 某一领域的专长并不会自动迁移到另一领域。

domain.en: The dataset covers three knowledge domains: biology, economics, and law.
domain.zh: 数据集覆盖生物、经济与法律三个知识领域。

shift.en: The data reveal a marked shift in public attitudes over the decade.
shift.zh: 数据显示 10 年间公众态度发生了显著转变。

shift.en: This finding represents a shift away from purely behaviorist explanations.
shift.zh: 这一发现标志着对纯行为主义解释的偏离。

shift.en: A paradigm shift occurred once the new evidence became widely accepted.
shift.zh: 新证据被广泛接受后，范式转变随之发生。

notion.en: The notion of resilience has been criticized for its conceptual vagueness.
notion.zh: 韧性这一概念因界定模糊而受到批评。

notion.en: This chapter unpacks the notion of scientific objectivity.
notion.zh: 本章剖析了科学客观性这一概念。

notion.en: The findings challenge the widely held notion that older workers resist technology.
notion.zh: 研究结果挑战了年长员工抗拒技术的普遍观念。

agenda.en: The workshop concluded by setting a research agenda for the next five years.
agenda.zh: 研讨会最后为未来五年确立了研究议程。

agenda.en: Funding priorities inevitably shape the agenda of academic research.
agenda.zh: 资助优先事项不可避免地塑造着学术研究的议程。

agenda.en: The paper explicitly situates itself within a critical agenda.
agenda.zh: 论文明确将自己置于批判性议程之中。

causality.en: The cross-sectional design precludes strong claims about causality.
causality.zh: 横断面设计使研究无法就因果关系做出有力论断。

causality.en: Establishing causality requires experimental or quasi-experimental evidence.
causality.zh: 确立因果关系需要实验或准实验证据。

causality.en: The authors are careful to distinguish correlation from causality.
causality.zh: 作者谨慎区分相关性与因果性。

mortality.en: Infant mortality declined sharply following the introduction of vaccination.
mortality.zh: 疫苗接种推行后，婴儿死亡率急剧下降。

mortality.en: The cohort study tracked mortality over a twenty-year period.
mortality.zh: 该队列研究追踪了 20 年间的死亡率。

mortality.en: Air pollution is associated with elevated cardiovascular mortality.
mortality.zh: 空气污染与心血管死亡率升高相关。

credibility.en: Triangulation of sources strengthened the credibility of the account.
credibility.zh: 多来源的三角互证增强了该叙述的可信度。

credibility.en: The credibility of the survey depends on transparent sampling procedures.
credibility.zh: 这项调查的可信度取决于透明的抽样程序。

credibility.en: Member checking was used to enhance the credibility of the interpretation.
credibility.zh: 研究采用成员核验来增强解读的可信度。

fieldwork.en: Six months of fieldwork yielded over forty hours of recorded conversation.
fieldwork.zh: 六个月的实地调查积累了四十多个小时的录音对话。

fieldwork.en: The fieldwork was conducted in three rural districts between 2019 and 2021.
fieldwork.zh: 田野工作于 2019 至 2021 年间在三个农村地区开展。

fieldwork.en: Ethical approval was obtained before fieldwork commenced.
fieldwork.zh: 实地调查开始前已获得伦理批准。

case study.en: The book presents a detailed case study of a single manufacturing firm.
case study.zh: 本书对一家制造企业做了详尽的个案研究。

case study.en: Each case study combines archival data with practitioner interviews.
case study.zh: 每个案例研究都结合了档案数据与从业者访谈。

case study.en: A comparative case study design was adopted across the four schools.
case study.zh: 四所学校采用了比较个案研究设计。

literature review.en: The literature review identifies three gaps in existing research.
literature review.zh: 文献综述指出了现有研究的三个空白。

literature review.en: A systematic literature review was conducted following PRISMA guidelines.
literature review.zh: 按照 PRISMA 指南进行了系统性文献综述。

literature review.en: The literature review covers studies published between 2000 and 2023.
literature review.zh: 文献综述涵盖 2000 至 2023 年间发表的研究。

grounded theory.en: Interview transcripts were analyzed using grounded theory procedures.
grounded theory.zh: 访谈记录采用扎根理论方法进行分析。

grounded theory.en: The category system emerged from the data through grounded theory coding.
grounded theory.zh: 类目体系是通过扎根理论编码从资料中归纳出来的。

grounded theory.en: Grounded theory was chosen because little is known about the phenomenon.
grounded theory.zh: 由于对该现象知之甚少，研究选择了扎根理论。

exhaustive.en: The bibliography is not exhaustive but covers the major contributions.
exhaustive.zh: 书目并不详尽无遗，但涵盖了主要成果。

exhaustive.en: An exhaustive search of three databases identified 214 eligible studies.
exhaustive.zh: 对三个数据库的详尽检索找到了 214 项符合条件的研究。

exhaustive.en: No exhaustive account of the archive's holdings yet exists.
exhaustive.zh: 对该馆藏品尚无完备的记载。

broad.en: In a broad sense, both policies aim to reduce regional inequality.
broad.zh: 广义上，两项政策都旨在缩小地区不平等。

broad.en: The survey covers a broad range of household expenditure categories.
broad.zh: 这项调查涵盖广泛的家庭支出类别。

broad.en: The term is used in its broadest sense to include informal care.
broad.zh: 该词在最宽泛的意义上使用，包括非正式照护。

verbatim.en: Quotes from interviews are reproduced verbatim, with minor grammatical edits.
verbatim.zh: 访谈引文逐字呈现，仅做了少量语法修饰。

verbatim.en: The coding scheme was applied to the verbatim transcripts.
verbatim.zh: 编码方案应用于逐字记录的转录稿。

verbatim.en: Participants' explanations were archived verbatim for audit purposes.
verbatim.zh: 参与者的解释被逐字存档以备审查。

in light of.en: In light of these findings, the theoretical model requires revision.
in light of.zh: 鉴于这些发现，理论模型需要修正。

in light of.en: The policy was withdrawn in light of new safety evidence.
in light of.zh: 鉴于新的安全证据，该政策被撤回。

in light of.en: In light of the limited sample, the results should be read as preliminary.
in light of.zh: 鉴于样本有限，这些结果应视为初步性的。

on the basis of.en: Participants were grouped on the basis of their baseline scores.
on the basis of.zh: 参与者按基线得分分组。

on the basis of.en: The court ruled on the basis of the documentary evidence alone.
on the basis of.zh: 法院仅依据书面证据作出裁决。

on the basis of.en: On the basis of these results, we reject the null hypothesis.
on the basis of.zh: 基于这些结果，我们拒绝原假设。

by means of.en: Access to the archive was gained by means of a research agreement.
by means of.zh: 通过一项研究协议获得了档案的查阅权。

by means of.en: The effect was measured by means of a validated questionnaire.
by means of.zh: 该效应借助一份经过验证的问卷来测量。

by means of.en: Themes were identified by means of constant comparison across cases.
by means of.zh: 主题是通过对案例的持续比较来识别的。

as such.en: The report is a synthesis, not a primary study, and should be read as such.
as such.zh: 该报告是综述而非原始研究，应照此理解。

as such.en: The committee is advisory; as such, it cannot enforce its recommendations.
as such.zh: 委员会是咨询性质的，因此无权强制执行其建议。

as such.en: The sample is not representative and, as such, findings are illustrative only.
as such.zh: 样本不具代表性，因此结果仅作示例之用。

per se.en: Urbanization per se is not the cause; density and connectivity matter more.
per se.zh: 城市化本身并非原因；密度与连通性更为关键。

per se.en: The intervention does not aim to raise income per se but to stabilize it.
per se.zh: 该干预并非旨在提高收入本身，而是稳定收入。

per se.en: Technology is neither beneficial nor harmful per se; outcomes depend on use.
per se.zh: 技术本身无所谓利弊，结果取决于使用方式。

with regard to.en: With regard to ethics, the study received full board approval.
with regard to.zh: 就伦理而言，本研究获得了伦理委员会的正式批准。

with regard to.en: Little consensus exists with regard to the appropriate sample size.
with regard to.zh: 关于合适的样本量，目前几乎没有共识。

with regard to.en: With regard to limitations, the single-site design is the most salient.
with regard to.zh: 就局限而言，单点设计最为突出。

inter alia.en: The dataset includes, inter alia, household income, tenure, and education.
inter alia.zh: 该数据集除其他事项外，还包括家庭收入、住房产权与教育程度。

inter alia.en: The Act regulates, inter alia, the storage of personal data.
inter alia.zh: 该法规除其他事项外，还规范个人数据的存储。

inter alia.en: The workshop addressed, inter alia, questions of research ethics.
inter alia.zh: 研讨会论及了研究伦理等问题。

vice versa.en: Reading proficiency predicts writing quality, and vice versa.
vice versa.zh: 阅读能力预示写作质量，反之亦然。

vice versa.en: Policy shapes public opinion and vice versa, making causality hard to isolate.
vice versa.zh: 政策塑造舆论，舆论也塑造政策，因而难以分离因果。

vice versa.en: The model maps theory onto data and vice versa.
vice versa.zh: 该模型把理论映射到数据，也把数据映射回理论。

acknowledge.en: The authors acknowledge the limitations of a single-site study.
acknowledge.zh: 作者承认单一站点研究的局限性。

acknowledge.en: Few studies acknowledge the role of chance in these outcomes.
acknowledge.zh: 很少有研究承认偶然因素在这些结果中的作用。

acknowledge.en: The report acknowledges contributions from all participating laboratories.
acknowledge.zh: 报告对所有参与实验室的贡献表示感谢。

assemble.en: We assembled evidence from forty peer-reviewed studies.
assemble.zh: 我们从 40 篇同行评审论文中汇集了证据。

assemble.en: Panels assemble to evaluate grant applications each spring.
assemble.zh: 评审组每年春季召开会议以评估基金申请。

assemble.en: The team assembled a database of cross-national survey results.
assemble.zh: 团队汇编了一个跨国调查结果数据库。

assist.en: Research librarians assist students in locating primary sources.
assist.zh: 研究馆员协助学生查找原始文献。

assist.en: A laboratory assistant assisted participants with the equipment during trials.
assist.zh: 试验中一名助手协助参与者操作设备。

assist.en: Software can assist but not replace careful data inspection.
assist.zh: 软件可以辅助而不能替代细致的数据检查。

associate.en: Sleep deprivation is associated with impaired concentration.
associate.zh: 睡眠不足与注意力受损相关。

associate.en: Respondents associated the brand with reliability rather than novelty.
associate.zh: 受访者将该品牌与可靠性而非新奇联系在一起。

associate.en: Higher intake was associated with better test performance overall.
associate.zh: 更高的摄入量总体上与更好的测验表现相关。

communicate.en: Clear figures help authors communicate complex results efficiently.
communicate.zh: 清晰的图表帮助作者高效传达复杂结果。

communicate.en: Cells communicate through chemical signals in the bloodstream.
communicate.zh: 细胞通过血液中的化学信号进行交流。

communicate.en: The study communicates its findings to both researchers and practitioners.
communicate.zh: 该研究向研究者和实践者双方传达其发现。

compile.en: We compiled a list of all eligible trials published before 2020.
compile.zh: 我们编制了 2020 年前发表的全部合格试验清单。

compile.en: The annex compiles statistics gathered across nine ministries.
compile.zh: 附录汇编了九个部门收集的统计数据。

compile.en: Librarians compile citation records for the university repository.
compile.zh: 馆员为学校知识库汇编引文记录。

consume.en: Model training consumes considerable computational resources.
consume.zh: 模型训练消耗大量计算资源。

consume.en: Households in the region consume more water than the national average.
consume.zh: 该地区家庭耗水量高于全国平均水平。

consume.en: The revision consumed most of the research time budget.
consume.zh: 修订工作耗费了大部分研究时间预算。

cooperate.en: Hospitals across the region agreed to cooperate on the registry.
cooperate.zh: 该地区各医院同意就登记库开展合作。

cooperate.en: Successful surveys depend on respondents willing to cooperate.
cooperate.zh: 成功的调查依赖于愿意配合的受访者。

cooperate.en: The two labs cooperate by sharing equipment and samples.
cooperate.zh: 两个实验室通过共享设备和样本进行协作。

create.en: Random assignment helps create comparable treatment and control groups.
create.zh: 随机分组有助于形成可比的处理组与对照组。

create.en: Feedback loops can create unintended inequalities in ranking systems.
create.zh: 反馈回路可能在排名体系中造成非预期的不平等。

create.en: The intervention created new opportunities for rural learners.
create.zh: 该干预为农村学习者创造了新的机会。

distort.en: Selective reporting can distort the apparent effectiveness of a treatment.
distort.zh: 选择性报告可能歪曲治疗表面上的有效性。

distort.en: Outliers may distort the estimated trend if not handled carefully.
distort.zh: 若不谨慎处理，离群值可能扭曲估计的趋势。

distort.en: Translation can distort nuanced items in attitudinal scales.
distort.zh: 翻译可能使态度量表中的精细条目失真。

expand.en: Later chapters expand on the theoretical framework.
expand.zh: 后续章节对理论框架作了进一步阐述。

expand.en: The sample will expand to include secondary schools next year.
expand.zh: 样本明年将扩大至包括中学。

expand.en: Demand for the service expanded rapidly after launch.
expand.zh: 该服务的需求在推出后迅速扩大。

participate.en: Over three hundred teachers participated in the survey.
participate.zh: 三百多位教师参与了这项调查。

participate.en: Volunteers were compensated for participating in the experiment.
participate.zh: 志愿者因参加实验而获得报酬。

participate.en: Not every eligible household chose to participate.
participate.zh: 并非每个符合条件的家庭都选择参与。

prescribe.en: Clinicians rarely prescribe antibiotics for viral infections.
prescribe.zh: 临床医生很少为病毒感染患者开抗生素处方。

prescribe.en: Ethics codes prescribe how conflicts of interest should be disclosed.
prescribe.zh: 伦理准则规定利益冲突应当如何披露。

prescribe.en: The protocol prescribes a washout period between conditions.
prescribe.zh: 方案规定各处理条件之间需安排清洗期。

secure.en: The team secured funding for a five-year follow-up.
secure.zh: 团队获得了五年期随访研究的资助。

secure.en: Securing informed consent precedes any data collection.
secure.zh: 取得知情同意先于任何数据收集。

secure.en: Researchers must secure records against accidental deletion.
secure.zh: 研究者必须确保记录安全以防误删。

association.en: The association between income and health is well documented.
association.zh: 收入与健康之间的关联已有充分文献记录。

association.en: Correlation does not imply a causal association.
association.zh: 相关并不意味着因果关联。

association.en: She joined a professional association of statisticians.
association.zh: 她加入了一个统计学家专业协会。

communication.en: Open communication reduces errors in clinical teams.
communication.zh: 开放的沟通可减少临床团队的差错。

communication.en: The project funds public communication of research results.
communication.zh: 该项目资助研究结果的公众传播。

communication.en: Communication delays between departments distorted the timeline.
communication.zh: 部门之间的沟通延误打乱了时间表。

community.en: The research community welcomed the open dataset.
community.zh: 学术界对这一开放数据集表示欢迎。

community.en: Local community leaders endorsed the recruitment plan.
community.zh: 当地社区负责人认可了招募计划。

community.en: Peer review sustains trust within the scientific community.
community.zh: 同行评审维系着科学共同体内部的信任。

author.en: Each author certified access to the raw data.
author.zh: 每位作者均确认可访问原始数据。

author.en: The first author drafted the coding scheme.
author.zh: 第一作者起草了编码方案。

author.en: Anonymous review conceals the identity of every author.
author.zh: 匿名评审隐去每位作者的身份。

conference.en: The findings first appeared as a conference paper.
conference.zh: 这些发现最初以会议论文形式发表。

conference.en: Conference presentations attracted useful methodological criticism.
conference.zh: 会议报告获得了有益的方法学批评。

conference.en: Submission deadlines for the spring conference have passed.
conference.zh: 春季会议的投稿截止日期已过。

department.en: The department revised its graduate admission criteria.
department.zh: 该系修订了研究生录取标准。

department.en: Funding comes jointly from two departments.
department.zh: 经费由两个系共同提供。

department.en: A hospital department piloted the new triage form.
department.zh: 一家医院科室试用了新的分诊表格。

economy.en: Inflation cooled as the economy slowed in 2023.
economy.zh: 随着 2023 年经济放缓，通胀有所降温。

economy.en: The study compares health outcomes across a market economy and a planned one.
economy.zh: 该研究比较了市场经济与计划经济体的健康结果。

economy.en: Household debt constrains growth in the whole economy.
economy.zh: 家庭债务制约着整体经济的增长。

emotion.en: Participants rated each image for emotion and familiarity.
emotion.zh: 参与者就情绪和熟悉度对每张图片评分。

emotion.en: Naming an emotion reduces its intensity.
emotion.zh: 为情绪命名能降低其强度。

emotion.en: The scale measures moral emotion rather than mood.
emotion.zh: 该量表测量的是道德情绪而非心境。

layer.en: A thin layer of sediment sealed the artifacts.
layer.zh: 一层薄薄的沉积物封存了这些人工遗物。

layer.en: The model adds a hidden layer between input and output.
layer.zh: 该模型在输入与输出之间增加了一个隐藏层。

layer.en: Analysis proceeded layer by layer through the archive.
layer.zh: 分析逐层推进，逐层深入档案之中。

output.en: Factory output recovered to its pre-crisis level.
output.zh: 工厂产出恢复到危机前水平。

output.en: We audited the model output for systematic bias.
output.zh: 我们对模型输出进行了系统性偏差审查。

output.en: Research output is measured in publications and citations.
output.zh: 科研产出以论文和引用衡量。

project.en: The longitudinal project tracked cohorts for two decades.
project.zh: 这项纵向项目追踪队列达 20 年。

project.en: Budget overruns delayed the construction project.
project.zh: 预算超支延误了该建设项目。

project.en: Each student presents an individual research project.
project.zh: 每位学生展示一个独立研究项目。

region.en: The effect held in every region surveyed.
region.zh: 该效应在所调查的每个地区都成立。

region.en: A desert region supplied most of the samples.
region.zh: 一个沙漠地区提供了大部分样本。

region.en: Policies differ markedly across the same economic region.
region.zh: 同一经济区域内的政策差异显著。

revenue.en: Tuition forms a shrinking share of university revenue.
revenue.zh: 学费占大学收入的比例不断缩小。

revenue.en: The tax reform shifted revenue toward local government.
revenue.zh: 税制改革将收入重心转移至地方政府。

revenue.en: Advertising revenue declined as subscriptions rose.
revenue.zh: 随着订阅量上升，广告收入有所下降。

reward.en: Delayed reward is central to intertemporal choice studies.
reward.zh: 延迟奖励是跨期选择研究的核心。

reward.en: Bonus schemes reward quantity more than quality.
reward.zh: 奖金方案奖励数量而非质量。

reward.en: The algorithm learns by maximizing a reward signal.
reward.zh: 算法通过最大化奖励信号进行学习。

sector.en: Employment grew fastest in the service sector.
Public-sector wages lag behind comparable private jobs.
sector.zh: 公共部门工资落后于可比的私营岗位。

sector.en: The policy targets emissions across every sector.
sector.zh: 该政策针对所有部门的排放。

site.en: Excavation began at the coastal dig site.
site.zh: 发掘工作始于沿海的发掘现场。

site.en: Each field site received identical training for enumerators.
site.zh: 每个田野站点为调查员提供相同培训。

site.en: The data are mirrored on a university web site.
site.zh: 数据已镜像同步到一所大学的网站上。

status.en: Migrant workers occupy an ambiguous legal status.
status.zh: 外来务工人员处于模糊的法律地位。

status.en: We recorded the completion status of every case.
status.zh: 我们记录了每个个案的完成状态。

status.en: Socioeconomic status remains the strongest predictor.
status.zh: 社会经济地位仍是最强的预测因子。

symbol.en: Each symbol denotes one logical operator.
symbol.zh: 每个符号表示一个逻辑运算符。

symbol.en: The flag operates as a political symbol.
symbol.zh: 这面旗帜发挥着政治象征的作用。

symbol.en: Notation varies: no single symbol is universal.
symbol.zh: 记法各异：没有任何符号是通用的。

theme.en: Trust emerged as a central theme in the interviews.
theme.zh: 信任成为访谈中的一个核心主题。

theme.en: Coding proceeded from surface codes to broader themes.
theme.zh: 编码从表层编码推进到更宽泛的主题。

theme.en: The exhibition explores the theme of migration.
theme.zh: 展览探讨了移民这一主题。

topic.en: The workshop rotates its topic every semester.
topic.zh: 该工作坊每学期更换主题。

topic.en: Topic modeling assigned each abstract to a cluster.
topic.zh: 主题模型将每篇摘要归入一个类别。

topic.en: Off-topic replies were excluded from analysis.
topic.zh: 离题的回复被排除在分析之外。

volume.en: Traffic volume doubles during the harvest season.
volume.zh: 收获季节交通流量会翻倍。

volume.en: The journal volume includes a memorial issue.
volume.zh: 该期刊的这一卷包含一期纪念专刊。

volume.en: High volume can compromise careful review.
volume.zh: 数量过大可能影响细致的评审质量。

chemical.en: Chemical analysis confirmed the presence of phosphates.
chemical.zh: 化学分析证实了磷酸盐的存在。

chemical.en: The compound shows remarkable chemical stability.
chemical.zh: 该化合物表现出显著的化学稳定性。

chemical.en: Chemical treatments increased weed resistance over time.
chemical.zh: 随着时间推移，化学处理提高了杂草的抗性。

digital.en: Digital archiving transformed access to manuscripts.
digital.zh: 数字化存档改变了手稿的可及性。

digital.en: The experiment compared digital and printed reading.
digital.zh: 该实验比较了数字阅读与纸质阅读。

digital.en: Digital traces allow precise measurement of behavior.
digital.zh: 数字足迹允许对行为进行精确测量。

dynamic.en: Group norms are dynamic rather than fixed.
dynamic.zh: 群体规范是动态的而非固定的。

dynamic.en: Prices adjust in a dynamic equilibrium model.
dynamic.zh: 价格在动态均衡模型中调整。

dynamic.en: The relationship between the two variables is highly dynamic.
dynamic.zh: 两个变量之间的关系是高度动态的。

molecular.en: Molecular evidence revised the species classification.
molecular.zh: 分子证据修正了物种分类。

molecular.en: The lab specializes in molecular diagnostics.
molecular.zh: 该实验室专攻分子诊断。

molecular.en: Results hold from the molecular to the behavioral level.
molecular.zh: 结果从分子层面到行为层面均成立。

lead to.en: Insufficient sleep in adolescence can lead to lasting difficulties with concentration.
lead to.zh: 青少年期睡眠不足可能导致长期难以集中注意力。

lead to.en: A single flawed assumption can lead to systematic bias across the entire model.
lead to.zh: 一个有缺陷的假设可能导致整个模型的系统性偏差。

lead to.en: Pilot data suggest the intervention may lead to measurable gains in reading fluency.
lead to.zh: 试点数据表明，该干预可能带来阅读流利度上可测量的提升。

result in.en: Failure to document exclusions resulted in a request for retraction.
result in.zh: 未能记录排除标准导致期刊提出撤稿要求。

result in.en: Small rounding errors at each step resulted in a substantial deviation in the final estimate.
result in.zh: 每步的微小舍入误差累积后，在最终估计值中造成了显著偏差。

result in.en: The revised sampling frame is expected to result in more stable estimates.
result in.zh: 修订后的抽样框架预计将产生更稳定的估计值。

result from.en: Most of the discrepancy results from differences in coding schemes between the two teams.
result from.zh: 大部分差异源于两队编码方案的不同。

result from.en: The seasonal pattern appears to result from temperature rather than rainfall.
result from.zh: 这一季节性格局似乎源于温度而非降水量。

result from.en: Delays in publication often result from reviewer disagreements rather than editorial backlog.
result from.zh: 出版延误常常起因于审稿人分歧，而非编辑积压。

give rise to.en: The new measurement device gave rise to questions about comparability with earlier data.
give rise to.zh: 新型测量设备引起了人们关于其与早期数据可比性的疑问。

give rise to.en: Rapid urbanization has given rise to fresh challenges for public transport planning.
give rise to.zh: 快速城市化给公共交通规划带来了新挑战。

give rise to.en: Ambiguous definitions in the codebook gave rise to inconsistent coding.
give rise to.zh: 编码手册中含义不清的定义导致了编码不一致。

carry out.en: The team carried out semi-structured interviews with thirty practitioners.
carry out.zh: 团队对 30 名从业者开展了半结构化访谈。

carry out.en: Replication studies carried out in different countries strengthened the original finding.
carry out.zh: 在不同国家开展的复现研究加强了原有结论的说服力。

carry out.en: Ethical approval is required before carrying out research with minors.
carry out.zh: 对未成年人开展研究之前须获得伦理批准。

take into account.en: The model takes into account both student background and school resources.
take into account.zh: 该模型同时考虑了学生背景与学校资源。

take into account.en: Reviewers should take into account the limited access to archives during the study period.
take into account.zh: 评审者应考虑到研究期间档案获取渠道有限这一点。

take into account.en: Failing to take into account attrition can bias longitudinal conclusions.
take into account.zh: 不把样本流失计算在内，可能使纵向结论产生偏差。

shed light on.en: The corpus data shed light on the grammar of academic hedging.
shed light on.zh: 语料库数据为学术模糊限制语的语法提供了新的启示。

shed light on.en: These interviews shed light on why teachers resist the reform.
shed light on.zh: 这些访谈阐明了教师抵制改革的原因。

shed light on.en: The mechanism remains poorly understood, and the study only partially sheds light on it.
shed light on.zh: 该机制仍未被充分理解，本研究只是部分地阐明了这套机制。

in practice.en: In practice, random assignment is difficult in small-school settings.
in practice.zh: 在实践中，小学校情境下难以实现随机分组。

in practice.en: The policy sounds reasonable, but in practice it creates perverse incentives.
in practice.zh: 这一政策听起来合理，但实际上制造了反常的激励。

in practice.en: In practice, the two definitions converge on the same set of cases.
in practice.zh: 实际上，两种定义都指向同一组案例。

in principle.en: In principle, any open dataset may be reused with attribution.
in principle.zh: 原则上，任何开放数据集均可在注明出处后复用。

in principle.en: The method is sound in principle, though its execution is demanding.
in principle.zh: 该方法原则上成立，只是实施要求很高。

in principle.en: In principle the committee could reconsider the decision after new evidence.
in principle.zh: 原则上，委员会可在新证据出现后重新考虑该决定。

on average.en: On average, participants recalled thirty words after a single session.
on average.zh: 平均而言，参与者在单次学习后能回忆 30 个词。

on average.en: On average, the cohorts in the revised program outperformed the original sample.
on average.zh: 平均而言，修订后项目中的组别表现优于原样本。

on average.en: The two schemes cost about the same on average, but differ in variance.
on average.zh: 两种方案平均成本大致相同，但方差不同。

in turn.en: Higher expectations improve effort, which in turn raises achievement.
in turn.zh: 更高的期望改善努力程度，进而提升成绩。

in turn.en: Trust influences cooperation, which in turn predicts long-term participation.
in turn.zh: 信任影响合作，而合作又反过来预测长期参与。

in turn.en: Each chapter draws on the previous one and, in turn, sets up the next.
in turn.zh: 每章依托前一章，继而引出下一章。

to some extent.en: The decline can be explained to some extent by changes in the birth rate.
to some extent.zh: 这一下降在某种程度上可用出生率的变化来解释。

to some extent.en: Both approaches capture the phenomenon to some extent.
to some extent.zh: 两种方法都在一定程度上捕捉到了这一现象。

to some extent.en: To some extent, the reviewers' disagreement reflects definitional ambiguity.
to some extent.zh: 审稿人的分歧在某种程度上反映了定义的模糊性。

thereafter.en: Participants completed the survey; thereafter, they were reimbursed for their time.
thereafter.zh: 参与者完成问卷；此后，他们获得了时间酬金。

thereafter.en: The archive was cataloged in 1998 and closed to the public thereafter.
thereafter.zh: 该档案于 1998 年编目，此后即对公众关闭。

thereafter.en: Samples were frozen within an hour and analyzed thereafter.
thereafter.zh: 样本在一小时内冷冻，随后进行分析。

in that.en: The revised scale is superior in that it distinguishes two forms of motivation.
in that.zh: 修订后的量表更为优越，因为它区分了两种动机。

in that.en: This case differs from the others in that exposure was measured directly.
in that.zh: 这一案例不同于其他案例之处在于，暴露程度是被直接测量的。

in that.en: The argument is circular in that its conclusion presupposes its premise.
in that.zh: 该论证是循环的，因为其结论预设了其前提。

in addition to.en: In addition to the main survey, the team conducted twelve expert interviews.
in addition to.zh: 除主问卷外，团队还进行了 12 次专家访谈。

in addition to.en: In addition to summarizing the evidence, the report proposes a monitoring plan.
in addition to.zh: 该报告除总结证据外，还提出了监测方案。

in addition to.en: In addition to English, the database indexes sources in six languages.
in addition to.zh: 该数据库除英文外还收录六种语言的文献索引。

such as.en: Exclusion criteria such as prior diagnosis were applied uniformly.
such as.zh: 诸如既往诊断之类的排除标准一律适用。

such as.en: Metrics such as precision and recall were reported for every model.
such as.zh: 每个模型均报告了精确率与召回率等指标。

such as.en: Structural barriers such as cost and distance limit participation.
such as.zh: 成本与距离等结构性障碍限制了参与。

according to.en: According to the latest census, the region lost fifteen percent of its young adults.
according to.zh: 根据最新人口普查，该地区流失了 15% 的青年成年人。

according to.en: According to the authors, the discrepancy reflects sampling rather than measurement error.
according to.zh: 据作者称，这一差异反映的是抽样而非测量误差。

according to.en: The timeline was revised according to the reviewers' schedule.
according to.zh: 时间表根据审稿人的日程作了修订。

instead of.en: We report medians instead of means to guard against outlier effects.
instead of.zh: 我们报告中位数而非均值，以防异常值影响。

instead of.en: Coding was done independently instead of by consensus.
instead of.zh: 编码是独立完成的，而不是通过协商一致。

instead of.en: Instead of discarding outliers, the team flagged them for inspection.
instead of.zh: 团队没有丢弃异常值，而是将其标记出来供核查。

as a result of.en: Enrollment rose sharply as a result of the fee waiver.
as a result of.zh: 由于免除了费用，注册人数大幅上升。

as a result of.en: As a result of the replication failures, the original claim was withdrawn.
as a result of.zh: 由于复现实验失败，原有结论被撤回。

as a result of.en: Three datasets were excluded as a result of incomplete metadata.
as a result of.zh: 由于元数据不完整，三个数据集被排除。

apart from.en: Apart from two exceptions, every participant finished both sessions.
apart from.zh: 除两个例外，所有参与者都完成了两次测试。

apart from.en: Apart from its cost, the method offers few advantages over existing tools.
apart from.zh: 除成本外，该方法相较于现有工具几乎没有优势。

apart from.en: The results are sound; apart from that, only the sample size could be questioned.
apart from.zh: 结果是可靠的；除此之外，只有样本量可被质疑。

prior to.en: Prior to analysis, all sequences were checked for contamination.
prior to.zh: 分析之前，所有序列均作了污染物检查。

prior to.en: Written consent was obtained prior to any data collection.
prior to.zh: 在任何数据采集之前均取得了书面同意。

prior to.en: The codebook was pilot-tested prior to the main study.
prior to.zh: 编码手册在主研究之前经过了预测试。

relative to.en: Performance improved relative to the baseline measurement.
relative to.zh: 相对于基线测量，表现有所提高。

relative to.en: Rural schools are underfunded relative to their urban counterparts.
relative to.zh: 相对于城市学校，乡村学校经费不足。

relative to.en: The estimate is low relative to figures reported in meta-analyses.
relative to.zh: 该估计值相对于元分析报告的数字偏低。

on the one hand.en: On the one hand the design maximizes realism; on the other it sacrifices control.
on the one hand.zh: 这一设计一方面最大化了真实性，另一方面却牺牲了控制。

on the one hand.en: On the one hand, open data increase impact; on the other, they raise privacy risks.
on the one hand.zh: 开放数据一方面提升了影响力，另一方面也带来隐私风险。

on the one hand.en: The argument holds on the one hand but fails on the other.
on the one hand.zh: 这个论点在一方面成立，在另一方面却不然。

in contrast to.en: In contrast to the first cohort, the second showed no practice effect.
in contrast to.zh: 与第一组不同，第二组未显示出练习效应。

in contrast to.en: The present results, in contrast to earlier survey findings, differ markedly.
in contrast to.zh: 与早期调查结论相比，本次结果差异显著。

in contrast to.en: In contrast to laboratory studies, field data capture behavior in real settings.
in contrast to.zh: 与实验室研究相对照，实地数据捕捉的是真实情境中的行为。

affect.en: Smoking affects nearly every organ of the body.
affect.zh: 吸烟几乎会影响身体的每一个器官。

affect.en: The results were affected by several uncontrolled variables.
affect.zh: 结果受到了若干未控制变量的影响。

affect.en: Rising sea levels could affect coastal communities for decades to come.
affect.zh: 海平面上升可能在未来数十年间持续影响沿海社区。

adapt.en: Students must adapt to a new language environment within a few weeks.
adapt.zh: 学生必须在几周内适应新的语言环境。

adapt.en: The framework was originally adapted from a model in cognitive psychology.
adapt.zh: 该框架最初改编自认知心理学的一个模型。

adapt.en: Few species can adapt to such rapid environmental change.
adapt.zh: 很少有物种能够适应如此迅速的环境变化。

adjust.en: Participants were asked to adjust their schedules to the testing window.
adjust.zh: 参与者被要求将时间安排调整到测试时段内。

adjust.en: The model automatically adjusts for seasonality in the data.
adjust.zh: 该模型会对数据中的季节性进行自动调整。

adjust.en: It took her several months to adjust to the demands of graduate study.
adjust.zh: 她花了几个月才适应研究生学习的要求。

administration.en: She has spent twenty years in university administration.
administration.zh: 她在大学行政岗位工作了 20 年。

administration.en: The reforms were delayed by the change of administration.
administration.zh: 政府换届使这些改革被推迟。

administration.en: Hospital administration costs rose sharply over the decade.
administration.zh: 10 年间医院的管理成本急剧上升。

benefit.en: The benefits of early intervention are well documented.
benefit.zh: 早期干预的益处有充分的文献记录。

benefit.en: Widespread internet access has benefited many remote communities.
benefit.zh: 互联网的普及使许多偏远社区受益。

benefit.en: Employees benefit from a generous retraining scheme.
benefit.zh: 优厚的再就业培训计划让员工从中获益。

commit.en: The university is committed to reducing its carbon footprint.
commit.zh: 该校致力于减少碳足迹。

commit.en: Researchers must commit adequate time to validating the data.
commit.zh: 研究者必须投入足够的时间来验证数据。

commit.en: The report commits the agency to publishing its findings within a year.
commit.zh: 报告迫使该机构承诺在一年内公布调查结果。

concentrate.en: For this task, please concentrate on the opening chapter alone.
concentrate.zh: 做这项任务时，请只专注于开篇章节。

concentrate.en: The mining towns concentrate a large share of the region's extractive employment.
concentrate.zh: 这些矿业城镇集中了该地区采掘业的大部分就业。

concentrate.en: Students who concentrate on one skill at a time improve faster.
concentrate.zh: 一次专注一项技能的学生进步更快。

convert.en: The data were converted into a machine-readable format.
convert.zh: 数据已被转换为机器可读的格式。

convert.en: The old factory has been converted into a research facility.
convert.zh: 旧厂房已被改造成一处研究设施。

convert.en: Yeast enzymes convert the sugar into alcohol during fermentation.
convert.zh: 发酵过程中，酵母酶将糖转化为酒精。

detect.en: The test can detect the infection at a very early stage.
detect.zh: 这项检测能够在感染非常早期时就将其检出。

detect.en: Listeners could barely detect a difference between the two recordings.
detect.zh: 听众几乎察觉不出两段录音之间的差别。

detect.en: No significant effect was detected in the control group.
detect.zh: 对照组中未检测到显著效应。

fund.en: The study was funded by a national science foundation.
fund.zh: 该研究由一家国家科学基金会资助。

fund.en: Private donors fund roughly a third of the institute's budget.
fund.zh: 私人捐赠者资助了该研究所约三分之一的预算。

fund.en: Tax revenue funds most public research in the country.
fund.zh: 税收为该国大部分公共研究提供资金。

incentive.en: Tax breaks provide a powerful incentive for firms to invest.
incentive.zh: 税收减免为企业投资提供了强有力的激励。

incentive.en: Financial incentives alone do not improve teacher performance.
incentive.zh: 仅靠经济激励并不能提升教师的业绩。

incentive.en: The bonus scheme was intended as an incentive to retain experienced staff.
incentive.zh: 奖金制度旨在成为留住资深员工的激励手段。

inhibit.en: High humidity inhibits the growth of these bacteria.
inhibit.zh: 高湿度会抑制这些细菌的生长。

inhibit.en: Fear of judgment can inhibit participation in group discussion.
inhibit.zh: 害怕被评判可能会阻碍参与小组讨论。

inhibit.en: The drug inhibits the absorption of cholesterol in the gut.
inhibit.zh: 这种药物可抑制肠道对胆固醇的吸收。

initiate.en: The committee initiated an independent review of the case.
initiate.zh: 委员会着手对该事件展开独立审查。

initiate.en: Interviews were initiated only after written consent was obtained.
initiate.zh: 只有在获得书面同意之后才启动访谈。

initiate.en: Cultural change is often initiated by small, well-connected groups.
initiate.zh: 文化变迁往往由小而联系广泛的群体发起。

motivate.en: Intrinsic curiosity motivated the researchers to persist for a decade.
motivate.zh: 内在的好奇心驱使这批研究者坚持探索了 10 年。

motivate.en: Students are more motivated when they see the purpose of a task.
motivate.zh: 当学生看到任务的意义时，积极性会更高。

motivate.en: The need for recognition motivated much of his published work.
motivate.zh: 对认可的渴求推动了他大量研究成果的产出。

persist.en: Inflation persisted at double digits throughout the period.
persist.zh: 整个时期内通货膨胀率持续保持在两位数。

persist.en: Symptoms may persist for several weeks after the infection clears.
persist.zh: 感染清除后，症状仍可能持续数周。

persist.en: Many inequalities persist despite two decades of reform.
persist.zh: 历经 20 年的改革，许多不平等现象依然存在。

pose.en: The findings pose a serious challenge to the dominant theory.
pose.zh: 这些发现对主流理论构成了严峻挑战。

pose.en: Rising temperatures pose obvious risks to food security.
pose.zh: 气温上升对粮食安全构成明显威胁。

pose.en: Ethical questions posed by the experiment delayed its approval.
pose.zh: 该实验引发的伦理问题使其审批被推迟。

publish.en: The team plans to publish its results next spring.
publish.zh: 该团队计划明年春天发表研究成果。

publish.en: The findings were published in a peer-reviewed journal.
publish.zh: 研究结果发表于一种同行评审期刊。

publish.en: She published three monographs on urban poverty over ten years.
publish.zh: 10 年间她出版了三部关于城市贫困的专著。

pursue.en: Few graduates pursue academic careers in the humanities.
pursue.zh: 很少有人文专业的毕业生继续从事学术职业。

pursue.en: The firm pursued a strategy of aggressive expansion.
pursue.zh: 该公司推行了激进扩张的战略。

pursue.en: Further work is needed to pursue this promising line of inquiry.
pursue.zh: 要沿这一颇有前景的研究路径继续深入，还需更多工作。

reject.en: The reviewers rejected the manuscript without giving reasons.
reject.zh: 审稿人未说明理由便拒绝了这篇稿件。

reject.en: At the 5% level, we cannot reject the null hypothesis.
reject.zh: 在 5% 的显著性水平上，我们无法拒绝原假设。

reject.en: Voters rejected the proposal by a wide margin.
reject.zh: 选民以较大差距否决了这项提案。

resource.en: The university library is an underused resource for postgraduates.
resource.zh: 大学图书馆是研究生们的一个未被充分利用的资源。

resource.en: Water is the region's most contested natural resource.
resource.zh: 水资源是该地区争夺最激烈的自然资源。

resource.en: Each lab must justify its request for shared computing resources.
resource.zh: 每个实验室都必须说明申请共享计算资源的理由。

select.en: We selected participants from three distinct age brackets.
select.zh: 我们从三个不同的年龄段中选取了参与者。

select.en: Care must be taken to select a representative sample.
select.zh: 选取有代表性的样本时必须谨慎。

select.en: The algorithm selects the most relevant pages from millions of candidates.
select.zh: 该算法从上百万个候选页面中筛出最相关的页面。

submit.en: All authors must submit a conflict-of-interest statement.
submit.zh: 所有作者都必须提交利益冲突声明。

submit.en: The manuscript was submitted to two journals before it was accepted.
submit.zh: 这篇稿件在被录用之前曾投过两家期刊。

submit.en: Participants were asked to submit their responses online.
submit.zh: 参与者被要求在线提交作答。

suspend.en: The trial was suspended after two patients developed complications.
suspend.zh: 两名患者出现并发症后，该试验被暂停。

suspend.en: Funding will be suspended until the audit is complete.
suspend.zh: 审计结束之前，资助将暂被中止。

suspend.en: Fine dust particles remain suspended in the air for hours.
suspend.zh: 细密的尘埃颗粒可在空气中悬浮数小时。

transfer.en: Living cells transfer energy through a series of chemical reactions.
transfer.zh: 活细胞通过一系列化学反应来传递能量。

transfer.en: The data were transferred to an encrypted external drive.
transfer.zh: 数据已被转移到一块加密的外置硬盘上。

transfer.en: Skills learned in one context do not always transfer to another.
transfer.zh: 在一种情境中学到的技能并不总能迁移到另一种情境。

violate.en: Several of the included studies violate the assumption of independent errors.
violate.zh: 所纳入的几项研究违背了误差相互独立的假设。

violate.en: The experiment was halted for violating ethical protocols.
violate.zh: 该实验因违反伦理规程而被叫停。

violate.en: The ruling violated the terms of the original agreement.
violate.zh: 这项裁决违反了最初协议中的条款。

withdraw.en: Two participants withdrew from the study before the final interview.
withdraw.zh: 两名参与者在最终访谈前退出了研究。

withdraw.en: The authors withdrew the paper after a calculation error was found.
withdraw.zh: 发现一处计算错误后，作者撤回了论文。

withdraw.en: Groundwater is withdrawn from the aquifer faster than it can recharge.
withdraw.zh: 从含水层抽取地下水的速度快过其补给速度。

accumulate.en: Sediments accumulate at the mouth of the river, forming a delta over centuries.
accumulate.zh: 河流入海口处泥沙逐年淤积，历经数百年形成三角洲。

accumulate.en: Students accumulate vocabulary knowledge through wide reading rather than rote word lists.
accumulate.zh: 学生通过广泛阅读而非死记单词表来积累词汇知识。

accumulate.en: Static electricity accumulates on the surface during the drying process.
accumulate.zh: 干燥过程中，静电会在材料表面积累。

cite.en: Authors are expected to cite every source they draw upon.
cite.zh: 作者应对其援引的每一个资料来源作出注明。

cite.en: The review cites over two hundred studies published since 2010.
cite.zh: 这篇综述引用了 2010 年以来发表的二百余项研究。

cite.en: Economic stagnation was cited as the main cause of the policy shift.
cite.zh: 经济停滞被援引为该政策转向的主要原因。

dominate.en: A handful of firms dominate the global search market.
dominate.zh: 少数几家公司主导着全球搜索市场。

dominate.en: Manufacturing still dominates the region's export structure.
dominate.zh: 制造业仍在该地区的出口结构中占主导地位。

dominate.en: Fear of failure can dominate students' choices of courses.
dominate.zh: 对失败的恐惧可能左右着学生的课程选择。

exclude.en: We excluded participants who did not complete the baseline survey.
exclude.zh: 我们排除了未完成基线问卷的参与者。

exclude.en: The definition excludes informal work carried out within the household.
exclude.zh: 这一定义不包括在家庭内部进行的非正规劳动。

exclude.en: High inflation cannot be excluded as a contributing factor.
exclude.zh: 不能排除高通胀是促成因素之一。

interact.en: The two drugs interact to produce a stronger sedative effect.
interact.zh: 这两种药物相互作用，会产生更强的镇静效果。

interact.en: Children interact with peers differently online than face to face.
interact.zh: 儿童在网上与同伴互动的方式与面对面时不同。

interact.en: How molecules interact determines the material's melting point.
interact.zh: 分子间如何相互作用决定了该材料的熔点。

fluctuate.en: Temperatures fluctuate widely between day and night.
fluctuate.zh: 昼夜之间气温大幅波动。

fluctuate.en: Enrollment figures fluctuated between 4,000 and 5,500 over the decade.
fluctuate.zh: 10 年间，入学人数在 4000 至 5500 之间波动。

fluctuate.en: Prices fluctuate in response to changes in demand.
fluctuate.zh: 价格会随需求的变化而波动。

diminish.en: Regular exercise can diminish the risk of heart disease.
diminish.zh: 规律锻炼可降低患心脏病的风险。

diminish.en: The effect diminished after the first week of treatment.
diminish.zh: 治疗效果在治疗一周后便开始减弱。

diminish.en: Nothing diminishes the importance of careful replication.
diminish.zh: 没有任何因素会削弱严谨复现研究的重要性。

display.en: The dashboard displays trends in energy use in real time.
display.zh: 该仪表盘实时显示能源使用趋势。

display.en: Males display brighter plumage during the mating season.
display.zh: 繁殖季雄鸟会展现出更鲜艳的羽毛。

display.en: Results are displayed as a box plot for each group.
display.zh: 结果以每组一个箱线图的形式展示。

export.en: The country exports roughly half of what it produces.
export.zh: 该国出口的产物约占其总产量的一半。

export.en: Firms that export tend to be more productive.
export.zh: 出口型企业往往生产率更高。

export.en: Data can be exported from the database in several formats.
export.zh: 数据可从该数据库按多种格式导出。

finance.en: He works in corporate finance at a mid-sized bank.
finance.zh: 他在一家中型银行从事公司金融工作。

finance.en: Behavioral insights have reshaped the study of public finance.
finance.zh: 行为洞察正在重塑公共财政学的研究面貌。

finance.en: Household debt has become a central concern of international finance.
finance.zh: 家庭债务已成为国际金融领域的核心关切。

format.en: Please save the dataset in a machine-readable format.
format.zh: 请以机器可读的格式保存该数据集。

format.en: The journal imposes a strict format on reference lists.
format.zh: 该期刊对参考文献表的格式有严格要求。

format.en: Interviews were transcribed and coded in a standard format.
format.zh: 访谈按统一格式转写并编码。

inspect.en: Technicians inspect each wafer under ultraviolet light.
inspect.zh: 技术人员在紫外光下逐片检查晶圆。

inspect.en: Auditors inspect the records for signs of misreporting.
inspect.zh: 审计人员检查记录以发现虚报迹象。

inspect.en: Participants were given time to inspect the stimuli before responding.
inspect.zh: 参与者在作答前有时间仔细查看刺激材料。

legacy.en: The study relies on forty years of legacy climate records.
legacy.zh: 这项研究依托 40 年来既有的气候记录。

legacy.en: Migrating from legacy software is costly and risky.
legacy.zh: 从遗留软件系统迁移既昂贵又有风险。

legacy.en: The program left a mixed legacy in rural education.
legacy.zh: 该项目给农村教育留下了毁誉参半的遗产。

legal.en: Researchers must clarify the legal implications of data sharing.
legal.zh: 研究者必须厘清数据共享的法律影响。

legal.en: The framework rests on a body of legal precedent.
legal.zh: 该框架建立在一整套法律先例之上。

legal.en: Legal reforms altered the incentives for foreign investors.
legal.zh: 法律改革改变了对外国投资者的激励。

parallel.en: The two economies show striking parallels in their boom years.
parallel.zh: 两个经济体在繁荣时期表现出惊人的相似之处。

parallel.en: We ran the simulation in parallel on sixty processors.
parallel.zh: 我们在 60 个处理器上并行运行该模拟。

parallel.en: Few studies have drawn a parallel between the two phenomena.
parallel.zh: 很少有研究在这两种现象之间作类比。

passive.en: The survey coded responses as active or passive.
passive.zh: 该调查将回答编码为主动或被动两类。

passive.en: Passive smoking raises the risk of respiratory illness.
passive.zh: 被动吸烟会增加患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

passive.en: Heat loss through the walls can be reduced by passive design.
passive.zh: 被动式建筑设计可减少墙体热量散失。

periodic.en: The currency was subject to periodic crises throughout the century.
periodic.zh: 该货币体系在整个世纪里周期性爆发危机。

periodic.en: Records were audited at periodic intervals.
periodic.zh: 这些档案会定期接受审计。

periodic.en: Periodic fluctuations in sea temperature affect coral bleaching.
periodic.zh: 海水温度的周期性波动影响珊瑚白化。

reverse.en: The government moved to reverse the previous administration's reforms.
reverse.zh: 政府着手扭转上一届政府的改革。

reverse.en: No treatment has been shown to reverse the condition.
reverse.zh: 尚无疗法被证明可以逆转该病症。

reverse.en: The enzyme catalyzes the reverse reaction under anaerobic conditions.
reverse.zh: 厌氧条件下该酶催化逆反应。

schedule.en: Interviews were conducted according to a fixed schedule.
schedule.zh: 访谈严格按照既定时间表进行。

schedule.en: The project fell behind schedule after the funding delay.
schedule.zh: 资金到位延误后，项目进度落后于计划。

schedule.en: A detailed schedule of experiments appears in the appendix.
schedule.zh: 实验的详细时间安排见附录。

track.en: The register tracks outcomes for every treated patient.
track.zh: 该登记库追踪每一位受治患者的预后结果。

track.en: Wages have failed to track rising productivity.
track.zh: 工资未能跟上生产率的增长。

track.en: Participants were tracked for five years after discharge.
track.zh: 参与者在出院后仍被跟踪观察五年。

transmit.en: The species transmits the parasite between hosts.
transmit.zh: 该物种在宿主之间传播寄生虫。

transmit.en: Signals are transmitted along the axon as pulses.
transmit.zh: 信号以脉冲形式沿轴突传递。

transmit.en: The pathogen can transmit asymptomatically for several days.
transmit.zh: 该病原体可在数日内无症状传播。

contract.en: The university refused to sign the contract without an ethics clause.
contract.zh: 若合同中没有伦理条款，大学便拒绝签署。

contract.en: Wages under temporary contracts lag behind permanent ones.
contract.zh: 临时合同下的工资落后于正式合同下的工资。

contract.en: The study examined how enforceable verbal contracts are.
contract.zh: 该研究考察了口头合同在多大程度上可被强制执行。

deteriorate.en: Air quality deteriorated sharply during the heating season.
deteriorate.zh: 采暖季期间空气质量急剧恶化。

deteriorate.en: Relations between the two agencies deteriorated over budget negotiations.
deteriorate.zh: 两个机构之间的关系因预算谈判而恶化。

deteriorate.en: Without refrigeration the samples deteriorate within hours.
deteriorate.zh: 若无冷藏，样本数小时内便会变质。

complicate.en: Missing data complicate any comparison between the surveys.
complicate.zh: 数据缺失使两次调查之间的比较更为困难。

complicate.en: The analysis was complicated by inconsistent coding schemes.
complicate.zh: 不一致的编码方案使分析趋于复杂。

complicate.en: Overlapping mandates complicate coordination among agencies.
complicate.zh: 职权交叉使机构间的协调变得复杂。

diffuse.en: Pollutants diffuse rapidly through saturated soil.
diffuse.zh: 污染物在饱和土壤中扩散得很快。

diffuse.en: The innovations diffused slowly across the industry.
diffuse.zh: 这些创新在整个行业中的扩散十分缓慢。

diffuse.en: Light diffuses evenly under an overcast sky.
diffuse.zh: 阴天时，光线均匀地漫射开来。

scarcely.en: There is scarcely any evidence that the two measures capture the same underlying construct.
scarcely.zh: 几乎没有证据表明这两项测量捕捉到的是同一潜在构念。

scarcely.en: The effect was scarcely noticeable in the smaller samples retained for analysis.
scarcely.zh: 在保留用于分析的较小样本中，该效应几乎无法察觉。

scarcely.en: She scarcely mentioned the limitations of the design when presenting her results.
scarcely.zh: 她在展示研究结果时几乎未提研究设计的局限。

hardly.en: The revised instrument hardly differs from the original in wording or length.
hardly.zh: 修订后的测量工具在措辞或长度上与原版几乎没有差别。

hardly.en: There is hardly any agreement among reviewers about the appropriate statistical threshold.
hardly.zh: 评审者之间对于合适的统计阈值几乎没有任何共识。

hardly.en: The sample was hardly large enough to support subgroup comparisons across regions.
hardly.zh: 该样本几乎不足以支持跨地区的子群比较。

seldom.en: Such methodological irregularities seldom remain undetected in large-scale survey research.
seldom.zh: 在大规模调查研究中，这类方法上的违规极少不被发现。

seldom.en: Studies seldom distinguish between self-reported competence and observed performance.
seldom.zh: 研究很少区分自我报告的胜任力与实际表现。

seldom.en: Peer reviewers seldom challenge the robustness of published null findings.
seldom.zh: 同行评审者很少质疑已发表的零结果研究的稳健性。

especially.en: The effect was especially pronounced among participants with limited prior training.
especially.zh: 该效应在先前训练有限的参与者中尤为明显。

especially.en: Programs of remediation are especially costly when applied late in the academic year.
especially.zh: 补救性课程若在学年末才予以实施，成本尤其高昂。

especially.en: Peer review is especially valuable in fields where published evidence remains sparse.
especially.zh: 在已发表证据仍显稀少的领域，同行评审尤其宝贵。

chiefly.en: The explanation is chiefly statistical rather than substantive in nature.
chiefly.zh: 这一解释主要是统计性质的，而非实质性的。

chiefly.en: The population studied is chiefly composed of urban residents in the capital.
chiefly.zh: 所研究的总体主要由首都的城市居民构成。

chiefly.en: Growth in output was driven chiefly by increased investment in research infrastructure.
chiefly.zh: 产出增长主要由对研究基础设施投入的增加所推动。

fundamentally.en: The two theoretical frameworks differ fundamentally in how they treat uncertainty.
fundamentally.zh: 这两个理论框架在处理不确定性的方式上存在根本差异。

fundamentally.en: The evidence suggests that the association is fundamentally a matter of selection rather than causation.
fundamentally.zh: 证据表明，这种关联从根本上说是选择效应而非因果效应。

fundamentally.en: Reform of assessment would not fundamentally alter incentives within the current system.
fundamentally.zh: 评估改革并不会从根本上改变现行体制内部的激励机制。

crucially.en: Crucially, the sample was drawn from a single metropolitan region.
crucially.zh: 至关重要的是，样本取自单一的都市地区。

crucially.en: Crucially, the intervention proved effective only when staff received ongoing training.
crucially.zh: 至关重要的是，只有在工作人员持续接受培训的情况下，干预才显效。

crucially.en: Interpreters must also be able to justify their readings; crucially, they should document the reasoning.
crucially.zh: 译者还必须能够为自己的解读提供依据；关键的是应当记录推理过程。

importantly.en: Importantly, the reported effect persisted after adjustment for potential confounders.
importantly.zh: 重要的是，在调整潜在混杂因素之后，所报告的效应依然存在。

importantly.en: Importantly, the policy applies to public institutions rather than to private firms.
importantly.zh: 重要的是，该政策适用于公共机构而不适用于私营企业。

importantly.en: Importantly, replication in independent laboratories remains largely outstanding.
importantly.zh: 重要的是，独立实验室中的重复验证在很大程度上仍待完成。

marginally.en: The estimates differed only marginally between the two groups after weighting.
marginally.zh: 加权处理后，两组的估计值仅存在微小差异。

marginally.en: The committee marginally revised its recommendation without altering the underlying rationale.
marginally.zh: 委员会略微修改了建议，但并未改变其基本理由。

marginally.en: The authors report a marginally significant difference and do not discuss its practical importance.
marginally.zh: 作者报告了边际显著的差异，却未讨论其实践意义。

slightly.en: Scores decreased slightly after participants were asked to perform a secondary task.
slightly.zh: 在要求参与者完成一项次要任务之后，得分略有下降。

slightly.en: The fitted curve bends slightly upward near the upper end of the range.
slightly.zh: 拟合曲线在取值范围的高端略微向上弯曲。

slightly.en: A slightly lower threshold would have excluded several borderline cases from the analysis.
slightly.zh: 阈值若略低一些，本会把若干处于边缘的案例排除在分析之外。

vastly.en: The two corpora differ vastly in size and in the range of genres represented.
vastly.zh: 这两个语料库在规模以及所涵盖的体裁范围上差异极大。

vastly.en: The revised design would improve coverage vastly more than additional procedural detail would.
vastly.zh: 修订后的设计在改善覆盖度上的作用远远大于补充程序细节。

vastly.en: Urban and rural respondents expressed vastly different expectations about service delivery.
vastly.zh: 城市与农村受访者对服务供给的期待大不相同。

highly.en: Highly trained coders achieved substantially greater agreement on the qualitative codes.
highly.zh: 经过高度训练的编码员在定性编码上达成了明显更高的一致性。

highly.en: The topic remains highly contested among scholars working on colonial history.
highly.zh: 该议题在从事殖民史研究的学者之间仍存在激烈的争议。

highly.en: Highly cited papers are not necessarily of high methodological quality.
highly.zh: 被高度引用的论文并不一定具备较高的方法学质量。

infinitely.en: The number of possible interactions is almost infinitely large in even modest models.
infinitely.zh: 即使在中等规模的模型中，可能的交互作用数量也几乎无穷无尽。

infinitely.en: The appeal of the approach lies in its infinitely flexible analytical structure.
infinitely.zh: 这一方法的吸引力在于它具有无穷灵活的分析结构。

infinitely.en: Replication remains a weaker priority than the pursuit of infinitely novel findings.
infinitely.zh: 重复验证的优先级仍低于对无穷无尽的新发现的追求。

equally.en: The two treatments produced equally strong effects across the entire sample.
equally.zh: 两种处理在整个样本中产生了同样强的效果。

equally.en: Both groups are equally entitled to appeal the committee's final decision.
equally.zh: 两个群体都有同等权利对委员会的决定提出申诉。

equally.en: Municipal investment in transport is equally important for sustained regional development.
equally.zh: 市政交通投资对区域可持续发展同样重要。

uniquely.en: The dataset is uniquely suited to studying regional income inequality across decades.
uniquely.zh: 该数据集特别适合用于研究数十年来区域收入不平等的问题。

uniquely.en: This case uniquely illustrates the limits of the existing evaluation framework.
uniquely.zh: 这一案例独特地揭示了现有评估框架的局限。

uniquely.en: Each participating region contributes uniquely to the national research program.
uniquely.zh: 每个参与地区都为全国性研究计划提供独特贡献。

nearly.en: Nearly every participant reported improved concentration after the training intervention.
nearly.zh: 几乎每一位参与者都报告说培训干预后注意力有所改善。

nearly.en: The published literature provides nearly no evidence for such a strong claim.
nearly.zh: 已发表的文献几乎未提供支持这一强主张的证据。

nearly.en: The two instruments measure nearly the same construct, so their results converge.
nearly.zh: 两套工具测量的构念几乎相同，因此结果趋于一致。

almost.en: The trial almost failed to recruit enough participants from rural hospitals.
almost.zh: 该试验险些未能从乡村医院招募到足够的参与者。

almost.en: Recovery was almost complete when the follow-up survey was administered.
almost.zh: 随访调查实施时，受试者的恢复已接近完全。

almost.en: Almost every subsector reported persistent shortages of qualified data analysts.
almost.zh: 几乎所有子行业都报告合格数据分析人员持续短缺。

thoroughly.en: The authors thoroughly reviewed the evidence on early intervention programs.
thoroughly.zh: 作者全面审查了关于早期干预项目的证据。

thoroughly.en: The records were thoroughly cleaned before they entered the statistical model.
thoroughly.zh: 这些记录在进入统计模型之前经过了彻底清理。

thoroughly.en: Thoroughly documented procedures allowed independent teams to replicate the analysis.
thoroughly.zh: 详尽记录的操作流程使独立团队得以重复该分析。

fully.en: The model fully explains the variation observed across the two counties.
fully.zh: 该模型完全解释了这两个县之间观察到的差异。

fully.en: Participants were not fully aware of the purpose of the archive search.
fully.zh: 参与者并未充分意识到档案检索的目的。

fully.en: Full replication became possible only after the analysis code was fully documented.
fully.zh: 只有在分析代码得到充分文档化之后，完全的重复研究才成为可能。

entirely.en: Responsibility for data collection lies entirely with the participating clinics.
entirely.zh: 数据收集的责任完全由参与诊所承担。

entirely.en: The new measure is entirely different from the instrument used previously.
entirely.zh: 新测量方法与此前的工具完全不同。

entirely.en: Entirely new vocabulary items were added to the standardized reading test.
entirely.zh: 标准化阅读测验中新增了全新的词汇条目。

completely.en: The absence of a control group completely undermined the causal interpretation of the results.
completely.zh: 缺乏对照组彻底削弱了对结果的因果解释。

completely.en: Urban and rural samples were completely comparable in terms of age distribution.
completely.zh: 城乡样本在年龄分布方面完全可比。

completely.en: The new reporting standard completely reshaped how journals document sampling procedures.
completely.zh: 新的报告规范彻底重塑了期刊记录抽样流程的方式。

totally.en: The two instruments are totally incompatible with the original scoring scheme.
totally.zh: 这两套工具与原有评分方案完全不相容。

totally.en: The reform did not totally eliminate the gap between urban and rural regions.
totally.zh: 该改革并未完全消除城乡地区之间的差距。

totally.en: These measures are totally inadequate for assessing long-term learning outcomes.
totally.zh: 这些测量手段完全不足以评估长期学习结果。

partially.en: The results partially support the hypothesis that early intervention reduces dropout.
partially.zh: 结果部分支持早期干预可减少辍学的假设。

partially.en: Funding was only partially restored after the audit had been completed.
partially.zh: 审计完成之后，拨款才只是部分恢复。

partially.en: The available data partially obscure the effect of training on staff retention.
partially.zh: 现有数据部分掩盖了培训对员工留任的影响。

minimally.en: The intervention had minimally affected productivity across the participating firms.
minimally.zh: 该干预对参与企业的生产率影响极小。

minimally.en: Participants received only minimally adequate training in statistical methods.
minimally.zh: 参与者只接受了最低限度的统计方法训练。

minimally.en: The policy minimally reduced the administrative burden on small businesses.
minimally.zh: 该政策仅在极小程度上减轻了小企业的行政负担。

extensively.en: The phenomenon has been extensively studied across disciplines and national settings.
extensively.zh: 该现象已在多个学科和不同国家情境中被广泛研究。

extensively.en: The coastal wetland was extensively converted into farmland during recent decades.
extensively.zh: 近几十年间，该沿海湿地被大面积改造成农田。

extensively.en: The authors extensively reviewed studies published on early childhood language acquisition.
extensively.zh: 作者广泛评述了关于幼儿语言习得的已发表研究。

systematically.en: Sampling was systematically conducted to reduce selection bias in the analysis.
systematically.zh: 抽样工作被系统地实施，以减少分析中的选择偏差。

systematically.en: The department systematically collects data on graduate employment outcomes each year.
systematically.zh: 该部门每年系统地收集毕业生就业结果数据。

systematically.en: Researchers systematically applied the screening protocol to all retrieved records.
systematically.zh: 研究者系统地对所有检索到的记录应用了筛选方案。

rigorously.en: The sampling protocol must be rigorously documented before the study begins.
rigorously.zh: 抽样方案必须在研究开始前得到严谨的记录。

rigorously.en: Two reviewers independently assessed the manuscript and rigorously questioned every citation.
rigorously.zh: 两位评审独立评阅了该手稿，并对每一条参考文献严格加以质疑。

rigorously.en: The institute rigorously audits its laboratory procedures against international standards.
rigorously.zh: 该研究所依据国际标准对其实验室流程进行严格审查。

accurately.en: The questionnaire was designed to capture working conditions accurately rather than approximately.
accurately.zh: 该问卷旨在准确而非粗略地反映工作条件。

accurately.en: Automated systems can accurately transcribe lectures provided the audio quality is sufficient.
accurately.zh: 只要录音质量合格，自动化系统便能准确转写讲座内容。

accurately.en: Cost estimates must be updated accurately before the budget is submitted for approval.
accurately.zh: 预算提交审批之前必须准确更新成本估算。

efficiently.en: The new referral system allocates scarce clinical resources more efficiently than the previous arrangement.
efficiently.zh: 新的转诊系统比此前的安排更高效地分配有限的临床资源。

efficiently.en: Administrative duplication was removed, allowing staff to process applications more efficiently each month.
efficiently.zh: 行政冗余环节被取消，工作人员因而每月都能更高效地处理申请。

efficiently.en: Remote laboratories can analyze samples efficiently when transport delays would otherwise distort results.
efficiently.zh: 在运输延迟可能扭曲结果的情况下，远程实验室能够高效地分析样本。

reliably.en: Sensors in the field must record soil moisture reliably across seasonal changes in temperature.
reliably.zh: 田间传感器必须在温度的季节性变化中稳定地记录土壤湿度。

reliably.en: Repeated surveys indicate that graduates reliably find employment within six months of completion.
reliably.zh: 多项重复调查表明，毕业生能稳定地在完成学业后六个月内找到工作。

reliably.en: The instrument was calibrated so that it reliably distinguished subtle differences in reading ability.
reliably.zh: 该量表经过校准，因而能稳定地辨别阅读能力上的细微差异。

genuinely.en: Several reviewers argued that the journal's review process is not genuinely independent.
genuinely.zh: 有几位评审认为该期刊的审稿过程并不真正独立。

genuinely.en: A genuinely collaborative project requires shared data access and common standards of documentation.
genuinely.zh: 真正协作的项目需要共享数据访问权限和统一的记录标准。

genuinely.en: The reform is genuinely popular among frontline teachers, who report reduced administrative workloads.
genuinely.zh: 该改革在一线教师中确实颇受欢迎，他们报告行政工作量有所减轻。

independently.en: Two teams independently analyzed the same dataset and reached substantially identical conclusions.
independently.zh: 两个团队独立分析了同一数据集，并得出大体一致的结论。

independently.en: Members of the commission independently reviewed the evidence before the final hearing.
independently.zh: 委员会成员在最终听证之前各自独立地审查了证据。

independently.en: Universities should independently verify the provenance of submitted data and disclosure statements.
independently.zh: 各大学应独立核实所提交数据的来源及披露声明。

universally.en: No instrument measures reading comprehension universally across languages and educational stages.
universally.zh: 在跨语言和跨学段的比较中，没有任何工具能普遍地测量阅读理解。

universally.en: The principle is universally accepted within the discipline, although its implementation varies.
universally.zh: 该原则在该学科内被普遍接受，尽管具体实施方式存在差异。

universally.en: Universally applicable standards are difficult to formulate for rapidly changing digital technologies.
universally.zh: 对于快速变化的数字技术，难以制定普遍适用的标准。

globally.en: Supply chains disrupted by the crisis recover slowly, with costs transmitted globally across multiple sectors.
globally.zh: 受危机扰动的供应链恢复缓慢，其成本在全球范围内跨多个行业传导。

globally.en: The museum's collections are globally significant, drawing scholars from many countries each year.
globally.zh: 该博物馆的藏品具有全球意义，每年吸引来自许多国家的学者。

globally.en: Climate models project that the warming trend will continue globally throughout the coming decades.
globally.zh: 气候模型预测，在未来数十年中变暖趋势将在全球范围内持续。

politically.en: The proposal is technically feasible but politically difficult to enact in the current assembly.
politically.zh: 该提案在技术上可行，但在当前议会中难以在政治上获得通过。

politically.en: Public trust in the agency weakened after the report was perceived as politically motivated.
politically.zh: 该报告被认为带有政治动机之后，公众对该机构的信任有所减弱。

politically.en: Officials who make politically consequential decisions face stricter scrutiny from independent auditors.
politically.zh: 作出具有政治后果决策的官员，面临独立审计更为严格的审查。

socially.en: The technology is socially embedded, and its diffusion cannot be explained by price alone.
socially.zh: 该技术嵌入于社会之中，其扩散不能仅以价格来解释。

socially.en: Managers must consider socially acceptable working hours when scheduling laboratory shifts.
socially.zh: 管理者在安排实验室轮班时，须考虑社会可接受的工作时段。

socially.en: The reform had a socially visible effect, since waiting times in clinics fell sharply.
socially.zh: 由于诊所候诊时间大幅下降，该改革产生了为社会所察觉的效果。

economically.en: The intervention was economically justified once the long-term savings in care were accounted for.
economically.zh: 在把长期照护节省计入之后，该干预在经济上是合理的。

economically.en: Rural households remained economically disadvantaged despite sustained growth in regional output.
economically.zh: 尽管地区产出持续增长，农村家庭在经济上仍处于不利地位。

economically.en: The reform was economically costly in the short term but yielded lasting fiscal benefits.
economically.zh: 该改革在短期内成本高昂，但带来了持久的财政收益。

technically.en: The proposal is technically sound, although implementing it requires substantial investment in training.
technically.zh: 该提案在技术上站得住脚，但实施它需要在培训上投入大量资源。

technically.en: Technically, the two devices measure different properties of the same material specimen.
technically.zh: 严格说来，这两台设备测量的是同一材料试样的不同属性。

technically.en: Some reviewers objected that the claim was technically true but of limited practical value.
technically.zh: 一些评审提出异议，认为该论断在技术上是正确的，但实际价值有限。

theoretically.en: Theoretically, the mechanism should amplify intervention effects rather than dampen them.
theoretically.zh: 从理论上看，该机制应当放大干预效果，而非抑制这些效果。

theoretically.en: The model remains theoretically coherent even though the observed coefficients are unstable.
theoretically.zh: 尽管所观察到的系数并不稳定，该模型在理论上仍保持内在一致。

theoretically.en: Theoretically possible pathways must still be tested against the available longitudinal evidence.
theoretically.zh: 理论上可能的路径，仍须以现有的纵向证据加以检验。

historically.en: Historically, the discipline has been dominated by a small number of research groups.
historically.zh: 从历史角度看，该学科长期由少数几个研究小组主导。

historically.en: The manuscript situates the reform historically, tracing its roots to earlier administrative practice.
historically.zh: 该手稿从历史维度为这场改革定位，追溯其早期行政实践的根源。

historically.en: Such patterns have historically recurred whenever fiscal pressure weakened local oversight capacity.
historically.zh: 每当财政压力削弱地方监督能力时，此类现象在历史上都会反复出现。

critically.en: The review critically assesses the assumptions underlying the dominant theoretical framework.
critically.zh: 该述评批判性地审视了主流理论框架背后的基本假设。

critically.en: The housing subsidy is critically important for low-income households in rural districts.
critically.zh: 住房补贴对农村地区的低收入家庭而言至关重要。

critically.en: Data drawn from self-reported diaries should be interpreted critically because of systematic bias.
critically.zh: 源自自我报告日记的数据存在系统性偏差，因而应加以审慎解读。

mathematically.en: The result can be proved mathematically, although its interpretation remains philosophically contested.
mathematically.zh: 该结论可在数学上得到证明，尽管其解释在学理上仍存争议。

mathematically.en: Mathematically, the growth rate equals the sum of the component rates over the same period.
mathematically.zh: 在数学上，增长率等于同一时期各分项增长率之和。

mathematically.en: It is mathematically possible to model the diffusion process as a simple random walk.
mathematically.zh: 在数学上，扩散过程可被建模为简单的随机游走。

logically.en: The two sections of the report logically follow from the assumptions stated in the introduction.
logically.zh: 报告的两个部分在逻辑上均由导言中所述假设推出。

logically.en: A logically consistent argument must address every premise on which its conclusion depends.
logically.zh: 逻辑自洽的论证必须回应其结论所依赖的每一项前提。

logically.en: Such a policy is logically inconsistent with the stated objective of reducing regional inequality.
logically.zh: 此类政策与缩小地区差距的既定目标在逻辑上并不一致。

culturally.en: The findings are culturally specific and cannot be generalized without further comparative evidence.
culturally.zh: 这些发现具有文化特异性，若无进一步比较证据则无法推广。

culturally.en: Culturally, the community regarded the festival as a marker of collective identity.
culturally.zh: 从文化上看，该社群将该节庆视为集体身份的标志。

culturally.en: Such practices remain culturally significant even after their economic function has disappeared.
culturally.zh: 即便其经济功能已经消失，此类实践仍然具有重要的文化意义。

previously.en: Previously unpublished correspondence substantially revises the accepted chronology of the reform.
previously.zh: 此前未公开的往来书信实质上修正了人们所接受的改革时间顺序。

previously.en: The institute previously employed a larger staff before the budget was restructured.
previously.zh: 在预算重组之前，该研究所的雇员规模更大。

previously.en: Estimates previously reported for the northern provinces have since been revised downward.
previously.zh: 先前报告的北部省份估计数值此后已被下调。

immediately.en: The committee immediately suspended the license pending an independent review of the records.
immediately.zh: 委员会立即暂停了该项许可，等待对档案进行独立审查。

immediately.en: Such reminders immediately reduce the incidence of duplicate submissions in online forms.
immediately.zh: 此类提示可立即减少在线表单中重复提交的情形。

immediately.en: The amendment immediately altered the eligibility criteria for admission to the program.
immediately.zh: 修正案立即改变了该项目的入学资格标准。

already.en: The preliminary results already suggest a substantial decline in reported infections.
already.zh: 初步结果已经显示出所报告的感染人数大幅下降。

already.en: Several theoretical objections to the framework have already been articulated in the literature.
already.zh: 针对该框架的若干理论异议早已在文献中得到阐述。

already.en: The revised edition already incorporates the errata circulated among contributing authors.
already.zh: 修订版已经纳入了各撰稿人之间流传的勘误。

suddenly.en: The decline in enrollment suddenly reversed after the new admission criteria took effect.
suddenly.zh: 在新的录取标准生效之后，入学人数的下降突然逆转。

suddenly.en: Publication in a leading journal suddenly raised the visibility of the paper within the field.
suddenly.zh: 在权威期刊上发表论文突然提高了该文在本领域的可见度。

suddenly.en: The apparent stability of the series suddenly collapsed once the measurement error was corrected.
suddenly.zh: 在测量误差得到校正之后，该序列表面的稳定突然崩塌。

slowly.en: Structural change in employment tends to occur slowly and becomes visible only in aggregate data.
slowly.zh: 就业结构的变迁往往缓慢发生，只有在汇总数据中才可见。

slowly.en: The sediment record indicates that the lake filled slowly over many centuries.
slowly.zh: 沉积记录表明，该湖是在许多世纪中缓慢淤积而成。

slowly.en: Regulatory agencies slowly adjusted their requirements as the pattern of regional decline became clearer.
slowly.zh: 随着地区衰退的格局日渐清晰，监管机构缓慢地调整了监管要求。

temporarily.en: The dataset was temporarily withdrawn while an inconsistency in the coding scheme was corrected.
temporarily.zh: 在编码方案的一处不一致得到纠正之前，数据集被暂时撤下。

temporarily.en: Hospitals temporarily reduced elective admissions in order to preserve capacity for emergency care.
temporarily.zh: 各医院暂时削减了选择性收治，以保留应急救治所需的收治能力。

temporarily.en: The reading room was temporarily closed while the damaged catalog was restored.
temporarily.zh: 受损的目录得到修复期间，阅览室被暂时关闭。

indefinitely.en: The grant was renewed indefinitely, which weakened the incentive to seek alternative sources of support.
indefinitely.zh: 该资助被无限期地续拨，这削弱了寻求其他支持来源的激励。

indefinitely.en: Such arrangements cannot be maintained indefinitely without eroding the quality of teaching.
indefinitely.zh: 若不牺牲教学质量，此类安排不可能无限期维持下去。

indefinitely.en: The mandate allows the agency to extend the program indefinitely without any parliamentary review.
indefinitely.zh: 该授权允许该机构无需议会审议即可无限期延长项目期限。

continuously.en: The sensors continuously record temperature and salinity throughout the water column.
continuously.zh: 传感器沿整个水柱持续记录温度与盐度。

continuously.en: Continuously rising costs have eroded the competitiveness of the manufacturing sector.
continuously.zh: 成本的持续上升削弱了制造业部门的竞争力。

continuously.en: The model was continuously updated as new observations became available from the monitoring network.
continuously.zh: 随着监测网络提供新的观测数据，该模型被持续更新。

intermittently.en: The network failed intermittently, so the researchers repeated each trial several times.
intermittently.zh: 网络间歇性地出现故障，因此研究人员将每次试验重复了数遍。

intermittently.en: Rainfall in the region falls intermittently, so crop yields vary correspondingly from year to year.
intermittently.zh: 该地区的降水间歇性地出现，因而作物产量相应地逐年波动。

intermittently.en: Support for the reform appeared intermittently in the minutes, suggesting a divided committee.
intermittently.zh: 会议记录中间歇性地出现对该改革的支持，表明委员会内部分歧明显。

spontaneously.en: The participants spontaneously raised questions once the moderator opened the floor to discussion.
spontaneously.zh: 一旦主持人开放自由讨论，参与者便自发地提出问题。

spontaneously.en: The sample crystallized spontaneously, indicating that the reaction proceeded without an external trigger.
spontaneously.zh: 样品自发地结晶，表明该反应无需外部触发即可进行。

spontaneously.en: Vegetation spontaneously recovered on abandoned plots, providing evidence of persistent seed banks.
spontaneously.zh: 废弃样地上的植被自发地恢复，为持久存在的土壤种子库提供了证据。

voluntarily.en: Respondents voluntarily completed the follow-up questionnaire, which may introduce selection bias.
voluntarily.zh: 受访者自愿填写了随访问卷，这可能引入选择偏倚。

voluntarily.en: Staff voluntarily transferred to rural clinics during the reform, easing pressure on urban hospitals.
voluntarily.zh: 改革期间，医务人员自愿转往乡村诊所，减轻了城市医院的压力。

voluntarily.en: Departments voluntarily adopted the open-data policy before the national guideline required it.
voluntarily.zh: 在国家指南出台之前，各部门便自愿采纳了开放数据政策。

intentionally.en: The authors intentionally excluded incomplete cases, which they describe in the sampling notes.
intentionally.zh: 作者有意地剔除了不完整的案例，并在抽样说明中对其加以描述。

intentionally.en: Some institutions intentionally limit laboratory hours, reducing exposure to unnecessary reagents.
intentionally.zh: 一些机构有意地缩短实验室开放时间，以减少不必要的试剂接触。

intentionally.en: Participants were not intentionally deceived, since all deception was disclosed during debriefing.
intentionally.zh: 参与者并未受到有意欺骗，因为所有欺骗情形都在事后说明环节中予以披露。

successfully.en: The team successfully replicated the experiment across four laboratories with independent samples.
successfully.zh: 该团队以独立样本在四个实验室成功重复了这项实验。

successfully.en: Interventions that successfully reduce costs rarely replicate when local conditions change.
successfully.zh: 能够成功降低成本的干预措施在本地条件变化时很少得到重复验证。

successfully.en: She successfully defended her dissertation on the economics of informal credit markets.
successfully.zh: 她成功地以非正式信贷市场的经济学为题完成了博士论文答辩。

beforehand.en: Participants were told beforehand how the results would be stored and later destroyed.
beforehand.zh: 事先已告知参与者研究结果将如何保存以及日后如何销毁。

beforehand.en: Registering hypotheses beforehand limits selective reporting of the primary outcomes.
beforehand.zh: 事先登记假设可以限制对主要结果的选择性报告。
