beforehand.en: Researchers should review the sampling frame beforehand to avoid unobserved coverage errors.
beforehand.zh: 研究人员应在事先审阅抽样框，以避免出现未观测到的覆盖误差。

afterwards.en: Participants afterwards rated the clarity of the instructions on a standard questionnaire.
afterwards.zh: 参与者事后在标准问卷上评定了说明的清晰程度。

afterwards.en: The policy was revised afterwards to incorporate concerns raised during the public consultation.
afterwards.zh: 该政策事后经过修订，以纳入公众咨询期间所提出的意见。

afterwards.en: Cost estimates were revised afterwards, and the revised figures informed the final appropriation.
afterwards.zh: 成本估算事后进行了修正，修正后的数字成为最终拨款的依据。

once.en: Once the sample reached equilibrium, the instrument recorded a stable baseline.
once.zh: 一旦样本达到平衡，仪器便记录到稳定的基线读数。

once.en: Participants were allowed to revise their answers once before the form was submitted.
once.zh: 表单提交之前，参与者有一次修改答案的机会。

once.en: The extinction event occurred once during the entire period covered by the record.
once.zh: 在记录所涵盖的整个时期内，灭绝事件仅发生过一次。

altogether.en: Altogether, the survey covered four provinces and nearly three thousand rural households.
altogether.zh: 该调查总共覆盖了四个省份和近三千户农村家庭。

altogether.en: Altogether, the evidence favors a modest effect rather than a decisive causal claim.
altogether.zh: 总体而言，证据支持一种温和的效应，而非具有决定性的因果主张。

altogether.en: Altogether, the review identified only limited evidence for the proposed mechanism.
altogether.zh: 总的说来，该综述仅为所提出的机制找到了有限的证据。

certainly.en: The pattern certainly warrants further investigation, given its implications for regional planning.
certainly.zh: 考虑到其对区域规划的影响，该模式确实值得进一步调查。

certainly.en: Early results are certainly promising, but replication remains necessary before firm conclusions.
certainly.zh: 早期结果确实令人鼓舞，但在得出确定结论之前仍需重复验证。

certainly.en: The mechanism certainly cannot be inferred from a single controlled experiment.
certainly.zh: 单一受控实验确实无法推断出该机制。

definitely.en: The two measures are definitely not interchangeable, since they capture different constructs.
definitely.zh: 这两项测量明确地不可互换，因为它们捕捉的是不同的构念。

definitely.en: Additional replication would definitely strengthen the claim, although it would also extend the timeline.
definitely.zh: 进一步的重复验证肯定会增强该主张，尽管这也会延长研究周期。

definitely.en: The presence of such a bias was definitely ruled out by a placebo comparison.
definitely.zh: 通过安慰剂对照比较，这种偏倚的存在被明确地排除了。

even.en: Even experienced reviewers missed the same error, which suggests a limitation in the design.
even.zh: 即使经验丰富的审稿人也漏掉了同一处错误，这提示该设计存在局限。

even.en: The effect appeared even after adjusting for age, education, and prior employment.
even.zh: 即使在控制年龄、教育程度与既往就业之后，该效应依然存在。

even.en: Not even the control group showed the expected change in the recorded attitudes.
even.zh: 连对照组在所记录的态度上也没有出现预期变化。

rather.en: Regulators would rather reduce compliance costs than impose stricter reporting requirements.
rather.zh: 监管者宁愿降低合规成本，也不愿施加更为严格的报告要求。

rather.en: The sample was rather small, which limits the precision of the estimated effect.
rather.zh: 样本相当小，这限制了效应估计的精度。

rather.en: I would rather revise the analysis than defend an implausible interpretation.
rather.zh: 我宁可修订分析，也不愿为一种难以置信的解释辩护。

finally.en: The replication study finally confirmed the earlier finding that moderate doses improve recall.
finally.zh: 复制研究最终证实了先前关于中等剂量可改善记忆的发现。

finally.en: After years of dispute, the committee finally issued a formal statement on the matter.
finally.zh: 经过多年的争论，委员会终于就此事发表了正式声明。

finally.en: Only after the instruments were recalibrated did the sensor readings finally stabilize within the tolerance range.
finally.zh: 只有在仪器重新校准之后，传感器读数才终于稳定在容差范围之内。

broadly.en: Both studies broadly agree that the effect persists after controlling for demographic differences.
broadly.zh: 两项研究大体一致地认为，在控制人口学差异之后该效应依然存在。

broadly.en: The proposal was broadly supported by regional authorities, although funding details remained unresolved.
broadly.zh: 该提案得到了地方当局的广泛支持，尽管资金细节仍未解决。

broadly.en: Broadly speaking, the literature treats institutional trust as a precondition for compliance.
broadly.zh: 总体而言，文献把制度信任视为遵守规定的前提条件。

as well.en: The instrument measures reading comprehension as well as vocabulary size in secondary school pupils.
as well.zh: 该工具既能测量中学生的阅读理解水平，也能测量其词汇量。

as well.en: This approach reduces dropout rates as well as lowering the cost of each assessment.
as well.zh: 这一做法既能降低辍学率，也能减少每次评估的成本。

as well.en: Critics argued that the sample excluded rural households as well as very young children.
as well.zh: 批评者指出，该样本既排除了农村家庭，也排除了年龄极小的儿童。

at least.en: Participants completed at least three practice trials before the experimental block began.
at least.zh: 参与者在实验区组开始之前至少完成三次练习试次。

at least.en: The review found at least a dozen studies reporting a similar association in clinical cohorts.
at least.zh: 该综述发现至少有十余项研究在临床队列中报告了类似的关联。

at least.en: A reading age of at least eleven was required for entry into the longitudinal program.
at least.zh: 进入该纵向项目的条件是阅读年龄至少达到十一岁。

at most.en: Each respondent was allowed at most two questions in the follow-up interview.
at most.zh: 每位受访者在后续访谈中最多只能提出两个问题。

at most.en: The intervention may increase the sample at most by a small margin in rural districts.
at most.zh: 该干预措施至多只能使农村地区的样本小幅增加。

at most.en: Such a model would explain at most a modest share of the observed variation in attainment.
at most.zh: 这样的模型至多只能解释学业表现中已观测到的一小部分变异。

on the contrary.en: On the contrary, the follow-up survey found no evidence of the reported decline in engagement.
on the contrary.zh: 恰恰相反，后续调查并未发现所报道的参与度下降的证据。

on the contrary.en: The two traditions are not merely different; on the contrary, they imply incompatible standards of evidence.
on the contrary.zh: 这两种传统并非仅仅不同，恰恰相反，它们预设了互不相容的证据标准。

on the contrary.en: The policy did not merely fail to improve outcomes; on the contrary, it widened existing inequalities.
on the contrary.zh: 该政策不仅未能改善结果，恰恰相反，它还扩大了既有的不平等。

above all.en: Above all, the design must ensure that participants can withdraw without any penalty.
above all.zh: 最重要的是，实验设计必须确保参与者能够不受任何惩罚地退出。

above all.en: Above all, the report emphasizes the need for independent replication of its central claim.
above all.zh: 最重要的是，该报告强调需要对其核心论断进行独立的重复验证。

above all.en: The committee's recommendation reflects, above all, a concern for equitable access to public services.
above all.zh: 该委员会的建议首要地体现了对公共服务公平可及的关切。

after all.en: The intervention was modest, and after all it addressed a problem that had persisted for decades.
after all.zh: 该干预措施幅度有限，但它毕竟应对的是一个延续数十年的问题。

after all.en: After all, a measure of agreement is preferable to a prolonged dispute over terminology.
after all.zh: 毕竟，达成一定程度的共识总比围绕术语长期争论要好。

after all.en: It is unreasonable to dismiss the theory; after all, it accounts for a substantial share of the data.
after all.zh: 把这一理论弃置一旁是不合理的，毕竟它解释了数据中相当大的一部分。

if.en: If the sample size is insufficient, the estimator will produce misleadingly narrow confidence intervals.
if.zh: 如果样本量不足，估计量将产生具有误导性的过窄置信区间。

if.en: The grant can be renewed only if the investigators submit a detailed data management plan.
if.zh: 只有在研究者提交详细的数据管理计划时，该资助才能获得续期。

if.en: Replication remains difficult if raw materials and protocols are not publicly archived.
if.zh: 如果原始材料与实验方案未公开存档，重复验证仍然难以实现。

than.en: A longitudinal design yields stronger evidence than a single cross-sectional survey of attitudes.
than.zh: 纵向设计所获证据比单次的横断面态度调查更为有力。

than.en: Participants who received feedback performed better than those who received none.
than.zh: 获得反馈的参与者表现优于未获得反馈的参与者。

than.en: The revised scale was easier to administer than the earlier instrument had been.
than.zh: 修订后的量表比先前的工具更易于施测。

as.en: As the longitudinal dataset grows, estimates of regional inequality become progressively more stable.
as.zh: 随着纵向数据集的扩充，地区不平等的估计值逐渐趋于稳定。

as.en: As testing conditions changed over the decade, earlier scores cannot be directly compared with later ones.
as.zh: 由于十年间测试条件发生了变化，早期的分数无法与后期分数直接比较。

as.en: The gradient persisted as enrollment expanded into more rural districts across the region.
as.zh: 随着招生范围扩展到该地区更多的农村学区，这一梯度依然存在。

then.en: If the estimates converge, then the model can be accepted as an adequate description.
then.zh: 如果各项估计彼此收敛，那么该模型可以被接受为一种充分的描述。

then.en: The policy failed; then, what remained was to explain why implementation had diverged from design.
then.zh: 该政策失败了，那么剩下的便是解释为何执行偏离了原设计。

then.en: Suppose the estimates agree; then the conclusion is robust to a reasonable range of specifications.
then.zh: 假设各项估计彼此一致，那么结论对于合理范围内的模型设定是稳健的。

when.en: When the control variables were included, the association between exposure and outcome weakened substantially.
when.zh: 当纳入控制变量之后，暴露与结果之间的关联明显减弱。

when.en: Researchers must document when and why participants were excluded from the final analysis.
when.zh: 研究者必须说明参与者何时以及为何被排除在最终分析之外。

when.en: The reform was introduced when fiscal conditions made gradual adjustment politically feasible.
when.zh: 该改革是在财政条件使渐进调整在政治上变得可行之时引入的。

whenever.en: Whenever the sample size fell below the threshold, the analysis was repeated with a larger dataset.
whenever.zh: 凡样本量低于阈值，均须以更大的数据集重新开展分析。

whenever.en: The policy requires transparent reporting whenever a conflict of interest arises in the review process.
whenever.zh: 该政策要求，一旦审查过程中出现利益冲突，就必须作出透明披露。

whenever.en: Whenever possible, the researchers anonymized records before the data were released for secondary analysis.
whenever.zh: 在条件允许的情况下，研究人员在数据发布以供二次分析之前先行匿名化处理。

wherever.en: Wherever the sample originates, the same coding protocol must be applied without exception.
wherever.zh: 无论样本来自何处，均须无一例外地适用同一套编码方案。

wherever.en: The committee insisted that documentation accompany the findings wherever the work was subsequently published.
wherever.zh: 委员会坚持认为，无论研究成果日后在何处发表，相关文献都必须随附于结论。

wherever.en: Wherever the survey was administered, respondents reported similar levels of institutional trust.
wherever.zh: 无论调查在何地开展，受访者所报告的机构信任水平都相近。

whichever.en: Whichever treatment was assigned first, the recovery trajectories remained statistically indistinguishable across groups.
whichever.zh: 无论先行分配何种处理条件，各组的康复轨迹在统计上均难以区分。

whichever.en: The auditors examined whichever records the institutions deemed relevant to the reported discrepancies.
whichever.zh: 审计人员核查了各机构认为与所报告差异相关的各种记录。

whichever.en: Whichever model the committee finally adopted, it would require a formal review within the following year.
whichever.zh: 无论委员会最终采纳何种模型，均须在随后一年内接受正式评审。

whatever.en: Whatever the initial estimate, the revised analysis narrowed the confidence interval considerably.
whatever.zh: 无论最初的估计值如何，修正后的分析都大幅收窄了置信区间。

whatever.en: The regulation applies to whatever documentation a sponsor submits in support of a licensing application.
whatever.zh: 该规章适用于申办方为支持许可申请而提交的任何文件。

whatever.en: Whatever methodological objections the reviewers raise, the underlying data remain available for independent reanalysis.
whatever.zh: 无论评审者提出何种方法学质疑，底层数据仍可供独立重新分析。

whoever.en: Whoever conducts the interviews must record the consent procedure before any question is put.
whoever.zh: 无论由谁主持访谈，均须在提问之前如实记录知情同意程序。

whoever.en: The rule protects the identity of whoever reported the misconduct through the internal grievance channel.
whoever.zh: 该规定保护通过内部申诉渠道举报不当行为者的身份信息。

whoever.en: Whoever holds the dissenting view is entitled to have the minutes record the disagreement.
whoever.zh: 无论持异议者为何人，均有权要求会议记录在案以载明分歧。

lest.en: The archives restricted access lest the unpublished correspondence be damaged by handling.
lest.zh: 档案室限制查阅，以免未公开的通信资料在翻阅中受损。

lest.en: Sampling was suspended lest the disturbance of nesting birds should bias the counts.
lest.zh: 调查取样一度中止，以免对筑巢鸟类的惊扰使计数结果产生偏倚。

lest.en: Records are sealed lest early disclosure compromise the integrity of the subsequent inquiry.
lest.zh: 相关记录予以封存，以免过早披露损害后续调查的公正性。

nor.en: The respondents were not asked about income, nor were they required to disclose their employment status.
nor.zh: 调查并未询问受访者的收入，也未要求其披露就业状况。

nor.en: Neither the review panel nor the funding agency accepted the revised estimate as sufficiently robust.
nor.zh: 评审委员会与资助机构均不认为修正后的估计值足够稳健。

nor.en: The intervention had no measurable effect, nor did it reduce the reported symptom severity in follow-up.
nor.zh: 该项干预没有可测量的效果，在随访中也未减轻所报告的症状严重程度。

neither.en: Neither the control nor the experimental group showed a significant change in the primary outcome.
neither.zh: 控制组与实验组在主要结局指标上均未出现显著变化。

neither.en: Neither the qualitative interviews nor the archival records were sufficient to establish the sequence of events.
neither.zh: 无论是定性访谈还是档案记录，都不足以确立事件的先后顺序。

neither.en: Neither the authors nor the reviewers acknowledged the methodological limitations discussed at the workshop.
neither.zh: 作者与评审者均未承认研讨会上所讨论的方法学局限。

as if.en: The revised procedure proceeded as if the earlier calibration error had never been detected by the committee.
as if.zh: 修订后的程序照常推进，仿佛此前的校准误差从未被委员会察觉。

as if.en: Participants reported feeling orientated, as if the spatial layout of the campus were familiar to them.
as if.zh: 参与者表示感到方向明确，仿佛校园的空间布局对他们而言十分熟悉。

as if.en: The subsequent discussion unfolded as if the disputed results had been presented in an earlier draft.
as if.zh: 随后的讨论按部就班地展开，仿佛存在争议的结果曾出现在早前的草稿之中。

as well as.en: The index combines lexical frequency lists as well as learner corpus data from several institutions.
as well as.zh: 该词表索引综合了词汇频率表以及来自若干教学机构的学习者语料数据。

as well as.en: Graduate training should develop disciplinary breadth as well as deep methodological competence.
as well as.zh: 研究生培养既要拓展学科视野，也要夯筑扎实的方法学专门能力。

as well as.en: The revised framework treats statistical literacy as well as ethical judgment as core professional competencies.
as well as.zh: 修订后的框架将统计素养与伦理判断一并视为核心职业能力。

as far as.en: As far as the available records indicate, the program had no formal evaluation component.
as far as.zh: 就现有档案所能显示的情况而言，该项目并无正式的评估环节。

as far as.en: The model improves accuracy as far as the training data reflect the target population.
as far as.zh: 只要训练数据能够反映目标人群，该模型的准确度便会提高。

as far as.en: As far as the evidence goes, the association cannot be interpreted causally.
as far as.zh: 就现有证据而言，这一关联不能作因果解读。

no matter.en: No matter how the categories are defined, the overall distribution of responses remained remarkably stable.
no matter.zh: 无论类别如何界定，回答的总体分布都保持着异常的稳定。

no matter.en: The findings cannot be interpreted correctly no matter which statistical package reproduces the reported figures.
no matter.zh: 无论以何种统计软件复现所报告的数据，其结论都无法得到正确解读。

no matter.en: No matter the disciplinary origin of the reviewer, the evaluation criteria were applied identically across submissions.
no matter.zh: 无论评审者出自何种学科背景，评价标准在各份投稿中均获同等适用。

even so.en: Even so, the underlying mechanism remains poorly characterized in the available literature.
even so.zh: 即便如此，其内在机制在现有文献中仍缺乏充分的刻画。

even so.en: Even so, the committee recommended that the sampling frame be revised before the next wave of fieldwork.
even so.zh: 即便如此，委员会仍建议在下一轮田野调查之前修订抽样框。

even so.en: Even so, the reported decline in response rates cannot be attributed solely to the redesigned questionnaire.
even so.zh: 即便如此，回收率下降这一报告结果也不能仅仅归因于问卷的重新设计。

in case.en: Samples were stored in sealed containers in case contamination occurred during transport.
in case.zh: 样本被储存在密封容器中，以防在运输过程中发生污染。

in case.en: The protocol requires a written record in case the ethics committee requests further documentation.
in case.zh: 研究方案要求保留书面记录，以备伦理委员会要求补充材料时查验。

in case.en: Researchers should carry spare reagents in case equipment failure interrupts the experimental sequence.
in case.zh: 研究人员应携带备用的试剂，以防设备故障打断实验流程。

now that.en: Now that the baseline data have been collected, the analysis can proceed to the next phase.
now that.zh: 既然基线数据已经收集完毕，分析工作即可进入下一阶段。

now that.en: Now that peer review has been completed, the editors have released the accepted manuscript for publication.
now that.zh: 既然同行评审已经完成，编辑便放行已录用的稿件以供发表。

now that.en: Now that international cooperation has been established, the survey will cover institutions across the region.
now that.zh: 既然国际合作已经建立起来，这项调查将覆盖该地区的各类机构。

as soon as.en: The software notifies the reviewer as soon as a new version of the dataset becomes available.
as soon as.zh: 数据集的新版本一经发布，软件即会通知审阅人。

as soon as.en: Grant applications must be submitted as soon as the funding cycle opens in early spring.
as soon as.zh: 资助申请必须在春季资助周期启动后立即提交。

as soon as.en: The team will replicate the experiment as soon as the required laboratory space is allocated.
as soon as.zh: 所需的实验室空间一经分配，团队就会复现该实验。

in order that.en: The protocol was revised in order that participants could withdraw consent without penalty.
in order that.zh: 研究方案经过修订，以便参与者可以无惩罚地撤回同意。

in order that.en: Sample sizes were increased in order that the confidence intervals would remain stable across subgroups.
in order that.zh: 样本量得以增加，以使各亚组之间的置信区间保持稳定。

in order that.en: The researchers recorded every deviation in order that the analysis could be replicated independently.
in order that.zh: 研究人员记录下每一次偏离，以便该分析能够被独立复现。

supposing.en: Supposing that the treatment reduces mortality, the trial could be shortened without loss of validity.
supposing.zh: 倘若该干预措施确实降低死亡率，试验即可缩短而不损及效度。

supposing.en: Supposing the grant is approved, the laboratory will recruit two additional research assistants next term.
supposing.zh: 假设该项资助获得批准，实验室将在下学期增聘两名研究助理。

supposing.en: Supposing that early findings hold, a larger multi-site study would appear justified.
supposing.zh: 倘若早期结论成立，开展一项规模更大的多中心研究便显得合理。

assuming.en: Assuming the sample remains representative, the estimates should generalize to the wider population.
assuming.zh: 假定样本仍具代表性，这些估计应当可以推及更广泛的人口总体。

assuming.en: Assuming that measurement error is random, the resulting bias would mainly reduce statistical power.
assuming.zh: 假定测量误差是随机的，由此产生的偏倚主要会降低统计功效。

assuming.en: Assuming that grants continue at current levels, the program cannot expand beyond existing capacity.
assuming.zh: 假定资助维持现有水平，该项目便无法在现有承载能力之外继续扩展。

adopt.en: The committee adopted a revised protocol after reviewing the pilot data.
adopt.zh: 委员会审阅试点数据后采纳了修订后的研究方案。

adopt.en: Many universities have adopted open access policies to broaden dissemination of research findings.
adopt.zh: 许多大学已采纳开放获取政策，以扩大研究成果的传播范围。

adopt.en: The couple decided to adopt a child from the public foster care system.
adopt.zh: 这对夫妇决定从公共寄养体系中收养一名儿童。

administer.en: A trained researcher administered the questionnaire to each participant in a private room.
administer.zh: 一名受过专门训练的研究人员在独立房间内向每位受访者发放问卷。

administer.en: The agency administers the national program for student financial aid.
administer.zh: 该机构负责实施全国学生助学项目。

administer.en: The same dose was administered intravenously under close clinical supervision.
administer.zh: 在严密临床监护下以静脉方式给药，剂量与前次相同。

advise.en: The panel advised the ministry to revise the draft regulation before its adoption.
advise.zh: 专家小组建议主管部门在草案通过之前先行修订。

advise.en: Several senior colleagues advised her to seek a second opinion from the specialist.
advise.zh: 几位资深同事建议她向该领域专家再行请教。

advise.en: The supervisor advised the committee of the change in research protocol.
advise.zh: 指导教师就研究方案的变动向委员会作了通报。

affiliate.en: Several departments affiliated themselves with the newly established center for interdisciplinary research.
affiliate.zh: 若干院系挂靠新组建的跨学科研究中心。

affiliate.en: The ministry required private testing centers to affiliate with an accredited national body.
affiliate.zh: 主管部门要求各私营检测机构隶属一家经认证的国家机构。

affiliate.en: Two research teams affiliated their archives with the national library to improve long-term access.
affiliate.zh: 两个研究团队将各自的档案挂靠国家图书馆，以改善长期取用条件。

anticipate.en: Researchers anticipated that the reform would reduce delays in the review of grant proposals.
anticipate.zh: 研究人员预期该项改革将缩短科研基金申请的评审周期。

anticipate.en: We anticipate substantial variation in reading times across the sample of adult learners.
anticipate.zh: 我们预计成年学习者样本在阅读时长上存在显著差异。

anticipate.en: The conference proceedings were released earlier than the organizers had anticipated.
anticipate.zh: 会议文集的发布时间早于组织者的预期。

authenticate.en: The archive employs a cryptographic protocol to authenticate each digital record.
authenticate.zh: 该档案馆采用加密协议对每一份数字记录进行认证。

authenticate.en: The laboratory authenticates the provenance of samples before reporting their isotopic values.
authenticate.zh: 实验室在报告同位素数值之前对样本来源加以鉴别。

authenticate.en: Historians authenticate manuscripts by comparing inks, seals and scribal conventions.
authenticate.zh: 历史学者通过比较墨迹、印章与书写习惯来鉴别手稿真伪。

capture.en: The questionnaire was designed to capture variation in students' prior exposure to academic writing.
capture.zh: 问卷的设计旨在捕捉学生先前学术写作接触程度的差异。

capture.en: The camera captured the onset of the storm as it crossed the valley.
capture.zh: 摄像机记录下风暴越过河谷时的初始景象。

capture.en: The special issue captured a wide range of methodological approaches to the study of bilingualism.
capture.zh: 该专刊广泛汇集了双语研究中多种多样的方法路径。

classify.en: Researchers classify responses according to the level of agreement reported by participants.
classify.zh: 研究者依据受访者所报告的认同程度对作答进行归类。

classify.en: Taxonomists classify organisms by shared morphological traits rather than by superficial resemblance.
classify.zh: 分类学家依据共同的形态特征而非表面相似性对生物加以分类。

classify.en: The commission would classify the country as a high-income economy with rapid growth.
classify.zh: 该委员会将把该国归类为高收入且增长迅速的经济体。

conceive.en: The team conceived the study as a response to recurring gaps in published evidence.
conceive.zh: 该团队将这项研究设想为对已发表证据中反复出现的空白的回应。

conceive.en: It is difficult to conceive of a reform that would satisfy all stakeholders.
conceive.zh: 很难设想出一项能够满足所有利益相关方诉求的改革。

conceive.en: She conceived the framework after reviewing archival records from earlier decades.
conceive.zh: 她在审阅了此前数十年的档案记录之后构想出这一框架。

concur.en: Most reviewers concur that the sampling strategy limits the strength of the conclusions.
concur.zh: 多数评审者一致认为抽样策略限制了结论的效力。

concur.en: The committee concurred with the recommendation of the independent review panel.
concur.zh: 委员会同意独立评审小组提出的建议。

concur.en: Three separate surveys concur in their conclusion that rural schools face persistent shortages.
concur.zh: 三项彼此独立的调查得出相同结论，认为农村学校持续面临资源短缺。

conform.en: The revised protocol must conform to the ethical guidelines issued by the review board.
conform.zh: 修订后的方案必须符合审查委员会发布的伦理准则。

conform.en: The measurement scale conformed closely to the structure proposed in the original theoretical framework.
conform.zh: 该测量量表与原始理论框架所提出的结构高度吻合。

conform.en: Newly hired staff were expected to conform to the department's standards of academic writing.
conform.zh: 新入职的教职人员应当符合该院系对学术写作的规范要求。

consist.en: The final sample consists of graduate students enrolled in several disciplines.
consist.zh: 最终样本由来自若干学科的在校研究生构成。

consist.en: The difficulty of the task consists in the ambiguity of the instructions.
consist.zh: 该任务的难点在于指令表述的含糊性。

consist.en: The committee consists of senior scholars and representatives of the participating institutions.
consist.zh: 委员会由资深学者和各参与机构的代表组成。

convey.en: The abstract should convey the main finding without overstating its significance.
convey.zh: 摘要应当传达主要发现而不得夸大其意义。

convey.en: Nonverbal cues such as tone and posture convey meaning that words alone cannot capture.
convey.zh: 语调与体态等非言语线索传达出单纯依靠言语无法获取的意义。

convey.en: Pipelines convey crude oil from the producing region to coastal refineries.
convey.zh: 管道将原油从产区输送到沿海炼油厂。

cultivate.en: Universities cultivate the reading habits that underpin lifelong academic engagement.
cultivate.zh: 大学培养支撑终身学术投入的阅读习惯。

cultivate.en: She cultivated a disciplined writing routine through regular practice and feedback.
cultivate.zh: 她通过规律练习与反馈养成了一套严谨的写作习惯。

cultivate.en: The region cultivated rice on terraced fields that follow the contour of the valley.
cultivate.zh: 该地区在沿河谷等高线修筑的梯田上种植水稻。

dedicate.en: The research team dedicated the remaining months to refining the survey instrument.
dedicate.zh: 研究团队把余下的几个月全部投入到问卷工具的完善之中。

dedicate.en: This volume is dedicated to all those who sustained the project through difficult years.
dedicate.zh: 本卷献给所有在艰难岁月里支撑这一项目的人。

dedicate.en: The foundation dedicated its resources to rural literacy programs rather than urban infrastructure.
dedicate.zh: 该基金会将资源用于农村扫盲项目，而非城市基础设施建设。

depict.en: Recent studies depict the relationship between bilingualism and executive control as bidirectional.
depict.zh: 近期研究把双语能力与执行控制之间的关系描绘为双向的。

depict.en: The report depicts rural households as primary caregivers within the extended family structure.
depict.zh: 该报告把农村家庭描绘为扩展型家庭结构中的主要照料者。

depict.en: Archaeological evidence from the site depicts a trading settlement of considerable complexity.
depict.zh: 来自该遗址的考古证据描绘出一个相当复杂的贸易聚落。

displace.en: Automation displaced many routine clerical jobs within the banking sector.
displace.zh: 自动化取代了银行业中许多常规的文书岗位。

displace.en: Rising rents displaced long-established families from the inner urban districts.
displace.zh: 不断上涨的租金迫使长期居住的家庭迁出城市内城区。

displace.en: New evidence has displaced the earlier account of how the species dispersed.
displace.zh: 新的证据已取代了先前关于该物种扩散过程的说法。

emerge.en: A clear pattern emerged from the interview data once the coding process was completed.
emerge.zh: 在编码过程完成之后，访谈数据中呈现出清晰的模式。

emerge.en: The dispute emerged when the ministry published revised allocation figures without prior consultation.
emerge.zh: 当主管部门未经事先协商便公布修订后的分配数据时，这场争议浮现出来。

emerge.en: New forms of collective action emerged across several districts during the following winter.
emerge.zh: 在随后的冬季，若干地区涌现出新的集体行动形式。

intensify.en: Governments may intensify the effect of public spending through better administrative targeting.
intensify.zh: 政府可以通过更精准的行政投放来加强公共支出的效果。

intensify.en: Competition for scarce grants tends to intensify once the funding pool is reduced.
intensify.zh: 一旦资金池缩减，对稀缺资助的竞争便会加剧。

intensify.en: Regulators intensify their scrutiny when reported cases of misconduct become more frequent.
intensify.zh: 当被报告的不当行为案例增多时，监管者会加强审查。

incur.en: Farmers who neglected soil conservation incurred substantial losses during the subsequent drought.
incur.zh: 忽视土壤保持的农户在随后的干旱中遭受了巨大损失。

incur.en: Any applicant who withdraws late will incur the full processing fee.
incur.zh: 任何逾期撤回的申请人都将被收取全额手续费。

incur.en: The hospital incurred substantial costs in training staff on the newly introduced protocol.
incur.zh: 该医院为培训员工掌握新引入的操作规程承担了大量成本。

portray.en: The documentary portrays rural teachers as central to the reform of local schooling.
portray.zh: 这部纪录片把乡村教师刻画为当地学校教育改革的核心。

portray.en: Novels of the period portray the factory as a source of both discipline and menace.
portray.zh: 这一时期的小说把工厂表现为既是纪律之源，也是威胁之源。

portray.en: Public-health campaigns portray excessive sugar intake as a leading dietary risk.
portray.zh: 公共卫生宣传把过量摄入糖分表现为主要的膳食风险。

stipulate.en: The grant agreement stipulates that all data must be deposited in an open archive.
stipulate.zh: 资助协议明确规定，所有数据必须存入一个开放档案库。

stipulate.en: Contractual rules stipulate a minimum notice period before any major restructuring.
stipulate.zh: 合同条款规定，任何重大重组之前必须遵守最短通知期的规定。

stipulate.en: Reviewers stipulate that authors must declare all potential sources of conflict.
stipulate.zh: 评审人要求作者必须申报一切潜在的利益冲突来源。

stress.en: The introduction stresses the need to distinguish correlation from causal inference.
stress.zh: 引言强调必须区分相关性与因果推断。

stress.en: The minister stressed the need for transparent reporting of regional differences.
stress.zh: 部长着重指出有必要对地区差异进行透明报告。

stress.en: Reviewers stress that the effect remains substantial after the sample is reduced.
stress.zh: 评审人强调，在缩减样本之后该效应依然相当显著。

weaken.en: The robustness checks did not weaken the main conclusion of the analysis.
weaken.zh: 稳健性检验并未削弱该分析的主要结论。

weaken.en: Rising competition weakened the authority of the traditional regulating body.
weaken.zh: 日益激烈的竞争削弱了传统监管机构的权威。

weaken.en: Repeated revisions of the instrument weakened its construct validity over time.
weaken.zh: 对该工具的反复修订逐渐削弱了它的构念效度。

ambiguity.en: The ambiguity of the term prevented reviewers from reaching a shared interpretation.
ambiguity.zh: 该术语的含混之处使评审人无法达成一致的解读。

ambiguity.en: Ambiguity in the coding guidelines led two coders to assign different labels.
ambiguity.zh: 编码指南中的歧义导致两名编码者给出了不同的标注。

ambiguity.en: Policy documents should avoid ambiguity whenever enforcement depends on precise wording.
ambiguity.zh: 凡是执法依赖于精确措辞的场合，政策文件都应当避免歧义。

component.en: Each component of the scale was validated against an established external criterion.
component.zh: 该量表的每一个成分都对照已有的外部效标进行了验证。

component.en: The model combines several components, including demography and institutional trust.
component.zh: 该模型结合了若干组成部分，包括人口统计特征与制度信任。

component.en: Researchers replaced a component of the index after a factor analysis revealed redundancy.
component.zh: 在因子分析显示存在冗余之后，研究者替换了该指数中的一个成分。

consequence.en: The long-term consequence of early vocabulary instruction remains a matter of debate.
consequence.zh: 早期词汇教学的长期后果仍是一个存在争议的问题。

consequence.en: Policy makers underestimated the consequence of withdrawing subsidies from small farms.
consequence.zh: 决策者低估了取消对小型农场补贴所造成的后果。

consequence.en: A consequence of the sampling design was that older respondents were underrepresented.
consequence.zh: 抽样设计带来的一项后果是年长受访者代表不足。

construction.en: The construction of the case study required access to archival and interview data.
construction.zh: 该案例研究的建构需要获取档案资料与访谈资料。

construction.en: The meaning of the term is largely a construction of disciplinary discourse.
construction.zh: 该术语的含义在很大程度上是学科话语的建构。

construction.en: The construction of the survey instrument was revised after a pilot study revealed redundancy.
construction.zh: 在先导研究显示存在冗余之后，问卷工具的构造经过了修订。

consumption.en: Researchers estimated household consumption using repeated survey data collected across several regions.
consumption.zh: 研究人员利用多地收集的重复调查数据估计了家庭消费水平。

consumption.en: The agency reduced its own consumption of paper by requiring digital reporting throughout the department.
consumption.zh: 该机构通过要求全部门使用数字化报告，减少了自身的纸张消耗。

consumption.en: Rising consumption of imported grain placed considerable pressure on the domestic agricultural sector.
consumption.zh: 进口谷物消费量的上升给国内农业部门带来了相当大的压力。

cooperation.en: The findings suggest that cooperation between disciplines produces more robust conclusions than isolated effort.
cooperation.zh: 研究结果表明，跨学科合作比各自孤立努力更能得出稳健的结论。

cooperation.en: Regional authorities extended cooperation to share monitoring data during the outbreak investigation.
cooperation.zh: 地方当局在疫情调查期间扩大合作范围，共享监测数据。

cooperation.en: Such cooperation depends on clear institutional incentives and sustained funding across the participating agencies.
cooperation.zh: 此类合作取决于清晰的制度激励以及参与机构之间持续的经费支持。

controversy.en: The methodology has generated considerable controversy among practitioners of the discipline.
controversy.zh: 这一方法在该领域的从业者中引起了相当大的争议。

controversy.en: The controversy was settled only after the raw data were released for independent scrutiny.
controversy.zh: 只有在原始数据被公开以供独立审查之后，这场争议才得以平息。

controversy.en: Political controversy surrounding the regulation delayed its implementation for several months.
controversy.zh: 围绕该法规的政治争议使其推迟实施数月。

density.en: Population density explains only part of the variation observed across the sampled districts.
density.zh: 人口密度只能解释各抽样地区之间所观察到差异的一部分。

density.en: Regulators required developers to limit housing density near existing transport infrastructure.
density.zh: 监管机构要求开发商限制现有交通基础设施附近的住房密度。

density.en: Higher tree density reduced surface temperatures along the urban streets during the summer months.
density.zh: 更高的树木密度降低了夏季城市街道的地表温度。

depth.en: Interview depth improved the validity of the qualitative analysis considerably.
depth.zh: 访谈深度显著提升了定性分析的效度。

depth.en: The study examines the depth of cooperation between public agencies and local communities.
depth.zh: 该研究考察了公共机构与地方社区合作深入的程度。

depth.en: Hydrographic surveys recorded the depth of the channel along its entire navigable reach.
depth.zh: 水文测量记录了航道可通航河段沿线的深度。

detection.en: Earlier detection of the disease substantially improved the survival rate of treated patients.
detection.zh: 更早的疾病检出显著提高了接受治疗患者的存活率。

detection.en: Regulations require the detection of hazardous materials before construction begins in the area.
detection.zh: 法规要求在该地区施工开始前检出危险材料。

detection.en: The method allows rapid detection of small concentrations of contaminants in drinking water.
detection.zh: 该方法能够快速检出饮用水中微量的污染物。

duration.en: The duration of the interview was limited to prevent fatigue among older participants.
duration.zh: 访谈的持续时间受到限制，以防年长参与者产生疲劳。

duration.en: Attention must be paid to the duration of each treatment phase in the clinical protocol.
duration.zh: 必须关注临床方案中每个治疗阶段的持续时间。

duration.en: A longer duration of follow-up would have strengthened the evidence for the causal claim.
duration.zh: 更长的随访持续时间本可加强支持因果主张的证据。

ecology.en: Wetland ecology provides breeding habitat for numerous migratory bird species.
ecology.zh: 湿地生态为众多候鸟物种提供了繁殖栖息地。

ecology.en: The policy seeks to restore the ecology of rivers degraded by decades of industrial discharge.
ecology.zh: 该政策旨在恢复因数十年工业排放而退化的河流生态。

ecology.en: Ecological knowledge held by local farmers remains valuable for understanding regional ecology.
ecology.zh: 当地农民所掌握的生态知识对于理解区域生态仍然具有价值。

epidemiology.en: Modern epidemiology relies on longitudinal cohorts to identify causal relationships between exposure and disease.
epidemiology.zh: 现代流行病学依赖纵向队列来识别暴露与疾病之间的因果关系。

epidemiology.en: The department of epidemiology coordinates surveillance across regional hospitals and clinics.
epidemiology.zh: 流行病学部门协调各地区医院与诊所的监测工作。

epidemiology.en: Developments in molecular epidemiology reshaped the understanding of the outbreak's transmission pattern.
epidemiology.zh: 分子流行病学的发展重塑了对该疫情传播模式的理解。

equilibrium.en: The model assumes that the system quickly returns to equilibrium after a small disturbance.
equilibrium.zh: 该模型假定系统在小扰动之后会迅速回到均衡状态。

equilibrium.en: Fiscal rules are designed to maintain equilibrium between revenue and public expenditure over the cycle.
equilibrium.zh: 财政规则旨在维持整个经济周期内收入与公共支出之间的均衡。

equilibrium.en: Ecological equilibrium was disrupted when the invasive species spread throughout the river basin.
equilibrium.zh: 当入侵物种蔓延至整个流域时，生态平衡被打破。

equivalence.en: The study tests the equivalence of two measurement instruments across different populations.
equivalence.zh: 该研究检验了两种测量工具在不同人群中的等效性。

equivalence.en: Legal scholars dispute the equivalence of commercial arbitration and ordinary litigation.
equivalence.zh: 法学学者对商事仲裁与普通诉讼的等同性存在争议。

equivalence.en: No empirical basis establishes the equivalence of these two competing theoretical accounts.
equivalence.zh: 并无经验基础能够确立这两种相互竞争的理论解释之间的对等性。

essence.en: The essence of the argument lies in its treatment of historical context.
essence.zh: 该论证的实质在于其对历史语境的处理。

essence.en: Participants were asked to identify the essence of the problem before proposing solutions.
essence.zh: 参与者被要求在提出解决方案之前厘清问题的本质。

essence.en: Understanding the essence of this debate requires careful reading of the original correspondence.
essence.zh: 理解这场争论的精髓需要仔细阅读原始往来信件。

exclusion.en: Exclusion criteria were applied before enrollment to ensure a homogeneous analytical sample.
exclusion.zh: 在入组前设定排除标准，以确保分析样本的同质性。

exclusion.en: Social exclusion of migrants remains a serious concern for urban policy planners.
exclusion.zh: 移民遭受社会排斥仍是城市政策规划者所关切的重要问题。

exclusion.en: The exclusion of unusable records slightly reduced the statistical power of the analysis.
exclusion.zh: 剔除不可用记录略微降低了该分析的统计效力。

expectation.en: Participants' expectations about the purpose of the study were recorded before data collection began.
expectation.zh: 参与者对该研究目的的预期在数据收集开始之前即被记录下来。

expectation.en: Current evidence falls short of the expectation that the treatment will prove broadly effective.
expectation.zh: 现有证据未能达到该治疗将被证明普遍有效这一预期。

expectation.en: Contrary to widespread expectation, the reform produced no measurable change in regional inequality.
expectation.zh: 与普遍预期相反，该改革未对地区不平等产生可测量的变化。

expenditure.en: The study reports a substantial expenditure on laboratory equipment over the reporting period.
expenditure.zh: 该研究报告了报告期内用于实验室设备的大量支出。

expenditure.en: Reducing public expenditure requires careful targeting of subsidies toward vulnerable households.
expenditure.zh: 削减公共开支需要谨慎地将补贴定向投放至脆弱家庭。

expenditure.en: Expenditure on preventive care produces long-term savings in acute hospital admissions.
expenditure.zh: 在预防性医疗上的投入可带来急诊住院率方面的长期节省。

extension.en: The extension of the pilot program to additional districts proceeded smoothly throughout the year.
extension.zh: 试点项目向其他辖区的推广全年进展顺利。

extension.en: This paper examines the extension of fiscal support to self-employed workers during economic downturns.
extension.zh: 本文考察经济下行期间财政支持向自雇劳动者的延伸。

extension.en: Regional cooperation depends on the extension of shared technical standards across administrative borders.
extension.zh: 区域合作有赖于共同技术标准在行政边界之外的推广。

facility.en: The university provides a language laboratory facility for students requiring additional writing practice.
facility.zh: 该校为需要额外写作训练的学生提供语言实验室设施。

facility.en: Access to the research facility remains restricted to approved investigators and visiting scholars.
facility.zh: 研究设施的使用仍仅限经批准的科研人员与访问学者。

facility.en: In rural districts, the lack of a proper medical facility limits patient access to specialist care.
facility.zh: 在乡村辖区，缺少正规的医疗设施限制了患者获得专科诊疗的机会。

feedback.en: Written feedback from reviewers improved the clarity of the central argument in the manuscript.
feedback.zh: 审稿人提供的书面反馈提升了稿件核心论证的清晰度。

feedback.en: Prompt feedback on student writing increases engagement with revision and improves final grades.
feedback.zh: 对学生写作的及时反馈能提高其修改投入的积极性并改善最终成绩。

feedback.en: The committee solicited feedback from stakeholder groups before revising the funding guidelines.
feedback.zh: 委员会在修订资助准则之前征求了各利益相关群体的意见。

friction.en: Semantic friction between the two coding schemes made the merged dataset difficult to analyze.
friction.zh: 两套编码方案之间的语义摩擦使合并后的数据集难以分析。

friction.en: Administrative friction at the municipal level delayed the implementation of the housing policy.
friction.zh: 市级层面的行政阻力拖延了住房政策的实施。

friction.en: Surface friction in the composite material was reduced by applying a thin coating before testing.
friction.zh: 在测试前涂覆一层薄涂层，降低了复合材料表面的摩擦。

generation.en: Each generation of the survey panel reported declining trust in mainstream political institutions.
generation.zh: 调查样本中的每一代受访者都报告了对主流政治机构信任度的下降。

generation.en: The generation of greenhouse gases from industrial processes continues to accelerate under current policy settings.
generation.zh: 在现行政策安排下，工业过程的温室气体产生仍在加速。

generation.en: Generations of ethnographers have described the settlement as a center of craft production.
generation.zh: 数代民族志学者都将该聚落描述为手工业生产的中心。

hierarchy.en: The organizational hierarchy in the ministry delayed the circulation of research findings to practitioners.
hierarchy.zh: 部委内部的层级关系延缓了研究成果向实践者的传播。

hierarchy.en: Tax codes typically reflect a hierarchy of needs, from subsistence consumption to discretionary spending.
hierarchy.zh: 税收条款通常反映出从基本生存消费到可自由支配支出的需求层级。

hierarchy.en: Inequality research often situates class positions within a hierarchy of social stratification.
hierarchy.zh: 不平等研究常把阶级位置置于社会分化的层级体系之中。

identity.en: The reform sought to strengthen the professional identity of newly qualified teachers.
identity.zh: 该项改革旨在强化新任教师的职业身份认同。

identity.en: Participants described a strong sense of identity with their local community and its traditions.
identity.zh: 受访者描述了对其所在社区及其传统的强烈认同感。

identity.en: Textual identity across successive editions cannot be assumed without collation of the manuscript.
identity.zh: 若不对手稿进行校勘，便不能假定各连续版本之间文本的同一性。

index.en: The index to the collected works lists every contributor by institution and discipline.
index.zh: 文集的索引按机构和学科列出每一位撰稿人。

index.en: Prices for staple agricultural commodities served as an index of inflationary pressure in rural households.
index.zh: 主要农产品价格可作为农村家庭通胀压力的指标。

index.en: A subject index in the library catalog enables rapid retrieval of records by keyword.
index.zh: 图书馆目录中的主题索引使记录得以按关键词快速检索。

induction.en: Statistical induction from observational data cannot establish causal relationships without further assumptions.
induction.zh: 从观察性数据出发的统计归纳若无进一步假设，便无法确立因果关系。

induction.en: The induction program for newly appointed staff covers research integrity and data protection alike.
induction.zh: 面向新入职人员的入职引导涵盖科研诚信与数据保护两方面。

induction.en: Candidates who received structured induction reported greater confidence in administrative procedures.
induction.zh: 接受了结构化入职引导的应聘者对行政流程表现出更强的信心。

initiative.en: The government launched an initiative to expand rural broadband connectivity across underserved districts.
initiative.zh: 政府启动了一项举措，在服务不足的辖区扩展农村宽带接入。

initiative.en: Participants showed initiative in identifying gaps within the existing literature on labor migration.
initiative.zh: 参与者表现出主动性，识别出既有劳动力迁移文献中的空白。

initiative.en: A joint initiative between the university and the municipality funds longitudinal research on housing.
initiative.zh: 该大学与市政府的一项联合举措资助了住房方面的纵向研究。

inspection.en: Regular inspection of laboratory equipment reduced instrument drift during long measurement campaigns.
inspection.zh: 定期检查实验室设备减少了长时间测量过程中的仪器漂移。

inspection.en: An unannounced inspection revealed systematic failures in the recording of vital statistics.
inspection.zh: 一次不预先通知的检查暴露出生命统计记录中的系统性疏漏。

inspection.en: Quality inspection of imported samples continues to determine whether shipments are released.
inspection.zh: 对进口样品的质量检验仍决定着货物是否获准放行。

institution.en: The research institution maintains long-term partnerships with hospitals in several countries.
institution.zh: 该研究机构与数个国家的医院保持着长期合作关系。

institution.en: Marriage is an institution whose meaning has shifted substantially across industrialized societies.
institution.zh: 婚姻是一种制度，其含义在工业化社会中已发生显著变化。

institution.en: Reforming regulatory institutions requires sustained political commitment rather than short-term campaigns.
institution.zh: 改革监管机构需要持续的政治承诺，而非短期的宣传活动。

integration.en: The integration of qualitative interviews with survey data strengthened the analysis of employment trajectories.
integration.zh: 将定性访谈与调查数据相整合，加强了对就业轨迹的分析。

integration.en: Social integration of immigrant communities depends on access to language and vocational training.
integration.zh: 移民群体的社会融入取决于能否获得语言与职业培训。

integration.en: Integration of the two databases required careful harmonization of coding categories and identifiers.
integration.zh: 两个数据库的整合需要审慎地协调编码类别与标识符。

intensity.en: The intensity of the intervention was increased once a formal review of the trial data was completed.
intensity.zh: 在完成对试验数据的正式审查之后，干预的强度才得以提高。

intensity.en: Radiation intensity varied considerably across the sampling sites, which limited the comparability of the estimates.
intensity.zh: 各采样点的辐射强度差异相当大，这限制了估计结果的可比性。

intensity.en: The intensity of public scrutiny placed substantial pressure on the regulatory agency to publish its reasoning.
intensity.zh: 公众监督的强度给监管机构施加了实质压力，促使其公布推理依据。

interaction.en: The interaction between gene dosage and maternal age was not accounted for in the original analysis.
interaction.zh: 原始分析并未考虑基因剂量与母亲年龄之间的交互作用。

interaction.en: Policy design should anticipate the interaction between formal rules and the informal practices of local administration.
interaction.zh: 政策设计应当预判正式规则与地方行政的非正式惯例之间的相互作用。

interaction.en: Extended observation revealed a clear interaction between workload and error rates among junior staff.
interaction.zh: 延长观察期后发现，工作负荷与初级员工的差错率之间存在明显的交互作用。

latency.en: The latency between symptom onset and diagnosis remains a major obstacle to timely treatment.
latency.zh: 从症状出现到确诊之间的延迟时间，仍是及时治疗的一大障碍。

latency.en: Network latency measurements showed substantial variation across the region, indicating uneven infrastructure investment.
latency.zh: 网络延迟的测量结果显示该地区存在显著差异，说明基础设施投资并不均衡。

latency.en: Reducing latency in the reporting system requires reorganizing the workflow rather than adding staff.
latency.zh: 降低报告系统的延迟时间，需要重组工作流程，而非单纯增加人手。

manifestation.en: The most common manifestation of the condition was a gradual decline in cognitive performance.
manifestation.zh: 该病最常见的表现是认知功能的逐渐衰退。

manifestation.en: Policy failure was the clearest manifestation of weak coordination between the responsible agencies.
manifestation.zh: 政策的失败是各责任机构之间协调不力的最明显表现。

manifestation.en: Such a manifestation of regional inequality prompted the authors to revise their analytical framework.
manifestation.zh: 区域不平等的这种表现促使作者修订了原有的分析框架。

maturity.en: The maturity of the evidence base remains insufficient to justify such a sweeping reform.
maturity.zh: 现有证据基础的成熟度仍不足以支撑如此全面的改革。

maturity.en: Regulatory frameworks should be assessed against the maturity of the technologies they seek to govern.
maturity.zh: 监管框架应依据其所试图规制的技术的成熟度加以评估。

maturity.en: The maturity of the market was evident in the growing share of professionally certified providers.
maturity.zh: 市场的成熟度体现在持有专业资质的服务提供者比例不断上升。

modification.en: Any modification to the survey instrument required a full re-validation of the measurement scale.
modification.zh: 对问卷工具的任何修改，都要求对测量量表进行全面的重新效度检验。

modification.en: The modification of the original protocol was reported transparently in the clinical trial registry.
modification.zh: 原研究方案的修改已在临床试验注册库中透明地报告。

modification.en: A minor modification to the sampling frame reduced the coverage bias inherent in the first wave.
modification.zh: 对抽样框的微小调整减少了第一轮调查中固有的覆盖偏差。

momentum.en: The reform lost momentum once its funding source was withdrawn from the public budget.
momentum.zh: 一旦其资金来源被从公共预算中撤回，这场改革便失去了势头。

momentum.en: Maintaining momentum in the research program depends on stable and continuous funding.
momentum.zh: 研究项目能否保持势头，取决于资金是否稳定并持续到位。

momentum.en: The momentum of the campaign was checked by adverse publicity within a matter of weeks.
momentum.zh: 该运动的势头在数周之内便因不利的舆论报道而受阻。

motivation.en: Intrinsic motivation appears to sustain participation when external incentives are withdrawn.
motivation.zh: 当外部激励被取消之后，内在动机似乎更能维持参与行为。

motivation.en: The policy proposal offers little motivation for compliance unless responsibilities are clearly assigned.
motivation.zh: 若不明确分配责任，这项政策提案几乎无法为遵规提供任何动力。

motivation.en: Researchers reported that the main motivation for enrollment was the prospect of free treatment.
motivation.zh: 研究人员报告，登记入组的主要动机是能够获得免费治疗的前景。

necessity.en: The necessity of comparable definitions across jurisdictions is now widely recognized.
necessity.zh: 跨司法辖区采用可比较的定义，其必要性现已得到广泛承认。

necessity.en: The case for central oversight rests on the necessity of uniform standards for data protection.
necessity.zh: 主张设立集中监管的理由，建立在数据保护需要统一标准这一必要性之上。

necessity.en: Hospital administrators regarded additional staffing as a necessity rather than a discretionary expense.
necessity.zh: 医院管理者将增聘人员视为一项必需，而非可自由裁量的开支。

neutrality.en: Strict neutrality in the assessment of competing claims is essential to the authority of the tribunal.
neutrality.zh: 在评估相互冲突的主张时保持绝对中立，是法庭权威性的根本所在。

neutrality.en: The neutrality of the instrument was confirmed by comparing responses from groups with divergent interests.
neutrality.zh: 通过比较利益取向不同的各组的回答，证实了该测量工具的中立性。

neutrality.en: Participants doubted the neutrality of the interviewer whenever institutional affiliation was disclosed.
neutrality.zh: 每当受访者得知访谈者所属机构时，便会怀疑其中立性。

obligation.en: The obligation to report adverse outcomes applies equally to public and private providers.
obligation.zh: 报告不良事件的义务，对公立与私营服务提供者同样适用。

obligation.en: Legal obligation alone was insufficient to secure compliance among smaller employers in the sector.
obligation.zh: 单靠法律义务，不足以确保该行业中小型雇主遵守规定。

obligation.en: The researchers accepted a moral obligation to share their instruments with other laboratories.
obligation.zh: 研究人员接受了一项道义上的责任，即与其他实验室共享其研究工具。

orientation.en: The orientation of the study toward practice rather than theory shaped the resulting curriculum.
orientation.zh: 该研究偏重实践而非理论的定位，塑造了由此形成的课程体系。

orientation.en: A clear ideological orientation can limit which evidence a review is willing to consider.
orientation.zh: 明确的意识形态立场，可能限制一篇综述愿意纳入的证据范围。

orientation.en: Career orientation sessions were offered to undergraduate students uncertain about their future direction.
orientation.zh: 学校为对未来方向尚不确定的本科生提供了职业规划指导课。

participation.en: Community participation in the design phase measurably improved the uptake of the resulting services.
participation.zh: 社区在设计阶段的参与，显著提高了随后各项服务的使用率。

participation.en: Participation declined sharply once the meetings were rescheduled to inconvenient working hours.
participation.zh: 会议一经改到不便于上班的时段，参与率便急剧下降。

participation.en: The agency treats sustained participation as a precondition for the success of any reform.
participation.zh: 该机构把持续参与视为任何改革取得成功的先决条件。

partition.en: The researchers imposed a partition between lexical knowledge and conceptual knowledge in their analytical framework.
partition.zh: 研究者在分析框架中区分了词汇知识与概念知识。

partition.en: Regional partition of the sample allowed a comparison of productivity across comparable institutional settings.
partition.zh: 对样本进行区域划分，使研究者能够在条件相近的机构之间比较生产率。

partition.en: The partition between disciplinary and interdisciplinary research proved difficult to maintain in practice.
partition.zh: 学科研究与跨学科研究之间的界限在实践中难以维持。

partnership.en: The university and the regional authority entered a partnership to supervise the pilot program.
partnership.zh: 大学与地方主管部门建立伙伴关系，共同监管试点项目。

partnership.en: Academic partnership with museums has reshaped the study of material culture in several universities.
partnership.zh: 与博物馆的学术合作重塑了多所大学的物质文化研究。

partnership.en: Under the partnership agreement each party assumed responsibility for recruiting practitioners and supervising data collection.
partnership.zh: 根据伙伴协议，双方分别承担招募从业者与监督数据收集的责任。

persistence.en: The persistence of the effect across independent samples suggests that it is not an artifact of measurement.
persistence.zh: 该效应在多个独立样本中持续存在，说明它并非测量误差造成的假象。

persistence.en: Researchers examined the persistence of early language contact in communities undergoing rapid urbanization.
persistence.zh: 研究者考察了快速城市化社区中早期语言接触的持续性。

persistence.en: Policy persistence explains why several widely supported reforms were never implemented in practice.
persistence.zh: 政策的延续性解释了若干广受支持却始终未能落实的改革。

practitioner.en: Experienced practitioners in the field emphasized the need for clearer guidance on diagnostic assessment.
practitioner.zh: 该领域的资深从业者强调，诊断性评估需要更明确的指导。

practitioner.en: The study combined practitioner judgment with automated scoring to classify open-ended responses.
practitioner.zh: 该研究将从业者的判断与自动评分相结合，对开放式回答进行分类。

practitioner.en: Early career practitioners reported substantial difficulty in applying the revised coding framework.
practitioner.zh: 初入职场的从业者报告称，在应用修订后的编码框架时遇到很大困难。

priority.en: Given limited resources the priority must be to reduce measurement error before extending the sample.
priority.zh: 资源有限的情况下，优先事项应当是在扩大样本之前先降低测量误差。

priority.en: The research agenda places longitudinal evidence at a higher priority than cross-sectional comparisons.
priority.zh: 该研究议程将纵向证据置于比横断面比较更高的优先位置。

priority.en: Establishing priority access to the archive allowed the team to begin coding before dawn.
priority.zh: 取得档案的优先使用权限后，团队得以在天亮前开始编码。

productivity.en: Productivity in the writing process increased once participants received structured feedback between drafts.
productivity.zh: 参与者在各稿之间获得结构化反馈后，写作效率明显提高。

productivity.en: The authors report that rising labor productivity coincided with a modest decline in output per worker.
productivity.zh: 作者报告说，劳动生产率上升的同时，每位工人的产出却略有下降。

productivity.en: Policy design should consider how automation affects the productivity of expert professional work.
productivity.zh: 政策设计应当考虑自动化如何影响专家型专业工作的生产率。

proficiency.en: Language proficiency was measured with a validated test administered under supervised conditions.
proficiency.zh: 语言熟练程度采用经过效度检验的测试，在监督条件下实施测量。

proficiency.en: Reading proficiency in the target language predicts performance more strongly than years of instruction.
proficiency.zh: 目标语阅读熟练程度对表现的预测力强于接受教学的年限。

proficiency.en: The study limits its claims to participants who already possessed intermediate proficiency.
proficiency.zh: 该研究将其结论限定于已具备中等熟练程度的参与者。

profile.en: The demographic profile of the sample differs substantially from that of the wider population.
profile.zh: 样本的人口学特征与更广泛人口的情况存在显著差异。

profile.en: A longitudinal profile of the cohort reveals gradual but uneven gains in academic writing.
profile.zh: 对该队列的纵向追踪显示，学术写作水平呈缓慢而不均衡的提升。

profile.en: The authors present a detailed profile of the intervention sites and their staffing arrangements.
profile.zh: 作者对干预点及其人员配置情况给出了详细描述。

projection.en: Baseline projection of the demographic structure suggests a narrowing of the working-age population.
projection.zh: 对人口结构的基准预测显示劳动年龄人口比重趋于收窄。

projection.en: The projection assumes that current funding levels remain constant across the coming decade.
projection.zh: 该预测假定当前的资金水平在未来十年间保持不变。

projection.en: Researchers caution that any projection based on historical trends must be revised as new data arrive.
projection.zh: 研究者提醒，任何基于历史趋势的预测都必须随着新数据的到来而修正。

promotion.en: The promotion of evidence-based guidelines has been uneven across the health system.
promotion.zh: 循证指南的推广在卫生系统中进展不一。

promotion.en: Promotion on the strength of a single publication remains possible under the current regulations.
promotion.zh: 在现行规定下，仅凭一篇出版物获得晋升仍然可行。

promotion.en: Internal promotion policies shaped the composition of the senior academic staff.
promotion.zh: 内部晋升制度影响了资深学术人员的构成。

provision.en: The statute makes provision for independent review of the research assessment process.
provision.zh: 该法为研究评估程序的独立审查作出安排。

provision.en: Provision of adequate training remains a precondition for the successful adoption of the instrument.
provision.zh: 提供充分培训仍是该工具得以成功采用的前提条件。

provision.en: The regulatory provision was introduced in response to sustained pressure from professional associations.
provision.zh: 这一监管条款是在专业协会持续施压的背景下引入的。

qualification.en: Applicants must hold a teaching qualification recognized by the national accreditation body.
qualification.zh: 申请人须持有经国家认证机构认可的教学资格。

qualification.en: The authors state this qualification explicitly, noting that the assumption restricts external validity.
qualification.zh: 作者明确说明了这一限定，并指出该假设限制了外部效度。

qualification.en: Several studies report the same pattern, though their qualifications differ in important respects.
qualification.zh: 若干研究报告了相同的模式，但各自的条件限定在重要方面并不相同。

quota.en: The ministry introduced a quota limiting the number of new licenses granted each year.
quota.zh: 该部出台了限制每年发放新许可证数量的配额。

quota.en: The quota system was gradually replaced by a performance-based allocation formula.
quota.zh: 配额制度逐步被基于绩效的分配公式取代。

quota.en: Critics argued that the quota reduced incentives for training institutions to improve quality.
quota.zh: 批评者认为，配额削弱了培训机构提升质量的激励。

realism.en: The policy demonstrates a degree of realism rarely observed in earlier labor market reforms.
realism.zh: 该政策表现出早期劳动力市场改革中少见的务实。

realism.en: Philosophical realism holds that the entities posited by science correspond to independently existing objects.
realism.zh: 哲学实在论主张科学所设定的实体对应于独立存在的客体。

realism.en: The committee stressed realism in its assessment of what could be achieved within the available budget.
realism.zh: 委员会在评估现有预算内可实现的目标时强调了务实态度。

reciprocity.en: Social exchange theory treats reciprocity as the expectation that support will be returned.
reciprocity.zh: 社会交换理论把互惠视为支持行为将得到回报的期待。

reciprocity.en: The agreement was drafted to ensure reciprocity in access to research data between partner institutions.
reciprocity.zh: 该协议的起草旨在确保合作机构之间获取研究数据的对等性。

reciprocity.en: Reciprocity between the journal and its peer reviewers depends on timely and constructive reports.
reciprocity.zh: 期刊与同行评审者之间的相互性取决于及时而富有建设性的评审报告。

recommendation.en: The committee issued a recommendation that funding be redirected toward early intervention programs.
recommendation.zh: 委员会提出建议，主张将资金转向早期干预项目。

recommendation.en: Her recommendation of a mixed methods design shaped the subsequent analysis strategy.
recommendation.zh: 她关于混合方法设计的建议影响了随后的分析策略。

recommendation.en: Reviewers considered the journal's peer review policy a sound recommendation for early career researchers.
recommendation.zh: 评审者认为该刊的同行评审政策对职业早期研究者而言是一项中肯的建议。

recurrence.en: The recurrence of drought conditions prompted a revision of regional water allocation rules.
recurrence.zh: 干旱状况的反复出现促使该地区重新修订水资源分配规则。

recurrence.en: Researchers tracked the recurrence of seasonal influenza across a decade of clinic records.
recurrence.zh: 研究者依据十年门诊记录追踪季节性流感的再现情况。

recurrence.en: A recurrence of the same measurement error in two independent runs suggests a systematic instrument bias.
recurrence.zh: 同一测量误差在两次独立运行中重现，提示仪器存在系统性偏差。

reduction.en: A reduction in sample size reduced the statistical power of the experiment.
reduction.zh: 样本量的缩减削弱了该实验的统计检验效能。

reduction.en: The policy achieved a substantial reduction in energy consumption across public buildings.
reduction.zh: 该政策使公共建筑的能源消耗显著下降。

reduction.en: No reduction in mortality was observed among patients receiving the standard treatment.
reduction.zh: 在接受标准治疗的患者中，未观察到死亡率的下降。

refinement.en: The refinement of the method took several years of iterative testing.
refinement.zh: 该方法的精细化历经数年的反复测试。

refinement.en: Analysts noted a steady refinement of the theoretical model after peer feedback.
refinement.zh: 在同行反馈之后，分析者注意到理论模型得到持续改进。

refinement.en: Each refinement of the questionnaire removed ambiguous items from the final instrument.
refinement.zh: 问卷的每一次修订都从最终工具中删去了含义模糊的题目。

reinforcement.en: Positive reinforcement increased the rate of task completion among the participants.
reinforcement.zh: 正强化提高了参与者的任务完成率。

reinforcement.en: The reinforcement of regional institutions weakened the power of the central ministry.
reinforcement.zh: 对区域机构的强化削弱了中央部委的权力。

reinforcement.en: Social reinforcement through peer groups appears essential to long-term behavioral change.
reinforcement.zh: 借助同伴群体的社会强化，似乎对长期行为改变至关重要。

remedy.en: The regulator proposed stronger disclosure requirements as a remedy for persistent market failures.
remedy.zh: 监管机构提出更严格的信息披露要求，作为应对持续市场失灵的补救措施。

remedy.en: Such a remedy remains popular although the clinical evidence supporting it is limited.
remedy.zh: 尽管支持它的临床证据仍然有限，这类疗法依然颇受欢迎。

remedy.en: No single policy remedy can resolve the problem of regional inequality in educational access.
remedy.zh: 没有任何单一的政策补救措施能够解决教育获取方面的区域不平等问题。

reputation.en: A university's reputation often shapes the number and quality of applications it receives.
reputation.zh: 一所大学的声誉往往影响其收到的申请数量与质量。

reputation.en: The institute's reputation for rigorous peer review attracted several visiting scholars.
reputation.zh: 该研究所因严谨的同行评审而声名远播，吸引了多位访问学者。

reputation.en: Companies with a damaged reputation face higher costs when recruiting skilled personnel.
reputation.zh: 声誉受损的企业在招募专业人才时往往要付出更高成本。

reservation.en: Members expressed reservation about the proposal's likely effect on rural incomes.
reservation.zh: 成员们对该提案可能给农村收入带来的影响表示了保留意见。

reservation.en: Any reservation about the journal's new policy must reach the editorial board before publication.
reservation.zh: 对该刊新政策的任何保留意见都必须在出版前提交编辑部。

reservation.en: Reservations at the conference hotel were confirmed after the delegation submitted its travel plans.
reservation.zh: 代表团提交行程安排后，会议酒店的预订得到确认。

restriction.en: Import restrictions reduced the supply of essential components during the disruption.
restriction.zh: 进口限制在供应中断期间削减了关键零部件的供应。

restriction.en: The severity of the restriction depends on how widely the species migrates across borders.
restriction.zh: 限制的严厉程度取决于该物种跨境迁移的范围。

restriction.en: Academic freedom cannot be reconciled with blanket restriction of online publications.
restriction.zh: 学术自由无法与对网络出版物的全面限制相调和。

retrieval.en: Information retrieval systems rank documents according to their relevance to a query.
retrieval.zh: 信息检索系统按照文档与查询的相关程度对结果排序。

retrieval.en: The retrieval of source data required permission from the archive's governing board.
retrieval.zh: 获取源数据需要档案管理理事会的许可。

retrieval.en: Memory retrieval was tested after a controlled interval of rest.
retrieval.zh: 在受控的休息间隔之后，研究对记忆提取进行了检验。

revision.en: The revision of the manuscript followed a lengthy process of internal review.
revision.zh: 该稿件的修订经历了漫长的内部评审过程。

revision.en: Substantial revision of the theoretical framework was required before the article could be accepted.
revision.zh: 该文被接收之前，其理论框架需要大幅修订。

revision.en: Readers should consult the latest revision of the statistical guidelines before replication.
revision.zh: 研究者在重复实验之前应查阅统计指南的最新修订版。

rigor.en: The rigor of the argument depends on the quality of the underlying evidence.
rigor.zh: 论证的严密程度取决于基础证据的质量。

rigor.en: Quantitative methods contribute rigor to the comparison of regional economic indicators.
rigor.zh: 定量方法为区域经济指标的比较提供了严谨性。

rigor.en: The program lost scientific rigor when the control group was quietly dropped from the analysis.
rigor.zh: 当对照组被悄悄从分析中剔除时，该研究便失去了科学严谨性。

selection.en: Sample selection must be justified before any statistical inference is attempted.
selection.zh: 在尝试任何统计推断之前，必须为样本选择提供理由。

selection.en: The committee met the needs of the department through an open selection of junior fellows.
selection.zh: 委员会通过公开选拔初级研究员满足了院系的需求。

selection.en: Peer selection introduces biases that are difficult to detect in the published literature.
selection.zh: 同行遴选会引入难以在已发表文献中察觉的偏差。

separation.en: The separation of teaching and research functions weakens institutional coherence.
separation.zh: 教学与研究职能的分离削弱了机构内部的一致性。

separation.en: Laboratory separation of samples prevented cross-contamination during the survey.
separation.zh: 实验室对样本的分离避免了调查过程中的交叉污染。

separation.en: Judicial separation of powers provides a check on regulatory discretion.
separation.zh: 司法权力的分离为监管裁量提供了制衡。

severity.en: The severity of the decline in literacy was underestimated by policymakers.
severity.zh: 决策者低估了识字率下降的严重程度。

severity.en: Clinical severity scores were recorded for each participant at enrollment.
severity.zh: 研究在入组时记录了每位参与者的临床严重程度评分。

severity.en: Regulators graded the severity of the violation and imposed corresponding penalties.
severity.zh: 监管机构对违规行为的严重程度作出分级，并施加相应处罚。

simulation.en: Simulation results suggest that the proposed design would reduce structural failure.
simulation.zh: 模拟结果表明，拟议的设计方案能够降低结构失效的风险。

simulation.en: The simulation of rainfall patterns helped planners test drainage capacity.
simulation.zh: 对降水模式的模拟帮助规划人员检验排水能力。

simulation.en: Students used simulation to explore how policy choices affect market outcomes.
simulation.zh: 学生借助模拟来探索政策选择如何影响市场结果。

specification.en: The technical specification requires that all sensors meet stringent accuracy thresholds.
specification.zh: 该技术规范要求所有传感器满足严格的精度阈值。

specification.en: Ambiguous wording in the specification led to disputes during contract review.
specification.zh: 规范中的表述含糊，导致合同审查期间出现争议。

specification.en: Regulators revised the specification to reflect recent advances in material science.
specification.zh: 监管机构修订了规范，以反映材料科学领域的近期进展。

stability.en: Long-term stability of the composite was tested under repeated thermal cycling.
stability.zh: 复合材料在反复热循环条件下的长期稳定性接受了检验。

stability.en: The findings suggest considerable stability in the relationship across cohorts.
stability.zh: 研究结果表明，该关系在不同队列中具有相当高的稳定性。

stability.en: Political stability in the region determined the pace of institutional reform.
stability.zh: 该地区的政治稳定性决定了制度改革的推进节奏。

sufficiency.en: The sufficiency of the evidence was challenged by members of the review panel.
sufficiency.zh: 评审委员会成员对证据的充分性提出了质疑。

sufficiency.en: Sufficiency of statistical power depends on the expected size of the treatment effect.
sufficiency.zh: 统计检验效能的充分性取决于预期处理效应的大小。

sufficiency.en: The report questions the sufficiency of current funding for long-term archival work.
sufficiency.zh: 该报告质疑现行资金对长期档案工作的支持是否充分。

supervision.en: Effective supervision requires clear reporting lines between field staff and headquarters.
supervision.zh: 有效的监督要求田野人员与总部之间建立清晰的工作汇报关系。

supervision.en: The agency strengthened supervision of licensed laboratories after a series of violations.
supervision.zh: 在一系列违规行为发生之后，该机构加强了对持证实验室的监督。

supervision.en: Supervision of early-career researchers reduced uncertainty during the transition period.
supervision.zh: 对职业早期研究人员的指导降低了过渡阶段的不确定性。

supplement.en: A supplement to the main report contains the detailed methodological appendix.
supplement.zh: 主报告的补充材料包含详细的方法学附录。

supplement.en: Dietary supplement use was recorded among participants during the follow-up interview.
supplement.zh: 研究在随访访谈中记录了参与者的膳食补充剂使用情况。

supplement.en: The supplement provides additional context for the interpretation of the historical data.
supplement.zh: 该补充材料为历史数据的解读提供了额外背景。

survival.en: Survival rates for the transplanted seedlings declined sharply during the drought.
survival.zh: 移栽幼苗的存活率在干旱期间急剧下降。

survival.en: The model estimates survival probability under alternative assumptions about mortality.
survival.zh: 该模型在关于死亡率的不同假设下估算存活概率。

survival.en: Corporate survival in competitive markets depends on continuous organizational adaptation.
survival.zh: 企业在竞争性市场中的存续取决于持续的组织调适。

tactic.en: The committee adopted a negotiation tactic intended to reduce the financial burden.
tactic.zh: 委员会采取了一种旨在减轻财政负担的谈判策略。

tactic.en: Each research group selected a different recruitment tactic for the target population.
tactic.zh: 各研究小组针对目标人群选择了不同的招募策略。

tactic.en: Prolonged delay was recognized as a common tactic in regulatory evasion.
tactic.zh: 拖延被认定为规避监管的一种常见手段。

technology.en: Advances in technology have reduced the cost of large-scale data collection.
technology.zh: 技术进步降低了大规模数据采集的成本。

technology.en: The technology transfer office mediates cooperation between the university and industry.
technology.zh: 技术转移办公室在高校与产业之间的合作中发挥协调作用。

technology.en: Adoption of the technology was uneven across regions with comparable infrastructure.
technology.zh: 该技术在基础设施相当的不同地区之间呈现出不均衡的采纳状况。

tendency.en: The tendency of respondents to overstate income persists across repeated survey waves.
tendency.zh: 受访者夸大收入的倾向在多次调查波次中持续存在。

tendency.en: There is a marked tendency for graduate attrition to increase with departmental size.
tendency.zh: 研究生流失率随院系规模增大而上升的倾向十分明显。

tendency.en: His tendency to generalize from single cases weakened the analytical rigor of the review.
tendency.zh: 他倾向于从个别案例进行概括，这一特点削弱了评审的严谨性。

terminology.en: Differences in terminology complicate the comparison of results across regional studies.
terminology.zh: 术语上的差异使各地区研究结果之间的比较变得复杂。

terminology.en: The authors propose a standardized terminology for describing qualitative coding decisions.
terminology.zh: 作者提出了标准化的术语体系，用于描述定性编码的决策过程。

terminology.en: Ambiguity in the terminology of the directive led to divergent administrative interpretations.
terminology.zh: 指令术语上的歧义导致了截然不同的行政解释。

tolerance.en: Tolerance of measurement error varies substantially across instruments and laboratories.
tolerance.zh: 不同仪器和实验室对测量误差的容忍程度存在显著差异。

tolerance.en: The policy depends on public tolerance of a modest increase in taxation.
tolerance.zh: 该政策取决于公众对适度税收增长的容忍程度。

tolerance.en: Genetic differences in drug tolerance explain part of the variation in treatment response.
tolerance.zh: 药物耐受性的遗传差异解释了治疗反应变异的部分来源。

transformation.en: The digital transformation of public administration has reshaped how agencies deliver services to citizens.
transformation.zh: 公共管理的数字化转型重塑了政府机构向公众提供服务的路径。

transformation.en: Economic transformation in the region was driven by the relocation of manufacturing industries.
transformation.zh: 该地区的经济转型由制造业向低成本地区转移所推动。

transformation.en: Transformation of the existing curriculum requires sustained investment in teacher training and digital infrastructure.
transformation.zh: 现有课程的改造需要在教师培训与数字基础设施方面持续投入。

transmission.en: Transmission of the virus through airborne droplets remains the primary concern in epidemiological models.
transmission.zh: 病毒通过飞沫传播仍是流行病学模型中的首要关切。

transmission.en: The transmission of knowledge between research groups depends on sustained informal communication channels.
transmission.zh: 研究群体之间知识的传递依赖持续的日常沟通渠道。

transmission.en: Improved insulation substantially reduces heat transmission through the building envelope.
transmission.zh: 改进后的隔热措施显著减少了热量通过建筑围护结构的传递。

typology.en: The proposed typology distinguishes institutional from individual forms of political participation.
typology.zh: 所提出的类型学区分了制度性与个体性的政治参与形式。

typology.en: Such a typology assumes that all economies can be classified along a single continuum.
typology.zh: 这种类型划分假定所有经济体都可以沿单一的连续谱加以归类。

typology.en: Later revisions to the typology incorporated evidence from additional regional case studies.
typology.zh: 该类型学后来的修订纳入了更多区域性个案研究所提供的证据。

utilization.en: Utilization of satellite imagery has improved the accuracy of land cover classification.
utilization.zh: 卫星影像的利用提高了土地覆被分类的准确度。

utilization.en: The utilization of existing infrastructure reduces the environmental cost of urban expansion.
utilization.zh: 对既有基础设施的利用可以降低城市扩张的环境代价。

utilization.en: Hospital utilization data revealed substantial geographic disparities in access to primary care.
utilization.zh: 医院服务利用率数据揭示了初级卫生服务可及性方面的显著地域差距。

variability.en: Variability in rainfall across successive seasons complicates the calibration of crop yield models.
variability.zh: 各季降水量的波动性使作物产量模型的校准更为困难。

variability.en: Interindividual variability in treatment response was smaller than the authors had anticipated.
variability.zh: 个体间在治疗反应上的变异性小于作者原先的预期。

variability.en: Greater variability in measured outcomes prompted investigators to reconsider the sampling frame.
variability.zh: 测量结果的更大波动促使研究者重新审视抽样框的设计。

variation.en: Variation in the recorded data largely reflects differences in laboratory procedure rather than genuine change.
variation.zh: 所记录数据的差异在很大程度上反映了实验室程序的不同，而非真实变化。

variation.en: Genetic variation within the population explains part of the observed phenotypic difference.
variation.zh: 群体内部的遗传变异解释了表型差异的一部分。

variation.en: The new document records seasonal variation in water demand across the district.
variation.zh: 新文件记录了该地区水需求随季节的变化情况。

viability.en: The viability of the proposal depends on securing stable long-term funding.
viability.zh: 该方案的可行性取决于能否获得稳定的长期资金支持。

viability.en: Field trials were required to establish the viability of the treatment under local conditions.
viability.zh: 为确立该疗法在本地条件下的可行性，有必要开展田间试验。

viability.en: Researchers doubt the commercial viability of the technology without sustained government support.
viability.zh: 缺乏持续的政府支持，研究者对该技术的商业可行性持怀疑态度。

vitality.en: The vitality of the local economy depends on the continued competitiveness of manufacturing exports.
vitality.zh: 当地经济活力取决于制造业出口能否保持持续竞争力。

vitality.en: Ageing populations threaten the vitality of rural communities in many regions.
vitality.zh: 人口老龄化威胁着许多地区农村社区的活力。

vitality.en: The vitality of a theory lies in its capacity to generate new empirical questions.
vitality.zh: 一个理论的生命力在于其提出新的经验问题的能力。

volatility.en: Price volatility in agricultural commodities reduces the willingness of producers to adopt new crops.
volatility.zh: 农产品价格的高波动性降低了生产者采用新作物的意愿。

volatility.en: Volatility in the exchange rate complicates the assessment of international competitiveness.
volatility.zh: 汇率的频繁波动使国际竞争力的评估变得复杂。

volatility.en: Political volatility has discouraged private investors from committing capital to the sector.
volatility.zh: 政治动荡已使私人投资者不愿向该部门投入资本。

welfare.en: The welfare of rural households depends on access to transport and public health services.
welfare.zh: 农村家庭的福祉取决于能否获得交通与公共卫生服务。

welfare.en: Policy reform should not pursue economic growth at the expense of social welfare.
welfare.zh: 政策改革不应以牺牲社会福利为代价追求经济增长。

welfare.en: Welfare agencies reported an increase in referrals during the winter months.
welfare.zh: 福利机构报告称冬季转介数量有所增加。

accessible.en: Remote rural areas remain poorly accessible to specialist medical services.
accessible.zh: 偏远农村地区仍难以获得专科医疗服务。

accessible.en: The museum has made its collections accessible online for researchers worldwide.
accessible.zh: 该博物馆已将其馆藏在线开放，供全球研究者使用。

accessible.en: Accessible design principles ensure that the interface remains usable for users with disabilities.
accessible.zh: 无障碍设计原则确保界面对残障用户依然可用。

accountable.en: Public agencies must remain accountable for the environmental consequences of their decisions.
accountable.zh: 公共机构必须对其决策带来的环境后果负责。

accountable.en: The new framework holds each ministry accountable for the outcomes it has committed to deliver.
accountable.zh: 新框架使各部委对其承诺交付的成果负有问责义务。

accountable.en: Without transparent reporting mechanisms, elected officials cannot be held accountable for spending decisions.
accountable.zh: 若缺乏透明的报告机制，就无法追究民选官员在支出决策上的责任。

apparent.en: The apparent decline in the disease was partly attributable to changes in reporting practice.
apparent.zh: 该疾病表面上的下降部分可归因于报告实务的变化。

apparent.en: An apparent correlation between two variables does not establish a causal relationship.
apparent.zh: 两个变量之间的表面相关并不能确立因果关系。

apparent.en: The committee questioned the apparent consensus among reviewers on the proposed reform.
apparent.zh: 委员会对评审者之间就拟议改革表现出的表面共识提出质疑。

authentic.en: The manuscript contains authentic field notes recorded during the original expedition.
authentic.zh: 该手稿包含最初远征期间记录的原始田野笔记。

authentic.en: Researchers questioned whether the letters were authentic or later fabrications.
authentic.zh: 研究者质疑这些信件究竟是原件还是后来伪造的赝品。

authentic.en: The museum acquired an authentic example of the regional folk tradition.
authentic.zh: 博物馆购得了一件该地区民间传统的真品。

autonomous.en: The region obtained autonomous status and began drafting its own regulations.
autonomous.zh: 该地区取得自治地位后开始起草自己的规章。

autonomous.en: Robots must remain autonomous while operating in unstructured outdoor environments.
autonomous.zh: 机器人在非结构化的户外环境中运行时必须保持自主运作。

autonomous.en: Faculty members strongly resisted the introduction of autonomous managerial control over research.
autonomous.zh: 教职人员强烈反对把自主的经营控制引入学术研究。

beneficial.en: Moderate exercise proved beneficial for patients recovering from cardiac surgery.
beneficial.zh: 适度运动被证明有益于心脏手术后的康复患者。

beneficial.en: Subsidies for public transport remain beneficial to urban air quality.
beneficial.zh: 公共交通补贴对改善城市空气质量仍然有益。

beneficial.en: The authors argue that shared infrastructure would be beneficial for both sectors.
beneficial.zh: 作者认为共享基础设施对两个部门都会有益。

categorical.en: The proposed coding scheme produces categorical variables that simplify subsequent statistical analysis.
categorical.zh: 所提出的编码方案生成分类变量，从而简化了随后的统计分析。

categorical.en: His categorical rejection of quantitative evidence drew criticism from reviewers.
categorical.zh: 他对定量证据一概排斥的做法受到评审者批评。

categorical.en: The framework replaces loose groupings with clearly defined categorical distinctions.
categorical.zh: 该框架以明确划分的类别取代了宽泛的分组。

characteristic.en: Characteristic features of the language include a rare aspirated consonant.
characteristic.zh: 这种语言的典型特征包括一个罕见的送气辅音。

characteristic.en: The mineral displays the characteristic crystalline structure of its chemical group.
characteristic.zh: 该矿物呈现出其所属化学族的特有晶体结构。

characteristic.en: Such delays are characteristic of archival research conducted under restricted access.
characteristic.zh: 这类延误是限制查阅条件下开展档案研究的典型特征。

collective.en: The collective effort of the research team shortened the experimental timeline considerably.
collective.zh: 研究团队的集体努力大幅缩短了实验周期。

collective.en: Collective bargaining agreements determine wages across the entire manufacturing sector.
collective.zh: 集体谈判协议决定了整个制造业部门的工资水平。

collective.en: The collective burden of care work falls disproportionately on rural women.
collective.zh: 照护劳动的整体负担不均衡地落在农村妇女身上。

conditional.en: Funding for the program is conditional on satisfactory progress reviews.
conditional.zh: 该项目的资金拨付以令人满意的进展评估为条件。

conditional.en: The model's predictions are conditional on the accuracy of the underlying assumptions.
conditional.zh: 该模型的预测取决于基本假设的准确性。

conditional.en: A conditional offer of admission allows applicants to decline once results are published.
conditional.zh: 附条件的录取通知允许申请者在成绩公布后拒绝入学。

deliberate.en: The omission appears deliberate rather than the result of accidental sampling error.
deliberate.zh: 这一遗漏似乎出于故意，而非随机抽样误差所致。

deliberate.en: Deliberate efforts to reduce response bias improved the quality of the survey data.
deliberate.zh: 为减少回应偏差而作出的审慎努力提升了调查数据的质量。

deliberate.en: The committee made a deliberate decision to postpone publication until replication was complete.
deliberate.zh: 委员会经深思熟虑决定推迟发表，直至重复验证完成。

ethical.en: The protocol was approved by an independent ethical review board before recruitment began.
ethical.zh: 该方案在招募开始前获得了独立伦理审查委员会的批准。

ethical.en: Researchers must disclose every ethical consideration that could affect participant consent.
ethical.zh: 研究者必须披露一切可能影响受试者知情同意的伦理考量。

ethical.en: The award recognizes outstanding ethical practice in the conduct of clinical research.
ethical.zh: 该奖项表彰了临床研究实施过程中出色的伦理实践。

finite.en: Only a finite number of responses can be collected before the survey link expires.
finite.zh: 在调查链接失效之前只能收集到有限数量的回答。

finite.en: The model assumes a finite population of households in the target district.
finite.zh: 该模型假定目标区域内的家庭总体是有限的。

finite.en: Human attention is a finite resource that must be allocated across competing tasks.
finite.zh: 人的注意力是一种必须分配给各项竞争性任务的有限资源。

formal.en: The paper provides only a formal description of the model without any empirical test.
formal.zh: 该论文仅对模型作了形式化描述，没有提供任何经验检验。

formal.en: Formal approval from the ministry is required before the survey can begin.
formal.zh: 调查启动之前须取得主管部门的正式批准。

formal.en: The distinction between formal and informal institutions shapes economic outcomes across regions.
formal.zh: 正式制度与非正式制度之间的区分影响各地区的经济结果。

hypothetical.en: The simulations explore a hypothetical scenario in which carbon prices rise sharply.
hypothetical.zh: 这些模拟探讨了碳价急剧上升的假想情形。

hypothetical.en: The example is hypothetical, but it clarifies how the estimator behaves under bias.
hypothetical.zh: 该例是假设性的，但它阐明了估计量在偏差下的表现。

hypothetical.en: Participants were asked to judge a hypothetical case rather than recall a real event.
hypothetical.zh: 受试者被要求评判一个假想案例，而非回忆真实事件。

identical.en: The two laboratories reported identical results for the same reference material.
identical.zh: 两家实验室对同一标准物质报告了完全相同的结果。

identical.en: Participants saw identical stimuli, yet their recall performance differed considerably.
identical.zh: 受试者看到的是完全相同的刺激，但回忆表现却相差甚远。

identical.en: Replication succeeded only when the analytical procedure was identical to the original design.
identical.zh: 只有在分析程序与原始设计完全一致时，重复验证才获得成功。

innovative.en: The innovative method reduces measurement error without raising the total cost.
innovative.zh: 这一创新方法在不增加总成本的情况下降低了测量误差。

innovative.en: Universities are encouraged to develop innovative teaching programs for blended delivery.
innovative.zh: 高校被鼓励开发适用于混合式教学方式的创新项目。

innovative.en: The committee praised the innovative design of the pilot study's data collection.
innovative.zh: 委员会赞赏了试点研究数据收集环节的创新设计。

interdependent.en: The economic and ecological systems of the region are deeply interdependent and cannot be planned separately.
interdependent.zh: 该地区的经济系统与生态系统相互依存，无法分开规划。

interdependent.en: Small-scale fisheries and coastal livelihoods are interdependent, so governance must span both domains.
interdependent.zh: 小规模渔业与沿海生计相互依赖，因此治理必须跨越这两个领域。

interdependent.en: Interdependent feedback loops between climate and land use complicate efforts to model long-term outcomes.
interdependent.zh: 气候与土地利用之间相互依存的反馈回路，使长期结果的建模更趋复杂。

logical.en: A logical argument must distinguish clearly between the premises and the conclusions drawn from them.
logical.zh: 合乎逻辑的论证必须清楚区分前提与由此得出的结论。

logical.en: The proposal presents a logical progression from observed data to a testable set of hypotheses.
logical.zh: 该提案呈现出从观察数据到可检验假设的条理清晰的推进过程。

logical.en: His objection was logical, yet it rested on an assumption the study never examined.
logical.zh: 他的反驳在逻辑上成立，却建立在该研究从未考察过的假设之上。

measurable.en: Only measurable indicators can support a defensible assessment of policy performance over time.
measurable.zh: 只有可测量的指标才能支撑对政策绩效的可靠评估。

measurable.en: The review insisted that learning outcomes be translated into measurable criteria before evaluation began.
measurable.zh: 评审要求在评估开始之前将学习结果转化为可衡量的标准。

measurable.en: Progress toward the stated goals remained largely unmeasurable because no baseline data had been collected.
