lasting.en: The essay left a lasting impression on the examination panel.
lasting.zh: 这篇文章给考试评审留下了长久的印象。

invariant.en: Total energy remains invariant throughout the transformation.
invariant.zh: 总能量在整个变换过程中保持不变。

invariant.en: The study tested whether the coefficient is invariant across the sampled populations.
invariant.zh: 该研究检验了这一系数在所抽取的各个总体中是否保持不变。

invariant.en: Scale-invariant patterns persisted even when the raw counts were rescaled.
invariant.zh: 即使对原始计数重新缩放，尺度不变的格局依然存在。

argue.en: The authors argue that regulation must adapt to the pace of technical change.
argue.zh: 作者主张监管必须适应技术变化的速度。

argue.en: Reviewers argue against publishing the results before the replication is complete.
argue.zh: 审稿人反对在重复验证完成之前发表这些结果。

argue.en: She argued that the proposed definition excluded a large class of cases.
argue.zh: 她论证说所提议的定义排除了一大批案例。

appraise.en: Independent experts were invited to appraise the quality of the evidence.
appraise.zh: 独立专家受邀评估证据的质量。

appraise.en: The committee will appraise the significance of the revised findings for policy.
appraise.zh: 委员会将评估修订后的研究结果对政策的意义。

appraise.en: Performance indicators should not be used to appraise individual researchers.
appraise.zh: 绩效指标不应用于评价个别研究者。

appraisal.en: The paper offers a critical appraisal of the method used in earlier trials.
appraisal.zh: 该论文对早期试验所用的方法作了批判性评估。

appraisal.en: A detailed appraisal of the archival material is still required.
appraisal.zh: 仍需对档案材料进行详尽评估。

appraisal.en: Her appraisal of the provenance of the archive changed the argument of the article.
appraisal.zh: 她对该档案来源的鉴定改变了这篇文章的论点。

reiterate.en: The director reiterated the importance of reporting negative results.
reiterate.zh: 主任重申了报告阴性结果的重要性。

reiterate.en: Reviewers should reiterate that the estimates remain provisional until further data arrive.
reiterate.zh: 审稿人应反复说明在获得更多数据之前这些估计仍是初步的。

reiterate.en: She reiterated her objection to the revised terminology throughout the hearing.
reiterate.zh: 在整场听证会上她反复重申自己对修订术语的反对。

restate.en: The abstract restates the research question in fewer than thirty words.
restate.zh: 摘要在不到三十个词内重述了研究问题。

restate.en: Let me restate the argument in more precise terms.
restate.zh: 让我用更准确的措辞重新表述这一论点。

restate.en: The revised chapter restates the hypothesis without adding supporting evidence.
restate.zh: 修订后的章节重述了假设，却没有补充支持性证据。

reconsider.en: The panel was asked to reconsider the design after the pilot failed.
reconsider.zh: 试点失败之后评审组被要求重新考虑该设计。

reconsider.en: We should reconsider our interpretation of the early survey data.
reconsider.zh: 我们应当重新审视对早期调查数据的解读。

reconsider.en: The court agreed to reconsider the case in light of new testimony.
reconsider.zh: 考虑到新的证词，法院同意重新审视此案。

situate.en: The introduction should situate the study within the wider debate on urban transport.
situate.zh: 引言应把该研究置于更广泛的城市交通讨论之中。

situate.en: The lecture situates each poet in the political conditions of her own time.
situate.zh: 讲座把每位诗人置于其所处时代的政治环境之中。

situate.en: Without situating the figures in historical context, the argument is hard to assess.
situate.zh: 如果不把这些数字置于历史背景之中，这一论点就难以评估。

delimit.en: The authors delimit the scope of the survey to three coastal provinces.
delimit.zh: 作者把调查范围限定在三个沿海省份。

delimit.en: The abstract delimits the research question narrowly and defensibly.
delimit.zh: 摘要对研究问题作了范围较窄且立得住的界定。

delimit.en: The agreement delimits the responsibility of each agency involved.
delimit.zh: 该协议划定了各相关机构的责任边界。

reconstruct.en: Archaeologists reconstructed the exchange network from pottery fragments found along the coastal sites.
reconstruct.zh: 考古学家依据沿海遗址出土的陶器碎片重建了这条交换网络。

reconstruct.en: The simulation reconstructs the historical sequence of land use from pollen and charcoal records.
reconstruct.zh: 该模拟依据花粉与木炭记录还原了历史上的土地利用序列。

reconstruct.en: Laboratory analysts reconstruct the original pigment mixture by separating layers of the painted panel.
reconstruct.zh: 实验室分析人员通过分离彩绘板上的颜料层还原了原始的颜料配比。

overstate.en: Summaries that overstate the implications of a single site risk misleading readers about the broader pattern.
overstate.zh: 夸大单个遗址之含义的综述，可能使读者误解整体格局。

overstate.en: The review explicitly warns against overstating a correlation as evidence of a causal mechanism.
overstate.zh: 该综述明确警告不要把相关性夸大为因果机制的证据。

overstate.en: Advocates sometimes overstate the benefits of the reform while understating its distributional costs.
overstate.zh: 倡导者有时会夸大改革的好处，同时淡化其分配成本。

bolster.en: Two independent replications bolster confidence in the reported effect size.
bolster.zh: 两项独立的重复研究增强了对所报告效应量的信心。

bolster.en: The revised chapter bolsters its central claim by adding a formal sensitivity analysis.
bolster.zh: 修订后的章节通过补充一项正式的敏感性分析来加强其核心论点。

bolster.en: Citing archival records bolsters the credibility of the chronology proposed by the author.
bolster.zh: 引用档案记录增强了该作者所提出年代序列的可信度。

reframe.en: The research group decided to reframe the problem in terms of incentives rather than intentions.
reframe.zh: 研究小组决定从激励而非意向的角度重新表述该问题。

reframe.en: When a key assumption fails, analysts must reframe the hypothesis before collecting more evidence.
reframe.zh: 当关键假设失效时，分析者必须在收集更多证据之前重构假设框架。

reframe.en: Later scholarship reframed the debate by shifting attention to institutional arrangements.
reframe.zh: 后来的研究通过把注意力转向制度安排重构了这一争论的框架。

rethink.en: A crisis in replication led researchers to rethink the unit of analysis used in the survey.
rethink.zh: 重复性研究出现的危机促使研究者重新思考该调查所采用的分析单位。

rethink.en: Critics urged the team to rethink how learning outcomes are operationalized across disciplines.
rethink.zh: 批评者敦促该团队重新思考学习成果在不同学科中的操作化方式。

rethink.en: The seminar was designed to rethink the boundary between description and explanation.
rethink.zh: 该研讨班的设计意图是重新思考描述与解释之间的界线。

interrogate.en: Statisticians should interrogate the data for missing values and implausible patterns before modeling.
interrogate.zh: 统计学家在建模之前应当细查数据中的缺失值与不合常理的模式。

interrogate.en: The seminar invites participants to interrogate each assumption that underpins the published model.
interrogate.zh: 该研讨班邀请参与者追问已发表模型所依赖的每一项假设。

interrogate.en: Field researchers interrogate assumptions about what participants are willing to disclose.
interrogate.zh: 实地研究者细查关于受访者愿意透露何种信息的种种假设。

objection.en: Any valid objection to the sampling procedure must be addressed in the revised protocol.
objection.zh: 对抽样程序的任何有效异议都必须在修订后的方案中予以处理。

objection.en: Reviewers raised a strong objection to the way the dependent variable was operationalized.
objection.zh: 评审者对因变量的操作化方式提出了有力的反对意见。

objection.en: The author replied to the objection by presenting an additional robustness check.
objection.zh: 作者通过给出一项额外的稳健性检验来回应这一异议。

counterexample.en: A single counterexample is enough to refute a claim stated as a universal generalization.
counterexample.zh: 一个反例就足以驳倒一个被表述为普遍规律的主张。

counterexample.en: The authors search the corpus for a counterexample that would weaken their thesis.
counterexample.zh: 作者们在语料库中搜寻一个能削弱其论点的反例。

counterexample.en: Reviewers treat a counterexample as a standard test of whether a mechanism generalizes beyond a single case.
counterexample.zh: 评审者把反例视为检验某一机制能否超越单个案例而推广的标准手段。

misconception.en: Diagnostic interviews revealed a widespread misconception about how the vaccine actually protects individuals.
misconception.zh: 诊断性访谈揭示了关于该疫苗究竟如何保护个体的普遍误解。

misconception.en: The instructor corrected a common misconception by contrasting correlation with causation.
misconception.zh: 教师通过对比相关与因果纠正了一个常见误解。

misconception.en: Misconceptions about statistical significance persist even among graduate students in the discipline.
misconception.zh: 关于统计显著性的错误观念即使在该学科的研究生中也依然存在。

burden.en: In civil litigation the burden of proof rests with the party bringing the claim.
burden.zh: 在民事诉讼中，举证责任由提出主张的一方承担。

burden.en: The burden of explanation falls on the author who reports an unusual effect.
burden.zh: 解释责任落在报告异常效应的作者身上。

burden.en: Interview schedules were kept short so that the burden on participants remained low.
burden.zh: 访谈提纲被设计得很短，以使受访者的负担保持在较低水平。

concordance.en: The concordance between the two raters was high, which supports the reliability of the coding scheme.
concordance.zh: 两位评分者之间的一致程度很高，这支持了该编码方案的可靠性。

concordance.en: A concordance search of the corpus reveals how often the collocation appears in academic prose.
concordance.zh: 对该语料库所作的索引检索显示这一搭配在学术文本中出现的频率。

concordance.en: Agreement between the coders was summarized with a concordance correlation coefficient.
concordance.zh: 编码者之间的一致程度通过一致性相关系数加以概括。

modality.en: The study compares three modalities of governance used by similar regional organizations.
modality.zh: 该研究比较了同类区域组织所采用的三种治理方式。

modality.en: Each modality of assessment captures a different aspect of student proficiency.
modality.zh: 每一种评估方式都捕捉到学生熟练度的不同侧面。

modality.en: The authors distinguish between the legal modality and the informal modality of the practice.
modality.zh: 作者区分了该实践的法律形态与非正式形态。

sound.en: The argument proceeds on sound premises and reaches a conclusion that the evidence can support.
sound.zh: 该论证建立在可靠的前提之上，并得出证据能够支撑的结论。

sound.en: A methodologically sound design must specify its sampling frame and its exclusion criteria in advance.
sound.zh: 方法上严谨的设计必须预先说明其抽样框与排除标准。

sound.en: Reviewers judged the interpretation sound even though the underlying measurement was imperfect.
sound.zh: 尽管测量本身并不完美，评审者仍认为这一解释是严谨的。

credible.en: A credible account of the events requires more than a single witness statement.
credible.zh: 对所发生事件的可信叙述需要的不止是一份证人陈述。

credible.en: The committee insisted on a credible mechanism linking exposure to outcome before accepting the proposal.
credible.zh: 委员会在采纳提案之前，坚持要求给出把暴露与结果联系起来的可信机制。

credible.en: Without external validation the claim lacks a credible basis for generalization.
credible.zh: 缺少外部验证，该主张便缺乏可据以推广的可信依据。

convincing.en: The convergence of independent lines of evidence makes the interpretation highly convincing.
convincing.zh: 多条独立证据线索的汇聚使这一解释极具说服力。

convincing.en: Presentations rarely change practice unless the evidence appears convincing to senior colleagues.
convincing.zh: 除非证据在资深同事看来令人信服，报告很少能改变实践。

convincing.en: The authors offer a convincing demonstration that the effect survives alternative model specifications.
convincing.zh: 作者给出了一个有说服力的论证，表明该效应在替代的模型设定下依然成立。

germane.en: The chair ruled that testimony about earlier funding decisions was not germane to the current inquiry.
germane.zh: 主席裁定关于早期经费决策的证词与当前调查无关。

germane.en: Only observations germane to the research question were retained in the final dataset.
germane.zh: 最终数据集中只保留了与研究问题直接相关的观察。

germane.en: Applicants are asked to omit any information that is not germane to the criteria.
germane.zh: 申请人被要求略去任何与评审标准无关的信息。

epistemological.en: The paper offers an epistemological grounding for treating disagreement as evidence rather than noise.
epistemological.zh: 该论文为把分歧视为证据而非噪声提供了认识论依据。

epistemological.en: Reviewers disagreed on epistemological grounds, since the two teams read validity in different ways.
epistemological.zh: 评审者在认识论立场层面存在分歧，因为两个团队对效度的理解方式不同。

epistemological.en: The course introduces students to epistemological questions about how claims acquire warrant.
epistemological.zh: 该课程向学生介绍关于主张如何获得根据的认识论问题。

ontological.en: The framework makes explicit its ontological commitments about the kinds of entities it admits.
ontological.zh: 该框架明确交代了其关于所容纳实体种类的本体论承诺。

ontological.en: Reviewers asked whether the model carries ontological assumptions that the data cannot check.
ontological.zh: 评审者追问该模型是否带有数据无法检验的本体论假设。

ontological.en: Disagreement about ontological commitments complicates any comparison between the two traditions.
ontological.zh: 围绕本体论承诺的分歧使两个传统之间的任何比较都变得复杂。

axiomatic.en: The treatment rests on an axiomatic foundation developed for formal networks long ago.
axiomatic.zh: 该处理方式建立在一个很久以前为形式网络发展出来的公理基础之上。

axiomatic.en: Rather than merely appeal to intuition, the author derives each proposition from an explicit set of axioms.
axiomatic.zh: 作者并非仅仅诉诸直觉，而是从一组明确的公理出发推出每一条命题。

axiomatic.en: Critics doubt that the axiomatic approach captures the messiness of empirical research.
axiomatic.zh: 批评者怀疑这种基于公理的方法能否把握经验研究的杂乱性。

abductive.en: Diagnosis in medicine relies on abductive reasoning, since the clinician seeks the best available explanation.
abductive.zh: 医学诊断依赖溯因推理，因为临床医生要寻找现有的最佳解释。

abductive.en: The abductive inference moves from the surprising observation to the hypothesis that would account for it.
abductive.zh: 这一溯因推论从令人费解的观察出发，推向能够解释它的假设。

abductive.en: Abductive reasoning complements deductive and inductive arguments in scientific practice.
abductive.zh: 在科学实践中，溯因推理与演绎论证和归纳论证互为补充。

descriptive.en: The first chapter provides descriptive statistics for the full sample before any modeling.
descriptive.zh: 第一章在任何建模之前给出了完整样本的描述统计。

descriptive.en: A descriptive account of regional variation is useful even when no causal claim is made.
descriptive.zh: 即便不作任何因果断言，对区域变异的描述也仍然有用。

descriptive.en: The paper stays descriptive throughout and makes no claim about mechanisms.
descriptive.zh: 该论文通篇停留在描述层面，不对机制作出任何主张。

prescriptive.en: The report separates descriptive findings from prescriptive recommendations about how policy should change.
prescriptive.zh: 该报告把描述性发现与关于政策应当如何改变的规范性建议区分开来。

prescriptive.en: A prescriptive claim about ideal governance goes beyond what the survey data can establish.
prescriptive.zh: 关于理想治理的规定性主张超出了调查数据所能确立的范围。

prescriptive.en: Critics object that the document is too prescriptive for an exploratory stage of the project.
prescriptive.zh: 批评者反对说，对于尚处探索阶段的项目，该文件的规定性过强。

incisive.en: Her incisive critique of the model revealed its hidden circularity.
incisive.zh: 她对该模型尖锐的批评揭出了其中隐藏的循环论证。

incisive.en: The paper draws an incisive distinction between adaptation and mitigation.
incisive.zh: 该文在适应与减缓之间作了切中要害的区分。

incisive.en: The interviewer asked incisive questions that exposed inconsistencies in the testimony.
incisive.zh: 访谈者尖锐的提问暴露了证词中的自相矛盾之处。

penetrating.en: The article offers a penetrating analysis of the causes of the crisis.
penetrating.zh: 该文对危机的成因作出了透彻的分析。

penetrating.en: Her penetrating questions revealed what the survey had overlooked.
penetrating.zh: 她敏锐的提问揭示了调查所忽略的部分。

penetrating.en: The penetrating scrutiny of the archive changed the accepted chronology.
penetrating.zh: 对档案的透彻审视改变了公认的年代序列。

scholarly.en: The scholarly debate over this term has run for two centuries.
scholarly.zh: 围绕这一术语的学术论辩已持续两个世纪。

scholarly.en: Her scholarly tradition traces back to a treatise on natural philosophy.
scholarly.zh: 她的学术脉络可追溯到一篇关于自然哲学的论著。

scholarly.en: The journal publishes only scholarly work that has been peer reviewed.
scholarly.zh: 该期刊只发表经过同行评审的学术性成果。

judicious.en: The judicious use of primary sources strengthened the argument considerably.
judicious.zh: 对原始文献的审慎使用显著增强了论证力度。

judicious.en: Judicious editing preserved the manuscript without altering its voice.
judicious.zh: 审慎的编辑保存了这份手稿而未改变其语调。

judicious.en: She made a judicious decision to postpone the survey until the flood receded.
judicious.zh: 她明智地决定把调查推迟到洪水退去之后。

prudent.en: The report offers prudent policy recommendations for coastal managers.
prudent.zh: 该报告为海岸管理者提出了谨慎的政策建议。

prudent.en: Prudent budgeting kept the laboratory solvent through the lean years.
prudent.zh: 谨慎的预算使实验室在拮据年份得以维持收支平衡。

prudent.en: It would be prudent to verify the figures before the article goes to press.
prudent.zh: 在文章付印之前核对这些数字是审慎之举。

astute.en: Her astute reading of the evidence anticipated what later trials confirmed.
astute.zh: 她对证据敏锐的解读预见了后来的试验所证实的结论。

astute.en: The astute negotiator recognized the ambiguity in the offer immediately.
astute.zh: 那位精明的谈判者立刻察觉到报价中的模糊之处。

astute.en: An astute reviewer spotted the flaw in the identification strategy.
astute.zh: 一位敏锐的审稿人发现了识别策略中的缺陷。

apt.en: Epidemiology provides an apt description of how the outbreak spread.
apt.zh: 流行病学为该疫情如何扩散提供了恰当的描述。

apt.en: The author selects an apt term for a concept long recognized in the trade.
apt.zh: 作者为一个早已在该行业中被认识的概念选取了切题的术语。

apt.en: Her metaphor was apt enough to carry the argument a long way.
apt.zh: 她的比喻十分贴切，足以把论证推进很远。

appreciable.en: Rainfall had an appreciable effect on the growth of the seedlings.
appreciable.zh: 降雨对幼苗的生长产生了相当大的影响。

appreciable.en: The reform brought about an appreciable decline in infant mortality.
appreciable.zh: 该改革带来了婴儿死亡率的显著下降。

appreciable.en: Even an appreciable sample size cannot rescue a biased sampling frame.
appreciable.zh: 即使样本量相当可观，也无法挽救一个有偏的抽样框。

landmark.en: The landmark study reshaped how the disease was understood.
landmark.zh: 这项里程碑式的研究重塑了人们对该疾病的理解。

landmark.en: Their landmark discovery opened an entirely new field in chemistry.
landmark.zh: 他们的划时代发现在化学中开启了一个全新的领域。

landmark.en: The court handed down a landmark ruling on the boundary question.
landmark.zh: 法庭就边界问题作出了里程碑式的裁决。

invariably.en: The rule invariably follows from the assumptions set out above.
invariably.zh: 该规则始终如一地由上文所列的假设推出。

invariably.en: Delays invariably followed the arrival of the inspection team.
invariably.zh: 延误总是随着检查组的到来而发生。

invariably.en: Whatever the sampling scheme, the estimate invariably points in the same direction.
invariably.zh: 无论采用何种抽样方案，估计值总是指向同一方向。

narrow.en: The study adopted a narrow focus on a single river basin.
narrow.zh: 该研究采取了仅聚焦于单一流域的狭窄视角。

narrow.en: A narrow scope limits what the survey can claim about the whole region.
narrow.zh: 狭窄的范围限制了调查对整个地区所能作出的论断。

narrow.en: The narrow pass between the ridges funnelled the winter winds.
narrow.zh: 山脊之间的狭窄隘口使冬季的风汇聚成股。

inconsistent.en: The estimate is inconsistent with prior findings from the same laboratory.
inconsistent.zh: 该估计与同一实验室此前的发现不一致。

inconsistent.en: His argument is internally inconsistent and cannot sustain its conclusion.
inconsistent.zh: 他的论证在内部自相矛盾，无法支撑其结论。

inconsistent.en: Inconsistent coding across the two teams inflated the error rate.
inconsistent.zh: 两个团队编码不一致抬高了误差率。

conflict.en: There is a conflict between the theory and the evidence assembled here.
conflict.zh: 理论与此处汇集的证据之间存在冲突。

conflict.en: The conflict between the two dating methods has yet to be resolved.
conflict.zh: 两种定年方法之间的冲突至今尚未解决。

conflict.en: Where the two codes conflict, the more conservative one prevails.
conflict.zh: 在两部法典抵触之处，以较为保守的一部为准。

conflicting.en: Conflicting evidence from the two sites complicates the reconstruction.
conflicting.zh: 来自这两处遗址的相互冲突的证据使重建工作复杂化。

conflicting.en: The witnesses gave conflicting accounts of the same evening.
conflicting.zh: 各位证人对同一晚的情形给出了相互矛盾的陈述。

conflicting.en: Conflicting reports were reconciled by returning to the original logs.
conflicting.zh: 通过回查原始日志，相互冲突的报告得到了调和。

contested.en: The contested concept has been defined in at least four incompatible ways.
contested.zh: 这一有争议的概念至少有四种互不相容的界定。

contested.en: Control of the contested plain passed between two rival administrations.
contested.zh: 这片被争夺的平原的控制权在两个对立的行政当局之间易手。

contested.en: Historians continue to debate the contested origins of the institution.
contested.zh: 历史学家仍在争论该机构那颇受争议的起源。

disputed.en: The disputed findings were reanalyzed before appearing in the review.
disputed.zh: 这些有争议的结论在进入综述之前被重新分析。

disputed.en: The boundary remains disputed among three neighboring provinces.
disputed.zh: 这条边界在相邻的三个省之间仍存争议。

disputed.en: A disputed estimate of population size biases the whole reconstruction.
disputed.zh: 一个有争议的人口规模估计会使整个重建产生偏倚。

contentious.en: The proposal met with a contentious reception at the public hearing.
contentious.zh: 该提案在公开听证会上引起了充满争议的反响。

contentious.en: Genetic modification remains a contentious topic in the curriculum debate.
contentious.zh: 基因改造在课程论辩中仍是一个易引起争执的话题。

contentious.en: The committee deferred the contentious issue of funding to a later session.
contentious.zh: 委员会把经费这一有争议的问题推迟到后续会议处理。

inconclusive.en: The results were inconclusive and did not settle the question.
inconclusive.zh: 结果并不确定，未能就此问题作出定论。

inconclusive.en: The trial stopped early because the interim analysis proved inconclusive.
inconclusive.zh: 由于中期分析证明无定论，试验提前终止。

inconclusive.en: Inconclusive evidence about the mechanism keeps the model under debate.
inconclusive.zh: 关于该机制的证据不确定，使该模型持续处于争论之中。

indirect.en: The program had an indirect effect on prices in adjacent markets.
indirect.zh: 该项目对邻近市场的价格产生了间接影响。

indirect.en: Indirect evidence from the archive supports the later chronology.
indirect.zh: 来自档案的间接证据支持了较晚的年代序列。

indirect.en: The link between the two variables is indirect but consistent.
indirect.zh: 两个变量之间的联系是间接的，但保持一致。

unbiased.en: Random sampling yields an unbiased estimator of the population mean.
unbiased.zh: 随机抽样给出一个关于总体均值的无偏估计量。

unbiased.en: The reviewers stayed unbiased by declining invitations from both camps.
unbiased.zh: 审稿人拒绝了来自双方的邀请，从而保持了不偏不倚。

unbiased.en: An unbiased assessment requires that the raters remain blind to the source.
unbiased.zh: 无偏的评估要求评分者对来源保持盲态。

nontrivial.en: The treatment had a nontrivial effect on recovery time.
nontrivial.zh: 该治疗对恢复时间产生了显著的影响。

nontrivial.en: Establishing a nontrivial causal link requires a longitudinal design.
nontrivial.zh: 确立一条实质性的因果联系需要纵向研究设计。

nontrivial.en: The difference between the two estimators is nontrivial in small samples.
nontrivial.zh: 两个估计量之间的差异在小样本中不可忽略。

desirable.en: Stability is a desirable property of any long-term estimator.
desirable.zh: 稳定性是任何长期估计量都合乎需要的性质。

desirable.en: It is desirable to replicate the analysis with a second instrument.
desirable.zh: 用第二种测量工具重复该分析是值得期望的。

desirable.en: The authors identify several desirable trends in the regional record.
desirable.zh: 作者辨认出区域记录中的若干可取趋势。

secondary.en: Fatigue proved secondary to pain, which was the dominant complaint among patients.
secondary.zh: 在患者中，疼痛是主要主诉，疲劳则被证明居于次要地位。

secondary.en: The protocol treats adherence to the schedule as a secondary objective rather than the main aim.
secondary.zh: 该方案把遵守时间表视为次要目标，而非主要目的。

secondary.en: Economic gains remained secondary to ecological objectives in the evaluation of the scheme.
secondary.zh: 在该方案的评估中，经济收益相对于生态目标而言仍居次要地位。

unambiguous.en: The isotope ratios provided unambiguous evidence that the samples shared a common source.
unambiguous.zh: 同位素比值提供了明确的证据，表明这些样品来源相同。

unambiguous.en: Reviewers asked for unambiguous wording so that replication of the procedure remains feasible.
unambiguous.zh: 审稿人要求表述明确不含糊，以便该程序仍可被重复。

unambiguous.en: Her interpretation rests on unambiguous signals in the archival record rather than on inference.
unambiguous.zh: 她的解释依据档案记录中明确的信号，而非推断。

insufficient.en: The sampling rate was insufficient to detect rare adverse outcomes in the treated group.
insufficient.zh: 抽样率不足以在治疗组中检出罕见的不良结局。

insufficient.en: Measurement precision was insufficient for stable estimation of the coefficient.
insufficient.zh: 测量精度不足以对该系数进行稳定估计。

insufficient.en: Two reviewers judged the description of the instrument insufficient for exact replication.
insufficient.zh: 两位评审认为该工具的描述不够充分，无法精确重复。

multiple.en: Each participant completed multiple trials in randomized order across the session.
multiple.zh: 每位参与者在该次实验中以随机顺序完成了多次试验。

multiple.en: The synthesis used corrections for multiple comparisons to control the family-wise error rate.
multiple.zh: 该综述采用了多重比较校正，以控制族错误率。

multiple.en: Multiple regression with interaction terms clarified the independent effect of each predictor.
multiple.zh: 含交互项的多元回归厘清了各预测变量的独立效应。

study.en: Her study challenges the assumption that growth in enrollment is driven by rising population.
study.zh: 她的研究质疑了入学增长由人口上升驱动的假设。

study.en: The study reports that attrition differed substantially between the two recruitment channels.
study.zh: 该研究报告称，两条招募渠道之间的流失情况差异显著。

study.en: Because the study drew on archival records, its conclusions remain open to reanalysis.
study.zh: 由于该研究取材于档案记录，其结论仍有重新分析的空间。

paper.en: The paper was accepted after the authors added a robustness check to the appendix.
paper.zh: 在作者于附录中补充稳健性检验后，该论文被接收。

paper.en: Every paper in the volume addresses the relation between labor markets and migration.
paper.zh: 该文集收录的每篇论文都探讨了劳动力市场与迁移之间的关系。

paper.en: Her paper has been cited mainly for its methodological appendix rather than its conclusions.
paper.zh: 她的论文主要因其方法附录而非其结论被引用。

discussion.en: The discussion section should acknowledge alternative explanations for the observed pattern.
discussion.zh: 讨论部分应当承认对所观察模式的替代性解释。

discussion.en: The seminar discussion revealed that participants held incompatible definitions of fairness.
discussion.zh: 研讨会上的讨论显示，参与者对公平的定义互不相容。

discussion.en: Her contribution to the discussion of the case remains open to later scrutiny.
discussion.zh: 她对该案例讨论所作的贡献仍有待后人审视。

review.en: A systematic review of the trial evidence was carried out under a registered protocol.
review.zh: 对试验证据的系统综述是在注册方案下完成的。

review.en: The manuscript received a constructive review from three anonymous referees.
review.zh: 该稿件收到了三位匿名评审人的中肯评审意见。

review.en: We review the competing models and explain why the simpler specification suffices.
review.zh: 我们评述了各竞争模型，并说明为何较简单的设定已足够。

practice.en: Best practice in this field requires preregistration of the analysis plan.
practice.zh: 该领域的最佳实践要求预先注册分析计划。

practice.en: Clinicians abandoned the procedure once it proved inconsistent with routine practice.
practice.zh: 临床医生一旦发现该程序与常规实践不符便予以放弃。

practice.en: Trainees practice the procedure under supervision before working unsupervised.
practice.zh: 受训者在独立操作前，先在监督下练习该流程。

statistics.en: The statistics reported in the abstract did not match those in the main tables.
statistics.zh: 摘要中报告的统计数据与正文表格中的并不一致。

statistics.en: She teaches statistics to graduate students in the social sciences.
statistics.zh: 她为社会科学专业的研究生讲授统计学。

statistics.en: The summary statistics obscure the heterogeneity between the two subgroups.
statistics.zh: 这些汇总统计数字掩盖了两个子群之间的异质性。

input.en: The model receives input from several sensors mounted along the frame.
input.zh: 该模型接收来自安装在机架上的若干传感器的输入。

input.en: Policy input from ministries was consolidated before the modeling exercise began.
input.zh: 在建模工作开始前，各部委提供的政策意见被统一汇总。

input.en: Increasing the input of nitrogen raised yield but also intensified leaching.
input.zh: 增加氮肥投入提高了产量，但也加剧了养分淋失。

task.en: The task was to determine whether the intervention changed referral behavior.
task.zh: 该研究任务是确定干预措施是否改变了转诊行为。

task.en: Participants who received training finished the task in less time.
task.zh: 接受培训的参与者完成该任务所用的时间更短。

task.en: Each task in the battery was piloted with students before the main session.
task.zh: 该测验组中的每项任务都在主实验前由学生试做。

standpoint.en: From a historical standpoint, the reform belongs to a wider movement of institutional change.
standpoint.zh: 从历史角度看，这场改革属于更广泛的制度变迁运动。

standpoint.en: The author's standpoint is that classification should follow function rather than form.
standpoint.zh: 作者的观点是分类应依据功能而非形式。

standpoint.en: Adopting the standpoint of the practitioner clarifies what counts as a meaningful outcome.
standpoint.zh: 采用实践者的立场有助于厘清何为有意义的结果。

lens.en: Viewed through the lens of labor economics, the reform appears to be a form of income redistribution.
lens.zh: 从劳动经济学的视角看，这场改革似乎是一种收入再分配。

lens.en: A wide-angle lens captured the whole observatory in a single frame.
lens.zh: 一只广角镜头在单帧中拍下了整座天文台。

lens.en: Historians examine the event through the lens of later developments.
lens.zh: 历史学家以后来的发展为视角来审视这一事件。

barrier.en: Informal financing remains the principal barrier to scaling the intervention.
barrier.zh: 非正式融资仍是扩大该干预规模的根本障碍。

barrier.en: Language certification continues to be a substantial barrier for qualified migrant researchers.
barrier.zh: 语言资格认证对具备资质的移民研究者而言仍是重大障碍。

barrier.en: Low literacy erected an enduring barrier to participation in village assemblies.
barrier.zh: 识字率低下为参与村庄议事会设置了长期障碍。

continuum.en: Care for patients with chronic pain spans a continuum from self-management to specialist referral.
continuum.zh: 慢性疼痛患者的照护涵盖从自我管理到专科转诊的连续谱。

continuum.en: The authors argue that addiction severity lies along a continuum rather than in categories.
continuum.zh: 作者认为成瘾严重程度处于连续体上，而非隶属于若干类别。

continuum.en: Anxiety was measured on a continuum from mild worry to severe distress.
continuum.zh: 焦虑程度是在从轻微担忧到严重痛苦的连续谱上测量的。

utility.en: The utility function is concave, implying diminishing marginal benefit from additional units.
utility.zh: 该效用函数是凹的，这意味着追加单位的边际效用递减。

utility.en: Participants evaluated the utility of each option under the stated time constraints.
utility.zh: 参与者在给定的时间限制下评估了每种选项的效用。

utility.en: Utility theory underpins the choice model used in the analysis.
utility.zh: 效用理论构成了该分析中所用选择模型的基础。

match.en: Each treated case was matched with several controls sharing age and clinical severity.
match.zh: 每个接受治疗的病例都按年龄和病情严重程度与若干对照进行了匹配。

match.en: The design should match the two groups on prior attainment and socioeconomic background.
match.zh: 该设计应在既往成绩和社会经济背景上使两组保持可比。

match.en: Matching on pretreatment covariates reduced the imbalance between the compared groups.
match.zh: 按处理前协变量进行配对减轻了受比较组之间的不平衡。

nonresponse.en: Nonresponse was addressed by repeated callbacks on different days of the week.
nonresponse.zh: 无应答问题通过在一周不同日期反复回访来解决。

nonresponse.en: A high nonresponse rate among younger households introduced selection bias.
nonresponse.zh: 年轻家庭中的高无应答率带来了选择偏倚。

nonresponse.en: Nonresponse analysis showed that the missing units resembled those who replied.
nonresponse.zh: 无应答分析显示未作答单位与作出应答者特征相似。

census.en: Census data for the district were obtained from the national statistics office.
census.zh: 该地区的普查数据取自国家统计局。

census.en: The team conducted a census of every household rather than drawing a sample.
census.zh: 研究团队对每一户人家进行了全面普查，而非抽取样本。

census.en: Census records allow the researchers to compare birth cohorts across two decades.
census.zh: 普查记录使研究者得以比较跨越二十年的出生队列。

pilot.en: A pilot run revealed that the instrument took far longer than expected.
pilot.zh: 预试验显示该工具所耗时间远超预期。

pilot.en: The pilot informed substantial revisions to the consent materials.
pilot.zh: 试点工作促成了知情同意材料的实质性修订。

pilot.en: Two laboratories served as pilot sites for the new protocol.
pilot.zh: 两个实验室充当了新方案的试点场所。

quasi-experimental.en: The quasi-experimental design exploited a phased rollout across districts.
quasi-experimental.zh: 该准实验设计利用了各地区分阶段推行的条件。

quasi-experimental.en: Because assignment was not random, the quasi-experimental analysis relies on adjustment for observed confounders.
quasi-experimental.zh: 由于分组并非随机，准实验分析依赖于对已观测混杂因素的调整。

quasi-experimental.en: A quasi-experimental comparison of the two schedules is the closest available alternative to a trial.
quasi-experimental.zh: 对两种时间安排的准实验比较是现有条件下最接近试验的替代方案。

CONSORT.en: Trial reports must follow the CONSORT statement to support transparent assessment of methods.
CONSORT.zh: 试验报告必须遵循 CONSORT 声明，以支持对研究方法的透明评估。

CONSORT.en: Reviewers asked authors to submit a CONSORT flow diagram alongside the trial registry identifier.
CONSORT.zh: 审稿人要求作者在投稿时附上 CONSORT 流程图与试验注册标识。

CONSORT.en: Journal editors cited CONSORT as the basis for checking whether outcome definitions were reported consistently.
CONSORT.zh: 期刊编辑以 CONSORT 为依据，核查各结局指标的定义是否报告得一致。

STROBE.en: Cohort papers should follow the STROBE statement when describing participant selection and outcome measures.
STROBE.zh: 队列研究论文在描述受试者选择与结局指标时应遵循 STROBE 声明。

STROBE.en: The STROBE checklist helped reviewers locate biases in the retrospective analysis of hospital records.
STROBE.zh: STROBE 清单帮助审稿人发现了该回顾性病历分析中的偏倚。

STROBE.en: Authors explained how their cohort design met each STROBE item that applied to observational research.
STROBE.zh: 作者说明其队列设计如何满足适用于观察性研究的每一项 STROBE 条目。

standard error.en: The reported standard error grew as the sample size within each subgroup declined.
standard error.zh: 各亚组样本量下降时，报告的标准误随之增大。

standard error.en: Confidence intervals were derived from the standard error of the estimated mean difference.
standard error.zh: 置信区间由均值差估计值的标准误推得。

standard error.en: Rounding the standard error upward made the reported effect appear less precise than it was.
standard error.zh: 将标准误向上取整会使所报告效应的精确度显得低于实际水平。

covariance.en: Covariance between the two markers was positive, indicating that their concentrations tended to move together.
covariance.zh: 两种标志物之间的协方差为正，表明其浓度往往同向变化。

covariance.en: Ignoring covariance between the variables distorted the estimated variance of their sum.
covariance.zh: 忽略变量间的协方差会使其总和的估计方差失真。

covariance.en: Positive covariance between rainfall and yields indicates that the two variables tend to move together.
covariance.zh: 降雨与产量之间的正协方差表明，这两个变量往往同向变化。

heteroskedasticity.en: Heteroskedasticity in the residuals invalidates the usual standard errors of the regression coefficients.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 残差中的异方差性使得回归系数的常规标准误失效。

heteroskedasticity.en: Heteroskedasticity-robust estimators were reported because the variance of the errors differed across groups.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 由于误差方差在不同组间确有差异，研究报告了异方差稳健估计量。

heteroskedasticity.en: Plots of squared residuals against fitted values helped diagnose heteroskedasticity before any formal test.
heteroskedasticity.zh: 以平方残差对拟合值作图，可在任何正式检验之前诊断异方差性。

autocorrelation.en: Autocorrelation in the residual series inflated the apparent precision of the estimated trend.
autocorrelation.zh: 残差序列中的自相关夸大了所估计趋势的表观精确度。

autocorrelation.en: Positive autocorrelation in annual rainfall implies that wet years tend to follow wet years.
autocorrelation.zh: 年降水量的正自相关意味着多雨年份往往接续出现。

autocorrelation.en: The model was refitted with an autocorrelation term to account for dependence among successive observations.
autocorrelation.zh: 模型重新拟合并加入自相关项，以处理相继观测之间的依赖性。

missing data.en: Missing data were handled with multiple imputation rather than by deleting incomplete cases.
missing data.zh: 数据缺失采用多重插补处理，而非直接删除不完整个案。

missing data.en: A sensitivity analysis examined how strongly the missing data mechanism had to depend on unobserved values to change the conclusions.
missing data.zh: 一项敏感性分析考察了数据缺失机制须在多大程度上依赖未观测值，才会改变结论。

missing data.en: Reporting the amount of missing data for each variable is now expected by most journals.
missing data.zh: 报告各变量的数据缺失量如今已成为多数期刊的要求。

bootstrap.en: We bootstrap the standard error of the estimated effect to obtain a bias-corrected interval.
bootstrap.zh: 我们以自助法重抽样估计效应量的标准误，从而得到偏差校正区间。

bootstrap.en: Researchers bootstrap the sampling distribution when the analytical form of the estimator is unknown.
bootstrap.zh: 当估计量的解析形式未知时，研究者以自助法重抽样获得抽样分布。

bootstrap.en: Bootstrapping the model-selection procedure revealed how unstable the ranking of models was.
bootstrap.zh: 对模型选择过程进行自助抽样，揭示了模型排序的不稳定性。

permutation.en: A permutation test provides an exact p value when the sampling distribution cannot be derived analytically.
permutation.zh: 当抽样分布无法解析导出时，置换检验可给出精确的 p 值。

permutation.en: Permutation of the group labels was repeated many times to build a null distribution.
permutation.zh: 通过对组别标签进行置换并多次重复，构建了零分布。

permutation.en: The permutation scheme preserves the exchangeability assumption that the test relies upon.
permutation.zh: 该置换方案保留了检验所依赖的可交换性假设。

degrees of freedom.en: Reducing the number of covariates gives the regression more degrees of freedom.
degrees of freedom.zh: 减少协变量数量可为回归模型提供更多自由度。

degrees of freedom.en: The reported standard error was adjusted for the degrees of freedom lost by the restriction.
degrees of freedom.zh: 报告的标准误已就因约束而损失的自由度作了调整。

degrees of freedom.en: Simulation results depended strongly on the degrees of freedom assumed for each variance component.
degrees of freedom.zh: 模拟结果显著依赖于为各方差成分所假定的自由度。

chi-square.en: A chi-square test of independence revealed no significant association between treatment group and recovery time.
chi-square.zh: 独立性卡方检验显示治疗组别与恢复时间之间无显著关联。

chi-square.en: The chi-square statistic was unreliable because several cells contained very few observations.
chi-square.zh: 由于若干单元格观测数极少，卡方统计量并不可靠。

chi-square.en: Expected counts must be checked before a chi-square approximation is trusted for sparse tables.
chi-square.zh: 在稀疏表中依赖卡方近似之前，必须先检验期望频数。

Monte Carlo.en: A Monte Carlo simulation was used to check whether the estimator was biased under a heavy-tailed distribution.
Monte Carlo.zh: 研究采用蒙特卡洛模拟检验估计量在重尾分布下是否有偏。

Monte Carlo.en: The Monte Carlo error decreased as the number of simulated replications grew.
Monte Carlo.zh: 随着模拟重复次数增加，蒙特卡洛误差随之减小。

Monte Carlo.en: Monte Carlo integration gave stable estimates of the expected value for the model.
Monte Carlo.zh: 蒙特卡洛积分为该模型的期望值给出了稳定的估计。

median.en: The median of the response times was lower than the mean because a few observations were extremely large.
median.zh: 响应时间的中位数低于均值，因为少数观测值极大。

median.en: Report the median together with the interquartile range when the distribution is skewed.
median.zh: 当分布偏斜时，应将中位数与四分位距一并报告。

median.en: A median regression was preferred to least squares because the residuals showed several outliers.
median.zh: 由于残差中存在若干离群值，研究采用中位数回归而非最小二乘。

quartile.en: The lower quartile of response times was under two seconds, indicating that at least a quarter of patients responded quickly.
quartile.zh: 反应时间的下四分位数低于两秒，表明至少四分之一的患者反应迅速。

quartile.en: Values above the upper quartile were inspected for recording errors before analysis continued.
quartile.zh: 分析继续之前，研究核查了高于上四分位数的数值以排除记录错误。

quartile.en: Each quartile of the sample received a different level of the intervention.
quartile.zh: 样本的每个四分位组接受了不同强度的干预。

percentile.en: The ninetieth percentile of waiting time was reported to describe the burden on the service.
percentile.zh: 报告等待时间的第九十百分位数，用以刻画服务负担。

percentile.en: Percentile curves by age group allow readers to locate an individual's position within the distribution.
percentile.zh: 按年龄组绘制的百分位曲线便于读者确定个体在分布中的位置。

percentile.en: A percentile bootstrap interval was preferred over the normal approximation for skewed outcomes.
percentile.zh: 对偏斜结局，研究偏好采用百分位自助法区间而非正态近似。

recall.en: Recall measures the proportion of actual positive cases that the classifier correctly identifies.
recall.zh: 召回率衡量全部实际阳性个案中被分类器正确识别者所占的比例。

recall.en: A low recall for the minority class led the team to reweight the training examples.
recall.zh: 少数类别的召回率偏低，促使团队对训练样本重新赋权。

recall.en: Precision and recall were reported together because either metric alone can be misleading.
recall.zh: 精确率与召回率一并报告，因为单看任一指标都可能产生误导。

confusion matrix.en: The confusion matrix for the diagnostic classifier was computed on an independent holdout sample.
confusion matrix.zh: 该诊断分类器的混淆矩阵是在独立留出样本上计算的。

confusion matrix.en: Rows of the confusion matrix represent actual classes while columns represent predicted labels.
confusion matrix.zh: 混淆矩阵的行表示实际类别，列表示预测标签。

confusion matrix.en: Reading a confusion matrix showed that most of the errors fell into one particular cell.
confusion matrix.zh: 阅读混淆矩阵可见，多数错误集中于某一个单元格。

ground truth.en: The annotation team compared its labels with the ground truth produced by expert pathologists.
ground truth.zh: 标注团队将其标签与专家病理医师给出的真值进行了比较。

ground truth.en: Any evaluation of a classifier against ground truth is affected by errors in that reference labeling.
ground truth.zh: 任何依据真值开展的分类器评估都会受到参考标注错误的影响。

ground truth.en: Establishing ground truth for the historical photographs required lengthy correspondence with archives.
ground truth.zh: 为这些历史照片确立真值，需要与档案馆长期通信。

overfitting.en: Repeated model selection on the same data risks overfitting to the quirks of that sample.
overfitting.zh: 在同一数据上反复进行模型选择，会有对样本特征过拟合的风险。

overfitting.en: Cross-validation was introduced to detect overfitting before the model was deployed.
overfitting.zh: 在模型部署之前引入交叉验证，用以检测过拟合。

overfitting.en: The gap between training and test performance suggested mild overfitting in the deeper architecture.
overfitting.zh: 训练表现与测试表现之间的差距提示较深的网络存在轻度过拟合。

regularization.en: Ridge regularization shrinks the coefficients and reduces the variance of the fitted model.
regularization.zh: 岭回归的正则化收缩系数并降低拟合模型的方差。

regularization.en: Regularization strength was chosen by nested cross-validation to avoid optimistic performance estimates.
regularization.zh: 正则化强度通过嵌套交叉验证选定，以避免乐观的性能估计。

regularization.en: The penalty term acts as regularization and discourages the model from fitting noise.
regularization.zh: 该惩罚项起到正则化作用，抑制模型去拟合噪声。

annotation.en: Two coders worked independently on the annotation of each transcript before comparing their decisions.
annotation.zh: 两名编码者先独立完成每份转录稿的标注，再比较各自的判断。

annotation.en: Annotation guidelines were revised after the pilot study exposed inconsistent labeling of emotion.
annotation.zh: 预研究暴露出情感标注不一致后，标注指南作了修订。

annotation.en: The annotation interface let reviewers attach free-text comments to each coded segment.
annotation.zh: 标注界面允许审阅者为每个已编码片段添加自由文本批注。

coding.en: Open coding was applied to the interview transcripts before any thematic categories were defined.
coding.zh: 在界定任何主题类别之前，先对访谈转录稿进行开放式编码。

coding.en: Axial coding then linked the initial codes into broader categories that shaped the final framework.
coding.zh: 主轴编码随后把初始编码联结为更宽泛的类别，从而塑造了最终框架。

coding.en: The coding process proceeded in two passes, and the team documented each decision in the audit trail.
coding.zh: 编码过程分两轮进行，团队将每一项决定都记录在审计轨迹之中。

transcription.en: Verbatim transcription of the interviews required additional training and considerable time.
transcription.zh: 访谈的逐字转录需要额外培训并耗费大量时间。

transcription.en: The transcription service converted recorded lectures into searchable text documents.
transcription.zh: 该转录服务将录制的讲座转换为可检索的文本文档。

transcription.en: Errors in the transcription were detected by comparing audio recordings with the written record.
transcription.zh: 通过将录音与文字记录对照，研究者发现了转录中的错误。

member checking.en: Member checking allowed participants to correct misinterpretations before the final analysis began.
member checking.zh: 成员核验使参与者在最终分析开始前得以纠正误解。

member checking.en: Some researchers treat member checking as a standard safeguard in qualitative studies.
member checking.zh: 一些研究者将成员核验视为定性研究中的标准保障措施。

member checking.en: Thematic codes were revised after member checking revealed that several themes were poorly understood.
member checking.zh: 成员核验显示若干主题理解不足，研究者据此修订了主题编码。

audit trail.en: The audit trail documented every change made to the dataset during the study.
audit trail.zh: 审计轨迹记录了研究期间对数据集所做的每一处改动。

audit trail.en: Regulators require a complete audit trail for all electronic health records.
audit trail.zh: 监管机构要求所有电子健康记录都具备完整的审计轨迹。

audit trail.en: Without an audit trail, it becomes difficult to establish who approved each protocol change.
audit trail.zh: 缺少审计轨迹时，便难以确定每一次方案变更由谁批准。

purposive.en: Purposive sampling was used to recruit participants with varied experience of the phenomenon.
purposive.zh: 研究采用目的性抽样招募具有不同现象经验的参与者。

purposive.en: Critics argue that purposive samples limit the statistical generalizability of the findings.
purposive.zh: 批评者指出目的性抽样限制了研究结论的统计可推广性。

purposive.en: A purposive design was chosen because the research question concerned depth rather than breadth.
purposive.zh: 由于研究问题关注深度而非广度，研究者选择了目的性设计。

ethnography.en: Ethnography was conducted over several months in two community settings.
ethnography.zh: 研究在两个社区场景中开展了为期数月的民族志调查。

ethnography.en: Her ethnography of clinical work reveals routines that formal models of care tend to overlook.
ethnography.zh: 她对临床工作的民族志研究揭示了正式照护模型往往忽略的惯例。

ethnography.en: Ethnography remains valuable when quantitative indicators fail to explain how work is actually organized.
ethnography.zh: 当定量指标无法解释工作实际如何组织时，民族志仍然具有价值。

latent.en: Latent variables cannot be observed directly and must be inferred from observable indicators.
latent.zh: 潜在变量无法直接观察，只能从可观测指标加以推断。

latent.en: The model assumes that some of the variation in test scores reflects a latent aptitude.
latent.zh: 该模型假定测验分数中的部分变异反映了某种潜在能力。

latent.en: Latent demand remained hidden until a sudden change in policy brought it into the open.
latent.zh: 潜在需求一直隐藏未露，直到一项政策突然改变才公开显现。

screening.en: Screening of large cohorts identified participants eligible for the intervention.
screening.zh: 对大型队列的筛查识别出了符合干预条件的参与者。

screening.en: The screening protocol excluded individuals with severe renal impairment.
screening.zh: 筛查方案排除了伴有严重肾功能损害的个体。

screening.en: Literature screening was performed independently by two reviewers to reduce selection bias.
screening.zh: 文献筛选由两名评审者独立完成，以减少选择偏倚。

surveillance.en: Surveillance data revealed a gradual decline in the incidence of the infection.
surveillance.zh: 监测数据显示该感染的发病率呈逐步下降趋势。

surveillance.en: Active surveillance captured more cases than passive reporting by clinicians.
surveillance.zh: 主动监测所捕获的病例多于临床医生被动报告的病例。

surveillance.en: The surveillance system collects information from laboratories and hospitals nationwide.
surveillance.zh: 该监测系统从全国范围的实验室和医院收集信息。

scoping review.en: A scoping review was conducted to map the range of approaches used in this field.
scoping review.zh: 本研究开展范围综述，以梳理该领域中所采用的各种方法。

scoping review.en: The scoping review identified gaps in how outcomes are reported across published studies.
scoping review.zh: 该范围综述发现了已发表研究中结果报告方式的空白。

scoping review.en: Unlike a systematic review, the scoping review did not assess the quality of included studies.
scoping review.zh: 与系统综述不同，范围综述未评估所纳入研究的质量。

peer review.en: Every submission underwent anonymous peer review by two independent reviewers.
peer review.zh: 每份投稿均由两名独立评审人进行匿名同行评审。

peer review.en: The journal strengthened its peer review procedures after several retractions.
peer review.zh: 在数起撤稿事件之后，该期刊加强了其同行评审程序。

peer review.en: Peer review comments helped the authors clarify the limits of their argument.
peer review.zh: 同行评审意见帮助作者澄清了论证的限度。

conflict of interest.en: Any conflict of interest must be disclosed in the acknowledgements of the article.
conflict of interest.zh: 任何利益冲突都必须在文章的致谢部分予以披露。

conflict of interest.en: Members with a conflict of interest were recused from the committee deliberations.
conflict of interest.zh: 存在利益冲突的成员被要求回避，不参与委员会审议。

conflict of interest.en: The editorial policy treats a declared conflict of interest as a matter for full disclosure.
conflict of interest.zh: 该编辑政策将已申报的利益冲突视为应当充分披露的事项。

open access.en: Depositing the accepted manuscript in a repository has made the article open access.
open access.zh: 将接受稿存入存储库使该文章得以开放获取。

open access.en: Open access publishing has widened the readership of the journal in low-income regions.
open access.zh: 开放获取出版扩大了该刊在低收入地区的读者群。

open access.en: Many funders now require that all resulting outputs are freely available through open access channels.
open access.zh: 许多资助机构现要求所有成果通过开放获取渠道免费提供。

grant.en: The project was supported by a national research grant awarded to the lead investigator.
grant.zh: 该项目获得授予首席研究者的国家科研基金资助。

grant.en: Writing a competitive grant proposal requires a clear budget and a realistic timeline.
grant.zh: 撰写有竞争力的基金申请书需要清晰的预算和切合实际的时间安排。

grant.en: Her grant application was reviewed by an international panel of external experts.
grant.zh: 她的基金申请由国际专家组成的外部评审组评审。

platform.en: The platform provides researchers with a shared environment for analyzing large datasets.
platform.zh: 该平台为研究者提供了一个分析大型数据集的共享环境。

platform.en: Institutional repositories can be integrated with the platform through standard interfaces.
platform.zh: 机构存储库可通过标准接口与该平台集成。

platform.en: Governments increasingly rely on digital platforms to deliver public services online.
platform.zh: 政府越来越依赖数字平台在线提供公共服务。

architecture.en: The architecture of the system separates data storage from the services built on top of it.
architecture.zh: 该系统的体系结构将数据存储与其上构建的服务相分离。

architecture.en: A modular architecture allows individual components to be replaced without redesigning the whole.
architecture.zh: 模块化的体系结构使单个组件可以在不重新设计整体的情况下被替换。

architecture.en: The proposed architecture addresses the scalability and reliability requirements set by the funder.
architecture.zh: 所提出的体系结构回应了资助方提出的可扩展性与可靠性要求。

repository.en: An institutional repository preserves the digital record of research output for the long term.
repository.zh: 机构存储库长期保存研究产出的数字记录。

repository.en: The dataset was uploaded to the repository with detailed documentation.
repository.zh: 该数据集连同详细文档被上传至存储库。

repository.en: Repository policies usually require authors to deposit accepted manuscripts in a timely manner.
repository.zh: 存储库政策通常要求作者及时提交接受稿。

interoperability.en: Interoperability between the two systems depends on a shared vocabulary and consistent formats.
interoperability.zh: 两个系统之间的互操作性取决于共享的词汇表和一致的格式。

interoperability.en: Limited interoperability remains an obstacle to combining registries from different countries.
interoperability.zh: 互操作性不足仍是整合不同国家登记系统的障碍。

interoperability.en: The project aims to improve interoperability for health records across regional providers.
interoperability.zh: 该项目旨在改善各地区医疗服务提供者之间健康记录数据的互操作性。

metadata.en: Metadata describing each file allows the archive to be searched by date and author.
metadata.zh: 描述每个文件的元数据使档案能够按日期和作者检索。

metadata.en: The metadata schema was extended to record the provenance of derived datasets.
metadata.zh: 该元数据模式被扩展以记录衍生数据集的来源。

metadata.en: Poor metadata practice reduces the reuse value of otherwise rich research data.
metadata.zh: 元数据管理不力会降低内容丰富的研究数据的复用价值。

ontology.en: The ontology provides a formal representation of the concepts used in the domain.
ontology.zh: 该本体提供了该领域中所用概念的形式化表示。

ontology.en: Mapping the records onto a shared ontology improved consistency across the databases.
ontology.zh: 将这些记录映射到共享本体提升了各数据库之间的一致性。

ontology.en: Ontology development requires agreement among experts on the meaning of key terms.
ontology.zh: 本体开发需要专家们就关键术语的含义达成一致。

privacy.en: Privacy protection requires that personal data be collected only for stated purposes.
privacy.zh: 隐私保护要求个人数据仅为既定目的而收集。

privacy.en: The study obtained informed consent after explaining how participant privacy would be maintained.
privacy.zh: 在说明如何维护参与者隐私之后，研究取得了知情同意。

privacy.en: Regulators have tightened privacy rules for organizations that handle health information.
privacy.zh: 监管机构已收紧处理健康信息的组织所适用的隐私规则。

cybersecurity.en: Cybersecurity training is now a routine requirement in health research institutions.
cybersecurity.zh: 网络安全培训如今是卫生研究机构的常规要求。

cybersecurity.en: A cybersecurity incident in the registry exposed an unpatched weakness in the system.
cybersecurity.zh: 登记系统中的一次网络安全事件暴露了系统中未经修补的弱点。

cybersecurity.en: The committee reviews cybersecurity policies annually to keep controls aligned with current threats.
cybersecurity.zh: 该委员会每年审查网络安全政策，使控制措施与当前威胁保持一致。

intellectual property.en: The agreement clarifies who holds intellectual property rights in jointly produced material.
intellectual property.zh: 该协议明确了共同产出成果的知识产权归属。

intellectual property.en: Universities often retain intellectual property in the software developed within funded projects.
intellectual property.zh: 各大学通常保留在受资助项目中开发的软件的知识产权。

intellectual property.en: A formal policy reduces the risk of disputes over intellectual property between collaborators.
intellectual property.zh: 正式的政策降低了合作者之间就知识产权发生争议的风险。

copyright.en: The copyright notice appears at the foot of every page of the manuscript.
copyright.zh: 版权声明出现在手稿的每一页页脚。

copyright.en: Researchers must respect copyright when reproducing figures from published articles.
copyright.zh: 研究者在复制已发表文章中的图件时必须遵守版权规定。

copyright.en: Copyright law protects the original author against unauthorized use of the text.
copyright.zh: 版权法保护原作者免受文本被未经授权使用的侵害。

open science.en: Open science encourages researchers to share data and code as early as possible.
open science.zh: 开放科学鼓励研究者尽早共享数据与代码。

open science.en: The journal promotes open science by publishing peer review reports alongside each article.
open science.zh: 该期刊通过在每篇文章旁附上同行评审报告来推动开放科学。

open science.en: Open science has changed how laboratories collaborate across institutional borders.
open science.zh: 开放科学改变了各实验室跨越机构边界开展合作的方式。

open data.en: Governments release open data so that citizens can scrutinize how public money is spent.
open data.zh: 政府发布开放数据，以便公民监督公共资金的使用。

open data.en: The municipality built a portal where open data are downloaded in standard formats.
open data.zh: 该市府建立了一个门户网站，开放数据可在其中以标准格式下载。

open data.en: Researchers combined open data from several agencies to model regional air quality.
open data.zh: 研究者合并了多个机构的开放数据以对区域空气质量建模。

climate change.en: Climate change alters rainfall patterns and puts pressure on regional food systems.
climate change.zh: 气候变化改变降水模式，并给区域食物系统带来压力。

climate change.en: The report links climate change to the spread of vector-borne diseases.
climate change.zh: 该报告把气候变化与媒介传播疾病的扩散联系起来。

climate change.en: Emissions reductions are now central to national climate change policy.
climate change.zh: 减排已成为各国气候变化政策的核心。

land use.en: Land use change is the largest driver of biodiversity loss in the tropics.
land use.zh: 土地利用变化是热带地区生物多样性丧失的最大驱动因素。

land use.en: Remote sensing images allow planners to monitor land use across the whole province.
land use.zh: 遥感影像使规划者能够监测全省范围内的土地利用情况。

land use.en: Zoning rules restrict land use and development near the wetland.
land use.zh: 分区规定限制湿地附近的土地利用与开发。

public health.en: Public health authorities issued guidance on food safety during the outbreak.
public health.zh: 公共卫生主管部门在疫情暴发期间发布了食品安全指南。

public health.en: Clean water supply remains a cornerstone of public health in many regions.
public health.zh: 清洁供水仍是许多地区公共卫生的基石。

public health.en: The journal publishes evidence that can be applied directly in public health practice.
public health.zh: 该期刊发表可直接应用于公共卫生实践的证据。

health inequality.en: Health inequality between income groups widened over the study period.
health inequality.zh: 研究期间不同收入组之间的健康不平等有所扩大。

health inequality.en: Housing conditions contribute substantially to health inequality across neighborhoods.
health inequality.zh: 住房条件对不同社区之间的健康不平等有显著影响。

health inequality.en: The study quantifies how health inequality varies by education level.
health inequality.zh: 该研究量化了健康不平等如何随教育程度而变化。

life expectancy.en: Life expectancy at birth rose steadily across the twentieth century.
life expectancy.zh: 出生时的预期寿命在二十世纪稳步上升。

life expectancy.en: Regional disparities in life expectancy persist despite rising average incomes.
life expectancy.zh: 尽管平均收入上升，区域间的预期寿命差距依然存在。

life expectancy.en: Preventive care is expected to improve life expectancy in later decades.
life expectancy.zh: 预防性医疗有望在此后数十年提高预期寿命。

mental health.en: Mental health services were expanded to reduce waiting times for assessment.
mental health.zh: 心理健康服务得到扩充，以缩短评估的等待时间。

mental health.en: The survey links financial insecurity to poor mental health among younger workers.
mental health.zh: 该调查把经济不安全感与年轻劳动者的心理健康不佳联系起来。

mental health.en: Universities are expected to embed mental health support within ordinary academic routines.
mental health.zh: 高校应在日常教学安排中融入心理健康支持。

risk factor.en: Smoking is a major risk factor for cardiovascular disease in this population.
risk factor.zh: 吸烟是该人群心血管疾病的主要风险因素。

risk factor.en: The authors adjusted for known risk factors when estimating the effect.
risk factor.zh: 作者在估计效应时对已知风险因素进行了校正。

risk factor.en: Low birth weight was identified as an independent risk factor for later disability.
risk factor.zh: 低出生体重被认定为日后残疾的独立风险因素。

randomized controlled trial.en: A randomized controlled trial provides stronger evidence than an observational design.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 随机对照试验提供的证据强于观察性设计。

randomized controlled trial.en: Participants in the randomized controlled trial were randomly allocated to two groups.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 该随机对照试验的参与者被随机分配到两组。

randomized controlled trial.en: This conclusion rests on a single randomized controlled trial in a narrow population.
randomized controlled trial.zh: 该结论仅依赖一项研究对象范围较窄的随机对照试验。

numeracy.en: Numeracy skills shape how well students interpret statistical information.
numeracy.zh: 计算能力影响学生解读统计信息的能力。

numeracy.en: The intervention tested whether explicit teaching improves numeracy among adolescents.
numeracy.zh: 该干预措施检验了显式教学能否提升青少年的计算能力。

numeracy.en: Financial numeracy varies widely across adult populations in the survey.
numeracy.zh: 该调查中成年群体的金融数理素养差异很大。

instruction.en: Differentiated instruction improved outcomes for mixed-ability classes.
instruction.zh: 差异化教学改善了混合能力班级的学习效果。

instruction.en: Instructional time was limited by the availability of laboratory equipment.
instruction.zh: 实验设备的可用性限制了教学时间。

instruction.en: Teachers received training in how to structure instruction for large cohorts.
instruction.zh: 教师接受了如何为大型队列安排教学的培训。

scholarship.en: Her scholarship on early modern trade networks appeared in a leading journal.
scholarship.zh: 她关于近代早期贸易网络的研究发表于一份顶尖期刊。

scholarship.en: The book gathers scholarship from several disciplines on urban history.
scholarship.zh: 该书汇集了多个学科关于城市史的学术研究成果。

scholarship.en: That debate reshaped subsequent scholarship on colonial economies.
scholarship.zh: 那场辩论重塑了此后关于殖民地经济学的学术研究。

enrollment.en: Enrollment in the trial reached its target within six months.
enrollment.zh: 该试验的入组在六个月内达到了目标。

enrollment.en: Low enrollment rates limit the statistical power of the cohort study.
enrollment.zh: 入组率低限制了队列研究的统计效能。

enrollment.en: Enrollment at the college rose after the new scholarship program was introduced.
enrollment.zh: 新奖学金项目推出后，该学院的注册入学人数增加了。

engagement.en: Student engagement declined as class sizes increased.
engagement.zh: 随着班级规模扩大，学生参与度下降。

engagement.en: The review examines public engagement with the findings of the trial.
engagement.zh: 该综述考察了公众对试验结果的参与情况。

engagement.en: Sustained engagement from community partners shaped the design of the program.
engagement.zh: 社区伙伴的持续投入塑造了该项目的设计。

behavior.en: Sleep behavior was recorded by wearable devices over a two-week period.
behavior.zh: 睡眠行为通过可穿戴设备连续记录了两周。

behavior.en: Nudging can shift consumer behavior without any change in incentives.
behavior.zh: 助推手段可以在不改变激励的情况下改变消费者行为。

behavior.en: The intervention aimed to modify risky behavior among young drivers.
behavior.zh: 该干预措施旨在改变年轻驾驶员的高风险行为。

taxation.en: Progressive taxation reduces the after-tax income gap between households.
taxation.zh: 累进税制缩小了家庭之间的税后收入差距。

taxation.en: Taxation of carbon emissions shifted production toward cleaner technologies.
taxation.zh: 对碳排放征税促使生产转向更清洁的技术。

taxation.en: The model compares the revenue raised under alternative taxation schemes.
taxation.zh: 该模型比较了不同税收方案带来的财政收入。

cost-effectiveness.en: Cost-effectiveness analysis guided the decision to fund the program.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 成本效果分析为是否资助该项目提供了依据。

cost-effectiveness.en: The intervention was rejected because its cost-effectiveness was poor.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 该干预措施因成本效果不佳而被否决。

cost-effectiveness.en: A cost-effectiveness ratio alone cannot settle the ranking of interventions.
cost-effectiveness.zh: 仅凭成本效果比无法确定各干预措施的排序。

disincentive.en: High transaction costs act as a disincentive for small firms to invest.
disincentive.zh: 高额交易成本对小企业投资构成抑制因素。

disincentive.en: Removing the tax penalty eliminates the main disincentive to reporting errors.
disincentive.zh: 取消税务处罚消除了报告错误这一行为的主要抑制因素。

disincentive.en: The subsidy was reduced because it functioned as a disincentive to competition.
disincentive.zh: 该补贴被削减，因为它对竞争构成了抑制作用。

audit.en: An independent audit confirmed that the reported figures matched the source records.
audit.zh: 一项独立审计确认所报数据与源记录相符。

audit.en: The data audit revealed inconsistencies between two reporting systems.
audit.zh: 数据核查暴露出两个报告系统之间的不一致。

audit.en: A routine audit of laboratory procedures is carried out every year.
audit.zh: 实验室流程的例行审计每年进行一次。

supply chain.en: Disruptions in the supply chain delayed the delivery of raw materials.
supply chain.zh: 供应链中断延误了原材料的交付。

supply chain.en: The firm mapped its supply chain to identify single points of failure.
supply chain.zh: 该公司绘制了供应链图谱以识别单点故障。

supply chain.en: Rising energy prices put pressure on the whole supply chain.
supply chain.zh: 能源价格上涨给整个供应链带来压力。

entrepreneurship.en: Universities across the region have begun to teach entrepreneurship as a distinct field of study.
entrepreneurship.zh: 本地区的多所高校已开始把创业学作为一门独立的学科来教授。

entrepreneurship.en: The paper examines how local culture shapes entrepreneurship among first-time founders.
entrepreneurship.zh: 该论文考察当地文化如何影响初次创业者的创业活动。

entrepreneurship.en: Entrepreneurship requires tolerance for ambiguity, but it also demands careful planning.
entrepreneurship.zh: 创业既需要容忍不确定性，也需要周密规划。

unemployment.en: The study examines the relationship between unemployment and mental health across regions.
unemployment.zh: 该研究考察了不同地区失业与心理健康之间的关系。

unemployment.en: Prolonged unemployment may weaken the skills and social ties of affected workers.
unemployment.zh: 长期失业可能削弱受影响劳动者的技能与社会联系。

unemployment.en: Local governments expanded training programs to reduce long-term unemployment among young adults.
unemployment.zh: 地方政府扩大了培训项目，以减少年轻成年人中的长期失业。

workforce.en: The firm plans to retrain much of its workforce for roles in data analysis.
workforce.zh: 该公司计划对大部分员工进行再培训，使其胜任数据分析岗位。

workforce.en: A shortage of technical skills constrains the growth of the national workforce.
workforce.zh: 技术人才短缺制约着全国劳动力的增长。

workforce.en: The workforce participated in a company-wide training program on workplace safety.
workforce.zh: 全体员工参加了公司范围内的工作场所安全培训项目。

inequality.en: Income inequality remains a central concern for economic policy across many societies.
inequality.zh: 收入不平等仍然是许多社会中经济政策的核心关切。

inequality.en: The report argues that inequality in educational access reproduces wider social disadvantages.
inequality.zh: 该报告认为教育机会的不平等会复制更广泛的社会劣势。

inequality.en: Researchers used a decomposition method to measure inequality between occupational groups.
inequality.zh: 研究者采用分解方法衡量不同职业群体之间的不平等。

artificial intelligence.en: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used to support decisions in clinical diagnosis.
artificial intelligence.zh: 人工智能正日益被用于辅助临床诊断决策。

artificial intelligence.en: The chapter discusses how artificial intelligence may reshape labor markets and required skills.
artificial intelligence.zh: 本章讨论人工智能可能如何重塑劳动力市场及所需的技能。

artificial intelligence.en: Oversight of artificial intelligence systems remains an unsettled question among regulators.
artificial intelligence.zh: 对人工智能系统的监督仍然是监管者面临的一个悬而未决的问题。

machine learning.en: Machine learning models can detect patterns that are difficult to observe by hand.
machine learning.zh: 机器学习模型能够发现难以凭人工观察的模式。

machine learning.en: The team applied machine learning to predict demand from historical sales records.
machine learning.zh: 该团队运用机器学习依据历史销售记录预测需求。

machine learning.en: Concerns about transparency limit the use of machine learning in high-stakes decisions.
machine learning.zh: 对透明度的担忧限制了机器学习在高风险决策中的应用。

fairness.en: The authors examine fairness in a lending model by comparing outcomes across applicant groups.
fairness.zh: 作者通过比较不同申请群体的结果，考察贷款模型中的公平性。

fairness.en: Fairness cannot be achieved by simply discarding variables from the training data.
fairness.zh: 仅从训练数据中删除若干变量并不能实现公平性。

fairness.en: Regulators now ask vendors to document how fairness was measured in deployed systems.
fairness.zh: 监管机构如今要求供应商说明在已部署系统中如何度量公平性。

framing.en: Media framing of the scandal shaped public opinion long before the trial began.
framing.zh: 媒体对丑闻的框定在审判开始之前很久就塑造了公众舆论。

framing.en: The paper analyzes framing strategies in newspaper coverage of immigration policy.
framing.zh: 该论文分析报纸关于移民政策报道中的框架化策略。

framing.en: Framing the problem as a technical failure changed how the public understood the risk.
framing.zh: 把该问题框定为技术失效，改变了公众对风险的理解方式。

misinformation.en: Social media platforms have invested in systems that limit the spread of misinformation.
misinformation.zh: 社交媒体平台已投入资源建设限制错误信息传播的系统。

misinformation.en: The study compares reactions to misinformation before and after verification.
misinformation.zh: 该研究比较了错误信息在核验之前与核验之后引发的反应。

misinformation.en: Even a short correction rarely removes the effect of earlier misinformation on public opinion.
misinformation.zh: 即便是简短的更正，也很少能消除先前错误信息对公众舆论的影响。

disinformation.en: Because disinformation is deliberate, its authors are difficult to identify and prosecute.
disinformation.zh: 由于虚假信息是蓄意制造的，其制造者很难被识别和起诉。

disinformation.en: The chapter distinguishes disinformation from misinformation by the intent of its producers.
disinformation.zh: 本章依据生产者的意图区分虚假信息与错误信息。

disinformation.en: Coordinated disinformation campaigns often exploit genuine footage to create false narratives.
disinformation.zh: 协同发起的虚假信息攻势往往利用真实影像来制造虚假叙事。

statistical significance.en: A result may reach statistical significance and still have little practical importance.
statistical significance.zh: 一项结果可能达到统计显著性，却几乎没有实际重要性。

statistical significance.en: The authors report statistical significance for the interaction between the two factors.
statistical significance.zh: 作者报告了两个因子交互作用的统计显著性。

statistical significance.en: Statistical significance alone does not justify accepting a hypothesis in the field.
statistical significance.zh: 仅凭统计显著性并不足以在该领域接受某一假设。

systematic review.en: A systematic review can provide a more reliable summary of the available evidence.
systematic review.zh: 系统综述能够对现有证据给出更可靠的概括。

systematic review.en: The protocol for this systematic review was registered before the search began.
systematic review.zh: 该系统综述的研究方案在检索开始之前已予注册。

systematic review.en: Compared with a narrative review, a systematic review follows a transparent and reproducible procedure.
systematic review.zh: 与叙述性综述相比，系统综述遵循透明且可复现的程序。

mixed methods.en: A mixed methods design combines quantitative measures with qualitative interviews.
mixed methods.zh: 混合方法设计将定量测量与定性访谈结合起来。

mixed methods.en: The authors justify their mixed methods approach by explaining how the two strands answer different questions.
mixed methods.zh: 作者说明了采用混合方法的理由，指出两条路径分别回答不同的问题。

mixed methods.en: Sequential mixed methods studies often use one strand of evidence to refine the other.
mixed methods.zh: 序贯式混合方法研究通常用一条证据路径来细化另一条。

gender.en: Gender was recorded as a self-reported category in the questionnaire.
gender.zh: 问卷把性别作为自我报告的类别加以记录。

gender.en: The analysis examines whether gender interacts with age in shaping participation rates.
gender.zh: 分析考察性别是否与年龄交互作用并影响参与率。

gender.en: Researchers must not assume that gender predicts outcomes without empirical support.
gender.zh: 研究者不得在没有实证支持的情况下假定性别可以预测结果。

ethnicity.en: Ethnicity was self-identified by participants in the survey form.
ethnicity.zh: 族裔由填写问卷的参与者自行认定。

ethnicity.en: The study compares attainment across ethnicity groups while controlling for parental education.
ethnicity.zh: 该研究在控制父母教育程度的前提下比较不同族裔群体的成就水平。

ethnicity.en: Ethnicity categories overlap with but are not identical to race in national statistics.
ethnicity.zh: 在全国统计中，族裔类别与种族有所重叠，但二者并不完全相同。
